reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Buser is a great guy and absolutely loves economics, however I would recommend not taking him if possible. Must go to class to answer TopHat questions (which you must answer correct to get participation, kind of absurd). Online homework is useless and no help in preparing for exams... Just find another professor and save yourself
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Econ 2001 is one of the easiest classes at OSU, and honestly most of the people complaining on here have only themselves to blame, because there's plenty of videos, lectures, and resources that help enforce the relatively easy material. The class is kinda boring, and Buser is an ok professor. Lectures are mandatory, but study and you'll be fine.

I hate this guy. Exams make up the majority of your grade, and they're very difficult. I have 5 other friends in my class and we all have C's. His lectures are incredibly boring, and for some reason instead of using a microphone he just yells his lectures at the top of his lungs so everyone can hear him. 2/10 would not take again
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Least favorite professor I've had at OSU. Lectures are boring. Tophat is part of your grade so if you don't go to class, your grade will drop. He purposely makes the midterms and final very hard because he always wants the class average to be a 75. Didn't learn anything from this class, I learned everything off youtube. Lots of homework.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Professor Buser is honestly one of the worst professors I have EVER had. Be prepared to teach yourself literally everything then have the hardest exams. He is not helpful at all when you ask questions or go to office hours. Good luck if you take his course.
I'm glad I got him as my econ professor. Econ is not a fairly interesting subject if you don't love it but he does his best to make you enjoy it. VERY LOUD and ENERGETIC
Read the book, do the assignments, and keep up on TopHat. Not difficult to get an A despite his goal to have a 75% average.

Everyday is a great day for economics thanks to Jeffrey Buser. Just do the online homework on time. Take notes from the videos rather than lecture. And get the tophat questions right. You'll get an A- or higher if you do that. Key to the midterms is the practice tests, the quizzes.

Textbook is online and is taught through videos. Material is taught FOUR times so you really understand, but can be annoying. Likes to entertain during lecture. Tests can be difficult, but if you do the practice tests you should be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Jeff is a good lecturer. He's very passionate about Econ and wants to teach as much info as possible. He doesn't necessarily want to watch you fail his class, but he definitely makes you work for it. He expects a class average of 75% on all exams and he will adjust the difficulty of the next one based on that. Offers decent amount of extra credit.

Dr. Buser assigns a bunch of homework due before lecture that teaches you everything you need to know, but you have to go to lecture to do the top hat quizzes that are 10% of your grade. Microeconomics is not a very complicated topic so he basically just reads off the slides.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Every lecture is legendary
No readings for class. Instead videos and learning modules were assigned for credit. Homework was simple and exams were manageable. Quizzes for recitation were challenging but given in groups.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Reasonable choice for microeconomics. I had him in Independence Hall, and he was very laid back as he hammered through the slides. He is engaging, but with such a big lecture hall, he can't control the class. Many people don't pay attention, as the topics covered were already in the homework. Everyone just focuses on the top hat. Study for tests.

Go to class even though the lectures aren't very helpful because the participation on tophat is a real grade booster. Read the book and try to complete the online hw not just by guessing. The recitation is not helpful either.

Class is basically an online class but you still have to go to lectures because he gives quizzes along with the lectures. The class isn't that difficult but the homework takes a while. Do the practice tests before the midterms and final.

Professor Buser is a good lecturer, and does care about students learning the information, but his tests are difficult. He shoots for an average of a 75 on the exams, and will adjust the level of difficulty until that range is met. However, if you do well on the rest of the assignments you can still get an A/A- with extra credit opportunities.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Overall he is very funny, but he simply wants all his averages on quizzes, midterms, and final to be a C minus at best. There are always several questions on his midterms and final that never have any correlation to what we went over in class.

The standards are clear. Gives 5% bonus but will not curve exams. There are other Macro professors who are easier so no reason to take Buser. He expects the class average to be around a C and is willing to curve down exams. Although it is boring, make sure to go to lecture because TopHat is worth 5% of your grade
Biggest regret was taking macro economics with this guy, he makes it way harder than it needs to be. Biggest advice, is take this class with anyone but him!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Large lectures, uses tophat for pop quizzes and attendance. Do the sapling assignments and read the textbook and lecture won't really matter at all. Seems like a nice enough guy, tests are manageable. No curves but extra credit is available.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: He is terrible when it comes to lectures, however, it is mandatory to attend lectures because of Tophat. His midterms are tough and he has a habit of yelling while reading off slides. My advice is not to take this class under him.

Should only be taken by students who need it for major requirements or a GE. If economics is not something you are interested in it will be boring. Lectures were mandatory( tophat) but he read off of slides so all my studying was done outside class. Tests are hard. Be prepared to be in an 800 person lecture with many distractions. TA not v helpful

Your experience in this class is almost entirely dependant on your TA. Mine was terrible in recitations so I really struggled in this class. Mostly you have to self-teach based on your online hw, so if Econ isn't a strength, avoid this class

Jeffrey Buser is a nice guy and everything but his lecturing SUCKS. He just reads off slides the whole time and doesn't engage in real problemsolving. Sometimes his lectures are helpful but he only scratches the surface when it comes to problems. He hardly never goes into detail. And because of this, this makes the midterms really hard. Bad teacher
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: A caring professor , but he cannot handle a big class. He obviously is experienced, but when there is that much of students, it's hard to control them. The professor goes fast to finish material in 55 mins, and he doesn't guarantee if you understand or not. Participation and correctness of answers through tophat is mandatory. Challenging exams!

The textbook isn't exactly a book but a collection of videos to watch instead and answer a simple question for each but you can access the textbook as well. Homework load is moderate, depends on number of videos for each week. Need a phone, laptop or ipad to use tophat every time for attendance and questions and moblab occasionally.
I hated Econ, so I am probably not the best candidate for reviewing this class. But he made a 800 person lecture hall feel smaller. I sucked at the class, but that was on me.

He's that one instructor that makes lecture mandatory because of TopHat, but reads right off the slides so lecture is essentially useless but you are required to go. TA's weren't helpful. Wouldn't recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Lectures were useless as most of the learning takes place outside of class but I was forced to go because of the tophat questions. The lectures are just him reading off the slides and making jokes. The exams are hard and you need to read the textbook. I emailed him three times throughout the semester and he did not respond until grades were final.

Great professor with an interesting sense of humor. To be successful: Watch the videos. Read the corresponding section in the book. Do homework/LS. Review all quizzes for exams and the study guides given by TAs. Do not miss class; attendance is part of your grade. Two generous extra credit assignments that are quite easy so do them!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Professor Buser is a great and explains things so well. I am taking his Macro class next semester because I learned so much. I recommend reading the textbook as you do the homework before lecture, that's what worked best for me. The test are very fair and manageable. As long as you study a few days in advance you should do well. Extra credit helps!

Great guy, who is really passionate about economics. His tests are quite difficult, but doable at the same time. If you're ever struggling, go to his office hours. He will sit down and explain whatever you are not understanding. Overall, good professor
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Buser's class isn't too hard. I am a business minor and suck at anything not health related, but he made this class fun. Go to class, attendance and top hat are 5% of final grade. Tests aren't that difficult if you study.

The guy's a hoot in lectures. It's true that this class requires a fair bit of work, but let's be honest, you need to put in the work to understand microeconomics (hardest economics topic) Tests aren't bad so long as you study adequately (for me, 38/40 on first, 37.95/40 on the second), and do go to lecture, as TopHat is 5% of your final grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: This class requires a lot of outside work, so be ready for that. Things are due on a topic before he lectures on it, followed by a homework assignment. Buser is very intelligent & tries to make his lectures entertaining. His exams are really hard and there is no curve. Weekly quizzes are pretty hard too but you do get a partner.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Highly recommended. Test are fair. Give practice questions, and the test questions are similar: 2 midterm each consist of 40 questions. final consists of 80 question . Easy extra credit (do another one week HW). HW takes 30 min every week. Rec is graded by group of 3-4, so make sure have a good teammate Go to office hour if you have any question.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Sounds like Ray Ramano. Lectures are hit or miss for entertainment. Go to recitation and study and you should be fine.

Professor Buser is one of my favorite Econ professors. I took ECON 4001 and 4002 with him. Read the book, go to class and you will be fine. Exam are MC. Every time I thought I did horrible but turned out to be fine. Recommended.

A really good professor. You can tell he's extremely knowledgeable of the subject and somewhat "dumbs it down" for you during lecture which is nice. Tons of material but he makes it work well. I took notes on my laptop and copied the power points and then made flash cards of important things before the exams. HARD exams. Go thru the powerpoints.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Buser wasnt too bad. Go to lectures but only for TopHat quizzes. I learned everything from the book. Never spoke to the guy, so I cant speak on how helpful he is outside of lectures, but lectures was just slide reading.
The course content is all online and easy to consume. Buser is an effective teacher and uses Tophat in class to keep students engaged
Very enthusiastic. Textbook helps a lot. TopHat grade counts for a lot in the end. Multiple choice exams. Weekly group recitation quizzes. Not an easy course, but not too much work.

Professor Buser was one of my favorite professors this past semester. It is very difficult to make econ exciting, but if there's one person who can do it, it's Professor Buser. He's very funny (unexpectedly sometimes), witty, and really cares about his students. Exams are very tough but up to 6 points of EC available. Definitely take him for econ!

So Jeff is a really great guy. You have to attend lecture to complete the Tophat quizzes to learn the material and if you don't it will severely affect your grade. He's a great guy, even tho he teaches huge classes, he's great for seeking help outside of class. He's very knowledgeable and I would definitely take from him again, just a smaller class
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: This class was extremely difficult. I am a first-year who took this class first semester. Paying attention in lecture is necessary to do well in the class and on Tophat quizzes (which are taken for a grade. Exams were extremely difficult with no curve. Read the textbook!!!!!
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--TEST HEAVY--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: I actually really enjoyed this prof. My piece of advice is to sit in the front and pay attention in lecture. In a class of 700 it can get hard to hear in the very back. Also, he helps you out in the front of the class during TopHat quizzes. There is a lot of homework but it's not hard and as long as you read and try.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Caring

reviews.comment: Generally an enjoyable professor to have. He made sure to emphasize important aspects about the content and the course set up and he was well understood in such a large lecture hall. The course gives you plenty of opportunities to work on your grade but the exams are tough and could bring it down a bit if you don't study on your own time.

The way the grades are set up are really unforgiving and the tests are extremely hard. I feel like this class would've been easier if I had a good TA but my TA wasn't helpful in reviewing the material. This class requires lots of outside work and studying.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: He had us do TopHat quizzes all class so you had to go and pay attention the whole time. The homework was very long and the quizzes and exams were challenging. However, he is a pretty good teacher and is great at explaining topics. He wants an avg of 75% on exams but gives 5-6% extra credit which helps. Would probably take again
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Lots of calculus for a non-calc based econ class. At least two online HWs a week and a quiz every week and a half.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Gives good lectures and does a good job of connecting topics (better than the textbook videos), make sure you keep up with the videos and reading. The tests are pretty hard though, a lot of work and studying outside of class.

hard to pay attention in class, seems to drag on. Tests are difficult and there is a great deal of homework (most of which does nothing for your grade). I attended every lecture, studied, and still struggled to skate buy with 75% on each exam.

'Ol Jeff Buser stands up in front of the lecture hall, reading slides off to the students. That's about all he does. He will then give you Tophat quizzes on material that he is about to "teach" you, and yes, that is for a grade. So, if you want to do well, read the chapter and understand every single detail before showing up to lecture.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Prepare for tons of online quizes/video study, tophat pop-out questions(10% calculated in final grades), recitation quizes. Also you will have difficult exam questions. I have a good grade so far, but it costs me a bunch of time and energy, I don't think it worth that much.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: He is a very enthusiastic professor, and you can tell he really wants all of his students to understand the material. The review sessions before the exams are useless, though. He usually goes over 3 questions. You need to pay for the textbook for the online code for the homework.

Prof. Buser is a great guy and one of the best professors at explaining materials. It has been 3 years since I took Principles and high school so I was a bit worried about being able to pick up the information, but Busser made it very easy for me. Sometimes he misspeaks during lecture which can be confusing but he usually corrects himself.

Jeffery Buser is the best economics professor in Ohio, ney, the nation. Jeffery delivers his lectures with the confidence and wit that only teachers like Confucius could. If I had to choose between saving Buser or my first born, well, a lot of people would question my morality. Only formula you will need: BuserGOAT. He will prolly solve cancer.

He is a nice, interesting, humorous, and animated guy. That being said, he only teaches the basics and gives impossibly hard tests with no curves. Last midterm, the class average was a 73% with the highest grade being a 79%--still no curve. Good professor, but makes the class hard to succeed in.

Mr Jeffrey Buser is very knowledgeable, very experienced instructor, he uses real world examples. uses the board extensively to draw graphs to illustrate the points. he cares about student and encourages them . he  gives extra credits, he also gives test study guides that really helps. i recommend taking him 100%

I took ol Jeffrey's class for micro and am taking macro with him next semester. He really loves economics and you can tell that he is passionate about teaching. Sometimes its hard to listen to him after he's been screaming for thirty minutes straight, but the exams are VERY fair and he gives so much extra credit at the end. I recommend this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Oh Jeff, I loved him as a person but I would generally not listen to a word he said in lecture, but definitely go because of tons of extra credit you get. I took him for micro and macro, the textbook for macro made the class 100% easier, way easier to comprehend. Do ALL of the extra credit, its easy and gives a huge grade bump. Beware 600+ lecture.

Jeffrey is such an amazing professor. He really cares about the material and makes lecture really interesting. He makes the material as simple as possible. The exams aren't too difficult if you know what you're doing.

He is really good at teaching because he is funny and it keeps you paying attention. The class structure was a little strict but the online practice work didnt matter much for the grade. Tests were challenging. Non mandatory attendance. Extra credit for attendance. Good voice projection. He was helpful and nice in an email response.

If you go to class and just copy the slides, you shouldn't have a problem on the exams. He gives small assignments every week that are easy and help you prepare for the exam. You get to take it a few times until you get it right.

The exams can be kinda difficult, but his lectures are pretty interesting and he seems to care even in a hall of 500+ students. There is a bunch of extra credit opportunities so if you take advantage of those and study a reasonable amount, the class is pretty easy in my opinion. Got an A- without putting in too much time.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Buser is very knowledgeable but can be quite dry at times. Workload is pretty heavy but all the assignments are online and you can do them ahead of time. Exams are challenging. Show up to class for a ton of extra credit for showing up to class.

Class was really interesting but  super hard.  A lot of useful information learned about things that apply to everyday life.  Prof Buser is very passionate about the subject. If you don't attend class you may not pass.  The quizzes and tests are soooo hard!  Do the extra credit. Lots of homework but NO papers to write so yay for that!

Lectures are extremely dry and seem to be never ending.  The two midterms and final are difficult, even after studying and never missing class.  Also a few hours of online homework each week.  I would recommend taking with someone else.

His lectures are pretty boring and not very helpful. The exams were significantly easier than the homework and quizzes. The homework and quizzes were difficult but they are on MyEconLab and you just keep redoing them until you get them right. Take advantage of the many extra credit opportunities.

A genuinely knowledgeable lecturer who is well-versed in the material and provides interesting classes. The course work is not terribly difficult and there are many extra credit opportunities. An overall positive experience.

Professor Buser is a very good guy. He cares a lot about his students and is always available for questions and will help you. Exams are kind of tricky but he offers a good amount of extra credit. My biggest advice is READ THE BOOK! His notes from lecture are alright but the questions on exams are based from the book. Recitation is helpful as well!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr Buser is a fun and great lecturer. However, if you think his economics classes are going to be a walk in the park, you have another thing coming. His exams are extremely hard, even when you've read the material. In order to pass this class with better than a C, you're going to have to do lots of reading and know your stuff!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: The material is hard. Offers a decent amount of extra credit in order to compensate for the difficulty of his test. Before every lecture he makes you do  a homework assignment to make sure that you read the material. He just covers material from the book. It's up to you either read the book or go to class extra credit for going to class

He's a great lecturer who really makes the material interesting and clear.  My friend had a different professor for microeconomics and didn't learn half the material I did.  He really gets you interested in the subject.

Prof. Buser is a super fun guy. He is interested in what he is talking about. Although the material can be boring, I found his way of lecturing to be a good approach. He makes lots of little jokes and is always energetic. Material is mostly through videos, and grading is straightforward. Extra credit also offered.

I'm not sure why people are giving this guy such a low rating. Professor Buser is an amazing lecturer despite having 700+ kids and he makes the class interactive. Make sure you read the textbook it'll help out alot but even then his lectures make all of the material super accessible.

He provided us with some videos and related tests online as homework. But I think it is  not too much, and I can self-study well. We never use textbook on class, but some of my friends read book to review. I think his lecturer is interesting and he is really nice to answer my questions. He also provided us with extra credits.

Worst class I have ever taken. His lectures are very large and all he does is read from powerpoint slides and you are not able to access any of his materials outside of class. His tests are extremely difficult to an unnecessary level. He does not respond to any email I have ever sent him. 10/10 would not recommend this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Lecture is large for 1 professor to take care of, but he is good not the best but worth the class

Jeffrey was the best lecturer I've had. He's easy to listen to and explains things well. He's pretty goofy and really tries to get some participation out of the 700+ crowd he's lecturing to. He doesn't always get through the full topic then moves on at the next lecture, so make sure to do the DSMs before class in order to really get the material.

Ugh. Jeffrey Buser is like a corny uncle. He reads straight from power point slides and fills the rest in with awful jokes. I didn't learn a thing in lectures, but recitation was really helpful. Buy the econ lab without the etext because the book doesn't help. Don't buy print copies of anything because online stuff it required.
DONOT TAKE THIS CLASS IF YOU ARE A SENIOR SOOO MUCH HOMEWORK AND QUIZZES!!!

Prof Buser really is a great guy.  His lectures can get a little tedious , but he cares about his students.  The material can be tough, but if you go to office hours, he is always willing to help.  Overall I think he is a great professor, he is really enthusiastic about economics and it shows during lecture.

Attendance is optional but he passes around a sign up sheet.  Only tests were a midterm and a final which were pretty average in difficulty.  Pretty easygoing professor.  Homework due online before every lecture, on material taught AFTER the homework assignment was due (to get you to read).
One of the worst classes I've taken. Lectures are very dry and just him reading powerpoint slides of the book. Tests are extremely tough and cover a lot of info. Would not recommend.

He read power points that were taken exactly from the book. No point in ever going to class. HW's and quizzes on my econ lab are harder than his actual tests. Several of his test questions were poorly written and confusing. He's nice and the class isn't hard, but not very insightful.
He's great, but his test questions will make you think so be ready.

He was so awesome!! Such a great teacher & so enthusiastic! Such an influence for me as an economics student! His notes are clear & his tests are generally fair! He was a great teacher! I had this class mwf until 5 and i would always go to my friday class because he was great! If you get a chance to take his class I would!!! (also extra credit yay)

While he may be a nice and funny guy, which I love about him, he does not teach practically at all during lecture. He will go on a story about his life for 20 minutes and then the rest of class is his slideshow that is sloppily put together and is the only study materials in the course. Do not recommend if you actually plan on learning something.
Literally the most engaging lecturer and nicest guy. Best professor at OSU.

Dr. Chordas is a great lecturer. Lectures aren't mandatory, however there are various in class assignments that are graded. He lets the class decide how your grade will be made up by a survey in the 1st week. Labs make up a large portion of your grade and tend to drag on week to week. Which TA you get will ultimately make up your fate in the class.
Best professor I've had at OSU. I would highly recommend. Read the slides and you will be set for the test. He was a goofy guy and told great stories.
He is the best.
He's hilarious and have so many stories related to work, a very good overall experience. Would recommend you to take his class

Very fun and goofy lectures. I admittedly already knew the material from a previous course by coincidence, but I was still interested and engaged regardless. You can really tell he loves what he does and he is a very caring professor.
Dr. Chordas is an engaging prof who makes lectures fun. Exams focus on lecture notes, so staying on top of those is key. unstuckstudy was a huge help for study prep.

This man is hilarious!! His lectures are so easy to follow he keeps things fun yet gets straight to the point. He allows you to vote if you want collaborative quizzes and also has you vote on how the exam is set up. Attendance isn't completely necessary in my opinion but I did go to all of his lectures just because he was so easy to follow TAKE HIM

Certified Yapper, is what I call him, but ties it into the subject well. Material is easy and the exams are easy (read the slides!). Literally did a poll in the beginning so we could choose basically the entire grading criteria. Pretty awesome guy! Attendance not 100% mandatory but you will have to go a decent amount to maintain a good grade.

Dr. Steve is an amazing professor. He made our 80 minute lectures entertaining with his comedy. The exams are very straightforward and only relies on his lecture notes. The only downside to this class is a lot of points being from lab. If you get a TA who's a tough grader it is difficult to keep an A in the class without doing well on exams.
Dr. Chordas is an amazing professor.  His exams are 100% based on lecture material which is easy to remember if you pay attention.
This is by far the best professor I have ever had at OSU. The class breakdown is very nice and he always brings in stories about his life and keeps the course interesting.

Dr. Chordas is a great person and professor. He is very goofy and will not hesitate to crack jokes during lecture and does a great job of keeping his students engaged. He allowed us to vote on how we wanted the final and in class assignments to be set up which was very nice. I would 1000% recommend Dr. Chordas.
His lectures are entertaining specially when he relates lessons to his entomology research. Try on Packback, reading quizzes, and exams and you'll be fine.

Dr. Chordas was amazing, such a nice professor who had interesting lectures. At the beginning of the semester, he asks you how you would like to be graded and the majority rules. Would take again, great teacher and course.

Did well in Bio1113, expected this class to be easier. Dr. Chordas himself is a fantastic lecturer and his exams aren't difficult at all, but the lab portion of the class was incredibly tough for some reason. If your TA is not lenient when grading your lab worksheets you are going to be in for a tough time for this class. Be prepped for lab.

Such a chill class. Would recommend taking his class if you don't like science but need the credit. Attendance for lectures is required but the lectures can be very entertaining. Students are also allowed to work together on reading quizzes and there are only 3 quizzes.

Chordas is a great lecturer and loops his own experience into each lecture so it makes sense. Attendance isn't mandatory but he doesn't go off of slides or record lectures so if you don't go you could miss things. Very funny and likes to make class fun even though its over boring topics.

Dr. Steve is a great teacher. He encourages his students to work together on quizzes and class assignments. He let us vote on the point distribution and how we wanted the final formatted. Very personable and humorous. Also cares a lot about the students that make an effort.
Dr. Chordas is very passionate in teaching and tries to make lectures as interesting and engaging as possible.

He is so engaging and genuinely loves teaching students about nasty ticks and mosquitoes. You would think learning about bugs is boring, but he makes it so interesting that you can't help but listen when he is speaking even if you are not fully paying attention. Exam was not bad at all. Just pay attention in lecture and you will be fine.

I seriously loved Steve and his class! His lectures were so interesting and made it very easy to learn and digest the material. Exams were pretty straightforward as well, no trickery. I wish I could go back and take this class again!
Super nice and has cool work experiences that he shares in class. The class can be a little unorganized but it doesn't matter because it's super chill. Enjoyed him and the course.
Class was easy but his exam was closed note and pretty hard. Encouraged students to work together but was an online class.
If Easy A was a person it'll be Stephen Chordas. Let that sink in well
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Chordas was definitely the easier of the 2 professors that you get for this course. The lectures did not seem to interest me at first, but I quickly got drawn into them because I believe Dr Chordas has a great way of delivering them. The questions on quizzes and the exam was very clear and there were no trick questions. Watch lectures and get an A.

Bio 3401 is a 2 module class. Dr Chordas taught the first module on vector borne diseases. The content is very interesting despite learning a lot about mosquitoes. Take good notes on the lectures and you will be fine. He does not make questions to trick you and as long as you put in a little effort and complete the assignments you'll get an A.

Dr. Chordas is such a down to earth and humble professor. Everytime you email him, he is so nice and gentle. His lectures are amazing and his exam can be a little confusing but all you need to is to go to his lectures and take good notes. Also, he is so helpful outside of class. I wish I could take all my classes with him.

At the beginning of class, he lets us selected how we want to be graded so that's nice. Coming to class is encouraged because his lecture notes are kind of bare so it's easy to miss important information. You can tell he is passionate about the topics and he cracks jokes often. In-class quizzes and assignments are very similar to the exam
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Steve is a legend 100% would recommend. He gives me the willpower to continue with a BS in biology.

He truly cares about his students, very straightforward, makes material concise and easy and fun. You know exactly what you need to do to get an A and it isn't hard. He's also hilarious and makes it interesting, but if you don't come to lecture you won't get the material.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Best professor at OSU, let students vote for class set up. Very straight forward grading. Go to class.

Dr. Chordas was the best professor I ever had at Ohio State. He is incredibly enthusiastic, he finds a relatable way to understand concepts and has an awesome sense of humor making it easy to look forward to lecture. You are doing yourself a disservice not to attend lecture.

Dr. Chordas is one of the best professors I have had at OSU. He is so down to earth and loves teaching and inspiring students. His section was so much fun and he could make any subject interesting. You got to choose all aspects of the class (test format and quiz format etc). Dr. Chordas never failed to put a smile on my face. He's amazing!
Very funny and made those 3 hour lectures a breeze and entertaining.
Awesome instructor! His quirky stories allow you to be relaxed an enjoy his lectures. Would recommend doing all the assigned "homework." Almost guaranteed to get perfect scores if you attempt it.

Very down to Earth. Always there to help you. His class is fairly easy. Just do the assignments, and you'll guarantee to get good grade. Not to mention his exam is super easy. Go to class because most of the assignments and quizzes are done in class.

AWESOME. Best professor I've had yet at OSU after 3 years. He makes information easy to understand at all levels and interesting no matter what you're learning about. Very helpful and very friendly when approached. Wish I could take another class with him!

It's been 2 semesters since I've had Stephen Chordas but man was he a great professor! He was very relatable and didn't sound like some stuck up science professors we have around here.  His class was a breeze. I barely had used my book.

Dr. Steve's portion of the class was super easy. Show up to class for the pop group work for participation points. My only complaints were that the class had a lot of worksheets and in class group work, which gets tedious. I also wasn't a fan of all his long winded stories, but most people think they're hilarious.

Dr. Steve is great. He is funny and he knows what he is talking about. There are pop quizzes throughout the semester so attending lecture every day is highly recommended. He is very engaging and kept me interested throughout his lectures.

Dr. Chordas is a really engaging teacher. He is so excited about the subject matter and it makes it easy to stay interested in the class. He would go above and beyond to help any student and helped me to secure a research position with the government. I would take any class that he teaches.

Funny, knowledgeable, easy going. This prof. makes Biology super interesting. I would recommend this class to anyone. His lectures are fascinating and relevant. Enjoyed every class. Attendance is not mandatory but I strongly recommend it because there are pop quizzes which are easy if you take notes. Class power-points are posted on Carmen.

Dr. Chordas is my favorite professor of the semester.  He makes his lectures interesting and very entertaining.  He's very clear to understand.  You need to go to class though, he does pop quizzes, his notes are not online, and we do not go with the book (don't even buy it).  I'd definitely take more classes from him.

Steve's lectures were to the point and entertaining. He tried to get a class of 200+ as involved as possible. He does not give study guides for exams so you have to learn all material on lecture slides. That being said, he is very clear of what topics are being tested over. Come to lecture because there are pop quizzes. BAD HAIR.

Dr. steve was probably one of my favorite professors at Ohio State. He made things easy to learn and so interested to listen to. He is always very friendly and helpful when asked. If you get a chance to take a class with him, snatch it up!! (hotness rating because of the sick waterfall mullet)

If you need to get your Bio Gen Ed out of the way, take 1102. Steve is my favorite professor this semester. He does a good job making the lectures interesting. He gives out pop quizzes, but they're very straight forward. Exams are not too difficult. Not textbook needed. If you go to lecture, take good notes, and study for exams, you'll do well.

Steve was awesome, if you participate then you will do well. Pop quizzes but you did them with the whole class, so pretty darn easy. He also gave all the assignments the 1st day, so you had plenty of time to do them.
Book not needed. Lectures are entertaining. Pop quizzes are easy if you pay attention in lecture. Take this class with Dr Steve, you won't regret it.

He's awesome. Makes lectures super stimulating and is extremely helpful if you reach out to him. He also really considers the students and lets you vote on a lot of aspects of the class. His personal stories make the class easy to pay attention too. Take all assignments seriously though!!

Best hair on campus. Seriously he is still rocking a mullet so clearly a chili pepper for this dude. Also the best teacher I've ever had. He cares about the material, provides excellent examples, tells personal and relevant stories about the material and teaches it well. Take this class to fulfill your gen eds. You will not regret it.

This guy is great. I wish he was here for the whole semester. He explains things so wonderfully you'll remember what you learned in class and won't need to take too many notes. Very entertaining guy. The labs are never related to lecture though.
Dr Steve is amazing and very helpful. He makes his lectures funny and interesting. One thing about this course, take all the assignments seriously including the exams.
Funny guy. Open to any and all questions. Makes class enganing and worthwhile.

My favorite professor at Ohio State. Makes lectures interesting, funny, and his tests are fair=if you study you will do well. Very easy to get an A in the class if you do all the HW and go to class and take notes. TAKE HIME!!!!

Best Professor at OSU. Every time I asked him a question after class he explained it really well. He was so laid back and funny. A lot of professors are a bit intimidating but with him it was completly different. His exams and quizes are very fair!
Amazing Professor, he's very helpful, kinda funny in a cute way. Fav class of the semester! If you have him, you will love Bio!!!!
Awesome professor! Classes weren't too difficult and he was hands down my favorite professor at OSU. I definitely recommend this GEC.

Chordas is one of the best professors if not the best I have ever had at osu. Keeps lectures interesting and makes you enjoy bio. I don't like science at all and I liked coming to his class. Easy A and you will actually learn a lot more than you would if he made mad the class difficult. Hes also a very funny guy.

BIO 101 with Steve Chordas was one of the easiest classes I've taken at Ohio State. The one project he assigns is a cake-walk. I got a B- while I had mono and literally slept through 5 quizzes and didn't do a single thing. Unless you come down with an energy-killing disease that wrecks you, expect an A.
Steve was awesome. If you went to class you got an A.
Steve was awesome. His lectures were interesting and I still remember all of his funny stories. He wins for telling the most stories about his wife. Definitely a professor to have
Dr Steve is amazing. He makes you interested in Biology and his stories stick with you through college. I still remember random things biological because I'll remember a story he told us.
Easily one of the best professors. I hated bio but man he makes you want to come to lecture! DO NOT TAKE BIO WITH ANYONE ELSE!
Dr. Steve was great!  You will get an easy A if you attend lecture and DO your work!!  If not...you won't!  Pretty simple..huh?
Chordas was so cool and easy A.
Great lecturer.  I enjoyed lectures.  Would highly recommend.
I absolutely loved Chordas! His jokes are hilarious and he does an incredible job making the class interesting and interactive.

Dr. Steve is an excellent lecturer. I wish he could lecture all my classes - he's funny, he explains thing incredibly clearly, and he's definitely motivated about teaching and helping students.  Don't buy the book -- completely useless. He even puts copies on reserve at the library.
super funny and is always telling stories that relate to what we're talking about. even in a lecture of 200+ people, we can still still ask lots of questions and interact.
Dr. Chordas is a great lecturer, I haven't missed a class. He's funny, tells hilarious stories and is friendly and entertaining. Class material is super easy and well-paced.
Dr. Steve teaches in a very laid back atmosphere.  Lots of great information given in an easy to understand manner. He gets an A.
He was a great teacher! I hate Biology and he made it bearable!

Dr. Steve was great!  This class was easy but very interesting and helpful. Take the class and with the professor.  He is funny, loves the material, teaching and life! One of my favorite teachers so far.

He's the funniest professor ever! Always interesting, cracks jokes constantly to keep the course material bearable (which is not bad, just basic biology, you probably learned it in high school). I would definitely recommand this prof!!!
Awesome! Need I say more? Dude, Dr. Steve is the SHIZNAT!
Great teacher. Communicates very well with colorful and entertaining slides. Take him for an A
He was just the course coordinator for this course, but he was so helpful. You could go to his office hours and he would clarify everything the crazy lady teacher said.
He was really understandable and kept everything basic. Unannounced quizzes every couple classes that weren't too bad.  I would definitely recommend his class.
Very good professor class was pretty easy. Dr Steve understands its a GEC so he does not go much in depth and is very easy to do well.He does make lots of wife jokes but there not that bad
He is a very clear teacher

Dr. Chordas was by far the best professor I have had at Ohio State. I never thought Biology could be so interesting, and he always throws in hilarious anecdotes to keep things going. Also the easiest class ever! TAKE HIM!

A gentleman and a scholar. Steve Chordas is the best professor I have ever had the pleasure of studying under. He was extremely thorough and clear, but his best quality is that he puts the students and keeps the class interesting and fair. Attendance shouldn't be an issue in this class because you'll actually look forward to his lecture/story time.
dr chordas was my prof. at columbus state. a great teacher for every one in the class.
I hope Dr. Steve checks this so he can see how awesome he is! This guy is what the other Ph.D's at OSU should emulate...class act, treats students FAIRLY, and just a happy go lucky kind of guy!
His attendance policy was not strict. You had to attend labs but lectures you did not. He would "take attendance" by having random-ish quizzes.

He is the only reason why I go to BIO. He is what the class needs to make it tolerable. The other professors are a train wreck!!! Only wish he taught a module too. Super great guy, likes the students. You can just tell he loves life and his job...unlike the rest who hate the world...and their students

One of the easiest classes I have taken so far at Ohio State.  He was interesting and made everything clear.  He also was pretty funny and made lots of jokes in class.  It's hard to get anything below an A in this class as long as you attend lecture.

great guy. He was the course coordinator for this class and was very clear in everything, was extremely helpful and understanding and just fantastic. Really balanced out the poor quality of the other teachers in this class and made this class somewhat enjoyable and worth going to. Fantastic course coordinator and is exactly what we needed.

Dr. Steve is the best Bio 101 teacher ever! Attendance is not mandatory but if you attend lecture you will do well. He is funny and interesting and plays not tricks, its an easy A if you go to class and take notes. This was one of my best classes so far.
He is so funny! I find biology interesting, but HIS teaching of the class made me actually enjoy the subject and the class. Plus he's just really nice and a very easy prof.
One of THE easiest classes I have taken so far. If you want an A+ take this class!

Awesome professor! If you can get this guy for biology, definitely go for it. His classes are easy, he's always ready to help, and he keeps the class fun and entertaining. Also, if you're not the biggest fan of science, this is the class to take. He recognizes that most people are in there just for the GEC req.
He's a genuinely nice guy.  Makes lectures very fun and interesting.
Great teacher. ery easy class. Pay attention and you will do well. I was in the class with a 100 on the midterm. AMAZING.
Awesome teacher!!!!
A+ professor. Class was very interesting. Tests and quizes are very easy. This is the man you want for Biology.

Best Professor Ever! I actually looked forward to going to his class. He explains things very well and throws in funny jokes to keep it interesting. Definitely take this class...you will be glad you did.
No Comments
He is soo awesome! He makes lecture actually enjoyable and I look forward to going! He'e hilarious too.
Take this class!! If you don't you will regret it! Its so easy

I love it! He makes the class easy and enjoyable, I don't totally dread going to the class.  He makes the notes fun and short which def makes it easy to remember.  He gives quizzes, so going to lecture is a good idea so you don't miss one, but they are straight forward and directly from the notes. Def take him, he's awesome!!!

He is a great guy, his jokes are kind of ridiculous but, still, very fun-loving. The class was really easy because he is very understanding of college students and what to expect from us. There are no outragous assignments, and his lectures are very clear so that you sort of just... remember.
The best professor in the world. Take him.

Unbelievable guy! Just gave 650 kids in my Biology lecture 100% on their midterm exams just for showing up to class. Thats like 20% of our overall grade! He's a legend and if you don't take him your making a mistake!
Very good teacher! Funny, smart and really into what he does! Made me consider biology for a major!
This class was great. It was really easy. Dr. Chordas helps out alot makes class really interesting. Also tells wife jokes

Great class! Biology 101 with Dr. Chordas is easy, humorous, and even somewhat enjoyable! He has a great sense of humor and relates many bio. topics to personal stories (which often involve his wife!) Exams are extremely straightforward, as are pop quizzes. Wants you to succeed! Highly recommend this course!
The absolute best teacher ever!! He is so entertaining, funny and energetic! Class was a breeze, very straightforward! TAKE HIM! You'll love his class!

He makes Bio fun and there were times I was actually looking forward to class.  Very easy to understand and the exams are not hard whatsoever.  Also, he is very easy going when it comes to questions or responses

Doctor Chordas is by far the best science teacher I have ever had... Maybe one of the best intro instructors I have ever had! He uses real-life examples that are interesting... Information you will actually USE! He's entertaining, smart, and honest. Take this class!!

Awesome professor. Easy A. 2 exams, which are barely any harder than the quizzes. The quizzes are extremely easy and the answers often follow a pattern, such as a b c d e aaaaa. One project, you get all quarter to do and it's easy and counts for as much as an exam. TAKE THIS CLASS!
Easy and fun.  Biology can be interesting with this guy.

Professor Chordas is one of the best I've had! I hate science and he made it a fun class, very funny guy. Doesn't talk down to you, very approachable. Do not take any other proffesor! Class isn't mandatory but there are pop quizzes. Book isn't necessary either. This class should have been an easy A but I got high C due to myself!
GREAT GREAT GREAT PROFESSOR!!! I hate science and he made it fun and interesting. Loved going to class!!! Dr. Chordas is the best!

Great Professor! comes across very clear and does not teach you boring stuff you don't need to know. Would recommend going to class, tells hilarious wife jokes and tells you exactly what you need to know.  Do not buy book! you need to only read short pieces and can go the library to do so. Great class, very easy A

Great class! I was worried about this class- a long class and about science! Ugh! Don't worry! Flew by and had fun! Notes are online! Never a dull moment! Learned a lot and use the info in my other science class from his notes! Luved the class! Best prof!

It is the best class with the the best prof. I was worried about this class- a long class and about science! Don't worry! Flew by and had fun! Notes are online! Never a dull moment! Learned a lot and use the info in my other science class from his notes! Luved the class! Best prof!
Great professor! Makes a long night of lecture entertaining. Has many hilarious stories about his wife. Overall cool dude.

Good professor for a long night lecture.  I hated biology in high school but consider it tolerable now.  If you have taken any chem class at osu you will notice that they treat you like babies in the labs.  Bio101 is so much easier than chem101.

Has slides posted on carmen with some blanks to fill in during lecture.  4 best of 5 pop quizes. Labs are boring but easy, research assignment is easy and can be done in one night.  midterm and final are straight from notes.  likes to put "words" in Matching and quizes like, NOBIGDEALK or DECAF...look for those, go to reviews, easy A.  great prof!
what a professor ! take his class !!

Dr. Steve is awesome. He makes the 3 hour long lecture go by so fast --- he's really fun and makes biology interesting, his tests are what 101 level tests should be, definately take his class if possible.
If anyone needs to fulfill a science GEC requirement at Ohio State. I highly recommend taking Bio. 101 with Chordas.
If you want to know how to make Biology fun ask Steve Chordas.

Chordas is the best professor I've ever had. He is super cool, and tells jokes all the time. I love to go to his lectures even though they last till late night. The only bad thing about this class is the Lab, which I feel boring and not really helpful. But that again could be the problem of my TA.
You the man, Steve!!!
Definitely recommend taking his class and going to his review sessions for the exam ;)
GREAT! PROF. Cool Guy! Love the stories. And he keeps it REAL. I am a non traditional student and I would recommend this class to anyone that has been out of school for a long time.
Steve is pretty amazing! He made  a GEC interesting. I would recommend him for bio 101. Library project is a pain, but it is easy

Great Professor if you just want to get biology out of the way. Short, clear lectures and his jokes are pretty funny. His final was awesome b/c most q's had an outrageous answer that makes you laugh, which is a nice help during a bio final. His fu man chu is almost as cool as his mullett too. Oh, and labs are a joke.
He is a great professor, prob. my favorite so far at OSU! He is really great, and the tests are not hard!! He has a review.
Made learn FUN

He is a great teacher! He understands that his students are not bio majors and relates the lectures to things that will affect you, they are interesting.  REALLY EASY.  the library project was an easy 100 pts and if you do the labs you will get an A
I LOVED him! Great Teacher :)
All around a great guy, exams are easy, and classes are usually interesting and funny
I usually struggle with science, but this class was so easy.  He keeps it basic and is able to relate to his students.  I would advise taking Bio 101 with him!

Dr. Steve is an extremely nice guy, who goes out of his way to help students. He actually remembers when he was a poor student with bad professors so he's strives to do well. VERY FAIR TESTS. Also has very amusing stories which are related to material. I didn't think I'd take anything away from this class, but I did. He's a great prof.

Dr. Steve is an extremely nice guy, who goes out of his way to help students.  He actually remembers when he was a poor student with bad professors so he's strives to do well.  VERY FAIR TESTS.  Also has very amusing stories which are related to material.  I didn't think I'd take anything away from this class, but I did.  He's a great prof.

If ur good @ memorizing.Take this class!Because that is all u have to do for the exams.He is a great great prof-helpful,patient,and wants u to get that A.Bonus pts are everywhere.Only recommendation i can give u is pick the right TA(that is the key)Get that A in the lab and ur set.The rest as i said is straight up memorization.JUST LIKE THAT- A

If ur good @ memorizing.Take this class!Because that is all u have to do for the exams.He is a great great prof-helpful,patient,and wants u to get that A.Bonus pts are everywhere.Only recommendation i can give u is pick the right TA(that is the key)Get that A in the lab and ur set.The rest as i said is straight up memorization.JUST LIKE THAT- A

This guy is the greatest, he wants students to do well so he makes the class easy.  As long as you go to the majority of the classes and study a little bit, you're guaranteed an A.  SOOO much easier than any other bio teacher!
Had a good time in class, though lectures are long and boring...If you take it at night he WILL keep you til 9

one of the easiest classes i've taken!! his lectures aren't boring, he keeps your attention and makes it interesting by making it simple, explaining everything, and telling jokes and stories. he tells you what to study for the exams, and his tests are super easy. he gives tons of bonus. and puts almost half the notes online... take this class!!!!!!

Dr. Steve is a smart man with three PhDs! Don't let that scare you; he is very clear in lecture. I hate Biology, I'm all about the social sciences, but Dr. Steve made Biology tolerable and do-able. The tests are a little hard because there's so much information you have to know/memorize, but the questions aren't trick questions. HIGHLY RECOMMEND!

Dr. Steve is a smart man with three PhDs! Don't let that scare you; he is very clear in lecture. I hate Biology, I'm all about the social sciences, but Dr. Steve made Biology tolerable and do-able. The tests are a little hard because there's so much information you have to know/memorize, but the questions aren't trick questions. HIGHLY RECOMMEND!

Dr. Steve is the man. He tells you exactly what you need to know for exams and is one of the nicest guys you'll ever meet. His sense of humor makes lecture enjoyable, and he usually lets you out of very eary. This guy is a great professor.
Awesome teacher all around.  Made learning fun!  Didn't make you learn things you would never need to know in life.  Extremely helpful.  You have no idea until you take his class!
Excellent professor with a wonderful sense of humor. Precise in explanation, helpful in every sense of the word.
Comprehensive class, but he took out the fluff and it was nice and easy.
I would definitly take another class of his.
Cool Professor. If you attend class, you can get an A. He is a nice guy and tries to be funny, which he is most of the time. He does NOT have a chip on his shoulder. Fun class

Dr. Steve, you don't have to call him dr., was a really good professor. SOOO much better than Prof. Rissing who also teaches Bio 101. He was sort of boring but he put his lectures, most of them, on WebCT for us.  Overall, I really liked his class.

For me the lectures were impossibly boring. His jokes were so lame too. His tests are pretty easy though. Usually they spell something. If you like men that have mullets and bash their wives then take this class. If you hatelate night classes then don't.
Made lecture fun to go to, which was a plus. Tests are not hard, and half the final is exactly the midterm. He usually gives hints answers on the quizzes (abcde or all b's, etc.).

Good lecturer, even though the talks were somewhat boring.  He did make an effort to make the class interesting, and that's why I did well.  He's easy to understand and comfortable to talk to.  Knows his stuff, and has a sense of humor.
Steve is a really great teacher!  I'm planning on taking his 102 when it's offered!
Easy to understand and very helpful yet doesn't go into too much detail in non-major courses because he believes that should be saved for major courses, also a pretty funny guy when he wants to be:)
No Comments
No Comments

Dude is a beast. Dr. Otter is the best history professor I've ever had. He gives insightful lectures, asks genuinely thought-provoking questions, all while maintaining a dry and timely sense of humor. Outside of class, he is understanding and is very reasonably accommodating. He's a fantastic professor whom I hope to take again before I graduate.

Prof Otter was my favorite professor all semester and might be my favorite so far here at OSU. The lectures are long and some can be boring, but he tries to make them funny and his accent is hilarious. 3 essays for 60% of the grade all 3-5 pages. Final essay is 8-10 pages and worth 40%. First two essays can be re-written until they are a 100%.

The class was easy, with a total of 4 assignments. While the presentations were black text on gray backgrounds, he managed to make it enjoyable with his great sense of humor. I'd recommend this class and Otter if you need it for an easy elective/gened.

Pretty easy class, with four papers graded by the TA. If you didn't like your score on the first two, you could rewrite them. Otter has a good sense of humor and made the lectures that were comprised of "boring" information super engaging and interesting. Good class to take for a GE, or history credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Otter is an amazing professor, although I didn't particularly love the subject matter if you take Otter you'll learn and enjoy the class.

dr. otter cares a lot for his students. there are three 3 page papers and a 10 page final. you get unlimited rewrites on the first two. i took this as a ge and do not care about the content, but he made it enjoyable. i highly recommend if you dont mind writing
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Otter is top 3 of my favorite professors here at OSU. He makes the lectures interesting to learn about even though it's a history class. I have never written a ratemyprofessor review but I had to for him because he's the best history teacher I've had in a LONG time. Please take this class especially for a Theme course!

Great professor, very helpful and attentive. Learned a lot about a relatively boring subject (in my opinion) in a very interesting way.  Dr. Otter made what would usually be a very rough class to take one of the highlights of my day.

Chris Otter was hilarious, caring, and really made this class entertaining. I've never cared about history until this class! Your grade only rests on attendance and four papers though, so if you're not a good writer I would not recommend this course. It's also important to pay attention to the syllabus for the requirements for each of the papers.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Otter is awesome!  He is funny and keeps his lectures engaging by having class discussions.  Class has 3 shorter papers (3-5 pages) and one 10 page final paper.  The papers are graded hard, and the class takes a good amount of effort but if you put the effort in you will learn a lot!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Prof Otter is one of the best professors I have had at OSU. Even though papers can be a bit challenging, if you put a fair effort, he will give you a high grade. He's very friendly overall and he will make sure that you earn a fair grade based on the effort you put in.

Dr. Otter is a fantastic professor! Very knowledgeable about the history topics covered in the course. Course assignments consist of three shorter 3-5 page papers and one final term paper. He can be a tough grader, but he allows the first two papers to be rewritten. Be sure to utilize the readings in your papers; omitting them will hurt your score.

Professor Otter is very knowledgeable! He explained all of the material well for all of us to understand. I would say he was a tough grader at first but you're able to revise 2 of the 3 response papers. Assigns readings, but it goes along with what we learned in lecture. As long as you get used to how he grades and what he wants, you will do well!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Otter is a great professor! Hes very knowledgeable and wants his students to succeed. However, he is also an extremely tough grader. I would not recommend this class if you want an easy A; youll spend a lot of time reading and writing. But if you want to get challenged and learn something new, Otter is the best person to learn from.

Professor Otter was a great professor, but his lectures progressively became less interesting. All students have to write their notes on paper (no electronics allowed unless SLDS) and it is beneficial when it comes to retaining information, but he talks really fast and does not leave his slides up for enough time.
reviews.rating_tags: So many papers--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Best professor ever. Attendance is mandatory but his lectures are amazing and you'll learn a lot. Three response papers and one final paper but he lets you re-write the first paper until you're satisfied and you can always ask him to read drafts and provide feedback. He genuinely cares about his students and works to make classes fun & interesting
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Nicest professor ever!! Really cares about his students and is really willing to work with them regarding deadlines/assignments. Grades based on 3 papers each worth 20% of grade, 1 final paper worth 30%, and 10% attendance. No daily homework. Requirements of papers are clear. He tries to make the lectures as entertaining as possible

Chris cares so much about his students and it shows! Always responds to emails within the hour, sometimes less! Very personable & tries to gain student engagement. There is no electronics allowed in his classroom, but it is honestly beneficial because you use all your notes to write your papers. Very good guy, would recommend to anyone!

Dr. Otter was an amazing professor. He's very understanding of the fact that his students have many other obligations outside of his class. Assignments were very manageable. Grades in the class came from attendance and a few papers, but he allowed you to resubmit them as many times as necessary to get the grade you wanted. I would highly recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Caring

reviews.comment: Attendance was required, but the class is great. He was very interactive without making anybody feel awkward in discussions. There wasn't really any technology allowed and we took notes on paper, which helped me learn and retain information. There were 3-4 assignments total, all papers, but he was helpful and gave lots of feedback before grading.

He is absolutely FANTASTIC and EXTRAORDINARY. He is extremely intelligent and knows his fields of interests really well. Going to classes and listen to him lecturing in his beautiful British accent is just an enjoyment. If you pay attention to the paper requirements and do all the readings, you will learn a lot.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: ONE OF THE BEST PROFESSORS IVE EVER ENCOUNTERED he is extremely knowledgeable. He is very kind and understanding with students conflicts. He is attentive and helpful when it comes to our papers. He is extremely funny and has such a vibrant bright personality that makes class entertaining and fun. Overall an amazing professor!I recommend history2703

I have mixed feelings about Chris. On one hand, he did his best to make extremely dry material interesting, and was a guy who cared about what he taught. Then again, when there's only 4 grades, and three of them are papers, it's hard to get a great grade. It's a decent amount of work for a history GE. Take it if you prefer papers over tests.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--SO MANY PAPERS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I took this class for my history GE and it was perfect. 3 4-5 page papers based on topics talked about in class, then one 10 page paper final. Attendance is part of the grade too. Papers are not hard as long as you put in the effort to write them with the right material. Pretty easy Class! Highly recommend. Very helpful and wants you to succeed!

Christ is a great professor! He is funny and makes the class interesting. He is always willing to help you and answer questions whether it's during class, outside of class, or by email. He exceptionally good about emailing back quickly. I wrote 4 papers for his class and there was no exam, which i loved. I would recommend Chris!

Great British accent.  Wrote a paper on how to write a paper; get the books to do the research but don't really do the research, just say how you would.  A couple book reports and papers, no tests.  Very easy if you read the books and are already a good writer.

This class was not on the most interesting topics but Chris made it do able. Attendance is mandatory, although I was not always mentally present(early) But his TA was a ridiculous grader. 2 4-5 page papers and 10 page final paper. Exam is half ids and half a paper....not looking forward to it..NOT AN EASY A!

Professor Otter is great. Lectures are informative and engaging. Very little book usage, several papers, a final paper and an exam. However, he had a TA who was a ridiculously hard grader, and I'm not sure I'll end up with an A despite my ridiculously high effort. Don't take if you're looking for an easy GE course.

Great teacher, actually made class super interesting and fun.  Takes attendance. 2 4-5 page response papers on assigned topics (pick from like 5 choices) and then a 10 page final paper on a topic of your choice.  Also a final that had identification of terms and then short essays.  Posts all notes online. Study from that. Take this class!!!!!!

Absolutely wonderful. If you get the chance to take him, do it. This class was simple: a midterm and final with essay questions you already knew before hand, a  research paper, and recitation participation. Funny guy with  a British accent, his lectures were actually enjoyable.

Nice, funny guy. Organized lectures and doesn't required textbook reading (has supplemental readings but you didn't have to read them to do well). He's the kind of guy you just sit back and listen to; he paints a great picture of history. Grade consisted of attendance, two papers and essay exam. Easy class, fun teacher.

Professor Otter is very great and enthusiastic. While we had a T.A. who graded our final/midterm and term paper, Prof. Otter's lectures were very, very fun and interesting. One can tell that he spends a great deal of time preparing slides etc.  He is extremely knowledgble on British-if you get the chance-take him!
Best and easiest history prof I have had.  His grading policy is very fair and he has an interesting lecture that I only attended just to listen to him speak.

Prof Otter is a good guy. i am SHOCKED he didnt get any hotness ratings? hes super cute and british! History of technology has 4 five pg papers and 1 ten pg paper.. which i didnt knowcoming into it.. kind of annoying. no tests. dont pay attention in class. no book. takes attendance every lecture :(

Very friendly guy. Has a sense of humor about history. The textbook use is low, only need it for the papers you write. No need to read the assigned readings because they are never discussed in class. Glad we could rewrite papers. Posted class powerpoints on Carmen for future reference which was very helpful. Final exam wasn't bad.

I had Professor Otter for History 398 and he made a mundane class extremely interesting. He was very interested in helping students and had an extensive knowledge of European history. If you have to take 398, take it with him. I will definitely take another class with Professor Otter!

I love this professor. He is very helpful and absolutely adorable, I love his accent! He is a very fair grader and he lets you rewrite your papers which is awesome. 398 info is rather boring, but he makes it as interesting as possible! I definately recommend him and will def take other classes with him.

The 1:48 long classes are usually the bane of my existence, by Professor Otter moved class along in a way that facilitated interesting conversation between students.   All in all, he found a way to make class enjoyable and profitable.

This was one of the more interesting history classes I have taken. The professor has an encyclopedic understanding of this time period. Material very relevant to modern US problems and politics. Grading and writing definitely reasonable.
Interesting teacher with English accent.  Lectures were pretty boring and not necessary.  Attendance to recitation is required.  Gives you the questions prior to the exams, which helps a lot.
No Comments

Easy teacher, only got an A- due to my laziness. Nice guy and very clear about stuff. The class was boring because it was 398 (How to research and write history) and he tried to make it as amusing as possible.

AWESOME! Take this professor if you can. I am a bio major, but I still got an A-. For his midterm/final, he gives a list of possible prompts. If you prepare for 3 or 4 of them, you're golden. Very easy grader.There's a ten page paper but it's not hard. There is a lot of reading, but I found that it wasn't necessary to actually read it.

Definitely an interesting class with engaging topics, and he isn't a bad professor. However, he tends to ramble, which makes lectures feel long and sometimes dreadful. The class is based on three midterm exams (60%), which doesn't leave much room for the other assignments (40%) to help your grade. Lastly, emails often go unanswered.

overall okay professor but exams are based on niche applications of class topics to the point where even if you study for 8+ hours, you still probably won't get an A and you have to rely on educated guesses rather than what you actually learned

Not a difficult or bad class, but I do have a few issues. Professor Gelpi uses a lot of filler words when speaking, to the point where it's genuinely distracting. His slideshows consist entirely of pictures, meaning you have little to no guidelines on what to take notes on. Seems like a nice guy, love the dogs, but this class was just okay.

Very memorable and enjoyable class due to Professor Gelpi. The dogs and general wholesome attitude was made it a really enjoyable atmosphere. Although there is some tough readings and some of the statistics can be quite dry it never feel overbearing or stressful.

Prof Gelpi was awesome. His lectures were super engaging, his tests are not very feasible, and the final paper is graded by a TA. Additionally he gives crazy amounts of extra credit at the end of the semester for SEI's and other things.

Prof. Gelpi gives actually engaging lectures. 

Tests are super easy -- all memorization of terms and almost no application. He gives you the terms ahead of time.

Final paper was broken down throughout the year so it was easy to complete.

You can get 100 on his reading quizzes just by reading the title of the reading assignment.

This class is ok. Gelpi was rarely on time, impossible to reach, and overall disorganized. I only got an A in the class because of all the extra credit (4 pts for SEIS, and 4 pts for attendance). I didn't learn anything, which made writing a 12-page research paper difficult. The TAs grade them though so you'll get an A even if your paper is awful

Great professor! Really cares about students. Easy grader, if you think something was misgraded you can ask to change it.

Not many assignments and they are easy and you'll learn. Few small assignments for participation, 2 exams (easy), 1 final paper that is broken up throughout semester. Plus he brings his dog!
Dr.Gelpi is very passionate about what he teaches and it definitely shows. He is willing to answer questions and help students succeed. He explains everything in detail and keep us entertained.

Lectures are sometimes boring but if you pay attention and take notes in lecture you'll do well on the exams. Reading quizzes are not hard because he goes over reading materials during lecture so even if you don't actually read you'll still get full points on the quizzes.

Pretty easy class while still learning a lot. Gelpi is a really good story teller so his lectures are pretty interesting. The review sessions before the midterm and final covered everything and the paper is broken down so its not very hard.

Attendance counts as extra credit & he brings a dog. Lectures are extremely boring. Second half of class after the midterm is more interesting. Paper is broken into parts so no stress to put all together. Exams are easy, he gives you a study guide & just know what he says. Hard to reach out of class. Quizzes are easy. Boring, but easy A.
Professor Gelpi is great! Nicest dude, really knows his stuff, very good lecturer. Hard to get a hold of sometimes, though.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I showed up to class 5 times the whole semester; the midterm, to turn in the different parts of the paper, and the final. You don't need to show up. He gives a study guide for the midterm and final and they are multiple choice. It was super easy and minimal time was put in out of class besides the paper.
Exams were tough. Paper has no clear grading criteria so its hard to know whats expected for a sizable chunk if your grade. Interesting guy, interesting topics, but be cautious with this class.

Really nice guy and he really wants you to do well. Very clear and interesting lecturer but also puts everything online. The paper was over a long period of time and in section so it guarantees a good grade. And the final exam was the easiest thing I have ever taken in college I was shocked. Highly recommend. (He also brings dogs to class!)
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Respected

reviews.comment: Prof. Gelpi lectures in a very understanding manner. His lectures are pretty basic and they are not hard to follow. Grading comprised of 1 midterm, 1 final, quizzes, and a final paper. Readings are not necessary and they are all available on Canvas. I highly recommend taking his class. Test grades are weighted quite heavily, so be sure to study!
He is awesome

Political science isn't exactly my strongest subject, but this was wasn't horribly difficult. If you really understand political science, the lectures probably aren't necessary. The information is all on the powerpoints, but I thought some of his lectures were really interesting. Tests were fair, and study guides were given out before each one.

Dr. Gelpi is a good professor and is very willing to help students. His only downfall is that he has a tendency to lecture directly from his powerpoint slides. This class is not hard, if you find PS4315 difficult and are studying polysci  int studies  you should probably change your major.

I learned shockingly little new information in class. Like, shockingly. Readings were helpful occasionally, but Dr. Gelpi spent most of his time in lectures rewording his slides so it sounded like he wasn't just reading from them. So not bad information necessarily, just horrendously, horrendously boring.

He is very boring and the lecture is just what's on the sides, there really isn't reason to go to class especially since the TA does all the grading and comments. Also the exams are very short. 3 ID terms and 2 essays, missing one brings the exam down, and with only 3 grades , midterm, final, and paper its do or die.  Avoid this class and teacher!
