Amazing professor. The only slight someone could hold against him is that his teaching style can be a little confusing. I learned the best by spamming his problem sets and regularly reviewing his notes. He is worth taking by just how helpful he is during his office hours.
Very condescending. Tough accent and constantly repeats himself. Exams will have topics that we barely went over despite him saying it wouldn't be on the test.

Dr. Chang was an amazing lecturer! He doesn't record lectures so you have to come to class to take notes, but he explains most things very clearly and uses fun analogies. Quizzes weren't too difficult if you had done the recitation worksheets + practice quizzes + reviewed notes. Exam questions are very similar if not directly taken from practice.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: When I was looking at RMP prior to last semester, I saw many ratings that said he was bad for students that have SLDS. The only reason I am writing this review is because Dr. Chang was nothing but accommodating for me. Yes, 2510 is a hard class, but I am very happy I decided to switch into his section.
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr Chang is my personal hero. Never in my life have I had a professor give everyone a 40/40 on a quiz because osu beat the team up north. Not just that, but his lectures are really good. No matter what people say about his lectures his answers are always in the notes I have found. Attend all lectures + office hours. Office hours was a life saver.

Very hard to understand quite honestly. Tells you what is going to be on tests and quizzes and a lot of the time nothing he says is on it. Throws very random specific things from the notes on the tests. Extremely harsh grader. Do not recommend taking him at least for O chem 1.

Dr. Chang is an alright professor but there is not a lot to be graded on in this class. If you didn't take him for ochem 1 (like me) then good luck because it'll already feel like you're behind everyone else. There isn't a very big curve either. I'd recommend taking a different ochem 2 professor if you haven't already had him.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He cares about his student performance, but there are consequences from not having him for ochem 1. Students who had his ochem 1 course know how he works with unique a exam style, and these students are basically gonna set your [small] ochem 2 curve. Chang teaches more of a memorization class than intuitive class, and you should know that going in.

Very transparent, straightforward, no-bs guy. He makes it very clear what he expects of you and how you should prepare. It's not an easy class but he is not out to get you or trick you in anyway - his mantra is simple, you follow his plan and put in the effort and you'll do well. Relationship is 2 ways tho - you put in effort and he'll be there.

I think Dr. Chang does one of the best jobs regarding how difficult the content of this class is. I wish he recorded his lectures because missing class can be detrimental. He's caring, funny, and wants to help. The exams are based mostly off of his practice problems and recitation worksheets, which is helpful.

Dr. Chang is one of the best professors I've ever had. I had him for 2510 and 2520 and he definitely made organic chemistry understandable for me. I recommend taking him! Be sure to always attend his lectures since he mentions how he structures his exams. Good luck!
Stop scrolling and just take this professor already. As long as you put in the work you'll be fine.

If you're aiming to get the best possible grade out of all ochem lectures take this professor, but class is still very difficult. Your grade will consist of quiz and exam grades, with some extra credit. Very generous curve, so even if you don't do well on exams you'll probably pass. Focus on recitation worksheets and problem sets for exams
Kind but hard class.

Dr. Chang is extremely kind and funny, however his tests and quizzes were pretty difficult with the averages being in the 50s to 70s. His teaching style wasn't my favorite, and he does offer 5 extra credit points/week (better than nothing) but with exams being around 240 pts each it doesn't do much. My 83.5 got curved to a B+. Go to lecture!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: No lecture recording, so go to class! Dr. Chang is an enthusiastic teacher. It is the way the course is set up that there are a lot of materials we need to memorize in a short period of time.  I don't like one thing about his teaching style that he goes into detail without explaining the big picture/context. Be ready to study on your own for a lot.

Does his best for students.Weekly recitation quizzes worth 40 points. He also allowed students to get 5 extra credit points for worksheets based on completion each week. Exams were difficult but he was very straightforward about content. Lots of problems came from practice resources given. This year the curve for a B was at 70.5% and 78% for a B+.

Dr. Chang is very fair, and very straightforward. Especially compared to other orgo 2 lecturers, he really outlines what you need to know for his quizzes and exams. Orgo 2 was absolutely doable with Dr. Chang. However, do not expect any sort of curve for his class, as his exams are fair enough where a curve is not necessary. Know the lecture notes!

Dr. Chang is a great professor. Just make sure that you study every day and you'll be fine. There are weekly quizzes so prepare for them. Extremely approachable if you have any questions. Exams are relatively straightforward if you prepare.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Best OChem prof especially if your goal is to get a good grade. Go to every class, take clear notes, and you'll pass. Grade is just based on exams and quizzes, with recitation packets for extra credit, which I liked (no time sink online HW). The exams weren't that difficult, and he prepared us well ;) Wish I had taken him for OChem 2. TAKE HIM.

Dr. Chang has an amazing curve. If you do all the recitation activities & problem sets multiple times, rewrite your notes, and practice daily, you WILL get an A. For future reference, a 73%-82% this semester was a B+, which is a pretty good curve! He Automatically makes the average a B-, and curves at least 25% of the class to an A. You got this!

Aside from how easy he makes understanding ochem and doing good in his class, this man is amazing! I have had several issues related to this class and have actually, embarrassingly, cried in front of him several times. He sat down and spoke with me about how to help myself. I don't know a single professor who would do that for a student. Take him!

Dr. Chang cares about his students and truly wants them to succeed. The only downside to his class was that he doesn't provide recorded lectures so you do have to go to class each day. Watch YouTube videos, take your own notes, do all the practice material Chang provides, and try to stay on top of the content. Ochem is very manageable with Chang!
The best prof you will ever have and will make you love ochem if you hated it from ochem 2510.

I got an A- in this class. Dr. Chang curves 25% of his students get an A/A-, which is a lot higher than other professors. My advice? Start studying early. The first day you get to class is when you start studying. Also, so every problem set and recitation worksheet. I promise that if you do & don't give up, you WILL get an A with Dr. Chang.

I got a B+ in this class. I was 2% away from an A-. Had I not thrown up during the 2nd midterm, I believe I would have gotten an A-. Dr. Chang is an amazing professor! He has an accent, but he is absolutely hilarious in class. Out of all the professors at OSU, Chang is the easiest, no questions asked. Curve is amazing!

Great professor who teaches the content in fun, memorable ways. 2 midterms and 1 cumulative final. No hw except for wkly recitation worksheet (only graded for extra credit). 8 recitation quizzes and 2 lowest are dropped. Very fast-paced so definitely have to put in the work outside of class to succeed. Vry accessible in office hrs and outside class
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: dr. chang is the best ochem professor at osu by far. all my homies love dr. chang
such a sweet man. Gives a lot of extra credit and tells you exactly what is on all of the exams before hand.

Dr. Chang is one of the best professors I had at OSU. Wish I had him for Ochem 1. Wants to see his students succeed and emphasizes he wants to see who really studies in the class. With the vast amount of practice he provides you, you will see much of what he wants you to learn beforehand and will feel better about going into quizzes and exams.

Dr. Chang has been my favorite professor at OSU! I had him for both OChem 1 + 2. I was very worried about OChem given its rep, but he made things fun + easier to understand. I enjoyed his lectures + he was always willing to make time for students in and out of class. His quizzes/exams were fair and he is quick to regrade + correct mistakes.

Great professor. Although lectures can go pretty fast, if you prepare beforehand you'll be okay. He values helping his students very highly, as long as you are putting in effort. The class wasn't easy, but no orgo chem class will be. I highly recommend him.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Chang was a great prof who truly cares for his students. He tries his best to prepare everyone for the common exams, which are about the same level as his quizzes and recitation worksheets. His lectures go fast but go to office hours, read Ochem as a 2nd Language, and watch lots of youtube videos. Also lots of extra credit with recitation!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Chang has to be my favorite professor I've had in college. He is definitely not easy on his students, but it's for a reason. He gives everyone an opportunity to succeed, but makes you work for the grade you earn. His classes tend to have very smart people so it gets competitive. Such a fun guy though, I can't recommend him enough.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Chang is a good guy and a caring prof. He really wants you to succeed, and gives you the materials to do so, which is why I chose to do both semesters of ochem with him. My only complaint was that his pre-covid practice quizzes/exams did not prepare you for his online exams, though I definitely see why the online versions had to be harder.

Dr. Chang is very thorough in his lectures so be sure to attend and stay after class as he takes the time to answer extra questions. Quizzes and exams are formatted similar so practicing quizzes and the worksheets offered are best practice for exam. Not the nicest person but somewhat generous. Drops lowest two quizzes and curves very well.
Dr. Chang is great and I felt like I really understood ochem concepts because of his teaching. Aa long as you attend all lectures and do the homework and practice you can do will with him.

Organic Chemistry is a very difficult class. Dr. Chang gives lots of material to help study and he is very helpful during office hours. His exams and quizzes aren't too hard. I recommend practicing the old ones he gives you for practice as well as the recitation activities ;) The TA's can be somewhat confusing on some things so go to Chang first.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Easily the best professor I have ever had. I took 2510 and 2520 with him and he does an amazing job at taking very abstract and difficult concepts and breaking them into memorable metaphors. Be prepared to easily spend 10+ hours a week on Ochem alone, especially 2520. Exams are hard and make you think, but he draws mostly from practice materials.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Chang is the best ochem prof at OSU. Eventhough he has an accent, he teaches the material very well, is very nice and funny, and his test questions are very clear and straightforward (unlike other professors). He also gave us extra credit and had a lot of office hours.

Amazing! Best ochem professor at OSU. English isnt perfect but he does his best to speak loud/clear and repeat things multiple times. Gives funny analogies to help students understand reaction conditions and mechanisms. Very fair and genuinely wants his students to do well. Lots of study resources. He makes sure hard work  success in his class.
Wallah my favorite teacher. I hate my teachers now I would retake his Ochem class again just for fun if I could. He made me love Ochem

Dr. Chang is honestly awesome. I retook this class after failing with Callam and Dr. Chang's exams are EXTREMELY reasonable. He tells you what's on the exam and the questions come from his question sets. Aside from that, he's kind, wants you to succeed, & makes time at the beginning of class for questions. Also, good curve!! TAKE HIM!

Dr. Chang's lectures were very organized. Lecture is extremely important and I don't think you could do very well in the class if you didn't go to lecture. Practice exams are very helpful in preparing for the exams. Dr. Chang is EXTREMELY straightforward in what he will ask you on the exam.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: He is one of the better ochem profs, but he does not see mental illness as a real issue. He is not American and people from his culture do undermine mental illness. If you do struggle with ADHD, anxiety, or depression. Look for a different prof

Dr. Chang is the best!! Such a caring guy, who genuinely wants his students to succeed. A lot of the test questions are very similar or identical to past quizzes and worksheets and lecture examples. So if you study, you will do well.

His lectures are better than the other Ochem profs, but his exams will have a lot of things on there that was barely touched in class. Averages are around 50-65 percent, which is still awful. He puts the 2nd midterm and final VERY close!! Everyone was very rushed for the final and many students did poorly. He gives a 10% so 50% u will not pass
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Chang is the best combo of a great professor from whom you'll learn a lot, and easy grading criteria that you will find in from an Ochem professor. Dr. Chang gives weekly extra credit, and many of his exam questions come straight from quizzes and homework. His class is still a lot of work, but take him at all cost if it fits your schedule.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Organic chemistry is hard, but Dr. Chang really tries his best to make it as understandable as possible. He reads multiple textbooks and summarizes the information for you in a clear way. Go to all the office hours you can, too! He's really personable and wants you to succeed. The curve was kind but you do have to work for it.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. Chang is a great professor. As tough as Organic chemistry is, he truly makes this class as fair as possible. This is shown through multiple ways such as how he gives extra credit and numerous amount of practice problems. Although, I will say that his class is very lecture based so skipping them is not a good idea.

Dr. Chang is one of the most caring professors I've had thus far. He is so helpful in office hours (which I highly recommend attending) and is great at explaining things in lecture. He also gives a TON of extra credit for those who participate in class and recitation. He has high expectations, but he makes it easy to succeed in this class.

Dr. Chang teaches a tough class and has high expectations, but he does his best to help students be successful. His lectures are clear (no textbook needed - he gives you all the info and practice problems that you need). He also is very helpful in office hours. He expects students to put in the work, but he will do whatever he can to help.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. Chang provides all of the resources you need to do well in the class. If you consistently review your notes, the recitation packets, and the problem sets, it is definitely doable to get an A. Compared to other Ochem instructors at OSU, he is much more straightforward and he is also pretty funny as well and keeps students fairly engaged.

He keeps tests as fair as possible and avoids ambiguity or exceptionally tricky questions. He REALLY CARES about students and is willing to do anything to help you understand the content. A downside of taking him is that he's not very good with explaining some ideas as he isn't very good with words.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: I loved having Chang for ochem 1. The tests are hard, but the problem sets and recitation activities he gives you are really good prep. If you know how to do those, you should be fine. Go to lecture because he doesn't post most of his lecture notes on Carmen. Very accessible - has multiple office hours a week and works one on one with you.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--EXTRA CREDIT--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Fantastic teacher. Tons of practice problems. No surprises. Always available to help.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Ochem is a hard class and Dr. Chang does his best to make it better. He genuinely cares about student's and does anything he can to help. His notes are very detailed and only available in class if you attend it. Don't skip class! Go to office hours for help. He really cares about you.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Very kind and caring professor, in my opinion one of the best ochem professors you could have at OSU. Wish I could have hime again for 2520 just wouldn't work for my schedule :/
The worst teacher I've ever met

Dr. Chang is an amazing, funny, and helpful professor who wants to see his students succeed. That being said, you need to attend lecture and write down ALL of his notes because his exam questions come directly from the lecture notes/examples. Go to office hours; you will get lots of help and hints from him. There is extra credit offered as well.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Probably the best Ochem professor there is. If you have a chance, definitely take him. Super caring and makes the class hilarious yet informative.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: Great professor, lectures are down to earth and Chang makes things easy to understand just make sure you pay attention and take good notes.  Gives lots of resources to students and always there for your success.

Dr. Chang is easily one of my favorite professors ever. He is really funny. He would always come up with funny analogies that make the chemistry make more sense. GO TO OFFICE HOURS!!! He gives out a lot of extra points in recitation and his exams are tough but fair. You will earn the grade for the work you put into the class.

Dr. Chang is amazing. He's funny and really cares about students. He offers extra credit opportunities and helps students whenever needed. He also asks for questions at the beginning, during, and end of lecture. I've learned a ton more from this professor than I have from any chemistry professor. Attendance is not mandatory, but highly recommended.

Dr. Chang is one of the best professors I've had so far. In the beginning his accent makes understanding hard but you get used to it fast. He is unambiguous about what's going to be on the exam, gives a lot of extra credit and genuinely wants to help his students succeed. He is sooo hilarious in class. LOVED HIM

Dr. Chang is a very fair grader. He tells you what to expect on the exams and gives you materials to succeed in his course including a lot of practice problems. He is entertaining in lecture. He even gave out free frosty coupons to people who answered. Overall, great professor, very helpful. Would take again. Love this man.

Dr. Chang really cares about his students and wants to make sure they understand the topics. He offers a lot of extra practice and handouts on Carmen. Exams are fair. I took entire weekends off to prepare for his 2 Monday midterms and just repeated practice problems over and over. There is also extra credit. He's a funny guy and made ochem fun

Besides his accent he is very clear and explains concepts well. Holds lots of office hours, highly recommend to go to as many as possible. Gives extra credit on exam and does lecture mistakes that are worth extra credit. Going to class EVERY DAY is a must to do well in his class. The book is not 100% needed, but at least know someone that has it.

Dr. Chang is one of my favorite professors thus far. He is incredibly helpful--office hours are invaluable and he also presents plenty of study materials. This is by no means an easy subject but if you put in the time, Dr. Chang will make getting a good grade possible. Bonus: he gives A TON of extra credit.

Dr. Chang is my favorite professor here at Ohio State.  He genuinely cares and wants to help out his students.  He gives out tons of bonus, around 100 points.  He makes the lectures very interesting.  Don't listen to what people say about his clarity, he goes fast at times but he is clear on what you need to know  wait a semester for him if you can

Extremely hard to understand at times. I spent more time trying to piece together the broken English than understanding material. Practically taught myself as he was an almost entirely useless resource. Easy grading scale just to make up for the fact that he is just awful at teaching. You won't understand anything unless you're a good self teacher.

Chang was an amazing professor. I thought his handwriting was neat and his notes are point on. Lectures are very helpful. He is very eager to help students and wants them to do good. Exams are pretty fair and not difficult if you study and prepare for them well.
Attend office hours and it will change your grade. A great guy who really cares about the material, pay attention to his lectures!

He is crystal clear in what he wants you to know for midterms and for the final he gives a deatiled breakdown of the things that are on the final. In additon for the midterms he tells you in class exactly what is on them even telling you that specific examples verbatim are on there. Up to 120 points of extra credit. Easy A if u do the work.

Dr. Chang is the best ochem professor at OSU. A ton of extra credit, a lot of practice problems on Carmen, which no other professors offer for their students. Big curve at end of class. Tells you exactly what will be on the midterms and final. Doesn't put anything that isn't in his notes. Do not skip class. Start studying a week before the tests.
He is hard to understand and his writing his hard to read.

Dr. Chang has definitely been one of my favorite professors so far. He worries more than the students sometimes about their grades and is very clear. His class is challenging, but if you use the resources he gives you, the class is not a problem at all. He makes O. Chem super interesting and cuts out all the unnecessary material. Would recommend.
Dr. Chang is extremely approachable and eager to help his students be as prepared as possible for everything that comes at them. His course was wonderful!

Great professor, very tough class. O-chem is difficult, but prof. Chang is by far the best professor to take at OSU, he offers the most extra credit, and he cares a ton about his students and making sure they understand the material. He also provides lots of extra materials (problem sets, notes, etc.) to give students ample tools to study with.

Chang is super helpful and a very good professor. If you attend lectures and do all the recitation problem sets and HW you will receive a fair grade in his class. He gives a lot of opportunities for bonus points and runs the class well.

Okay, so I didn't do well. I got a C+, but I had to do a lot of extra credit to get it. This guy challenged me and made me work my butt off. If I studied more, I'm sure I could have gotten an A. He's sometimes hard to understand but always makes sure to correct himself to get his message across. Cool guy, and he sometimes stressed more than we did.

Funny nice guy, but his Midterms are RIDICULOUS. honestly i would drop out of his class and try another teacher. Our class averages were in the 40-50% and the other organic chemistry teacher was in the 70-80%

Dr Chang is Awesome. His lectures are very thorough and in-depth. His exams and quizzes are difficult but he provides his old tests and quizzes which we HAVE to do in order to succeed. His lecture notes are way more important than the book.

Excellent professor who is always willing to help. His midterms are tough but if you work hard on his materials, you will do perfectly fine. Make sure you score his extra credit opportunities in which you'll be required to correct his 'lecture mistakes'. Don't be surprised that these bonus points will boost your final grade.

Dr. Chang is a great professor. He really cares about his students and their success in his class. The material is very tough but he explains it as clearly as possible, do the problem sets and study his notes front and back and you will do great!
Great professor who really cares about his students! Very willing to help. His office hours are very helpful and lectures are definitely worth attuning. Overall great professor!

Dr. Chang is very well organized and a funny guy. I would have really liked him as a professor if it weren't for two major shortcomings. Dr. Chang goes WAY TOO FAST in lectures. He is very hard to keep up with if you take notes, making it hard to learn from his lectures. He also often overestimates the learning ability of students

Dr. Chang was a VERY good professor for ochem. He was super approachable and it was obvious he cared about his students and how they were doing in the class. His exams were hard, but completely fair. He also had a lot of opportunities for us to get extra credit, which was super helpful!
He is a very nice and approachable professor, and has a very organized set up to his class. his notes are very helpful and clear.

Very helpful teacher. Makes things clear and easy to understand. Exams are fair and similar to practice exams. Attendance is recommended. He gives you descriptions on what he expects you to know for the exams. I was never good at Chemistry, but I was able to do well in this class.
Such a good professor! He's very helpful and his exams are extremely fair. Just STUDY! If you don't study organic chem and get a poor grade it's your own fault, especially in his class.

Dr. Chang is a great lecturer. He repeats things more than once, and he is very helpful during office hours. Do all of his problem sets multiple times before exams, and study for the recommended amount of time (15 hours per week). The exams are hard, but very doable. Just know your material!!!
Great instructor, works hard to explain the material.

Seems to teach in a round about way, but pretty clear overall.  His exams will frequently have little easy to miss trip ups such as a negative sign. Exam 3 was unreasonable as it was a multiple choice where you would answer one question and the next 3 would depend on that answer. No partial credit given.

Dr. Chang is definitely an accessible professor; he answers emails and stays after class to answer questions. His tests are very difficult. However, he does teach by the book & lectures slides. To get an A, read the book, know the slides, know the notes, and be able to answer end of chapter questions in the book. Hardest examples appear on exams!

Chang is awesome. He is very interesting in lecture and makes jokes. His tests are hard, but if you take the time to study you'll be fine. Lecture is not mandatory. I skipped over half the lectures and still got above average on every exam.

Dr. Chang is a great professor: he teaches the material very well and really cares about all of his students. If you put in hard work, keep up with the material, and ask questions you will do very well in his class. His exams are very fair and going to lecture will really help you succeed on his exams.
Funny lecturer, but the first exam was quite hard. Later, he made the exam easier to help the grade. He's a fan of Buckeye's too!
Hard class, but Dr Chang does his best to make it easy. Willing to go the extra mile to help students comprehend the material.

Dr. Chang is a great professor.  He is genuinely interested in helping you and came to class prepared and organized.  His notes were easy to follow and clear.  He is not necessarily easy, but if you pay attention to what he tells you will be on the test you will do fine.  I never once cracked the text book and did well in his class.

One of the best profs I've ever had. OSU should hire more people like Dr. Chang who really cares about students. I worked 2 jobs to pay for my tuition and I feel my money is worth it because this guy cares about the course. If you just want to get an easy grade, he is not your option. If you really wanna learn, I'd rec him.

Really passionate about the class and is super nice! Theres a big curve because his exams are hard. but if you go to lecture and complete aleks and utilize CE 160 for labs you will be golden no matter how you do on your tests.

Chang is a good teacher, but it's very hard to get an A in this class. You must go to class every day and take notes, he'll give you hints in class for tests so make sure to pay attention. Overall good teacher, just a difficult class.

A very difficult class, but a great professor. Always willing and wanting to help his students succeed. Often criticized for having outrageous tests that are impossible to study for. It's true his tests are difficult, but he tells you precisely what to study and tests off his notes. It's really not that hard to know what will be on it.

Very helpful professor! Gives many example problems in class and keeps that class interesting and durable. Often times he stars questions which will be on the midterms/final and overall lets you know what you need to know. Great professor. Very helpful. Would definitely recommend to take

He is a nice guy and I enjoyed his lectures. However, you never know what is going to be on the exams. The practice exams are 100% easier than the real one and he puts every exception possible. When he says that a question will be on a midterm, exactly, prepare for one with half the information missing. I would not take another class with him.

Overall a great teacher. Very devoted to his work and interested in seeing his students succeed. Bottom line, if you put the effort forth to pass, you will. If you think you can coast by and rely on the curve, you may get lucky and pass but your GPA will more than likely suffer. Study his practice midterms and finals,  some q's in exact format!

This was probably one of the hardest classes I've taken at OSU but Dr. Chang was easily one of the best professors I've EVER had.  I learned so much from his class and his enthusiasm and love for teaching and chemistry were beyond infectious.  He was extremely clear and taught extremely well!

Dr. Chang was very enthusiastic about his job, and the labs, quizzes, and Aleks were great tools in learning the material. However, there was no way to prepare for exams as the online practices were 100% different. The midterms and finals were very difficult. I would recommend going to lecture even though he is hard to understand.

Very nice guy.  Hard to understand and no way to prepare for the midterms and finals.  Do aleks.  The quizzes are easy and so are the labs if you try.  Just try your best on the midterms and finals and know ever exception to every trend.  I recommend doing the problems within each chapter of the book to see if you know the main idea.

The guy's hilarious and enthusiastic about his subject. Format the information's presented in isn't very helpful. Quizzes are easy, midterms are pretty tough and very different from the online practice, lots of minute details, but they're also curved a ton. as long as you prepare for the labs they're not bad and not much work outside of labs.

Yiiiikes! To my fellow pre-med majors I wish you well. He is a rough test maker and will have midterms averaging around 50%. His lectures are incredibly hard to follow, though I would recommend going as much as you can stand. If you can avoid DO IT, but you may be able to fight through it.

Chang is an awful lecturer. Going to lecture is rather pointless. You basically end up trying to figure out what all of the test and quiz questions will be in order to pass instead of actually learning anything (since he can't articulate himself very well). I love chemistry, but listening to Chang's lecture made me reconsider being a science major.
Dr. Chang is the most organized professor I have ever had. He is always well-prepared for lectures. I would highly recommend him.

He is very knowledgeable in chemistry, but he has a difficult time articulating his thoughts in English.  He doesn't know how to explain things in a way for students to understand.  I had a hard time understanding basic concepts with him.

Dr Chang is absolutely terrible.  I attended every lecture, took good notes, studied frequently, and still found myself struggling with everything in the class.  Chemistry took up so much of my time and forced me to focus less on other classes.  I now hate the subject and refuse to take any more related courses.

Can't stand anything about this course, one of the main reasons being Dr. Chang.  When you aren't hurrying to finish the extremely difficult labs, you're studying aimlessly to understand what hasn't been taught to you.  Avoid this at all costs.

Kind of hard to understand his accent, went kind of quickly through difficult mechanisms. Posts ppts online, but still has blanks on them even if not covered in class. A little easier than 245 though. Try to get a clearer speaking prof if possible; Chang was only option for summer lab.
Very difficult. 1/3 of students don't pass every quarter, I was one of them- so watch out!!

Good Professor.  His notes and lecture slides are your study guide.  Sometimes uses example from lecture in his quizzes and midterms.  Very tough midterms. Average was a 53% on Midterm I.  Work hard, study hard, go to lecture, do a lot of practice problems, and you will do well in his class.

Very good professor.  For 122 his notes are your life.  Does tons of problems on board and is very helpful during office hours. GO TO LECTURE, a little hard to understand sometimes, but overall very good.  Tells you exactly what types of problems will be on tests and quizzes.

Dr. Chang is a nice and helpful professor. He usually just reads his notes in class, so you can just get the same information online and not have to attend lecture, especially if you're familiar with the material. The exams and quizzes were unpleasant, so it would've been nice if he had homework grades to balance those out.

Dr. Chang is a very nice guy who is genuinely interested in chemistry, although he does not make a good professor at all.  His quizzes and tests are absolutely impossible and his lectures are not helpful.

Dr Chang is a good and very intelligent man. However, the class was incredibly difficult. I ended up with 2 A's the quarter, and I got a C- in this one. There is a reason why the Chem department at OSU is notorious. Simply put, this class is hard, and the tests are impossible.

He's a nice guy. Kind of hard to follow during his lectures, b/c he literally FLIES through his powerpoints...if you prepare for his lectures and review after lectures, it will help alot. so definately spend lot of time for his class..first midterm's avg was 55%

Nice guy, horrible lecturer. He literally reads directly from prepared power points. Rarely does he work out a problem on the board. Take anyone else for 122. This was his first quarter teaching, so maybe he will get better. You will need to read the book if you take him. I recommend doing all the problems and self tests to help you learn.

Dr. Chang is nice, but that's where the pluses end. He's very insensitive and completely ruled by his superiors. His teaching style is not helpful at all and his exams and quizzes are impossible. OSU's chem department sucks, and this prof is no exception.
Dr. Chang is a super nice guy but honestly, I learned more reading the book and doing the problems on my own than from lecture.  Exams and quizzes are really, really hard.

Dr. Chang means well, but definitely hasn't grasped the ability to teach well at all.  You absolutely have to print slides even if you usually take notes because he moves through them so fast.  His quizzes are hard and exams are nothing like the practice exams.  First avg was a 47%.  He gives you no time to absorb what he "teaches" at you.

Dr. Chang is a terrible professor. He doesn't make any sense and his teaching style makes it useless to attend lecture.  He has weekly quizzes, which are hard, and midterms that are impossible.  I mean only 4 people out of 230 got above a 69 percent.  Unless you were born as a general chemistry prodigy, you won't do well. Zellmer is much better.

Dr. Chang is very friendly and explains concepts and problems well.  He is also helpful when he comes through lab.  His exams are very difficult - the class average for the first exam was a 46.  However as a lecturer, he is very good and helpful.
Very professinal, amiable, very entertaining. Enjoyed lecture. Difficult exams, but nothing unreasonable.

Very exam heavy and your grade depends on tests. Exams are highly application based and don't match learning goals well. Hard if you're not a strong test taker. Exams aren't released and lectures aren't recorded, making it difficult to improve. Slides aren't very helpful.

I took this course my first semester at OSU as a pre-req for the CON. Her lectures were interesting and often funny, but she powered through them really quickly and focused a lot on topics that she then proceeded to not have on the exam, while concepts that had maybe one slide were foundational. READ THE BOOK and REVIEW EVERY SLIDE/NOTE TO STUDY
Funny lecturer, has good info on the slides that are given, hard to understand sometimes, tests are difficult, online homework is hard to get 100%
The class was hard and very fast paced but if you study well its a earned A

Dr. C's exams can be nearly impossible, and she pulls the most random concepts to test us on. The average for our final was a 62.8%. NO CURVES (ever). Go to class, you get TopHat points and have in-class activities. She's a nice woman, but speeds through lectures. Class is not weighted, so try to get every point you can. She was an okay prof.

Really cares about her students learning and is very knowledgeable about biology. If you go to class, take good notes, and do a lot of review before exams, you should be fine. The lab is very tedious though so try to get all the points you can in there. Get a good lab group! No curves on the exams though with difficult questions.
Speeds through lectures, then exam topics are 10x more complex and were covered for 1 slide max. Exams are horrendously hard, with class average being in the 60's. Homework will take minimum 2 hours.

I felt her lectures were beneficial along with the in class activities. You receive easy points by showing up and completing TopHat questions, so I would recommend going to class. She also points out important things to know and the TopHat questions are a good guide to study. Mastering biology was very difficult and for accuracy.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Nice professor. The class is pretty easy as long as you study.

Exams are difficult but doable if review all the slides, MasteringBiology, InClassActivity, TopHat. TopHat questions will be doable if you attend lectures and listen. PLTL is a 100% offered full and free credits and will be fun if you love debating and 2 drops for absence. Extra credits are easy to gain. Lab quiz is doable if review the lab manuals

Exams are difficult but it is doable, review slides, MasteringBiology, tophat, and InClassActivities. PLTL is interesting for people who like debating, points are easy to get and 2 drops for absence. TopHat questions will be easy to get correct once you attend lectures. Lab quiz will be doable if you read through the lab manual and 1 drop.

Horrible! DO NOT TAKE HER! I never make reviews but I had to for her. She speeds through lectures giving you slides that briefly explain the concepts and although attendance is not mandatory for lecture she still made tophats, I was ok with the tophats but you only get the points if you got the questions right and they were such complex questions.

Exams are harder than lecture slides. Expects you to know the material before class, as TopHat questions are difficult and you only get the points if you are correct. Rushed through lectures. No curve on the final exam with a low D average. PLTL is a waste of time, it's easy points though. Not difficult material, but she makes it hard to get an A.

She doesn't always explain concepts well. While attendance isn't mandatory, she uses TopHat during lecture for points. There is a lot of extra credit built into the class. Exams are a huge part of the grade but aren't unbearable. Study using the textbook because that's where she pulls material from. She's a funny lecturer but her class is tough.
Expects you to know materiel when you come to class. Will use TopHat and you only get credit if you get it right

Terrible at conveying material and the exams don't really reflect the slides (plus the slides barely have anything on them). Study study study for the exams though and you should be fine. Lots of other points aside from exams though which really helps your grade. Big group project at the end so get a good lab group.

She taught this class with Professor Danhart. The hardest part was the lab because it kind of had strict grading. In lectures, they teach, ask a tophat question, keep teaching, and sometimes give in-class activities. Exams are based on lectures, tophat, and the activities. Exams basically determine your grade by the end, so study and you'll be fine

If you have to take this class, she is a great professor and really funny, makes lectures entertaining. Biology is not my thing so I didn't like it, but she is a good professor and the lab instructors were really great.

This course was okay it was very difficult for me trying to keep up. We had to do a final presentation and final exam. The TA's were a little difficult to work with, overall the class is okay. The lecture is not mandatory, but you should go for TopHat points they help in the end.

This class was very difficult for me. I had a difficult time with the professor and TA. The exams are super hard but the tophat extra credit helped. Do not skip lectures, you will probably need the extra credit

She was a great professor, we had 2 midterms before the final, she only graded attendance through the tophat questions and had 20 extra credit tophat questions, so you could miss a few. You were allowed to miss one lecture without documentation but more than that you need documentation or its an automatic fail. overall pretty good class. 1113>1110
Make sure to study the tophat questions before exams. They are tricky, but as long as you attend class and study you should be fine.

The labs and exams are the things that determine your grade the most, as well as the top hat extra credit. If you get a good TA you are lucky. The first exam was not bad, second did not go as well but the final made up for it, as well as the extra credit you get from top hat. I enjoyed this class, definitely requires alot of time outside of class.

Dr. C was a good professor. Her exams were extremely hard and this class took a lot of studying. The lab that goes with it can be terrible or great all depending on the TA you get!! If you have a bad TA transfer to a different lab section as fast as you can because lab will greatly impact your final grade.

Honestly her class was unnecessarily hard. I studied for 27 hours for an exam with all of her lecture notes and study guides only for none of it to be useful on the exam. You have to go to lectures because she uses TopHat worth points for attendance. I would never take her again if I had the choice but will probably have to retake it in the spring.

I do not know why she is rated so low, yes her lectures were very long, BUT she went into detail with her lectures. Her lectures, activities, and homework helped prepare me for the final exam which I got a 114/120, and I am someone who struggles with science. Great professor! The lab TA (Eric) is also amazing, hard grader though. Nothing but good!

Though the lectures were long, I think she did the best she could to keep the material engaging and gave us lots of opportunities to earn extra points in her class with TopHat. Be sure to read the textbook and use the study guides, those are super helpful! The most difficult part of the class was the labs because they were graded too meticulously.

The class isn’t hard but she’s basically the worst. Labs are busywork and she is probably the least helpful professor at the university. Nothing in lecture has anything to do w labs and she grades so harshly on things she says not to spend too much time on. So much homework for no reason, feels like she wants to make the class harder than it is

Dr. Cubonova was an okay professor. I thought that the lectures were boring and dragged on. There is a lab once a week and the labs were very hard and made up a good part of your grade. You have to show up to class for the tophat questions and LPs. There are 3 midterms (a final), weekly homework, pre labs and labs.

Honestly, if you do all the work in this class and study a bit for exams you can get an A. Her midterms were pretty difficult, but I studied by reading the book and her lecture slides and did well. Weekly home and quizzes, but neither were too time consuming.

Attend class because TopHat is graded. Lectures were fast-paced but had all the info you needed for the exam, I recommend reviewing after class. Review tophats before an exam. reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring--LECTURE HEAVY

This class was crazy hard. No way around it. Good luck if you have to take this class. The prof is nice and tries to make lecture interesting, but the exams are hard and worth most of your grade. Study for weeks before in order to pass, go to lecture, read your textbook
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

Dr. Cole is my favorite professor in the Animal Science department! Her classes can be tough, but if you show up and participate, you'll understand the material. She's understanding if you try your best, and her TAs are incredibly kind and helpful. Highly recommend her class!

Great Professor!!!!

Great teacher! I highly recommend her!

When taking either 341 or 201 with her just remember that she is a busy person. It is difficult to get in touch with her. Seems to be nice and fun at first but has a temper and will turn and become extremely rude. Can be diffifult to get along with. Her degree is in poulty research and her horse knowledge is good on paper, her practical application of that knowledge is lacking.

awesome

As long as you complete the labs, read the course notes, and do the weekly quiz, this class is an easy A and the exams really are not that challenging either.

It is a very easy class if you do the work and practice the material. For the exams, the practice exam is just like the exams you take. Review that and you will get a 100 on each one.
Don't take this professor - take another one. course is good but prof is not. she will make your life miserable and is of no help when you have questions

Clair is a good lecturer, goes step by step over everything.  Lacks a little bit of personality, but if you can stay awake this class is very easy.

Clair Farris does a really good job with lectures and explaining everything step by step. After class she is always willing to answer any questions and for the labs, go on the zoom office hours. did not answer any emals

Great lectures that helped me understand the concepts better. There is labs that take a good amount of time but arent too difficult if you watch the lectures and read course notes. The exams were pretty easy and straightforward. Plenty of opportunities to get extra help.

I loved Clair so much. Has a lot of time allotted for office hours and truly cares about students' success. Friendly lady and very knowledgeable in Excel and Access. Class was pretty hard for the first couple of weeks but it all came together!
