reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: He is a very kind and generous professor who truly cares about his students and engages with them in an amazing way. I would take another course with him in a heartbeat. He made learning really fun, and I am now very interested in a topic I was actually intimidated by in the beginning.

Very lenient grader and will sitll mark you present if you come late to class as long as you put in effort. Lectures can be dry but he is a nice guy. Grades are based on attendance, weekly discussion boards/readings, one midterm, one non-cumulative final, one group project, and only one homework assignment.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I had this professor for Statistics in Sociology and he was great, so I was surprised by this class. Tests have 4 short answer questions (100+ words each) and 2 extended response questions (400-600 words each) and 90 minutes is allotted. There are no passes given for attendance and you learn all the information from research articles he provides.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Great professor, I had to retake this class from taking it with Adam Long. The class is set in a much more digestible fashion. Less tests, more well rounded tests, and more realistic expectations. I only got a C plus but getting an A in this class is definitely plausible if you can retain information from readings better.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Professor Zheng was one of my favorite professors I have ever had! He is so knowledgeable about so many different areas of sociology and is always willing to explain difficult concepts. There aren't a lot of assignments and he is a very lenient grader.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I'm genuinely confused by the ratings I have seen on here for Dr. Harmon. I took her 2200 MEB class, and she was extremely kind to all of her students and was always accessible after class to ask questions and offered additional professional advice. Her lectures seemed straightforward to me, and the class is 10x easier if you just show up.

Unfortunately, Dr. Harmon made a class with concepts that could be easily understood ten times harder. Her teaching style was near impossible to understand and I ended up teaching myself all of the content before exams. She also does not give clear directions on homework assignments of the portfolio (30% of the grade) leading to missed points.

Dr Harmon would lecture on a topic and not explain 90% of what was needed to understand what was being discussed. The requirements for homework and the final portfolio were also not very well explained where I had no idea what was needed in order to get a good grade in the class. She is extremely nice but she doesn't explain the topics very well.

For the sake of future students I hope that she can learn how to teach effectively. She is caring, but the issue is during lectures she gets nervous and half of the words she says are just filler. If she worked on explaining things concisely with helpful information, her lectures could be better. Exams shouldn't cover material not learned in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very sweet, made the broad scope of some pretty complex topics somewhat enjoyable- would take again.

Comp methods does not need to be as confusing as Dr. Harmon makes it seem. It would help so much if she explained the topics beforehand in simple terms and then expand upon them, but instead she just dives into the complicated content. I was expecting to learn Python (and was looking forward to it), but this course is mostly just math by hand.

Starting off, Dr. Harmon is very kind and energetic. However, her teaching style is not the kind for anybody. Her ways just don't click; she uses a lot of filler words and goes on tangents. It doesn't seem like she speaks with a purpose, and she doesn't simplify the concepts AT ALL. Whenever I walk out of class, nobody has a clue on what's going on

Dr. Harmon is one of the nicest people I've met, but when it comes to having her for a class, watch out. I don't think I have learned one single thing from her this semester and I mean that. She makes stuff way more confusing than it has to be. Also exams are a time crunch and she doesn't help with questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Terrible lecturer despite how nice of a person she may seem to be. Does not seem to understand the material herself 90% of the time and confused the entire class. Gets derailed easily by questions asked during lecture and will spend the entire lecture trying to explain her answer (that she doesn't fully understand.)
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: One of my favorite professors in the chemical engineering program at Ohio State. Her enthusiasm for the class was evident and made coming to class fun and enjoyable. Homework assignments could be corrected for full credit, which was awesome. Exams were fair and I felt well-prepared for all of them. Take her kinetics class if you have the chance!

If you can choose to have Dr. Harmon you should. She was very helpful with homework, exams and anything in between. She allowed for correction on homework that you messed up on for full credit which helped learn the difficult coursework of kinetics.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr Hashamova is greatly interested in the material she teaches, students are encouraged to interact with word and film alike to explore topics. For an online course, there was a good level of interaction with the instructor and other students. I would recommend if this fits your degree plan.

This class was great. Not too much work but I feel like I did learn a lot about Russia. Most of the assignments are watching Russian movements/reading short stories or going though presentations and taking quizzes on them.

Directions for quizzes are simple and she keeps things short. The class itself is really interesting. The media (movies) required for the course is entertaining but be ready to read. At first glance the readings seem daunting but the quiz that follows is usually easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Inspirational--Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Frau Heck is really a great professor who cares about her students. The class isn't much work and is pretty easy as long as you do what you're supposed to.
The sweetest woman ever. Cares about every person in the class. There was a good bit of homework and the class was difficult but she always helps you when needed you just have to ask.
Such an interesting professor and so kind as well. If I could take every German class with her, I would-I feel like I learned so much. She is incredibly patient and helpful. The best.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: I took a german class with Frau Heck in SP25, I loved her so much ! She is the second teacher I have ever written a rate my professor review for. She is so kind but she wants you to learn so she will push you to learn and also she would bring gummy bears and chocolate wafers to class. She teaches in a fun way. I loved the class and I love her!

Frau Heck is very kind and is willing to help her students. She has high standards for her students and is tough with grading. Her teaching is quite fast-paced however, I learned quite a few new grammar topics in this course. I recommend her as a teacher and this class is not too difficult as long as you do the work and put in effort.
Really fun and helpful professor.

Super sweet and caring woman, but she gives SO much busy work as assignments. It's really annoying after a while. Her teaching style reminds me of a grade school foreign language class. If you are in a 3000-level German class, you obviously (or should) know a thing or two about the language, but she acts like you need to be taught things 1000 times

Frau Heck is the best Professor I've ever had, on or out of the department. If you want to pass the class you almost definitely will. She is almost always in her office when not teaching, and is very easy to access. She is very understanding, if you're having problems and just shoot her an email she will almost definitely help you out. Love her!

Frau Heck truly is a kind and caring professor; however, she does not make 2102 easy. There's lots of homework each night, and she is a really tough grader, as she often takes lots of points off for small mistakes. She is extremely willing to offer help when you are struggling though, and genuinely cares about you and your performance in the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Frau Heck is the greatest professor that I've ever had. She genuinely cares about those who take her class and she will do anything to see that you succeed. The work load is not too crazy and she understands that sometimes you can't get to an assignment because you have other things going on. 10/10 would definitely take one of her classes again.

Frau Heck is literally the best. She's a great teacher in as sense that she can get her point across to anyone. She's also super easy to talk to which makes getting help a breeze. I love that she pushes you to see your potential. I consistently look for her classes when scheduling. Couldnt imagine the German dept. without her. She's such a gem.
The best teacher here in the department. Clear and logical lecture, always willing to help. Quizzes and Homework always prepare you better for the tests and learning language.
Frau Heck is the absolute best! She is great at being clear and speaking slow which is so important in foreign language acquisition! Very caring towards students.
She's honestly the best teacher I've had at Ohio State. She really cares about the students and helping them to succeed.
Love Frau Heck 3 i missed class multiple times and she was always extremely willing to meet with me outside of class and help out. She genuinely wants you to learn and succeed.
A little eccentric, but in a badass grandma sort of way. Very good teacher and very willing to work with students outside of class.

She's amazing. I've had Frau Heck since I came to school freshman year and she's become like a mentor to me. She is always there for you and loves what she does. She's a little kooky, but it gives her character and she has an amazing personality. Love this woman to death!

A very knowledgeable and helpful professor. If she knows you can do better than you're giving her, though, she'll try to push you to be better. A very caring woman and fun to shoot the breeze with. Also very helpful to talk to if you just need clarification on something. Always willing to talk.

sweet girl, BUT WOW IS SHE A TOUGH PROFESSOR TO HAVE. We have over 15 assignments per week and then a full exam every 3 weeks. And these exams are NOT easy. You cant just study for 45 minutes, memorize the terms and take it. You basically got to pretend like you're teaching somebody the class. And this class is for non-bio majors? yeah right

It is currently the week of Thanksgiving not only did she give the same amount of workload but she gave more. She is a very detailed professor who expects you to give not only just as much time but give more time than you would for an in person class. This is a 4-credit hour course and the work load can be 5+ hours a week in my opinion.

EXTREMELY difficult exams that do not match learning objectives. Be prepared to get a poor grade even after preparing 20 thorough pages of notes using her posted learning objectives. The exam average grades are always so low as well.

I took this class online, get ready to study but the professor is amazing and understanding. You have many chances of getting a higher grade so if you get a lower grade on the first exam you have a chance of getting it up

This class is a majorly about your exam grades. There were 5 exams in one semester? The exam questions were way more difficult than the study guide posted or homework from previous weeks. The averages on the exams were always very low which is concerning considering they are 'open note'. Way too much busy work. Required online discussion groups.

I took this class online. Easy class to pass. There is a good amount of assignments but it is not overwhelming. Due to the amount of assignments they really carry your grade. Only complaint I have is the tests are hard but open notes. You think you know the material but then you go into the test and the questions are worded weirdly.

Exams can be difficult but she goes back and sees what the most missed and such are and usually gives back points. There are many assignments though, so as long as you complete lecture activities and homework well then your grade won't be terrible. She also did graded discussions, which were free points as long as you tried and participated.

You have to be in class if you want to learn anything. If you prefer to do work alone, this class isn't for you as you are constantly working with a partner. Learning definitions won't work; you need to understand how parts of the body function/how they function in specific scenarios. Midterm questions are very abstract and confusing.

such a kind soul! dr. herrmann is genuinely so sweet and wants nothing but the best for her students. she is so supporting and genuinely eager to see her students do well. great at answering questions! lots of lecture though!

This class is hard, lots of work, & requires lots of studying. Memorization won't work, so make sure you know the material. Watch the lecture videos & take notes on all the assignments. Exams are difficult (there are 5 of them). She is very smart & is good at teaching the material. Just pay attention, actually put in effort, and you'll be fine!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: This professor believes her class is the only one at the University. She requires you participate in an enormous amount of homework. Her test are extremely EXTREMELY abstract. Memorization will not work in this course. You will need to understand an explain what she is teaching. Be prepared to put in a lot of time. Takes away from major

Lectures are boring and too much Tophat. She simplifies everything down too much. You could spend an entire class talking about one calculation. Her tests have confusing wording, so even if you know the concept you could get the question wrong. Talked to her a couple times and didnt seem like she cared about fair grading. Have had better profs.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Good professor, lectures are important and theres a ton of TopHat to keep you engaged. Her tests are worded confusingly at times but overall its not too difficult, especially if you study the lecture slides (which are online but omit key words/phrases that you can get from going to lecture, or lecture capture on Carmen). Some grade-boosters too!!

Dr. Herrmann is a good professor and you can learn a lot. Attendance and participation are taken daily via Tophat. Her lecture slides are posted online but she omits key phrases and terms making attendance a necessity.

Good class. Bio is hard but overall if you put in the work you can do well. More points are given in Lab than in lecture and/or tests. Kill the labs and easy assignments you should be fine. Only complaint i have is the wording on her tests can be very confusing. Other than that a good prof! I would recommend.

Dr. Herrmann is an outstanding professor. Her lectures are always interesting, her tests are not too difficult if you study for them, and she provides many opportunities to earn points outside of tests. I have never had a professor who is so genuinely excited to teach, and as passionate about their subject as Dr. Herrmann is- she's fantastic!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Awesome prof. You have to go to the lecture to get the content but her lectures are interesting and hobby quickly because they aren't boring. Also, she's pretty funny. Will meet with you outside of class to talk about grades or just whatever. If you have to take this class, take it from her.

Pay attention in class and take notes and this class is not hard at all. There is very little homework outside of class, and lectures are really good and easy to sit through. If you put in a little effort into the class and study, you'll enjoy this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Sam is super smart and is by far my favorite professor, but she is so difficult. You cannot simply slide by in this class. Attendance is mandatory (graded by TopHat, which is both for participation and actual credit, so good luck), and she flies by with her PowerPoints. Smartest lady I've ever met, hardest science class I've taken.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Students love her. She genuinely makes an effort to know her students. Quality discussion in class. Grading can be tough, but that's definitely more to the TA's credit, not hers. Conveys material in a light, conversational, intriguing manner: encouraging discussion, including real world examples and the occasional video. Would definitely recommend.
Unclear grading criteria (would always take points off for the silliest things), unnecessarily difficult tests and quizzes, not accessible outside of class, just no.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Her lectures are ridiculously long.
She is inflexible and rule oriented. Directions are unclear and she is unwilling to work with you.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Hard grader, not flexible or willing to work with you! You have to pay an extra fee to take the midterm and final at home even though it is an online class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: She's a great teacher, however this class will not be an easy A. She makes you work for every grade you receive. If you show up, you will do fine as long as you pay attention, which isn't hard to do because she is a fine woman.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Dr. Herrmann loves her students and is super passionate about what she does. The course coordinator makes the class 10x harder than what it needs to be. Gives a lot of easy test questions but you'd only know the answer if you went to class. You have to understand concepts, not just memorize stuff. Hard class but she makes it great.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: She's a great lecturer because she keeps things simple and clear. She provides Powerpoints with some blanks, so it's easy to take notes. One odd thing was she made her final harder than the previous 2 exams by filling it with tons of trick questions! So that wasn't cool, but overall I enjoyed having her and the class was easy enough.
She's nice.  She is not very helpful though. Your grade will not be based off of whether or not you know the content.
Very personable. Really cares if you understand the material and if you don't understand, she will sit there and help you until you do.

Dr. Herrmann is a very passionate and knowledge professor. She has a great personality  and makes the class fun. However, the course coordinator makes the class harder than it should be for a entry level biology class. The questions on the exams are not straight forward. With this being said, you have to take what you learned in class and apply it.
One of the best professors so far.

Very intelligent and easy to talk to! Great personality and sense of humor! This course involves a lot of time, especially for the project portion. There is so much information covered which made studying for exams difficult especially since there was no list provided as to what to even specifically study.  Definitely not an easy A.
No help at all. Her tests are difficult. She doesn't give out study guides. She goes through lecture notes way too fast. Would not recommend for future students

She's one of the coolest professors I've had. She goes pretty fast during lecture but if you ask her to stop and explain something she will. Don't have anything bad to say except that you definitely wanna study for tests. Expected to end the class with a C and got an A-. Go to class/recitatation it will definitely boost your grade a lot in the end
One of my favorite professors! She's so chill and funny and really cares about the students. She will teach whatever the students are most interested in. A lot of grades so very easy to get an A.

Honestly, take her class even if you don't like science/ biology. take it even if its hard. I promise you you will enjoy it. There are a few movies that you have to watch for recitation which takes up a lot of time but the movies were very interesting except one. Lecture felt like it was really short, maybe because she's such an amazing teacher

I've never seen any teachers/professors like her. (In a good way) her classes are pretty interesting although biology is my worst subject. There are at least 3 movies you have to watch and it takes a lot of time, also a group project. I feel like her tests aren't really that hard if you studied and prepare yourself well.

Definitely one of my favorite professors. She knows a lot about biology and is truly passionate about what she is teaching. Tests are tough, but if you pay attention in class and study, it's not bad. She makes lectures really interesting and bases them off of what students are interested in. Not much outside work, but a group project and one paper.
I love Prof. Herrmann. She makes class interesting and enjoyable. Although her tests are difficult, if you pay attention, go to class, and study, you'll be fine.

She is by far my favorite professor. You can tell she actually cares about our opinions and teaches us material that we want to know more about. Her lectures are hilarious and really interesting. Tests are a little tough but there's plenty of other points offered in the class that will help boast your grade.

She's  a very nice person, and clearly cares about her students. Her tests are extremely difficult, but there is enough other assignments given where you should be able to save your grade as long as you go to class. I enjoy her lectures, but I do not think the tests are worth it.

Pretty tough grader, but very nice! There's a ton of extra credit, so if you do them all then a good grade should be easy to achieve. She goes through the PPTS really fast - so I would suggest bringing your computer to class. Gives PPTS ahead of time, just have to fill in the blanks. Tests are pretty tricky but don't have to buy the book!

This class was definitely challenging. You have to work hard to get a good grade. The instructor was really nice and really helpful! She does go through material a little quickly but is always willing to slow to down if need be. Tests are tricky. I would definitely recommend not waiting until the last minute to study. Does give extra credit often!

As long as you go to class and pay attention this class is really easy and she is really nice! The final exam is just questions that have been on previous midterms she couldn't make it much easier to get an A in this class especially because there is always extra credit available.

Very polite and down to earth. Will answer any and all questions.....  Bad news is she flies through slides too fast and her tests make you want to put your head in a grinder. She covers material decently but the test questions are tricky and hard. TESTS ARE HARD. GRADING IS HARD. Find another instructor if possible. Do not take this class...
GREAT teacher! She takes her time to explain fine details of a topic you're confused about until you get it! Physiology is a hard topic but she makes it easier to understand. Wish she taught a class!
She is a nice person but this course is difficult. If you want a high GPA, do not attend this BIO1102
Very helpful on what to put on exams.
She was wonderful! There were great class discussions and everything was very hands on. Oh, and she's not hard on the eyes!

I wish he taught more undergrad courses. His delivery is interesting, and he'll often include supporting context from current or historical events to motivate. He manages the material very well for a course with such broad footing.

Professor Hwang is very unintentionally (?) funny, and cares a lot about students. come up to him if you have issues. Only one homework this year, and 5 quizzes with two dropped. TAs were harsh graders.Waiting on final so expect B- to B+ for me.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Hwang is a great lecturer and his homework and exams were fair. The exam questions were similar to the homework, and he lets you have a one sided cheat sheet with anything you want. Make a good cheat sheet, redo the homework and you'll do well. I loved his jokes that came out of nowhere and how down to earth he was.

Professor Jinwoo is a clear public speaker. He teaches like a physicist, refreshingly. The content in Transport Phenomena is not difficult, compared to the companion MATSCEN3141 (Phase Transformations). There are no makeup examinations. There were about 100 students in one section, which strikes me as insane for a junior-level class.

Dr Allen teaches the lectures as if you already know them. If you like masochism, take Dr Allen's class. I had to single-handedly teach myself Chem 1220. I studied for 14 hours straight on multiple occasions due to the lack of actual teaching in lectures. So, long story short, if you want to learn everything but what's on the exam, pick Dr Allen.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: If you enjoy learning everything but whats on your exam, this is the class for you. Skip or go to class, doesn't matter you'll get the same grade. The only hope you have is another professors lecture. If you enjoy pointless busywork, go ahead and take this class. Some people sign up for a GPA boost, but if thats not you then this is your class.

I went to her lectures for the first 2 weeks and learned nothing. She goes in-depth with all the easy topics and skips the hard ones. Going to lecture does nothing to prepare you for the exam. If you want to teach this class to yourself, take Heather Allen. If you have to take her, read the textbook and watch Dr. Fus videos.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Allen does not know how to teach this class. She told us during the first lecture she hasn't taught Chem 1220 in a while, and that is very clear. She teaches us as though we know it already and she is just doing review. She doesn't explain why things happen, she gives us a formula and moves on. You will be teaching yourself outside of class.

No matter which professor you have for chem 1220, it's going to be a hard class. Dr. Allen does a good job explaining the material, especially in office hours. She's very nice and willing to help students. If you want to do well in the class, read the textbook before lecture, and go to office hours after lecture.

I feel bad for giving her a bad review because she is genuinely a nice lady. I just think she could do a better job at lecturing. She is very dry and not engaging, but it could be worse. I skipped many classes and found it easy to catch up because she posted her slides online.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Lots of people hate on Allen, but shes not that bad. The class is meant to be difficult and she does her part in teaching the material. If you want to do well you have to read the book outside of class and study a lot. Not her fault that Chem 1220 is hard.

Professor Allen is one of the worst professors I've had. I can tell that she is passionate about chemistry, but she has limited knowledge about 1220 and often does not know how to answer or explain exam questions. Lectures are dry and unhelpful. If you have her, you're better off skipping lecture to study or going to Dr. Fus's lecture instead.

Dr. Heather Allen is probably one of the worst professors I have ever come into contact with. She goes over negligible material in class. I would recommend skipping lecture and using that time to study. She does not know what shes talking about and I honestly cannot fathom the University that presented her with her doctorate.
Just because you can, doesnt mean you should teach.

If you got AP Credit, don't take 1210, go to 1220. Dr. Allen has poorly organized lectures and she only does easy practice problems in class. I'd recommend a different prof if you really want to learn, but if you get stuck with her, its not the end b/c she is pretty nice during office hours. There was a 2 or 3 point curve at the end of the class
reviews.rating_tags: TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Her lectures were very dry. She does not always know how the answer is obtained on her own tests and sometimes struggles to answer students questions in a different way than it was already explained.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Prof. Allen is not a good teacher. She works out simple problems in class, taking up class time, but does not talk about anything remotely challenging. Lectures are boring and hard to sit through; she is not very approachable. While its true that the exams bare some resemblance to her practice material, it is not enough to make any difference.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Allen's teaching style did not click with me at all. Her lectures are painful to listen to, and she hardly ever works through sample problems in class. Chemistry courses should not be 90 minutes of pure lecturing. I prefer seeing problems worked out, step-by-step, on the blackboard. Her midterms are pretty difficult. Find another professor!!!

She is very clear and I understood everything she said. She is willing to help you if you come to her office hours or email her. Her practice midterms are super close to the actual midterm. However, she is very scatterbrained jumping from one topic to another at times. Also, she really stresses the easy stuff and does not go over the hard problems.

She was a TERRIBLE professor. She is SO scatterbrained and spends 20 minutes on simple things and briefly mentions hard topics. I taught myself everything by reading the textbook and doing practice problems. The homework doesn't help at all. She's rude when you meet with her. Her exams are just like her practice exams. Didn't curve the class alot.

One thing I do want to criticize her on is her usage of the blackboard. In a class of maybe 100-200 students who the vast majority sit too far from the blackboard is it that smart to use it? Her practice exams  the midterms so if you can ace the practice exams you can ace the midterms

Very disorganized. She will start lecturing on the board then try to use her lecture slides after. Her lecture slides are not organized at all. She will talk about something then come back to it later. She is passionate about her research, she will go off on a tangent a lot, but she is not a good lecturer. Can show up late and not miss a thing.

Pros: Streamlined useful information, was open to meeting with you to go over material if you emailed her, exams were not tricky/she let you know what you needed to study for the exams  Cons: She would frequently take a lot of time going over simple problems, demos were lackluster, lectures could be boring since they were the longer ones.

Basically taught myself. Stopped going to lectures toward the end of the semester because there was no point. The practice midterms are pretty much like the actual midterm so that was helpful but other than that, 10/10 don't recommend

Dr. Allen is very straight forward in describing what the exam will be like. Sometimes she doesn't explain topics well in lecture, but she's much more specific if you attend her office hours. Also, the visiting the chem tutors a couple times a week is helpful.

She's a pretty boring lecturer, but that's not too big of a deal. If you have a bent towards Chemistry, then her class will be no problem. Make sure to do the homework and practice midterms. I've only missed a total of 9 questions on all 3 midterms combined, a lot of that due to her practice midterms being almost identical to the actual midterms.

She literally just mumbles and scribbles stuff on the board. She assumes that you already know how to do everything so she doesn't really teach the material...I don't bother attending lecture because its useless. I spent a ridiculous amount of time with chemistry tutors.

I only showed up to 2 lectures before the first midterm and scored 20% above the average.  Never showed up to another lecture and the same happened each exam.  Just make sure you do the homework, practice problems and her practice midterms before the exam and then you will do well.  Her practice exams are almost exactly like the real exams.
She's a decent lecturer. You can tell she doesn't really like teaching, she likes research.  Exams are just like her practice exams and she does examples in lecture that are on exam.

I stopped going to her lectures because I learned nothing from her. Her "examples" usually consisted of working out half the problem, realizing she messed up, and said "but you guys get what I mean." If the practice problems we had were at a difficulty level of 4, then the midterms were at a 7, and the final a strong 10. Switch out of her class
She is awful!

This was by far the hardest class I have ever taken. DO NOT skip class. Even though her lectures are extremely confusing and poorly explained, attendance will help. Read the textbook because her notes come directly from it. She doesn't go over any math problems, so practice those! The average on the final was a 56%. Be prepared to study very hard.

Gave her class 0 curve for the fall semester when the average for the final was a 56. Awful teacher, not clear at all. The only compounds she knows how to manipulate are O2 and N2 since she's an environmental chemist. She has no idea how to explain the other topics in this class. SWITCH OUT IF YOU HAVE HER.

I write this for Asian international student only. This is a very easy course for Asian students to take, I stopped showing up in lectures since midterm 1. She is not helpful and it's better to study  by reading the book and the PPT that she posted. Lab's reports are kind of hard for international students to write. Anyway, easy to get A.

Dr. Allen was always available to help and really wanted her students to learn chemistry. She offered tons of incentive like coffee and food since lecture was at 8 am. If you don't read the textbook beforehand you're not going to understand her lectures very much. The midterms were like the practice ones but the final really tested your knowledge.

Dr. Allen tried to be helpful and encouraged students to come to class and office hours (coffee, doughnuts, reminders).  Although she tried to explain well, she is just too smart and a lot of what she said went over my head.  Her midterms were easy compared to other professors, but her final was ridiculously hard.

She is a good professor and lecturer. There were two things I hated about this class: home works were all over the week, she  would changed due dates and times 300 hundred times. Final was ridiculous, home works didn't help. The worst part is labs, where you will have to write reports like research papers. Yes chem classes are filtering at OSU.

Yea this class is brutal, but that's chemistry at THE Ohio State people! It's not meant to be easy, it's meant to be a filter class. With that being said, Dr. Allen was passionate about what she taught and very available for students with questions. She tried hard to connect with students and I appreciate that. Also she's a total babe.

If you read the textbook before class and come to class with any confusion she will be more than happy to help you after lecture or during her office hours. She is NOT confusing just listen and participate and you''ll be fine. Everyone giving her bad grades probably never went to class or prepared themselves. You can do it Be proactive.

I went to every lecture and she is unbelievably boring. She traveled before every midterm and the final so we could not ask her questions. If you can take Chem 1220 with another professor I would suggest it. At the beginning of the semester she said that she wanted to raise her score on this site. Well, in my opinion her score is accurate

If you are reading this, I am assuming that you are about to take Chem 1220 next semester. Most people forget that Chemistry at OSU is extremely difficult. Dr. Allen may not be the best professor, but she is definitely fair and equips students with the knowledge to do well. The students typing these reviews were probably asleep during lecture.

This professor is seriously horrible! Her lectures are VERY boring and she has very few practice problems in class that are actually related to the test problems. Her tests are extremely difficult and she doesn't really care at all! BEWARE!

Dr. Allen is a kind and friendly professor who is obviously very passionate about her work in environmental chemistry and research. With that being said, DO NOT take a class with her teaching. She is dry, doesn't know how to explain material and gives you an addition problem and then asks you to do calculus on her exam. She is a horrible teacher.

This professor asked us to fix her rating on here at the beginning of the semester, and while I wish I could do that, I can't. She did not teach more than basic concepts in lectures (and these concepts were covered completely and more clearly in the book), yet assigned homework and gave exams way above that basic level. Beware of this professor.

I would not advise this professor. While a nice person, she simply is not a good teacher. I went to every one of her lectures and learned scarcely anything. She only covered the basic concepts, yet a lot of the midterms/finals involved complicated mathematical problems. Plus even though the class final average was a 56% there was almost no curve.

Dr.Allen said her overall goal was to "redeem her rep. on rate my professor". However, with the limited time she put towards her students and the immense amount of time to her research-that was an impossible goal and she didn't succeed. i suggest a different teacher that doesn't do research & dedicates themselves to teaching.

Dr. Allen is a terrible professor. Her lectures were truly useless. I would suggest trying to find another professor ASAP. I, personally, just read the book and got a tutor because she doesn't teach anything. Her example problems are from the book and easy. Her exams are mostly all math. She is mostly interested in her research, not her students.

More interested in doing her research than actually helping students and making sure they understand. I advise taking a different professor if you actually want to do well in the class. Example problems she does in lecture are useless.

Dr. Allen is a terrible professor. Lecture is a waste of your time. She isn't good at explaining concepts, I learned more from reading the book and doing example problems myself. Only example problems she does are the easy ones that are already done in the book which at 20x easier than the ones on the exams. Take a different professor if you can
If you take a class with this professor, you will ruin your grades in other classes too. She gave too many time wasting materials that wouldn't help you in the exams.
Biggest waste of time. Absolutely ridiculous this class exists.
She's a nice person, but this class altogether is a horrible class! You really don't learn anything about chemistry in this class.

Take a different professor.The lectures are pointless. She does no example problems in class and if she does they are the easy ones that are already done out in the book.She didn't seem that interested in teaching;cared more about her research.

Dr. Allen is a far better lecturer than other ratings here may suggest. She said that her lectures are a supplement to reading the text, which seems accurate to me. Though dedicated to her research, she is still dedicated to students if you are willing to seek her out. The course isn't the best, but as far as professors go, she's reasonable.

We all know the Gen. Chem series at OSU is rough and is under review, and she helps out with that. She is a terrible professor. I knew when she asked on the first day to "avenge her reputation" on this site, that she was not going to be helpful. If you can, take another professor. You will not learn anything by going to lecture. Good luck.

She is more concerned about going to her conferences and her research than her students.  She is hard to contact since she is almost never available. Her lectures are pointless, she does not show you how to do the problems, her notes skim the information and do not help. You are better off reading the book and using the internet to help.

This professor seems very smart and into what she does but the lectures don't actually help me to learn the material. I have to read all the chapters in the book in order to feel prepared for the exams, which is hard to do while in other classes.
very easy to understand, and she knows her stuff. She is very helpful, and willing to help anytime! Fun answering questions through text  messages without need to buy Clickers!

Easily the worst class I've ever had. The Professor had no idea what she was talking about. All she did was write her notes on the board. This might've been fine if she'd be able to explain them , but someone else had clearly written said notes. Grading was easy but inconsistent.
crappy teacher, just interested in research, wasted all class time doing long drawn out examples on the board, then after taking an hour on one problem, she would realize she got the answer wrong
tests unfair

This was a terrible class.  It took up a lot of time and made it much harder for me to find time to work on my other classes.  As for the professor, she's really pretty good compared to the other two chemistry professors I had at this school.

Totally unclear lecturer;spends much of class going over sample problems only to realize that she left something out from the start, then goes back and redoes them all. Ends up spending about 80% of the class on such pointless examples. Exams often had no correct answer, justified by saying we should choose the closest one, or leave it blank. Avoid

Horrible notes, horrible teaching, impossible exams. My TA helped me out in the class an insane amount, giving 3 - 4 hour review sessions before exams. Labs are easier than 121. The only curve she gave was 60 - 80 C, 80 - 90 B, 90 - 100 A.. pretty lame.

Bad Class Bad teacher, doesn't help students in office hours, I would avoid her if i could do it again. Material is not to bad though, just don't count on her lectures to teach you what you need to know.
No Comments
No Comments
Tougher class but not because she was hard. If you payed attention in 121 and learned that stuff, this is much easier. If you didn't learn that, this class will just be that much harder.

This class will not be too difficult if you read the book. Just go to her class and read the chapter instead of paying attention to her. In the time wasted in 3 classes listening to her, you could have already read the chapter at hand 2 or 3 times and know more than what she presents in lecture. It works.
very tricky exams. her goal is to trap us in every questions she sets for the midterams and the finals.

Be prepared to teach yourself. This class was horrible. It was sad that we had people correcting our professor every single day in lecture. She even asked students on several occasions to look up the correct answers in the text and to get back to her with the answer...sad. At least her double scrunchy pony tail will keep you entertained.
horrible teacher; makes mistakes every lecture that throws many students off.  god help whoever takes this class with her

This class was very difficult.  You are expected to be responsible for all the material in the book and from the lectureds.  Lectures were helpful to some and not others.  However they were worth a few points.  Her exams were very difficult.  Expect to put alot of effort into this class-no slacking.

Lectures are a waste of time, as well as the clickers.  She spends most of the time going over useless problems that won't be on your exam anyway.  Her tests, for the most part, were extremely difficult.  And, if nothing else bothers you, then i'm sure her awful pony tail will keep you distracted just long enough to pass out from boredom.

Lectures were pretty worthless. Clicker was worthless except for the free points it got you. Her review tests were nothing like the real tests. She did examples wrong on a regular basis. Overall I would not recommend the class.

She will spend half of class going over a problem only to have a student tell her that she has done it completely wrong.  Her tests were random and she is very uncleaar and goes against the book a lot even though she claims she teaches from the book.  Maybe if she read it herself, she would be a better teacher.
Hard class, hard exams, ****y, does alot of problems wrong which throws you off and has stuff on the tests that she hasnt even covered.

She sucks. She does example problems in class wrong and only tells the kids who go to her office hours that she did it wrong.  On one of the midterms she did calculations wrong so that the exact answer wasn't a choice, and she didn't dicount that question either. She made the class so much more work because she sucked at teaching it

Very easy to understand, but she doesnt always seem to know everything she is talking about, and occasionally does enitre problems wrong. also, her exams are not straighforward at all, and include things not covered in lecture...the $50 clicker is also not my favorite. :/
She does entire 15 minute problems only to have a student tell her it's wrong and do it all over again.

As one of my classmates put it, "I wonder if she could pass her own exams." She does a problem on the board and doesn't realize it's WRONG until a student corrects her. She assumes you know things you don't. Test questions are really difficult. She doesn't seem to care about her students. Doesn't know the material. AVOID THIS CLASS IF POSSIBLE!!
No Comments
Lectures are actually helpful, but requires you to buy a $45 "clicker" for in lecture quizes. Her exams are pretty challenging, but she covers the material in class very thoroughly.
Very hard class, tried to be helpful, exams are impossible, good luck.
No Comments
I liked that class, it's one of the best that I had so far
One of the best teachers I have had.  She speaks very clearly and you get a lot out of the lectures.

One of the easiest classes ever.  If you don't know how to do dimensional analysis, maybe you should go back grade school because that is about all you need to know to pass this class.  That, and memorize some periodic trends.  Chem 121 is extremely easy, and she is not a bad teach at all.

Tests were not hard, she covered all the material that was needed, and I feel she did a pretty good job explaining it all.  Study the notes, do the homeworks, and you should be fine.  She's hot too.  Nice bonus.
shes hot

Her first time teaching 121, it was not really a good lecture.  She was used to teaching high level chemistry and simply assumed that we should all know certain things.  Nice woman, and helpful if you go to her, but if you aren't good with chemistry before her class...she'll lose you real quick.
It was the worst class i have ever taken!!!
Horrible
The flow of the material was horrible. The teacher doesn't teach well. Being self-taught is necessary to understand any material.
knows her stuff, willing to help or research anything she doesn't have an answer for on the spot. lots of  self-teaching from the book but she's always enthusiastic about the lecture.
terrible teacher, she can't answer simple questions for the life of her, i bet shes a smart woman, but teaching wise she's horrific, and theres not better word for it!
She tries really hard, but her lecture is dull and goes way too slowly. Her exams were easy, but you have to teach yourself or already know the material.
The students know more about chemistry then she does.  If you already are intested in chemistry I suggest taking this class since her exams and quizes are extremely easy

Very good professor but in this class he did not grade many of our heavily weighted projects and quizzes, some even from September, until the end of the semester which was frustrating because I didn't know what my grade was. But he is very passionate about LING you can tell, very lecture heavy he talks a lot. But he's funny

He's awesome!!! Best instructor ever!!! I was lost at the beginning because I'm non-linguistics major but he helped a lot, explaining everything clearly when I asked. After a few weeks, I was able to get pretty good grades.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Cool guy, super nice. Knows the course might be tough for non-linguists so gives review that might be boring to people who've taken ling2000. HW is pretty clear and tests are easy. Read the textbook and you will ace them. All around clearly knows his stuff and is willing to talk about things more in-depth during office hours or after class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Really fun and engaging lectures. Homework is given once every two weeks or so and is graded honestly and fairly. Exams and quizzes are easy if you pay attention, do the readings (for quizzes), and take good notes.

Top tier professor, not an easy class but he goes out of his way to help students understand the content. Can speak exact examples he used during his tenure at Scotts. Not going to be an easy class but he is such an amazing teacher.
He is the Goat Prof
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Test heavy

reviews.comment: Really great professor, one of my favorite I've taken at fisher so far. He genuinely cares about the content and making sure you understand how it can help you in your future career. He's always cracking jokes and it's really a pleasure to sit through his lectures, cool guy!
Good professor only issue is the class being 85% exams 5% on homework and 10% on attendance.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Respected--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Great guy, truly cares about his students and wants them to learn

Best Business Law professor at Ohio State 

Only issue with the class was the structure where 85% of the grade were based on exams
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Protect this man at all costs, top tier fisher professor
Super engaging teacher
Actually the best professor ever.
God bless Ivan Smith
he's like chris bosh. lebron is gonna help him out, but he's still very good on his own as a big man playing mainly in the paint with a solid jumper

Fantastic professor. Teaches the material in an informative and interesting way. Homework and textbook reading is not bad at all and if you do the class right, the exams aren't bad at all. Some of the best lectures I have had at Fisher, would definitely take another class with him.

Ivan Smith is an incredible person and instructor. His lectures are very engaging and he cares about his students. For the exams, he'll tell you exactly what you need to study. A lot of vocab but as long as you attend lecture you will be fine. Gave us extra credit for attending an osu basketball game. I learned a lot from this class! 10/10

This man is amazinggg probs the best lecturer here tbh. He gives helpful examples to almost everything so that you'll understand the topics. Reading the book def does help and he's extremely approachable too and genuinely wants to help you understand. This is one of the few classes where I will actually remember what I learned bc he taught so well
my glorious king

Prof. Smith is 10/10. The examples he gives are really helpful and he tells you exactly what you need to study for exams. Class was very engaging and I feel as though I learned a lot from it. Only downside is that the only grades are the chapter hw (1 point each) and the exams (40pts and 45pts). Other than that, love the class and Prof. Smith!!
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Didn't know much about law going into this class (was kind of nervous because its notorious for being a hard half semester class) Ivan was so awesome and engaging every lecture. Super easy to talk to and approachable when you have questions. As long as you pay attention and read the book the exams aren't bad either.

Gives great examples to everything and cares about students doing well, will direct you on exactly what to study on test so it gives you alot of answers. Just lots of vocab but if you study you will do good and he is very helpful

My favorite class/professor so far in college. Really engaging, loves the material he's teaching, and makes it relatable to students. If you do the work, you are in a great spot to succeed. Sneaky good sense of humor in lectures as well if you pay attention.

I would willingly take his class again if I could. It is very clear that he enjoys teaching and cares about his students. He gives lots of extra credit opportunities. If you complete & study the textbook assignments and study his lectures (go to class and take notes!), you will get an A on both tests.

I took 3500 and 4510 with Professor Smith and loved them. His passion and commitment made challenging material engaging. Unlike other classes, success required full attention, which inspired me. I value the practical knowledge gained and believe Professor Smith embodies what great teaching should be.

This class is difficult only because it is so much information crammed into half a semester. Ivan is a great guy who cares a lot about the topic. He offered SO much extra credit, it was just time consuming stuff and I was just too lazy to do any of it. He even offered us extra credit if we attended a basketball game!

Nice dude, kind of awkward at times but very genuine. There were only two exams and one quiz that was 85%, attendance and homework was 10% of the grade. I thought the exams weren't too hard and it was fine as long as you paid attention to the lectures. I looked forward to going to this class and would take it again :)
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I never rate professors. I literally made this account so i could rate this guy because I gotta give him his flowers. Such a good guy, cares about the material and his students. His lectures are engaging. He's a family man and just a down to earth person. the tests are hard and I didn't get the best grade but goddamn I enjoyed each lecture.

Professor Smith does not help students understand the material and gives no assistance for preparing for tests. The class is based off of two tests and meaningless homework that only is 5% of the grade total. The two tests make up 85% of the grade. If you are looking for a professor to help you prepare for the tests and the material, its not him.
Professor Smith's class was very tedious. I never felt like I learned walking out of there. The exams were very difficult. I wish there was more opportunity for extra credit.
Professor Inks is really a great teacher, and actually interesting to listen to.
I feel like this class is harder than it needs to be, but Professor Inks gives great real-world advice. You can tell he is very intelligent and experienced in his field

Exam was fair but the course was test heavy. 330 points for the entire course and exams make up 300 of the points. Very passionate about what he teaches and is so unintentionally funny. Manages to make a generally uninteresting topic become practical and useful. Went out of his way to schedule time with me outside of his regular office hours!

One of, if not, the best professor I have ever had. He emphasizes that he teaches for life and not for the exam, which means that you have to study for the exams, but the lessons taught in lecture are extremely beneficial outside of school, and it makes you really think about your future, which is so valuable.

He stated in our class that he is soon retiring, so this review may not be so relevant, but he is one of the best professors i have ever had. He does state that he teaches for life not for the exam, which means that you have to study for the exams, but the lessons you learn from the lectures are extremely applicable outside of school. Amazing prof

Mr. Inks is a great guy - even though he is retiring, if he ever decided to come out of retirement his class is good. The exams are hard and you are graded on few things in his class, but if you don't worry too much about the grade and take it with him I think it's a good course. Most of the people I know have a B- B or B+

Dr Inks has been a great professor this semester, I enjoy his lectures although they are not mandatory nor does he take attendance. The exams are not very difficult if you do a basic amount of studying beforehand (3hrs). I got a 94 with 3hrs+attending lecture. Just wanted to leave a review, even though he is retiring.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Professor Inks provides a great experience. Exams are a bit difficult, but read the book & take lecture notes and you'll do fine. Lectures are long, but he does a great job of keeping us engaged. He's a pretty funny guy, even if a little bit cringey at sometimes. Highly recommend dropping by his office hours, he's direct but very open to questions.

He seems like a good guy, but he's a horrible lecturer. The only graded assignments are the exams and three 5-point essays. The exams are 50x harder than you'd think. He rambles so much during lectures and says he doesn't "teach for the exam" which makes no sense because why are we paying 10k+ per semester if you don't teach us for the exam?
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He is an excellent lecturer and entertaining. The content might not be the most exciting, but he does a great job at explaining it. There are opportunities for extra credit that help tremendously. To do well on exams, I do recommend studying and making a quizlet for terms. Going to lecture helps, especially with more difficult concepts.

Even though the class was kind of boring, he genuinely seemed to care about the students and was easily one of the best professors I have ever had. If you study a little you will do good in the class. Overall fantastic professor.

You can tell when a professor actually cares about what they're talking about and that's exactly what this guy brings to the table, he cares about the material and his passion is contagious, which in turn makes the material easier to remember. 10/10 prof

Dr. Inks is my favorite professor at Ohio State. I've never had a professor that cares so much about their students and is so knowledgeable. His classes go by super fast because he is very interesting and also just an all around great guy. I didn't the tests were that bad as long as you read the book. 10/10 professor and person.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I don't understand why people are giving him bad ratings, Larry is a great professor who cares about his students very much. The exams are fair (I got 100% on both Exam 1 and 2, they aren't as hard as you'd think), and he curves them if needed. Your grade is only basically consisted of the 3 exams tho. My only complaint is that he tends to ramble.

You can tell he really enjoys teaching and cares about his students. Lectures aren't required but go! Out of 320 points, 20 are the 4 writing assignments and 300 are the 3 exams. As long as you attend lectures, take notes, READ THE BOOK, and follow his study guide you will do good. A lot of test questions involve applying the concepts and terms.

Every week there is at least two long chapters in the TWO required textbooks and (for me) prerecorded lectures and zoom lectures. He rambles on about nonsense, but it doesn't matter because the exams aren't on the content he teaches anyways. His exams suck and they are the only grades except for three 5-point assignments. He is pretty funny tho
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Inks is a cool guy, but the class can be tough. Lots of reading and exams are the main grades. Unstuck study was helpful for studying key concepts.
Dude only grades 3 exams and they're hard for what

He is a very interesting guy with engaging lectures but sometimes he gets off track. The class is based on tests only so if you grind the concepts you should be alright, it is a lot of memorization. Personally thought the first test was the hardest.
He is a great person and his lectures are pretty interesting. However, the class is based on exams and they are super difficult even if you study hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Inks is a great guy, cares about students way more than the average professor. The class concepts are fairly easy to grasp, but he prides himself on "not teaching for exams", so studying 7-8 chapters at once with little to go off of can be difficult. Read the textbook and attend online/in person lectures!
reviews.rating_tags: Inspirational--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He is a really cool guy who is pretty fun in my opinion, but not the best teacher. The tests are pretty difficult and the entire grade is just 3 tests. This makes it pretty hard to get a good grade. He requires a lot of reading as well which sucks. Just grind for the tests and you should be good. No attendance for lectures either.
Great guy, tough class
reviews.rating_tags: Caring--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Super down to earth cool guy. Sometimes professors feel like just that, but its nice when a professor can be personable and make you feel like more than just a student. Unfortunately the exams are hard and those are basically all you are graded on. He doesn't necessarily teach to the exam so you have to do a lot of reading in the textbook.

I have never sat through more boring lectures of my life. I'm trying so hard to listen to the lectures but Inks just never gets to the point, he spent such a LONG way of explaining terms and concepts that I'm lost by the time he finish. I rewatched all his lectures at least three times over for his extremely subjective exams and it's not enough.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Inks is a good guy.  He had good lectures that were interesting most of the time and often tried to tie in some current events as well.  The only downfall was that the only assignments were three exams that were worth I believe close to 80% of the grade which seemed kinda high.  Study lots of definitions for the exam.

No matter how much you study this course it is extremely difficult to do even average on exams. He does not "teach for exams" yet exams are basically the only grade and the averages are in the 60% range. Very great professor for what he teaches but the class is not a learning environment where you can succeed which is unfortunate.

Covers only half the material in online lectures that are posted every week, and is very definition based. Only had 3 in person classes over the whole semester, 1-2 weeks before the exam which was proctored online. Average for the first exam was only a 67% and didn't improve much on the second one. Only take if you have great time management skills
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Screw this guy. Studied my ass off for test and half of questions were subjective. A lot of which is least false like wtf kind of technique even is that. Dont take this clown
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Professor Inks is a very good guy, was very engaging. But the exams...... one of the hardest classes I have taken at OSU. The exams are pretty much the only grade in this class (besides the writing assignments), so if you do bad on one or two, you're screwed! Study everything in this class and still struggled on the exams, very misleading.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Inks is the best professor I've had at Ohio State. Great lectures, even on Zoom, covering really important material for anyone in the business school. Exams are challenging but fair, especially as he provides considerable study materials to help you. Writing assignments may take a bit but the questions are worth thinking about.

I loved Dr. Inks. He creates a very welcoming environment even on Zoom and he obviously cares about his students a lot. Gives lots of great advice. But the exams are hard. He's very upfront about how he grades and what type of things will be on the exam. If you don't study for the exam, watch the lectures, or read the textbooks, you'll struggle.

Absolute worst professor I have ever had. You can go to lecture and read the textbook all you want but it won't help at all. The exams are so objective to his own perspective and contain questions that ask impossible things like "Which one is the LEAST TRUE". LIKE EXCUSE ME WHAT?!?!?! I went to his office hours too and he was incredibly demeaning.

Easily one of the best professors I have had at Ohio State. Genuinely cares for all of his students' wellbeing and success. Navigated online learning with grace and transparency. I am so thankful to have had a professor that made a lasting impact on me and also taught me so much about HR, which is my specialization!

If you take this class seriously, I believe it's one of the most beneficial classes you can take, especially out of the business core. In addition, Dr. Inks is easily the most caring professor I've had. Such a great guy. Definitely attend/watch every lecture! For exams, he gives a great study guide and make sure you know every definition. Loved him

Dr. Inks is an amazing guy. He makes his lectures easy and explains the content exactly how you need to understand it for the exam. He really cares about his students and was really understanding about the new online format and COVID. Overall great professor.

Really nice and genuine guy, but he mentions repeatedly that he does not teach to the exam (AKA his lectures are relatively not helpful for exams- you have to read the textbook). Although he is nice, the exams are practically your only grade so if you cant read the textbook you will not excel here.

Prof Inks is a very caring but tough professor, I dont understand why the exams are so difficult. You can prepare in advance all you want, but it is hard to feel actually ready for the exam. Highly recommend staying away from this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Inks is a phenomenal guy. However, do not take him for orgs. You need to study too much material for the tests which makes it nearly impossible to remember everything for the exam. My buddy takes the other professor and is killing it doing way less work than I am. The other professor is open note for the exams if you are taking it online

Larry is a great lecturer and I enjoyed attending the review sessions for the online section. I think the importance of reading the book is under-emphasized in this class. He tells you to read it but the recorded lectures are what is really encouraged, but they don't provide the specific content of the book. Would recommend taking in person.

expected this class to be a cake walk, it could've been and should've been but Larry likes to make his own tests very long winded and harder than they should be. It's probably not his fault that the material is some of the most boring but he does a very bad job of making this class bearable. Larry is a nice guy but a bad teacher.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Inks is very passionate and caring professor with deep knowledge in the area of consulting. A lot of the course material is self-explanatory, sometimes dry or interesting. I found it to be an easy A. 3 exams, 3 self-occasional reflections. Watch his modules online, study a little before exams and you will be fine! Great professor.

By far the best Professor I have ever had. He shows more of a passion for our future as individuals than anything. His lectures were not required, but I looked forward to attending because of the stories he would tell. He is an inspirational teacher that cares most about what you take away from the class that can help you in life. Amazing prof.

The online session is slightly harder than in person so be careful. All you have to do for this class is take notes on all the modules (or lecture if in person) and read all the bolded words in the readings assigned with some skimming. There are maybe 3-6 questions about the readings in the tests, so don't prioritize the readings, but its not bad.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Inks is a great lecturer and he tries to make his material engaging. You need to get the textbooks and know the vocab from it for exams. The exams are very difficult but they are fair if you study and pay attention. He gives extra credit opportunities and he curves the class too. Overall a good class and a great professor
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Lecture heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Larry Inks is one of the best professors Ive ever had. Yes, his exams are difficult, but do yourself a favor and take this class in person and actually go to class. Larry Inks does a great job teaching the material, and he genuinely cares about his students. Also, be sure to read the book because he asks questions directly from it.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Inspirational--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Larry is a cool guy, someone you'd have a beer with, but his tests are way to hard for what the class should be. Many of the terms and graphs make sense in class, but once the test is in front of you, you become confused with the scenarios he throws out. He has a decent curve at the end, but it's not worth taking. Take the other guy instead.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: DO NOT TAKE INKS. His exams are ridiculous and he will ask extremely obscure questions that are from the fine print of the text or the online lectures. You will learn NOTHING because the information is extremely surface level. Get ready to memorize meaningless lists of information without actually understanding what they mean.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: The fact that I'm done with this class gives me more joy than anything. This is a horrible class with dumb stuff that you will never need in life. Coming in thinking everything is just HR and common sense. But I left every exam felt like an idiot.

Ha ha ha. This is the worst class with the worst professor I've ever taken at OSU. The materials were extremely irrelevant with you learn nothing from going to lecture. Inks' exams are the worst. They're abstract and don't make any sense. You can't use common sense for his class. He should just stick with teaching grad students.

If you look at this class through an overall life lens, rather than "business only," you'll realize that Inks teaches you a lot of things that will make you a better person in the future. The class itself isn't too bad if you read the textbook and keep up on lectures. Inks may have a reputation as a hardo, but he cares about all his students.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Inspirational--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: It's an embarrassment to our education system that this is a class. You can sit through hours of online lecture videos and get NOTHING of useful content. It's a pseudo-science course created purely by academics, and Prof makes the class unnecessarily difficult. Seems like a nice guy, but if you're forced to take HR, take it with another professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Took the online version of HR... eh probably going to get a C since I have done very average in the course. Watch the videos at speed 1.5x the normal speed and Larry talks at a normal speed. Very insightful professor and I wish I could have had him in an in-person class. Don't read the book/watch videos 3 days before exam. Stay on top of things.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Save yourself Inks is a very nice professor but not worth the heartache.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: A AWESOME professor, but super difficult for the undergraduate level. He is mainly a graduate level professor and that is how he teaches. His tests are extremely difficult, but his lectures are fantastic. Has great knowledge from all of his experience, but get ready to READ! Everything taught pertains to you, and your future career.

He's a great lecturer with plenty of experience to make the things you are learning practical. He teaches you soft skills which are vital to success in the business world, and he truly cares about your success not only in the class but in life. Plus his curve is great.
favorite professor I've had at OSU, but makes you work for your grade. Don't skip lectures and don't fall behind on the readings. This guy truly cares about his students.

Dr. Inks is an awesome guy. He is the probably the most caring and willing-to-help professor I have had at Ohio State. He really does care about his students, and he treats each individual as a person rather than just a number. Unfortunately, basically the only thing that is graded are three very detailed and convoluted exams. A's are rare.

Inks is an extremely frustrating professor to have. His exams are ridiculously and unfairly specific and hard. He is very hypocritical by constantly saying that he doesn't really believe in exams and hates giving them so he makes them very easy. The exam averages end up being C's. He promises to curve the class but only gave me a 1% curve.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Larry is a super awesome guy; he genuinely cares and is pretty funny. But the course is JUST 3 exams and he makes them dummy hard. Not too difficult to get a B if you put in work, impossible to get an A. It's only reading 2 textbooks and watching videos. I'd take other guy for easiness, but Larry is still way cool
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Crappy class don't take it unless your toby from the office and have a passion for HR. Class is extremely hard for concepts that will not help you in your career what so ever. News flash buddy HR is extremely easy in real life no one needs to know who created what motivation model.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Great professor. You need to budget a lot of time for his class because there's a lot to it. He's a great guy and a great teacher though. Every student wanted to meet him in person.

This class was easy but that could be because I'm genuinely interested. Inks is funny in his lectures and genuinely wants you to not only learn the material but learn about yourself and who you are as a leader. He is very good at what he does and I hope I get to take a class with him again soon!

He is a good guy but he is the one who holds the most difficult exams ever. His lecture only covers a small part of textbooks which means you have to work harder on your own. If you want to get a good grade, don't choose him. If you want to learn from the lecture, don't choose him. If you want to check your independent learning ability, choose him!

Professor Inks is one of the best professors Fisher has to offer. He is incredibly kind and caring, but also expects a lot from his students (in a good way). I am inclined to go to class because of the actual knowledge I receive from his lectures, not because of an upcoming exam, my grades, etc. You will regret not taking him.

The content Larry teaches is the most useful content you will get in college. You must go to his class to do well, but his lectures are fun to go to. I loved his class and it was probably my favorite class at OSU

Really does well making dry material more palatable, keeps things light and is genuinely interested in helping his students to be successful He says you need to read the books as the class goes along to pass, this isn't true, he will ask questions from the text on the exam but if you read the chapters quickly a few days before the tests you're fine
He's a good guy and inspirational in class, but his exams are way unreasonably difficult for the content he's teaching. There's no reason for the exams to be that hard.

Larry is a great guy and will share a lot of useful real life information. That being said, I've had him for 2 classes and he makes it very difficult to get a good grade in them with his unnecessarily difficult exams that he doesn't help prepare you for at all.

HR is the MOST boring class you'll ever take. Larry is a really nice guy but bad professor and unhelpful when it comes to preparing for exams; I asked many questions about what was important and all he ever said was "you need to know it all." 3 exams, SO UNREASONABLY DIFFICULT. My study guides were 27 pages per exam and I still only got Bs

The only grades in this class were 2 midterms and a final (none were cumulative). Since this was an online class, we only saw Inks in person was for the "mandatory" review sessions the week prior to each exam and during each exam.
