Took weeks to get HW/ Quizzes back, and Carmen was underutilized, so often times I was in the dark on my standing in the class. Good overall, but can be frustrating.

Solid lecturer, unfortunately I did not get to see him at his full power as the lecture hall had a white board instead if a black board. The exams and HW were very reasonable and he was very good at preparing us for them.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Tests? Not many--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Had Mokashi for 2010 and 2020 so I can't speak for other professors, but from what I've heard, he's the best of all the entry level ME classes. Great guy and go see him at office hours for some help if you're struggling and you'll pass no problem. His tests are hard but fair.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: If you have the choice to take him, you take him.  Mokashi is the man.
Take mokashi for mechE 2010, 2020, and 2030. You will not regret it he is a great teacher

Hands down best professor I've had at Ohio State. It is difficult to get an A, but that is because the course is hard. Mokashi provides excellent practice problems in class, and he is very helpful when answering questions. Go to class, do practice problems, and prepare for exams result in easy B at worst

He is a great lecturer, working examples in class that are directly related to the exams. He was also very respectful to us students, sometimes asking us what the best time would be during the week to give a quiz. If you do plenty of practice problems you will do well in the class, but you must have a very good understanding to get an A (o.w. B/C).
Mokashi was very clear in his lectures and his drawings/diagrams were great. Do a bunch of problems (book and ones he gives you) and you'll be fine.
He is the man, great lecturer and I honestly wish I could have him in another class.

Best lecturer ever. Worst class administrator. Very sassy. Really enjoyed going to his class. Test. Arent hard, but are very rushed. If you put in the work you will probably get a b, no better no worse

Directly from the mouth of Dr. Mokashi himself: "This class is easy to get a B in but will be hard to get an A".  Statics is not a fundamentally difficult course but it is algebraically intense at times. Only extremely careful work under testing conditions will get you an flat A.
Makes an impassable class a little more passable. Very helpful and clear in his lectures and office hours. Highly recommended.

One of the best professors at OSU. His lectures are clear, solves examples  on the board and explains everything very clearly.  Office hours are very helpful. Highly recommended. He makes an already tough subject .easier
The best professor I have ever had! Helps me to the day with other classes. " if you know how to draw free body diagrams you will pass the class".
Mokashi is the man. Wants all of his students to pass and do well.
Mokashi is the best, his handwriting and drawings are amazing

This class will be much easier if you do book problems along the way (Learn from my mistakes!). There weren't any hw assignments after the second midterm, so that really was the only practice you got.

Incredibly caring professor. Makes what most students hate (physics) clear and understandable. His exams, however, are incredibly challenging to complete in only 55 minutes.  Fairly tough questions as well. I actually really enjoyed attending the class, he is really funny and answers questions with detail and examples.
Best Engineering teacher by far. Take any class he teaches

Great lecturer, made a subject I normally hate (physics) clear and easy to learn. Tests were very straight forward and grading was always fair. Really wants his students to learn and do well. Would definitely recommend taking him if you get the chance!
Dr. Mokashi is the man.  He was really clear when he taught and didn't throw any curveballs with his tests.  If you can get into his class, do it.
One word: Perfect Prof, you can tell he loves teaching and he care about his students. Take him if you get chance.

The best ME professor I've had so far.  Explains things incredibly well and genuinely cares about his students- he wants you to do well.  Dynamics is a very difficult course, but Dr.Mokashi makes it easier to grasp.

Grades on a curve. Explains everything slowly and changes pace to keep with class ability. Slow to grade papers and update online. He puts the problems online, so you dont need the book. Very patient and helpful
Mokashi is the man. Take him if you get the chance. The subject is not easy but if you study, you'll get good grade.
Great teacher, helpful, nice and want you do well.

Best professor I have come across yet at OSU.  Does an excellent job breaking down very difficult information and problems.  Genuinely cares and wants to see students succeed.  And has the best chalk board skills ever.

Let's face it, this guy is an absolute genius. The class was incredibly difficult but he is such a good teacher. He writes clearly on the chalkboard and thoroughly explains everything. I would highly recommend Mokashi because he knows a lot about what he's teaching and can be very helpful if you aren't too intimidated by him!

Worked my ass off for an A. The only way I did it is that he was nice enough to tell us 15 problems that were possibly on the final and I memorized every one step by step. SUNY has lectures online for their dynamics class and I preferred their professor by a little bit, but Mokashi is still great.

Totally an awesome prof.  You'll never have a question that he can't answer, he's fair, and he draws the best circles on the planet!  3D sketch on the chalkboard?  He beasts them.  If you have an option, take Mokashi.  If you can't, wait till you can.  Because he's that good.

Best engineering prof at OSU.  He will make you think and he will make you study.  But he is extremely helful, crystal clear, and very kind.  Additionally, he's funny, has the best handwriting of any prof that I've ever had, and draws the best circles in the world!  TAKE HIM!
Excellent Prof.
Best professor ever....he writes everything on board...He work hard to make his students better.............
AMAZING!!! I hate physics/statics and mechanics but he has made the class enjoyable. He is very clear and concise plus his handwriting is literally perfect!!
I'm going to try to schedule him in the future whenever possible.

Mokashi is by far the best professor I've had at osu, even though he has tough midterms/final.  I've never learned as much in lectures but he is great at describing situations. Highly recommended as a professor but requires a good amount of studying.

He's ok. He teaches the material well, but doesn't go over many practice problems. His homeworks are extremely hard, his quizzes are book problems, and his exams can range from fairly easy to fairly impossible. I reccomend him, but if there's someone better, take them instead!

Wow.  He's a sensational lecturer.  His online homeworks are hard but TAs provide a lot of help and equations in office hours.  Tests are straightforward IF you've done all or most of the practice problems and prepared  well.  If you let him, he will teach wonders to you.
Great teacher.  I would highly recommend him as a teacher.  Funny teacher and quizes/tests are reasonable.  Recitations are mandatory, but very easy.
Nice
The greatest professor I have had at OSU. Thank the gods if you get Mokashi as your professor, you will LEARN. He even has good jokes.
I had him for 210, 420, and 430. Best professor in the ME department! Do anything you can to have him as your professor!!!

I had him for ME410-430 and now have him for ME 639. Mokashi is the best professor in the ME department that I have come across. I highly recommend taking a class that he teaches. He moves through material quickly, yet covers everything and more. I hope I have him for some graduate classes. YAAAAAAHHHHH!
Sweeet
He is the best teacher I've ever met.
Very good! Explain problems clearly
Dynamics is insanely hard regardless of the teacher, but he does a great job of explaining abstract ideas.

Dr. Mokashi... He's the man! I love the guy... Best Teacher in the departement, and probably the best in engineering, had him for 410 and I have him for 430 next quarter. He is an Excellent teacher, His tests are hard,but nothing that wasnt explained in class. study for them, and dont slack in this class. I WOULDNT RECOMMEND SKIPPING ANY LECTURES

Dr. Mokashi is an amazing professor. I took ME 410 from him and learned the material so well that I'm also taking 430 and 420 from him. His Indian accent is easy to get passed everyone I talk to thinks that he is an amazing professor as do I.

Great Teacher! He explains everything very clearly. DO NOT miss any of his lecture, I missed just one lecture and  had no clue what was going on in the next lecture.  Tests are pretty hard, but he gives you what to study for before them. I dont think he curves his class or barely curves it had a C  without a curve and thats what I got for the class

Best professor that I've had. Go to lectures because he will randomly take attendance for a grade and the quizzes aren't always announced beforehand. He explains everything very well and does a lot of examples. Take him if you can!!

Awesome prof. Incredible helpful, very very clear, easy to understand and follow. great guy, good personality. strongly recommend him. I will try and get in any other ME class he teaches. seriously one of the best profs at OSU
Best teacher in the engineering program
Stern but fair.  ATTEND CLASS...you will only need the book for HW problems. Tried to get him for ME420 but wouldn't fit my schedule.

By far the best professor I've had at this great university.  Tests were tough but he gives you more than enough material to prepare for it.  I signed up for another class with him at 8:30 in the morning, even though I couldve had him at 12:30 as my first class.  Thats how good he is. Thats what she said, Yaaaaaaaaaah

He's definitely not the easiest teacher, but you will learn a lot. He explains things very clearly in class and is always more than willing to help.  His exams are difficult and he knows it,so expect to work. You have to have some idea, or you'll fail.  Overall I recommend him. He's got the best personality out of any prof i've had. Yaaahhhhh.
YAAAHH!!! thanks for doing some of the homework problems this week, prasad

Yaaaahh, best teacher ever.  His work is very neat and orginized, he turns hard problems into easy ones, very helpful during office hours.  If you can get him for any engineering class, take him, hes the best.
One word Yeaaaahhh. He is awesome get him as a teacher for any engineering.

Very easy class, almost all the tests' problems come from homework or the review session he holds a day or two prior to the test. Maybe it was easy because he's a great teacher, and can communicate very well the methods and ideas used to solve problems. The best part was when someone made him laugh, as he tries to be really professional.

He takes the roughest problems and makes them look so incredibly simple it's deceiving.  If you don't know the material, you won't pass his tests as he is a picky grader and can spot BS from a mile away.
great teacher for this class - just as good or better than most professors (as he's still grad standing) also the book is good - makes a good reference book later on
EXCELLENT PROFESSSOR!!
He's a good professor. He knows the material well, and explains it clearly.

probably the best prof I've ever had.  Very helpful, available, and accomodating.  Very good at conveying concepts.  Use his office hours (and especially Vladimir J. office hours).  Test aren't bad if you understand concepts.  Final was difficult and based largly on new material.  Get Jovovic for TA. P.S. There was a curve. HW was key my to success
Great teacher.  Tests were challenging.  Just make sure you get all the HW points and do well on the quizes and you should be fine.
Very good teacher indeed, but give hard tests.
He knows how to teach. He makes the material clear, yet his test are very difficult, and he is very picky grading.
Excellent professor, makes the material very understandable and makes the class enjoyable

His tests are hard...  if you don't fully understand the material.  He can take something so difficult and make it seem so easy that it's deceiving.  One of the few teachers where when I walked out of their class I was positive I knew the material.  Excellent teacher.

prasad teaches the basics very well...that said, he tests you on the advanced...even though his exams were hard, you will leave his class with a solid grasp of the basics, which is what u'll need down the road anyway...highly recommended
He made this class much simpler than it is.  His breakdown of problems was masterful.  I highly recommend taking Prasad.

Prasad makes the class way easier than it is supposed to be.  Even though this is the first quarter he has ever taught ME 420, he did a hell of a job.  It's unfortunate that he won't be teaching any of my future classes.  Tests are not extremely difficult
Excellent professor for this class.  Made things clear and kept the class interesting.  Tests and quizzes followed things covered in class.
One of the best professors I've ever had. He's always available, and teaches the class by explaining every step. Tests are straight forward. But don't slack off. Its real easy to fall behind.

This guy rocks! I'm in his class now, and I'll say, it's like "Statics for Dummies". He doesn't assume that you know something, instead, he makes sure that you know it, and does not hesitate to backtrack on a subject matter to help you.
very good prof. likes to crack jokes here and there. not a boring class to sit through most of the time. exams were very straightfoward. highly recommended!
Tough course but he tries to explain things in simple terms. Do all the homework and use the availble help sessions!
Very helpful.  Tests followed lectures.  Classes were enjoyable.

Compositions count for a lot of the final grade, which is stressful, and she does mark every single error, but I've never gotten such detailed feedback on my writing in a Spanish class. There is a lot of homework and composition drafts, but no live lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: In my experience, the instructor did not provide much direct teaching during class, which made it difficult to fully learn the material through lectures. Most learning required independent study. The class felt more focused on assignments and expectations than guided instruction.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She grade very strictly, marking even small mistakes. But in class, she don't explain things well and rarely give helpful feedback on assignments. Students get low grades but don't know what they did wrong or how to improve, which can be frustrating.

She was an amazing professor and always willing to help and provide comments on work. Very reading heavy course with a one group project (she graded that really kindly), the rest of the writing assignments were graded to the rubric standards so no leeway there you have to try. For an honor class, not too terrible.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: She is a fantastic professor! Lots of writing and speaking practice opportunities. Also had a lot of funny stories or thoughts, which made class more fun. Definitely a fair grader and gives plenty of good feedback to improve written drafts.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: She is the harshest grader I have ever had the displeasure to suffer in University so far. No matter if you do your best on all assignments, she only gives you class time to revise timed essays that cumulatively are worth somewhere around 60% of your grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Professor Mason is one of the funniest & caring professors ever. Her classes & assignments are very clearly laid out and you know exactly what is expected. A lot of the homework is graded on completion. There are several graded writing assignments that make up a decent portion of your grade, but if you put in the work, you can receive a good grade.

Mason is passionate and funny, making her classes pretty enjoyable. However there is a lot of homework, with more than one assignment due almost each class day. She is quite accommodating and kind, and I'd recommend her as long as you can handle a higher workload.

Spanish 3403H - I thought she had good assignments and entertaining class discussions. The course material was well-balanced between reading, writing, and grammar. It is not too difficult if you keep up with readings and homework.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment:
SPAN: 3403

Amazing professor, very energetic and cares about her students and teaching. Wonderful person and very reasonable. Clear grading criteria and clearer syllabus. Great communicator and admits faults and mistakes Loved her.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment:
COURSE: SPAN2320, NOT SPAN 1103

if she is an option for any of your classes, do it. she is knowledgeable and endlessly energetic, truly loves teaching and is talented at it, maybe needs less caffeine but eh. wish I could do the semester over again, she made reading a 1000 page book entertaining and exciting

Loved her! I had not so good professors for Spanish 1 and 2 so having her for Spanish 3 was a great change! She was able to make the material easy to understand and would work with you until you understood it. She was a really nice grader. She was also super accommodating when I had to miss class a few times and when I had to reschedule my final.

no complaints! Becca is reasonable, knowledgable, speaks Spanish and English fluently, and is approachable/willing to help. In class she pretty much exclusively speaks Spanish but it's not as confusing or stressful as I thought it would be. She does a good job preparing you for the tests and most classes went by pretty fast.

Becca is pretty laid back and always makes class interesting. She understands that everyone has different strengths and encourages you to step out side your comfort zone but doesn't force it. She has lots of funny stories and is pretty approachable. She does a decent job of trying to explain things in different ways so everyone can understand
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Becca was so awesome! There are a lot of tests and a decent amount of homework, but she really helps you understand the material and prepares you for the exams. She's pretty laid back, a bit quiet but when she does get off topic, she always says something hilarious. Her class is a very fun atmosphere and I would definitely take it again if I could.

reviews.comment: Naomi was very helpful and cheerful during class. She wants her students to succeed. The exams are according to what we learned in class.

genuinely the model of what a prof/lecturer should be. explains concepts very well, accessible outside of class, very approachable for questions. also posts video recordings for lectures. software 1 is an intimidating class but she makes it feel easy. hw assignments/exams are all very fair and she prepares you well.

Amazing professor and easily one of the best I've had so far. Probably the best lecturer for that class. Gives good partial credit on exams as long as your logic is correct and gives lots of opportunities for you to succeed. It is a hard course, but hard to fail if you put in the effort. Highly recommend.

Naomi cares a lot about student success and does a great job breaking down difficult material in SW1. She provides copious review opportunities and is very approachable when students ask questions. The course feels fast paced, so it requires consistent effort, but the support she provides makes a big difference. I would totally recommend her.
Software 1 is a hard class, but Zweben makes topics and lectures easy to follow and enjoyable. Homework and tests are difficult, but the review sessions are helpful.
The best professor in OSU CSE Department. Wants you to succeed and always helps out. She gave me extra credit towards end of semester to get my grade up to an A.

Professor Zweben is probably the best CSE professor out there. She genuinely wants her students to thrive and pass the class. The grading for CSE2221 is pretty heavy on midterms and the final (not her fault), but she grades very leniently and provides good feedback. Attendance is mandatory, though, so make sure to go to class. Hard class, good prof
Professor Zweben makes this class very enjoyable and easy. Very good at breaking things down for you and gives a lot of partial credit on her exams.
Naomi is amazing and makes super fair tests. If you show up to every lecture you will have a great idea of what to expect on exams. She is super caring and an amazing professor 10/10!
Great teacher and definitely wanted students to succeed in the class
Professor Zweben is passionate, kind, and overall the only professor I would have wanted to take Intro to Java & Software1 with. Her teaching style is clear, effective, and very respectable.

Naomi is passionate about computer science and is very patient in explaining material. Her office hours are accessible and she goes above and beyond to make sure that her students learn. I 100% recommend you to take her class.

I don't normally write reviews but I must let everyone know that Naomi is an amazing professor. She is extremely lenient when it comes to grading and deadlines. She's also almost always available outside of class during her office hours. If you are stuck on a project or topic, she will spend as much time as she can to help you one-on-one.

I have nothing more to say, hands down the best CSE 2221 in the department. Each of the midterms and final had very easy extra credit points and the tests weren't so bad themselves. She's always quick to respond to emails and will always give a helping hand. Lectures are also recorded on zoom as well.

Great professor. She is the best professor I have ever had because she cares about her students and wants them to learn the material rather than focusing on deadlines. Very lenient on deadlines and wants her students to succeed in the class. The exams were also very fair.

CSE 2221:

Definitely a great professor I had for my first Semester at OSU. She is VERY lenient when grading exams and does not take crazy amounts of points away, especially for the coding questions on exams. Very lenient. Make sure to always do the hmwrk assignments and be 100% with attendance as those grades will be big boost to the final grade.

Naomi is the best professor I have had by far. We need more professors like her. She believes in test anxiety and is flexible with deadlines. I had to retake this class because I really struggled my first time because of the professor(and other classes), and Naomi made the class so much better. Explains concepts as if you never learned them. ICON.

I've had the pleasure of having Dr. Zweben for Software 1 and I can confirm that everything said about her here is 100% true.

She gives extra credit often and is very understanding of circumstances. She usually has a 12:40-1:35 section so take that if you want to get her for the 2024 spring semester. 

Makes CSE 2221 1000x easier.

Gives easy extra credit on exams in lieu of a curve, gives good hints for upcoming exam content, and really wants you to succeed in the class. She responds to emails pretty quickly. Just make sure to attend class as attendance is a portion of your grade.
Ms. Zweben approached each topic in a way that was easy to understand. She engaged with students during lectures and often would walk through things, step-by-step.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: One of the best CS professors. She actually cares about her students and wants you to genuinely succeed in her class. She will help you if you reach out to her. This is a tough class with the material had to grasp but she is the best teacher to go with for this class.

She is a great software 1 professor. She emails back very quickly and is always willing to provide additional help with anything you may be struggling with. Her exams are not too difficult and she is very lenient with partial credit on the coding questions. The projects were hard but going to her office hours was very helpful.

Very great professor. She would work with you and checks her email a lot. I highly recommend her if you are going to take software 1. This is a relatively difficult course and I had a big learning curve to adjust to but her office hours are very helpful
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Super sweet and one of the best professors I have had so far. Had her for cse 1223 autumn 2023 and she always recorded lectures, and gave helpful hints and feedback on projects. If you can have naomi I would definitely recommend her!

Naomi Zweben is the best prof I've ever had in my first year of college! She's a very caring instructor and generous grader. You would expect 3 or 5 extra credits for each of her exams (with full score of 100). She frequently holds office hours and answers questions clearly. She also writes fair exams so that there won't be any tricky questions.

This is my second time having Professor Zweben and she is just as great in SW1 as in Intro to Java. Great help on your projects and she is very good at explaining ideas or code logic if you are struggling on a concept. If you show up to class and ask for help if you are struggling, she makes this sometimes challenging course very fair.

Professor Zweben was fantastic. Her exams were very fair and she made it easy to succeed in the class. She clearly cares a lot about teaching and she even gave me an A in the class even though I was a percentage short. Highly recommend!

Awesome professor. The material was pretty boring, but she was able to make it interesting instead of reading straight from the slides. She really wants what's best for you; will give you extra days to work on projects in case you are sick or are confused on them. Also responds pretty quick to messages.
Dr. Zweben was very nice. She was very lenient regarding extensions, and her assignments were all quite easy. Even if you have no programming experience, this class will be just fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Great person and best professor I've had at OSU across two degrees. 2221 is a lot of work but she's amazing at explaining things and helping students when theyre struggling. Exams are tough but fair and won't make you feel like you're being tricked. Unlike other professors she understands the point of teaching is to help her students grow and learn

Dr. Zweben is super understanding and communicates the content well. She takes students' needs into consideration and recognizes that we have a life outside of class, which from my understanding is not common in the CSE department. I had her for CSE 1223 as well and I think I got a very good understanding of Java and coding practices from her.

Zweben is the best, and you definitely want her for Software 1 or any other CSE class. She is very accommodating to due dates and makes the midterms easier than the rest of the professors. She genuinely cares about your well-being and health and grades.

Naomi cares about her students and tries to know them more in depth. She is also very lenient with her extensions and exams and cares a great deal if a student is having issues. The class is very boring because of the materials but Naomi always approaches them with a happy attitude. The midterms and final were fair. Definitely take her if you can.

I absolutely loved her. She is my favorite teacher at OSU, she is so understanding and caring and genuinely wants her students to succeed. Whenever I asked her a question she would respond in a good manner.

Had her for SW 1 and I can say she truly cares about your understanding of the material. Easily reachable through office hours or email. Exams are doable. Will give you extensions to make sure you understand how to do the projects. Definitely recommend her regardless of coding experience.

Although Zybooks is mostly all that you need in this course, she really helps when its needed and understands that you have a life outside of class. She does a good job of trying to explain and also engages the class sometimes during lectures. Best professor I've had regardless of subject.

reviews.comment: Amazing teacher, highly reccommed. The class is not difficult and if you find that it is, Professor Zweben is very helpful!

She is a decent lecturer but her saving grace is the way that the class is set up. It is really well set up for people to learn and succeed. The content is pretty easy for me so I did not show up to labs because I finished them beforehand but they have labs for help.

I was already comfortable with Java prior to taking this class, so it was pretty easy, however I thought Zweben was a great professor. She had informative lectures, always answered students' questions, and responded to my emails quickly. Can't really complain about anything.

Her lectures go over the material well and she answers pretty much all of the student's questions. She also answered emails in a timely manner and helped me out quickly when going to office hours. The material is all through Zybooks which is pretty strict on odd things.

reviews.comment: Seems like a nice guy but his lectures might be the most boring thing I have ever had to sit through.

Nima is an excellent professor who genuinely cares about his students and explains the material clearly. He's flexible with deadlines and responds to emails quickly. With that said, the course is taught as part of a master class and graders are tough though!

Sitting in his class as we speak, currently showing us the same table on the board and from two different tabs on his computer on the projector. Just spent 40 minutes filling in an indifference table. I don't know if I can do this anymore. 

Seems like a nice guy tho no hate.

No joke, this guy rocks. With Mr. Painter, it's less like being a pupil than it is working with a teammate to solve a problem. Teaching style is very unique and seemingly universal (I know it is not just me- I've read the reviews). Classroom setting welcomes openness and collaboration. Prepare to learn a lot without realizing you are even working.
Inspirational. Caring. Respected. That sums it up. He's so chill I had to give him a rating before finishing the course.

Dr. Painter is one of the most caring professors and understands students have other commitments. There is homework/reflections daily and they are time consuming but nothing too difficult. You do have to study well for exams, as this is still DSA. Grades leniently on HW but more harsh on exams. However, he is easily the best prof for this course

Optional attendance which is nice because you can watch the videos online on your time. The class had a lot of homework and reflections on the homework. The exams were fair and questions based on the homework but still required studying to do well. Good class overall.

This was his first semester teaching 3902 and I thought it was a great experience! He's quite knowledgable about software development and in the video game industry. Pretty lenient grading on the project.
The professor is good and provide many materials to learn. However there are lots of hw and test aren't easy.
One of the best Foundations 2 professor you could ever get.

reviews.comment: The teacher is nice but the class wasn't easy. The midterms and final are graded harshly.

HIGHLY recommend taking Painter for 2331. Straightforward class. Attendance not required. There is homework for each lecture but they are quick, easy and mostly graded for effort. He has great youtube lectures that show exactly how to do everything. Notes/studying not needed. Exams are comically easy; you really have to try not to get an A.

Painter is great. He puts so much effort into making his course content understandable and easy to follow- in and out of lecture. His course is straight-forward and his homeworks are very nicely structured. His inverted classroom makes it quite easy to learn efficiently. Thank you Dr. Painter!

Nick Painter is one of the best professors I've had at OSU. He was hilarious and amazing at explaining tough concepts. His homework assignments and exam review guides/sessions were incredibly beneficial. I highly recommend taking a course with him!

Took this class solely because Nick's the one that's teaching it. Weekly homework and computing assignment, they're usually easy and he accept late submissions. Take home midterm and final, both are easy and straight out from lectures. 2 labs that were also easy (“do something with numerical method”). Overall a fun and interesting GPA bump class.

One of the best instructors I've ever had! Very personable with engaging lectures. The homework is manageable, and they prepare you well for the tests. If you have to take this class, this is the professor you want.
Nothing else needed to be said about Painter but what a teacher! Love his teaching style and how he teaches the course.
Great professor, actually cares about students and is very fair
Awesome professor, very caring
the goat of profs at osu. Extremely considerate cares a lot for students.
He is the best.

BEST professor for CSE no doubt. Exams are easy if you watch the video and do homework. Super chill and accept late work. HW are effort based and always harder than actual exam. Nick is super approachable and always willing to help. 10000/10 recommand.

Nick is the best professor in the CSE department by far, probably the best professor at OSU. He cares so much about his students and is also a genius when it comes to all things data structures and algorithms. His lectures are super easy to understand and funny, but the videos and notes he created are also insane if you don't want to go to lecture.

He is a good professor, but he talks too fast and assigns a lot of homework, which makes me confused and always behind. I dropped one semester with him, and the other semester, I got a D. Nick is a pretty nice guy; he gives a lot of extra credit opportunities. for me, the material he provided was too much and overwhelming, leading to confusion.

Great professor. Flipped classroom, consisted of about 2-3 homeworks due each week. Two midterms and a final. If you watch lectures, do homeworks, and study a decent amount for exams you will do good.

I didn't even have painter for CSE 2331but his youtube videos were the only reason that I was able to do so good in my foundations class. Painter is an amazing professor and explains the content so well.
Honestly one of the best professors with explaining confusing topics in a easy to understand way. Just watch lectures and complete homework assignments and exams are just like the homeworks.
GOAT of the department
Excellent!!!!! Really enjoy the classes!!!

reviews.comment: Nick is the best around. He assigns lecture videos to watch before each class, then you work on the homework in class with peers and ask questions. Homeworks are very reasonable but informative. Exams cover the material very fairly. Nick is incredibly compassionate and understands the stress of being in college. Thanks for a great semester, Nick!

The best of the best. He teaches flipped-classroom style, with lecture videos on Youtube and homework done in class. There are three homeworks a week, but they're not too hard and he is happy to help in class and in office hours. He teaches in a very clear and easy to understand way, and is very fair with regards to exams.

Easily one of the best professors I've ever had. Personally, the content was still hard for me, but he would make sure to go above and beyond for his students. Recommend chatting with him in office hours, something I wish I did more of! Don't skip class though, it's important to do homework in class to make sure you are aware of what's going on
I would literally pay double tuition to have Nick teach all of my classes.
Best professor in the CSE department. Teaches in a very systematic and consistent way which makes difficult content very easy to learn. Truly cares about his students as well.

reviews.comment: Always matches his shirt with his mask!
Best professor ever.

Before the semester I saw his rating here and thought "No way he has a perfect rating". But there's a reason for it. Probably the best professor I have ever had (and will ever have). He's very good at teaching the material and really makes sure we can understand it. I wish he could teach every course I take, he is seriously an incredible professor.

One of the best lecturers at OSU, hands-down. Homeworks are collaborative & not too difficult if you pay attention in class, exams feel very fair, and he's easy to reach on Discord if you need help. We did a flipped-classroom style which gave a lot of flexibility to lecture attendance

Nice and accomodating. 

Homeworks are harder than quizzes and exams.

Vote for flipped classroom model, this way he has much more time to help you on hw.

reviews.comment: Professor Painter was incredible and genuinely the best professor I've had. The only reason I didn't do better in his class was my own lack of effort, not anything he did.

Nick makes Foundations really interesting and easy to understand! He cares a lot about his students and goes out of his way to help them succeed in any way he can. I really appreciate his passion and knowledge on the subject - he knows what he's talking about and wants to help students understand why what we're learning is useful.

Stud. He presents class material in a way that will actually help you understand data structures rather than just math. Beyond the course topics though, he clearly wants to see everyone succeed and is very helpful.
The GOAT, nuff said

Nick was a lovely prof to have, I would highly recommend! He is extremely knowledgeable and talented at communicating pretty complex topics in an easy-to-understand manner. His empathy and genuine passion for teaching are palpable. He uses Discord and is extremely available to students in and out of class, and always kept everything fun!
Wish this guy taught all CSE classes at OSU

Easily the best professor I have ever had. Is empathetic towards students having an actual life outside classes. Great at explaining course content, and if you do not understand something, Nick will go out of his way to help you.
Literally the best professor Ive ever had.

amazing professor, tries his absolute best to help his students understand the material. foundations 2 is a hard class but professor painter provides a multitude of resources for students to do well on exams.
Nick is one of the best professors out there. He teaches his class in a way that makes even the worst concepts seem easy. 10/10 would take any class with him
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Took during SP20 online. Class consisted of lecture videos and office hours. Lecture videos are extremely concise and to the point, but some videos are a bit vague in certain areas, however, office hours helped fill in those gaps of understanding and expanded upon concepts. Hosted AMAs and non-academic things to help de-stress students.

If you can't pass the class with Nick Painter you won't pass. He is without a doubt the best professor I have ever had. He has personally constructed hundreds of YouTube videos to explain the concepts of the class. His course is designed in favor of your success. He's also just a friendly and, consequently, very approachable guy in general.

If OSU had a Professor Painter to teach every class it would be a tower casting a shadow over every university in the world. Build your entire schedule around getting into one of his sections and enjoy some real learning.

I can confidently say that Nick is the best professor I have ever had. Had him for foundations 1 and he made that class a great learning experience that was not overtly stressful or difficult despite that misconception that older students had lead me to believe that class would be. Taking him for foundations 2 right now and feel the same way.

Real nice guy. Cares about students and knows how it actually feels to be in college. Only catch though is the probabilistic analysis portion of class was tough and took up the majority of one midterm and the final which made them difficult.
Nice professor, but exams are tricky.

Awesome professor! Really cares about students and their success. The textbook he uses is unnecessary to purchase for this class and I've learned so much more from him than from the actual book. Really interested in adapting to student's needs. One time, I told him that the pacing was too fast and he shortened the lectures to accommodate.

Just the best dude, tries so hard for his students, cares tremendously, and offers a multitude of resources. That being said, while his homework and quizzes are not bad, 2331 is still a hard class so don't let the midterms pass you by because they're not easy. 10/10 professor.

foundations II is known as the hardest cse class at osu but he made it my favorite class all semester. the first half of the course is harder than the second half. exams are fair. homework and quizzes are harder than exams. he will go to great lengths to help you succeed. he really cares about his students. i wish i could have him again.

TAKE. THIS. PROFESSOR!! For either foundations 1 or 2, this is the guy you want teaching you. SUPER super caring, and amazing lectures. Gets points across easily and is ALWAYS accessible to help you if you need it! The absolute best professor I've had at OSU so far. I cannot recommend him enough, an absolute god tier professor.
The best teacher I've ever meet in my life. He is passionate about teaching and he really cares about students (both in your study but also in your life). You will enjoy the time on his classes.
This professor is always willing to help you learn. Whether it is in office hours or after class he is always willing to help guide you in the right direction.
Passionate, engaging professor, never a dull lecture. Genuinely cares about his students learning the material. Tests not bad, homework is reasonable amount and graded reasonably.
Does a lot of examples in class so you know how to do questions.
Foundations I- amazing lectures.

The best professor! Take his course and than you got A. Some question (only one or two in one exam and not counted much point) may be hard but most of problems is pretty and pretty easy. I end with total point 98.3/100 and the average point of the final is over 90 point.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Painter is a really chill guy. He has passions outside of the classroom which he finds an excellent way to put into his lectures and apply to the topic at hand. He handles a lot of things really well. Definitely take the class with him.
He handled the transition to online the best of all my professors this semester by being ridiculously available to help us through it. Great teacher, great person and 100% recommend him to anyone.

Painter is the only professor that made me enjoy learning CSE. His enthusiasm and kindness is really something I would never find anywhere else and visiting his office hours was not intimidating at all. He also gets frustrated at himself if he felt like he didn't teach it right, so you know he really cares about his teaching!

I can't say enough good things about this guy. I was a bit scared going in cuz I knew he was new but Holy cow. A breath of fresh air compared to the other CSE professors. Clear grading criteria, clear lectures, and SUPER detailed lecture notes if you miss any content. No way would've been able to understand the material this well with anyone else.

Best professor Ive ever had. Lectures were carefully thought out and the exams were extremely straightforward. He posts very detailed notes and examples online to supplement the lectures throughout the year that are very helpful.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Excellent professor. The lectures are very clear, and the progression of ideas is easy to follow. The board work is very neat and organized. The homework is challenging and really makes you think. There were 7–8 assignments in total, and I usually spent about 5–6 hours on each one. Learned a lot from this class!

Well rounded, all-around great class. Lectures are super important (and interesting), so go to them. A good amount of homework, but you can work with your peers, which is nice. Ask questions and engage, it'll make the class much more interesting. I found it to be easy, but some peers found it challenging; perspective on difficulty will vary.
Great professor
His lectures are very engaging. It's clear he cares a lot about the topic. There is a lot of reading, but not an overwhelming amount.

You can tell he cares so much about the subject, and this class is very interesting. However, it is SO much reading nearly every week, with the occasional hour long lecture posted to be watched outside of class. Just a lot of reading and effort expected overall.

reviews.comment: Informative.
Not too clear.  Can be vague.  Average caring.  Average lectures.

reviews.comment: Cranky.  Whining.  Yes, obsessed with Catherine the Great.  Maybe he wanted to be the horse, lol.

A very caring professor who gives clear lectures and is very willing to answer any questions. His slides are pretty sparse though so note taking is recommended. He gives a lot of feedback on papers. Although some days had a lot of reading, he suggested just picking just one detail to share if there was a discussion, so it was low pressure.
Lectures are not mandatory but the discussion once a week is and you need to participate.

reviews.comment: Professor Breyfogle is a very passionate lecturer, and uses this energy to clearly communicate the information to the class, and maintains the interest and attention of his students throughout the entire lecture. This was my favorite class this semester, and I would definitely recommend this professor!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: He is very passionate about what he talks about. He is also very fair when it comes to expectations about assignments. Everything is clearly laid out on the syllabus. A warning though, even though lectures is not mandatory, the material in them will be crucial to meet the word requirements in the Final Exam so listen and take good notes!

Good dude, he makes it a really interesting class. The papers are hard and its graded really tough but you can get up to 10% of extra credit and the discussion section of the class is worth 30% of your grade so if you read and participate you'll get a good grade even if you don't do too hot on the papers.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: The History of Water was one of my favorite classes I have every taken. Very interesting and unique. You write a paper every 2 weeks or so, but you have to read every week before discussion. Overall great class, not too much work

One of the better professors I've had, he is very devoted and passionate about the course material and gives interesting lectures, definitely learned a lot. Lectures are skippable but you must attend recitation every week.  Tests are all short answers and essay also a paper, managed an A without doing a ton of work & completing all extra credit
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Breyfogle is a wonderful lecturer. He has lots and lots of reading. I'm a history major, and his class was maybe the most reading I've ever had. Lots of essays. He gave great feedback, but he expects a lot.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: One of the best history professors I have had at OSU. The class subject matter is very interesting and Breyfogle makes it fun with clear and enthusiastic lectures. Discussion days as well. Class very paper heavy (determines most of your grade) and relies on the assigned novels. However, Dr. Breyfogle is very accessible and reads drafts beforehand
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Hilarious

reviews.comment: GREAT! Take his class, I took his Modern European history, great class and easiest A I have ever gotten. He offers 10% of final grade in extra credit (max score in class could be 110%) very easy, but very interesting. Great! Take it!

Professor Breyfogle was my favorite professor and I found a new interest in European history because of his enthusiastic lectures. He makes the class exciting and he is interested in the material. Study guides are terms that will be selected from for the tests, preparation is all you need for an A. Would HIGHLY recommend. Attendance is important

Prof Breyfogle made this class SO interesting because of his passion. He made this class so enjoyable. You HAVE to participate in recitation or you won't get a good grade. He hands out all the questions to the exams, which are short answers and essays, before hand so if you prepare well you'll do well. The books we had to read were interesting.

Amazing professor. Took 2204 as a gen ed and ended up loving the class because of Professor Breyfogle. Very educated on course matter and does more than read off slides. Doesn't put anything online so you have to attend class, but you'll be glad you did. Gives extra credit and easy to follow study guides for exams. Participate and you'll get an A

Professor Breyfogle is a great teacher.  I hate history and he actually makes the lectures interesting and fun.  He does not put lecture notes online so you have to go to lecture and listen, but he's so animated and passionate about history that it's nice to listen to.

Easily one of the best professors I've ever had. His lectures are very interesting and well organized and his sense of humor is great. He's always more than happy to talk after class too. He is a bit of a tough grader and the tests aren't exactly easy. You'll have a ton of reading too and if you don't do it you're screwed. I give this class 8.5/10

Prof. Breyfogle is awesome! His lectures are engaging, his sense of humor keeps things fun, and he moves through the material at a good pace. He is very clear about what he expects on tests and hands out the questions ahead of time. The reading assignments are really long, though, and he can be a tough grader at times. You have to work for it a bit

Prof. Breyfogle is a great instructor, his lectures are very engaging. The downside of this class was the huge amount of readings required how hard essays are graded. I spent twice as much time studying for this class and I didn't get the grade I expected. I don't recommend taking it if you have more than 12 credits.

Dr. Breyfogle was the best professor I have had at OSU. The lectures were always well organized and very interesting. He does expect a lot from you but the knowledge I gained made it very worth while. Great man, great class you should take it.

Easily one of the best professors I've ever had. Has a sense of humor, easy to approach. He takes the time to answer any questions and loves to talk after lecture. He even recognized me and said hello when I saw him at the library and I'd only talked to him once after lecture. His class WILL be demanding but he's more than happy to help.

Chances are that you're thinking about taking Professor Breyfogle's class. DO IT! He is a great professor that cares about the improvement of his students beyond the class...by far the best professor and class I've had. Very engaging and makes the material exciting! I highly recommend him to anyone!

This class so far was the best one I ever took in OSU. Of course the class is not easy and you do need some background on what is being covered here but if you do all the readings and attend lecture, you should be fine. The TA that I had for recietation had a good knowledge on what is being said and very helpful on helping students

I really liked this class. It was low-effort but topical/useful/informative. There are textbook quizzes on Carmen, but they aren't worth much and the exams were based entirely on lecture. Lecture kind of drones on, but he posts the slides online and the exams were cake.
If you're interested in his subject area, his class isn't too bad. But he's a fairly dry lecturer, and is a bit monotonous.
Great professor - a bit dry and hard to pay attention to. Very personable and willing to help if students need help. Excellent professor.
Pretty much the same as what other folks have said, he's not super inspiring, but his class is pretty easy and one of the best ways to get rid of the elective for the BS in PoliSci

To be frank, very boring course/professor. Lectures are dry/confusing and the whole course just falls flat consistently. The tests pretty much boil down to terminology which I find rather uninspiring but reasonably easy to study, so there's that at least. End of the day I feel I've barely learned anything from it and  that's a real shame.
Class is so so boring. Taught myself a lot of the time because it was so hard to go. The tests are a little tricky, but if you go to class and pay attention you can probably get an A.

He can be a bit dry, ok really dry. However he grades on a curve set from the bottom instead of the top which is nice. We hardly use the textbook and he uses a lot of examples. Take his pretests, most of the questions are on the exam.

We spent a day talking about Plagarism, but this was a 503 class-we ought to know all about that by now. He wastes time, & uses way too many examples! I really really dislike him for so many reasons, ranging from unclear directions, to changing class rooms in the middle of the quarter without telling you! He teaches and pushes intelligent design.

a nice guy but class is tremendously boring. Most of material is not relevant to daily life and generally not organized well. One extra credit assignment was offered and as stated before, not much room for error in assignments. In general, would not reccomend unless extremely and utterly interested in political psychology.

extremely nice guy but class is very dry and boaring. He tends to go off on tangents leaving the class fairly confused and does not intail what he wants or expects on assignments. If you have no knowledge or intrest in Psychology avoid this class at all costs.

Mandatory attendence... need I say more? The lectures were dull but the discussions were interesting. The text was poorly written and boring to read, but had a lot of interesting information. The novels were unnecessary but the paper topics were easy and he grades very easily on the papers. He also offers extra credit. Satisfactory professor.

Professor Nelson is boring at times, but I learned a lot about political behavior from his class. The tests are tough because they are only about 30 questions, meaning there is hardly any room for error. However, he graded on a curve and extra credit was offered by going to different politcal experiments.
No Comments
a little dull at times, but not difficult
horrible professor. Boring, inane notes, goes off topic

WORST. PROFESSOR. EVER. Boring doesn't begin to describe this sorry "educator." He's timid and dull and if you have any interest in keeping your sanity, i IMPLORE democrat and republican alike DO NOT TAKE A CLASS FROM THIS GUY!!!!!!!!!!!!
very boring. very soft-spoken. did not interact well with the class, and did not make course material especially engaging either. probably a pretty smart guy, but not a good teacher.
BOOOOOOORING! Class is in a small room and we still can't hear him. Best shot is to take this class with Soc101, it overlaps a lot of information (I learned from experience)
Quite possibly the most boring teacher in the dept.   Classes are not fun or very interesting.

Honestly the worst professor I have ever had. All of his in class examples are pre-filled in before class, and all he does is unhighlight them. Worst of all most of them are the incorrect answer and you are solving the problem yourself. He also isn't engaging at all. You are teaching yourself everything in this class. Exams are very hard too.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The class is so poorly structured.
You have many chances to get your grade up, lectures boring but if you put in effort you can pass the class. Exams are hard but you get a whole cheat sheet. Read the textbook!!!

You couldn't pay me to sit through one of his classes again.  He is the most boring and worst teacher I have ever had.  You basically have an exam every 2-3 weeks with almost no other grades. Genuinely have no clue how he has a job at OSU.  DO NOT TAKE HIM.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment:
He is the most boring professor I have ever had.  Basically your only grades are exams.  There are 4 quizzes and a final, but the quizzes are 50 questions on lockdown, with a 60 minute time limit.  This class is basically and exam every other week. 

Would never take him again. I am honestly surprised he is still employed by OSU. Must have tenure.
Don't take this class.
he should not be employed by OSU

genuinely never had a worse professor than this guy. For a class where the content really is not that difficult, your gpa gets messed up because this guy pulls the most random stuff out on the exam that even if it was covered in lecture there is no way you would have even caught it because he was the most boring professor i have ever had.

Extremely nice guy but not a great teacher. Nobody goes to lecture because you don't really get anything useful out of it in terms of exam prep. At least attendance was not mandatory. The exams are extremely difficult, but each one has a small weight as there are four total which helps if you really mess one up.
Seems like a nice guy, but can't teach at all. Almost everyone in my class stopped going to lectures halfway through the semester. Had to teach myself
exams are not related to lecture at all. do not take this professor
He is okay.
You can learn something from him if you really want to learn
easily worst prof at OSU. Business stats, analytics, calc, etc all much easier than this course.
If there is anything i can say is DO NOT take him
Nice guy,awful professor. going to class became a waste of time because nothing related to the exams was learned in class. Get ready to teach yourself everything.
Exams hardly reflect material taught in class. Hardest exams I've taken during my tenure at Ohio State and he hardly teaches anything during lecture.

This might be one of the worst professors I have taken so far at OSU. This guy teaches half of the stuff on the next exam before you even take the first exam. And this is repeated the whole semester. Heard that his average GPA for this class is almost a full point lower than the other classes.

Makes Billy Patterson look like a saint. Exams are ridiculously hard. Questions will ask about random statistics or dates that were mentioned maybe once in the textbook. Condescending over emails. This guy does NOT want to help you. Avoid O'Daniel if you want to save your GPA. Coming from someone who has never gotten below a B, I nearly failed.

Might be the worst professor I've ever had. Don't learn anything during lectures and doesn't go over any problems so you pretty much have to teach yourself. Exams are 10x more difficult than the homeworks with questions that weren't even on the homework. I've had TA's teach a class similar to this and were 100% better than this professor.

Dr. OR is very nice and helpful during the labs when we have lots of questions. He responds to emails pretty quickly and is always respectful. He takes attendance at lectures and lab attendance is mandatory. Overall I would definitely take this course with him again, and it was pretty easy.

Tons of people in class were clearly cheating in groups and the professor did nothing about it. Tough to get responses from him on emails with questions about homework. In person, the TA was better at answering questions than the professor. Easier version of ME2850 but a very forgettable class.
Rude and condescending in office hours, constantly late to class and kind of awkward to talk to.

Strange guy but decent professor and kind, clearly cares about BME. He wasn't neglectful but clearly didn't really bother to fix assignments from previous semesters. Literally just half try and you'll get an A. He made it interesting for what it was (MATLAB, gross).
She doesn't know how to teach. don't take it
One of the most boring teachers I have ever had. Avoid at all costs!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Olga really knows what she is talking about, and has a lot of experience. Really nothing bad to say about her except she can sometimes be kind of boring in lectures. Also, she called me out in class once, but I answered the question correctly. So, HA!

This class is a complete waste of time; I can't believe it's required. We spent the first few weeks on defining what a variable is and going over plagiarism. The labs are even more of a waste of time. Lectures are dry.

Attendance is mandatory, lectures are long, tedious, and EXTREMELY dry. Nobody pays attention because she is not engaging at all. You have to reteach yourself the material before the exam, she asks very specific questions about her lecture examples, and her slides are bullet points that her and her husband share. Shouldn't be a professor.

Prof. Kamenchuk is a fun lecturer. She can be just a bit difficult to understand but I did enjoy her class. Attendance was graded but she drops the worst exam so I didn't have to take the final. She provides all her slides online. Recommendation: Make a google doc with the study guide and share it with the class for an easy way to study for exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Olga is not an effective lecturer, as the lectures are dense and not engaging. While she provides great real-world examples and has industry experience, she is not the best at keeping students engaged or motivated.

Olga is pretty nice and shares lots of industry anecdotes, but her lectures are slow and not at all engaging. It makes it difficult to be successful in her exams, because you must carve out a lot of time to study the volume of content (since you are not learning in lecture). I have now taken two classes with Olga, and both were mediocre at best.

One of my favorite professors so far. Gives extra credit! Goes over alot of material but the exams are very fair and if you go to class they are an easy A. Not alot of homework or readings outside of class. 10/10 would recommend.

Olga is sweet and knows her stuff. She uses lots of real-world examples, which is helpful with applying concepts in a class where the content is not very exciting. You dont really need the textbook, because exam questions almost always from lecture slides. Exams can be a little tricky, but your lowest exam grade (out of 4) drops.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I have had Olga for 3 classes now and I love her classes. Her lectures are fun to listen to especially since she uses real world examples that are a big help when it comes to exams. She is also super accommodating and enjoys when students use office hours. Olga is pretty funny as well and I will be taking more classes she is teaching.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I was freaked out when I read the comment about her. I am glad that I didn't drop her class. I've been taking two classes with her, and the structure is the same. 4 exams (drop 1), watch documentaries, papers, EC. She gives detailed study guides for the exams. There are also simple class practices where you need to attend for participation points.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: so when i read all of these reviews, i thought i was screwed for the class. honestly, you don't need to pay attention in class (you can just cram the night before) and not even have the textbook (paid $350 for it and never ONCE opened it) because you can just make flashcards based off her lecture notes. yes, it's super boring, but not difficult!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Yes, her lectures are dreadfully boring. However, I never struggled in her classes. I'll say textbook isn't required, I pulled a good grade out of my ass without it. You can find all answers to her study guides from the slides. Lots of information in every lecture. I don't mind being in her class.

I've been doing great for all of my semesters but she screwed my last one. I haven't been bothering to attend classes because it's a complete waste of time since she only read off slides. I did well for exams because I studied the textbook, which means the slides were completely useless since I didn't even go through them. My only B in 4 semesters!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: If you don't want to mess up your GPA, then stay away,  I would not complain about a hard class; however, her lectures and PowerPoint don't  help with the test. Questions are not clearly worded, nor she is any help outside of class. Any sentence in the book is open for fill-in the blank. She read and explain what was on the PowerPoint and that it.

Reads straight off the powerpoints and often sounds confused as to what she is talking about. So much information on each exam and each exam's average is around a 60% because she does not teach very effectively for how difficult her tests are. I am a straight A student and am struggling to get a C in this course. Avoid her at all cost. Thick accent
reviews.rating_tags: TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Glacial response to emails. Had to literally get his boss involved so he'd get off the PlayStation and do his job. Otherwise not too bad - boring, honestly.
Very clear what was expected, had a reading before every class but was very manageable. 4 papers throughout the term, took AU 24.
Very slow at responding to emails.

reviews.comment: Straight forward expectations from the get-go. Readings due before pretty much every class (20-30 pages per class period). Assignments self-paced, not many outside of participation (if so, mainly papers). He's passionate in class and at office hours. Flexible with due dates. A little socially awkward at times. Good vibes overall.
