reviews.comment: Take Philos 1332  with him he makes it easy.
One of the best professors in the Philosophy department. Dont need to say anything else
Awesome professor, would love to have him again.

Amazing professor. Gives very clear lectures and he explains the content in a way where you understand. He is very clear on the grading material. Exams are super easy if you showed up to class and did the readings, there are no surprises or tricks questions. DEFINITELY TAKE HIM!!! Attendance is mandatory so if you want that A show up and try.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: My favorite professor so far. Super chill guy and explains things so well. You never feel afraid to ask questions or for him to elaborate. Went to office hours to ask questions about test and got points back. Rlly cares about the students!!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: It's a no brainer to take Philos 1332 with this guy. He makes the content likeable and provides a very good environment for discussion. Exams super easy, 4 short writing assignments you can do at any time of the year. Also learned a lot from this class and was not difficult at all

If you're taking 1332, take Olson. He is very understanding and has very few assignments. The ones he does assign he helps out greatly. The exams were easy if you were present in class. Just show up to class, put some effort into the assignments, and study a little for the exams and this is an easy A. Plus, Olson is a cool guy who lectures well.

He is a great professor! You definitely need to know and study the material to pass the tests, but everything on them was talked about during class and mentioned in the study guides. So glad I took this class with him he made the lectures interesting and I have zero complaints.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Really chill guy, attendance isnt mandatory but lectures are usually fun (Socratic method for most lectures). There is a lot of assigned reading but its easy to get by without doing most of it. Interesting topics that challenge beliefs.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Seems like a fun dude to talk ball with, but did not enjoy his class. Lots of difficult reading for homework and long, boring video lectures. You do get to watch Skip and Shannon or other sports documentaries for extra credit which is a plus
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Attending class is a WASTE OF TIME. I don't think we've ever gotten through an entire lesson before because he goes on LONG, REPETITIVE, ANNOYING TANGENTS and doesn't teach anything. The midterms are a guessing game because he DOES NOT TEACH. He only talks about his family and basketball. I can tell he's a nice guy, but not a good teacher at all.
Overall he was a great professor and was very responsive. If you take good notes you should do well.
He is very easy, but him and his TA never communicated which made the class more confusing half of the content on tests never covered

Prof is funny and a good guy but his class was incredibly unorganized, grade is based off of 3 midterms, which were a bit of a guessing game, and a group project that was also not well organized. Could tell him and the TA rarely communicated with another. Lecture heavy, and he goes on random tangents. Never bought the book tho, and ended with a B+
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Nice and cool guy, but extremely unorganized and takes forever to receive grades back.

Where do I even start, first of all these people do not know how to rate a professor. Whatever you do, DO NOT TAKE HIM FOR ANY OF THE COMM CLASSES. Unorganized, exams are a guessing game, did not teach just talked about his son and basketball, rude, doesn't communicate… I could go on. TA was helpful but professor doesn't communicate clearly to him.

This class is so unstructured and unorganized; he didn't follow the syllabus, and exams were a guessing game. He barely lectured, and when he did, it was confusing; he would often go on long tangents that had nothing to do with what we were learning. Both his and his TA's response time was poor, and many questions were left unanswered.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Easily the worst professor I've had. The class was disorganized, he didn't follow the syllabus, and exams were a guessing game. He barely lectured, talked about his son, and relied on guest speakers—then quizzed us on them. He encouraged kicking students out of group projects and couldn't answer questions about assignments.

This professor is interesting. But this class makes students so confused. After the second midterm, the entire class is based on guest speaker (they are on zoom) and group presentation. He asked us to come to class, but nothing is worth learning in class. The professor not willing to teach, and the TA does not communicate well with the professor.

Super funny which keeps lectures interesting. Cares about his students and knows a lot of them by name even in a 250 person lecture. Gives a lot of extra credit for random stuff like if you're a Lakers fan. If you have questions about the final project, which is a little vague, definitely go to office hours, it helps a lot.

The class is not hard but it is so painfully unorganized. The TA is so hard to communicate with and due dates aren't followed through on so everything is hard to keep up with. Take this class online if you can. It's just not worth the hassle.

He's funny and entertaining but not a good professor. Both himself and the TA are unorganized, so the class is structured poorly. Your grade is based on three large exams that are not open notes and one group project. Too much of class time is taken up by guest speakers that you will never actually connect with. You have to teach urself everything
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Anyone who says he is a good professor is lying. His course is horribly structured and he changes due dates on a whim. Everything is graded on three exams and one project- for which there is no class time to complete and very little instruction on. He is genuinely the worst professor I have had in the three years I've been here.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The professor himself is great- fun and competent in the material. His class- not so much. The entirety of the grade is exams, which are placed nearly back-to-back with an insane amount of readings you're supposed to have memorized for each exam. He hands out extra credit completely random and at whim. Very poor communication.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Appiah was wonderful at lecturing! Great online class to take.

I really enjoyed this class. Despite it being online, I could sense how passionate Dr. Appiah was about the content he was teaching. Exams come straight from the reading...so power through them. There are not a lot of points offered in the course so make sure you do well on each one to succeed. Also, take advantage of the extra credit!

Dr. Appiah does not know how to teach an online course. Weekly 5-7 articles (upwards of 25 pages each) we were expected to read, along with 2+ hour lecture video. 2 big exams where questions are all specific to the articles. Spent 10+ hours making a 30 for 30 video for final project and got C for things not mentioned in instructions and no rubric.
Osei is a great guy. Lectures can be a bit lengthy but the topic is interesting. Weekly discussion posts on the lecture and readings. A final, midterm, and final paper.

Entertaining lecturer. Exams are challenging. Readings are long, wordy studies. Takes forever (weeks, sometimes a whole semester) to upload grades. He won't tell you your grade if you ask. Your final grade is two exams and a research paper. He gives a lot of extra credit but didn't put it all in. I wish I could give a better rating.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Appiah is a great professor and is very nice. His class is very easy if you watch the lectures and do the discussions at the end of every week. If you do those things you will pass.
Osei was great in my COMM 4445 class. He is funny, down-to-earth and really takes times to explain course concepts.

Osei is an excellent professor who really takes the time to explain things well. All you do is listen to the lecture and do discussions. He makes everything make sense. He is really nice. My only complaint is that his TA grades everything and he will take off points without telling you why, and when you ask he won't tell you. Give me my points!

He is the greatest professor in the department at OSU. I had him when I first transferred and was eager to enroll in many more classes. 2 papers and an exam - that's it. Ask for help, he is extremely caring and understanding. He is funny and the GOAT at basketball. He will play you for extra credit. He left the biggest impact on my life.

This guy is hilarious and he hands out extra credit like candy. This class was definitely a highlight of my semester. It's not hard, but you also definitely need to review a little before the test. Graded on two exams and a final paper. Be sure to go to class so you can enjoy his funny stories and get in on those extra credit points.

Osei is really great and passionate about Advertising and the communication field. He is super enjoyable to listen to but honestly I scrolled through pinterest during lecture and pulled out a 94. Study his study guide topics and you'll do great on the exam

Appiah is the best professor I've had at Ohio State.  He is so funny and down to earth, and makes his lectures relatable and interesting.  Although he doesn't hardly ever take attendance, I always wanted to go.

This class is easy. He wants you to pass, plain and simple. He makes a study guide before each exam, and tells you basically what's going to be on it. He worked at Nike in the marketing department, so he knows what he is talking about. Plus he plays basketball and volleyball with students for extra credit.
Great professor! Easy class. He obviously enjoys his job and meeting new people. I definitely recommend him.
Great class, great prof!

This was an OK class. He's very funny, but gets off topic. Attendance isn't mandatory but he doesn't post anything online and in class he tells you exactly what questions will be on tests. I guess you could read the textbook and still pass the tests, but if you went to class you'll do better. Also he gives lots of extra credit.

Professor Osei is pretty funny and you can learn things on his lecture. He relies on his two TAs and they almost took charge on everything like midterms and finals for whole class. Every American student loves Osei but for an international student it's hard for me to understand all his lectures. Also, his tests are tough for me and my grade is suck

Dr. Appiah is very funny and his class is enjoyable. No attendance taken but he doesn't post notes online. He also offers A LOT of extra credit usually when people don't show up. His midterms can be a little bit confusing but you can get an A if you show up and do the work. He doesn't always reply to emails though which I thought was very annoying.
BEST teacher at OSU hands down! who doesn't love Osei? But very relatable and his work is easy and not too complicated

One of my favorite teachers at Osu! He is so funny and down to earth. He gives real world examples that help you remember class info. You get to watch movies about Mcdonalds and Nike. He worked at Nike too which is pretty neat! Easy exams multiple choice and short answer. I studied and got A's and High B's and i typically don't test well. EC avail.

He talks about himself a good amount. He is funny which helped. He knew a lot of info...But if he doesn't have a TA. Then he is super unorganized. The class material was clear but he was terrible at responding to my emails personally. Gives a lot of extra credit which was nice.
Osei is a boss!! Great class very interesting. Exams were tough! Doesnt post his notes online go to class everyday!

I had Osei for COMM 4445 and COMM 2331 and he was one of the coolest professors I've ever had.  His exams are pretty easy and if you pay attention and go to class, there is no way you wont pass either class.

Osei is the best teacher ever! He is so hilarious, we sometimes get so off track with all his stories. The material is easy, and he puts everything on power points; but you can only get the notes if you go to class. Exams are pretty easy if you study. Overall, he is the best professor I've had.
Osei was the man. His lectures were a pretty entertaining mix of stories and actual material. If you show up to class, the book is unnecessary. Easy A.

I believe it was the first day of class that he rambled on for a few minutes about his life and what it was like for him to grow up in California and how he doesn't like Ohio because it is cold and how he has never wanted to work/have a job. It was entertaining...and it was accurate...he does not want to work...

Very easy going guy, and so is his class.  He favors black people, but whatever.  He hates the winter weather in Ohio so every two weeks he flies back home to California so the TA just pops in a pointless video to entertain the class on days he is absent.  Pretty easy.  Taking notes on a laptop can be beneficial!  Must be nice to be Ossei. "ah-say"

Do you want to hear about how he played bball with Snoop Dogg, "could've" played in the NBA, worked for Nike, Apple, and a top ad agency in the world and hear at least 1 super innapropriate comment every class? Then this class is for you. It takes him over 3 weeks to grade scantron exams, and he never answers emails. 2nd class w/him & hes annoying.
This guy is pretty good. Sometimes the test are hard and there is nowhere to keep track of the grades but overal he makes class interesting enough to attend.Only class I am yet to skip.

Osei can run circles around students half his age. He used to be a great basketball player back in CA; he is blessed with excellent athletic abilities. A great teacher and a scholar. handsome enough to be a hollywood actor; can wow the ladies and make them faint like nine pins in a bowling alley. Too bad he got married at ISU--a dream professor.
Osei is great makes class anjoyable, he is funny and relates class to real world experience not what the text says.  Great class gets everyone involved and makes for a great learning environment

A certain boy wonder like me entered Appiah's class from a foreign country way back at ISU.This guy is awesome, I thought, why don't we have more teachers like him back home? I felt blessed to be his student. A stanford and cornell educated basketball master. Bravo, bravo, bravo.It was a pleasure to learn from you.
Very interesting class. Lots of chances for extra credit. Dr Appiah knows his stuff and is very intelligent.

Osei definitely made this class for me; he also has a lot of useful info because of his time in the industry. Extra credit is offered in class so attendance isn't mandatory but it's definitely worth it. Also some questions on tests come from lecture notes that can't be found in the text. If you need a GEC or it is required don't fear.

He gives you time to get all the note on the slide before he move on. His tests are really straight forward and not hard, but usually about 15% of the test is based on stories he talks about in class that you wont find in the book. Easy A, you don't have to attend all the time, and the TA is this really hot blonde chick.
Osei made the class interesting and worth my while to go. Definitely one of the best profs I've had at OSU and would definitely recommend taking him if needed.

Osei is one of the best professors I have had at OSU.  He is an EXPERT in his field of work having experience at Nike and I am pretty sure he worked at Apple.  He keeps lecture entertaining and knows so much about Strategic Comm. Principles.  The man went to Cornell and Stanford! He is a genius.

Sub-par. There are much better teachers. He knows so much about the subject, but doesn't know how to teach it. He inserts useless stories and talks on his opinions and his research while his TA's do the majority of the work in the class.
Great teacher, really funny.  It's a good class, but there is a lot of reading.  Class attendance isn't required, but you'll actually want to go.

I thought that "Strategic Communication Prinicples" was going to be really boring, but he made it really interesting. He obviously has lots of experience in this area and he was really good about keeping class interesting. His TA that wrote the test wasn't very helpful, but that wasn't Osei's falut. Take his class, its awesome.

Fun teacher gives extra credit for answering questions during class! tells lots of jokes and brings his real world experiences into the classroom and relates them  only problem is some things on study guide/exam are not in book or lecture and you have to go find it online

He is a great Professor. He teaches the class in a way where it is fun and interesting. His exams are a bit difficult for the material he teaches, but as long as you come to class your grade should be no lower than a B.
He doesn't post grades which I found annoying because his TA was really bad. Fun teacher, but exams hard.

Very nice guy and fun classes. Only problem i have is that he makes his tests too hard for the material covered. Makes each question have almost 2 identical answers for multiple choice. Does a horrible horrible job of answering emails too. But overall a good instructor.

He's cool. Very interesting material and a great teaching style. Every class was fun. He's a little elusive though and difficult to meet with. Luckily the tests are easy and don't require a lot of elaboration outside of the regular class time.

Osei was a fantastic comm professor!  He literally brought the subject to life through extensive use of example commercials. Made a 1hr48min class SO fun and interesting. Offered lots of extra credit, and tests were of medium difficulty; nothing you cant do if you study the inclass notes. Oh, and he is absolutely hilarious. You will love this guy.
Class was not difficult overall, however it is tough to get ahold of him outside of the classroom. Go to class and you should get no lower than a B.

Maybe the best professor I have ever had. It was actually fun to go and sit in lecture for an 1hr30. He knew his stuff, he was funny, class was interactive. The tests were based alot off of the text so you need to read in this class, but there couldn't be a better prof for this class. A+++

Wonderful teacher! Definetly knows his stuff! I went to class ever time we had it, and was always glad that I did. He was very helpfu and always willing to further explain things if you needed it. I HIGHLY recomment this teacher, it was a great experience!

Very intelligent professor who is definitely an expert in advertising.  He has a way of making even the most boring topic interesting.  It is amazing that a class can be so fun while being so informative.  I would take any class that he offered, I don't care if it's Advertising 22431.
Amazing! Osei is hilarious and so interesting. He makes the material fun by applying it to real life. What other teacher lets you watch Superbowl commercials in class?!  great, fun, easy class!

This guy was freakin' awesome!  Very intelligent, clear, concise, helpful, funny, fun, and and all around good prof.  Class wasn't that bad either, very interesting stuff, and he definitely knows what he's talking about.  Take any and all classes that you can with him, you won't be sorry!
Good stuff
He's a wonderful teacher.  I highly recommend taking him.
Easy- take it.  Book not necessary, just study the notes from class.  Funny guy who has an impressive resume.

This man is interesting and knows his stuff.  He has lots of experience and teaches on a level that students can learn from and WANT to learn from.  He is straight forward with his tests and if you read the book and study you will have no problem  I would highly recommend this class!

I don't know how anyone could give this prof a poor rating. He's the best I've ever had! His past experience in the industry makes him extremely knowledgeable. His stories and way of teaching make him entertaining! I want to take every class he teaches!
Advertising & Society - great class, never a dull moment!

Tracy is by far the best professor at Ohio State. At least in the ISE department. He genuinely cares about each student and strives to make sure everyone is comfortable in his class. Could not speak more highly of him!

I loved Professor Owen's class. He is down-to-earth and understands what's important to the students. He is very flexible and offers many out-of-class opportunities for research experiences. The class itself was fun, besides it being an evening class. Open-book, open-note exams. He genuinely cares.
Tracy is the best professor I have met at OSU, I look forward to taking more classes with him.

Tracy Owens is easily the best professor at Ohio State. Just learning from him is worth the extra work of the L&SS capstone program. He cares about each student individually, will match the effort you put in, and goes above & beyond to apply any feedback he is given! I can't speak highly enough of him.
straightforward lectures, great teaching methods, highly recommend.
Dr.Owens is a great professor. He ensures that all the questions that a student has get answered.

If you can take this course with Professor Owens, do yourself the favor and do it! Tracy balances being hands-off while also walking with you through this course well. He trusted my group's judgment on decisions, but was always willing to help if need be. The experience gained through this course is priceless. Easy choice to get your green belt!

reviews.comment: This guy puts the ISE department on his back IMO

Best professor I've had at OSU! Can definitely tell how much he cares about Six Sigma and genuinely wants to help each student pass the Green Belt certification class. Definitely have to put in the work outside of class and pay attention during, but it is so worth it

Great person, easy to talk to, great at explaining things if you needed more help and easy grader, but Zoom classes were just boring and online textbook homework was pretty tedious. Definitely would recommend taking her in person if possible!
Very kind professor. The courseload isn't light by any means, but she makes sure that if you're putting in the effort, you'll thrive. I recommend her.

Manuela is easily the best professor I have had thus far. If you are lucky enough to have her as your professor then you will have a great experience in Spanish 1102. Put in the work, come to class prepared, and you will thrive. Big emphasis on speaking in Spanish in class and discussing with partners:)

Profe was absolutely incredible. I would not have passed this class if I did not have her. She is a fair grader and wants everyone to understand the concept. Not the greatest at learning languages and I would not take another Spanish class unless she was teaching it!

Profe Olaru was the best professor I have ever had. You can tell she puts a lot of work into the class. I really love Spanish so Im really glad that I took her class. I feel like I got to practice my Spanish all the time and she made the class really interesting and was always very quick at grading and responding to emails.

reviews.comment: Prof. Olaru was super sweet and was very focused on class participation. we covered a lot of material and everything was pretty easy. you can still do well if you do mediocre on the midterms and exams. Talkabroads and an online component, but they were pretty easy, just time-consuming and stressful. understanding if you missed some of the deadlines
She doesnt answer emails and she expects you to learn everything on your own. Dont recommend at all.

She loves Spanish and the culture and makes me excited to learn about it! She cares a lot about her students and wants to help you any way she can. The class is pretty standard with a regular amount of tests and homework, but participation is super important.

She is a great professor! SO helpful, and provides specific study guides and rubrics for tests, papers and exams. She is very easy to talk to, and participation is a big grade in her class. Do your homework and MyLab online, and you´ll be fine. She will work with you if you have to miss class or something. One of the best professors that I´ve had!

reviews.comment: Manuela is a fantastic professor! It is easy to see that she genuinely cares about the education of her students. She goes above and beyond when answering questions and providing feedback. The course material is not difficult, and the class overall is structured, but not too strict.

Manuela is pretty much everything you'd want out of a teacher, though I did feel like a lot of the stuff I had to teach myself. The class is set up in a way that pretty much forces you to learn. I found it to be pretty easy and enjoyable. Not a hard grader at all and is very approachable. Expect homework nearly every night and go to class for an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: She is very helpful and will not be a tough grader. 10/10 recommend.

Manuela was an awesome professor! I had taken a few Spanish classes before this one, so I didn't find the material to be difficult. reviews.comment: Manuela is awesome! I have never taken spanish before this year and she's so helpful. Her tests really aren't bad. Just show up to class and participate and you don't really need to study. Makes the material fun and class was a good time! Tell her to bring flan on fridays.

Coming into this class, I had a solid background in Spanish. So much of this material I had already seen. For someone who is learning this all for the first time, it can get a little tricky. However, much of the class time was spent doing activities which really helped. Homework was usually given nightly, but it was never a crazy amount and helped.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Peace is very passionate and cares about students. She gives good lectures and goes out of her way to help students succeed.

Great professor but I feel like no one is talking about how the lab reports (yes lab reports) we have to do take SO LONG! If GIS isnt your major these labs can seem like a real TASK. reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor seems to care about teaching and is friendly in person. Sometimes grading was a bit strict. With remote sensing, the class certainly could have been much more difficult, so I appreciate the slow, introductory pace of the class. There aren't many assignments, but they take awhile so prep in advance, especially Lab 9 (roughly 20 hours).

With this class, it seems as though there is a broad rubric for every assignment and a secret specific nitpicky rubric because so many of my projects got docked points for arbitrary or pedantic reasons. The labs are starting to get outdated and there are multiple edits to keep them up to date that are hard to keep track of.

Dr. Parece is clearly knowledgeable in her field and this intro to GIS class is a pretty standard affair introductory class. It will focus on ArcGIS Pro only and the basic functions and features for someone who has never touched it. The homework takes a long time, but it is difficult to assign GIS homework that is short, so I understand the length.

Very detached from the class, lectures are old videos from a few years ago that don't bother trying to engage students or make things interesting. Lets her TA take care of any issues during lab times. Instructions are clear until halfway through the semester, when she leaves you to figure out a brand new software for yourself.

Tammy does not teach. In class (if she even shows up), she will just stand at the front and wait for students to ask questions. She's very unpleasant to deal with. She's rolled her eyes at me when I've asked questions. Her carmen page is very disorganized and instructions for assignments are unclear. I feel like I learned nothing from her.

Heavy course load. She seems disengaged  and out of touch with students. Grading has detailed rubrics, yet actual graded markdowns were often arbitrary and inconsistent. Class requires immense work which is welcome, but her merciless expectations are known and likely here to stay.

reviews.comment: Professor Parece actually has no idea what it's like to be a student in her class. My experience has been upsetting to say the least. I respect professors that want their students to learn, but I feel she doesn't care.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Professor Parece's teaching is ineffective and inconsiderate. She fails to explain concepts clearly in lab directions, leaving students confused and frustrated. Her workload is unreasonable, especially for those taking this class as a requirement. Instead of making the material accessible, she makes the course far more difficult than necessary.

Overall I would say this class went pretty well. For being an intro class for using GIS it was pretty friendly to those without experience on it. Tests were based on lectures and there weren't any textbooks required. this class will have you tearing your eyes out with frustration, sooo sooo poorly managed and designed

reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: 200 dollar(not kidding)required textbook that is vague and outdated (she has "updated" it by writing in edits with mismatched page numbers on carmen). This class desperately needs a TA and dozens of office hours a week. Just very poorly designed class, she seems nice, but you will literally flounder for hours just trying to get ArcGIS to run
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: When dealing with a complex program like GIS, nothing says "I could care less" like 1 class a week, years old prerecorded lectures, and a hands-off "figure it out" approach where your only true mechanism of consistent help is to keep hounding T.A's or posting in a discussion Q&A and awaiting a response. Lame, lazy, and a class that truly sucked.

Aside from the non-mandatory 8AM lectures, I enjoyed this intro course to map design and GIS. Labs were all useful and applicable, especially once you got to choose your own topics instead of following step-by-step directions. She is a passionate and enthusiastic professor who is ready to help whoever asks for it. TAs are helpful as well.

Dr. Parece is clearly passionate and enthusiastic about GIS. This comes across in her videos. TAs were helpful when need be, but the lab book we worked out of was clear enough that I never really needed to go in person to the labs. Pretty much everyone who takes the course is required to take it for a major/minor, and the class is good enough.
Good lectures, communicates information clearly

Dr Parece seems nice and knowledgeable, but I just didn't gain anything from the class. Her prerecorded lectures were all just her reading off the slides, and then the weekly quizzes would involve questions that were never mentioned. The labs all came from a textbook/workbook that was poorly written, and difficult to follow. Had to teach myself.

Even though this was an intro class, Dr. Parece brought so much enthusiasm to her lectures. You can tell she really likes to teach, and she is very knowledgeable as well. She is very willing to help students, and responds quickly to emails. Deadlines for labs were very manageable. Labs are pretty straightforward, exams are a breeze if you study.
Half-semester long class, very easy and fun. I enjoyed having Professor Parece and her lectures are fairly entertaining.
Dr. Parece has a good layout for GEOG 2200 that makes the class easy to follow. It was well structured and never too much work at once.

A good intro mapping class that fulfills data analysis GE. Professor is new but very kind and knowledgable on the programming you use for assignments. Homework is more or less weekly, a mapping assignment that guides you through the steps and you write a report at the end. Final project, no exams.

This was a pretty good class! Most assignments were easy to finish in one sitting, but most lectures were about 15 minutes long and each section had 3-5 lectures to watch. This was his online class, so it is most likely different from his in-person class. There were about 3 essays for the entire class, one being the final. All of which were easy.

The negative reviews are his online section so, inperson >

Prof Parrott was very helpful throughout the course. It is clear that he wants his students to succeed greatly and he even offers a number of extra credits to help your grade out. He was honestly the best prof when it came to writing assignments too since he gives great advice and will recognize the effort you put in. Definitely a 10/10

I have fairly severe ADHD, which tends for me to speak fast and occasionally get caught up in what I'm saying. In this class, you have to be correct in everything you say to avoid embarrassment. I enjoyed the content material, and engaged in it to better learn, however I was in fear the whole class of messing up. He embarrasses you when wrong.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This is my first history course but there was just the vibe that if I said something wrong, he would judge me hardcore. Lots of reading that I didn't do but literally all your essays are based off the readings. Interesting course but just wish there wasn't tests lol.

Despite the less than stellar rep on this page, I really enjoyed this class. His lectures were concise and informative, and none of the homework was overly complicated or too long. This class is pretty comprehensive in terms of what you learn, so I would only take this class if you were genuinely interested in it. Good guy with unfair reviews.

Some of the reading assignments were way too long, especially considering this was taken as an accelerated course and we needed to do two weeks of work in one. He also expected us to learn more from the readings than we did from the lectures, as his lectures were very general and he wanted more specific discussion details than what he provided.
The class itself was intriguing, but he comes off as very full of himself. He assigns an impossible amount of reading and is a very tough grader. I like challenges but I would not take him again.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: His lectures are great. You can clearly tell that he loves the subject but I swear to god. And he is not actually willing to help students at all even though he says so.

reviews.comment: One of the worst classes I have had the displeasure of taking. reviews.comment: He's a good guy and an interesting lecturer. Reading quizzes were unnaturally hard and the TA's grading was horrible.

reviews.comment: This guy is not good at teaching, his exams are nothing related to the practice exams or class content, much harder than both. He is extremely strict about phone policy and will call you out in front of 100 + lecture class and talk to you if your a child. Do not take and stay away.

No reason to rate him lower than a 4. The people who rated him low did not study for the exams on a consistent basis. This course is a class anyone can do well in based off what is taught. It's not like stats where you either get it or you don't. The only issue is he adds 2-3 rigged problems on every exam, but u get 10 free points, so it evens out

Marc Smith is a pretty decent teacher, but the class is a ton of work, and the exams are pretty difficult. This course is probably #1 or #2 for most difficult courses at Fisher so try to not get behind or else you will be studying for 12hrs a day for 5 days before every exam like I did.

Went into the class expecting to fail, but ended up passing with an A-. I'm in his 2300 now, and I've actually started to enjoy accounting. He provides great resources. Do the practice problems—they're a huge help. Also, try to participate in class. Even if you're wrong, it's fine; he'll guide you to the correct answer.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I've taken this class three times now in my life. In HS, my first year of college in 2014 abroad, and again in 2017 at Franklin. Credits didn't transfer when I transferred to OSU. I can say this is by far the best I've seen anyone teach this class. If you pay attention, it's not difficult to pass. Only thing is grading is weighted heavily.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Marc is a great professor and genuinely cares. His course is very well organized compared to others. Negative reviews often come from students who underestimate accounting. If you put in ~5 hrs/week, you can get an A. He's also very accommodating and supportive during difficult times. Rescheduled my exam, excused absence when a family membr passed.

Material is learned through videos and then lecture/recitation are practice. If you do everything (watch lecture videos, attend lecture, attend recitation) and actually pay attention to it all, you shouldn't have trouble with this class. He is a great teacher and his class is designed for you to succeed with all of the extra practice he gives.

Marc is great. The class is difficult and requires you to spend more time than you would in any other class to understand what is even going. There is tons of info you need to retain, and I mean a ton. Big concepts to little concepts and details you need. I feel like all the info you need for one exam compares to an entire other course
Marc is by far the best teacher I have ever had. The class can be difficult with a lot of information to retain, but he makes it easier and teaches this course very well.

There is so much information you need to remember for each exam, but it is doable and Marc gives you all the strategies and resources possible. My recommendation- follow the course calendar on the syllabus which literally tells you what to do every single day for the semester to keep up with the material
Anyone who complains about Marc either doesn't put in the work or simply doesn't have what it takes. Accounting is hard as there is a lot of material to cover but Marc is genuinely a great professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Respected--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Do not understand how anyone could dislike him. He is the best possible teacher anyone could have. He has to be a top accounting professor in the country, nobody teaches a course better than him.
Marc "Marc Smith" Smith
Nice guy but absurd attendance policy and doesn't make accommodations for anyone.

Listen…accounting is accounting. It's not going to be easy like other classes where u can just get through the class without trying. Marc teaches accounting how it's supposed to be taught. He may easily be the best accounting professor possible if you want to learn accounting. Marc makes the class easy to follow, simple, and organized
Marc Smith
Great professor. Just have to put in the work.
He is a very engaging lecturer. Just need to give the class the respect it deserves and you will do okay.

Marc is a great prof if anyone tells you otherwise they dont do the work and blames him for poor results. He sets students up for success its up to you to take advantage of it. Very possible to come back from a bad exam grade, especially with the typical 5% ish curve at the end of the semester. Love this guy, he actually made accounting interesting
He curved my 55% to a passing grade after I was 100% sure I was going to fail the class. God bless this man. I am going to give my full effort in the next class of this sequence.

If you are a ACCT. major you should take his class. However, if you are not in ACCT. or a bad test taker, I would not recommend. Test averages sit around 67% worth 77% of your grade. No make up for assignments and -15 pts per absense (2 excused). Learned my lesson, taking at CSCC. His course is designed to be difficult.
Test are way more complex/harder than examples from class lectures.
decently difficult class, but he is a really good professor that makes everything seem suer simple. Highly recommend

Graded mostly by quizzes and exams. The only other thing u are graded for is attendance. He is strict. Make sure you don't use your phone or be late to class. Try to attend every class you can. Attendance you do get two excused then 15 points deducted after that for each one and the grade can be negative. Beware he will call on anyone in lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: If you try, you'll be fine

Marc Smith is very fair and straightforward. Class is entirely graded by quizzes and exams which is annoying, but the exams are fair and only cover the material that he specifically talks about in class. He's great at explaining the material so if you pay attention to class and take notes, you'll be fine.

Personally, I found the class easy. There are 190 pts possible on exams but it's only worth 180. However, I didn't like him as a lecturer. The fact that he would disrupt class to call out someone on their phone & won't continue teaching until they put it away was annoying. He also puts away the problem sheets as soon as class starts; don't be late.

Personally I loved this class. As long as you watch the videos and pay attention in recitation it truly isn't that challenging. I didn't attend any of the lectures just watch the videos and do practice.
This class requires a lot of studying and work outside of class. The problems done in class are helpful, but much easier compared to the exams. Don't expect to get an A because it won't happen.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Good professor and decent lectures. The tests are incredibly hard—much harder than the example problems given in the lectures. It takes a lot of work to prepare for the tests.
Unreasonable and doesn't make accommodations
Marc is great

recorded lectures + in person problem sets taught by himself + in person problem sets taught by recitation leader

marc is a really funny guy who breaks concepts down very well. i would not understand a thing in accounting if not for him. you definitely need to put in the work and do practice problems, though.

I have never witnessed an individual who wants you to fail more than Marc Smith. Whether it's his exams that have ~30% of the points devoted to free response questions that you can't even get partially right, or the fact that he expects us to use his class like it's the only class we are taking, there are many ways to support my previous statement.

reviews.comment: The grade is based on only quizzes and 3 exams. As long as you do all the lectures, and do the practice problems, you will get a good grade. Professor Smith is super nice, and gives great guidance
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: His classes are hard overall, but if you just study the lectures and do the homework problems you should be all good. He also tends to add a curve at the end of the semester, but it's not something I would rely my grade on.

Amazing professor with lots of good energy, and passionate about the subject. You've got no choice to take him for Business, and the class can get hard but it's manageable. The work load isn't a lot, but you Really have to focus during that time if you want to do well. Genuinely one of the best professors I've ever had.

Marc was a fare dude. My biggest problem with him was that he would cold call on people. It made me not want to go to class out of fear of being embarrassed. Also, don't get on your phone or he will get extremely upset.

class is definitely hard. but as long as you have a work ethic and designate a couple hours a week to watching the lectures and doing the practice problems you will really be fine. the class is set up for you to succeed.
I thought his classes were difficult before, but now I think he is the best professor in the world, and his classes are so easy to learn.

This class can be difficult if you don't stay on top of things the whole semester but Marc is a great teacher. His ACCTMIS 2200 class has a no phone policy which is good to avoid distractions during class. His tests are all very similar so make sure you get to know how they are and STUDY. As long as you do the things you need you should be fine.

You'll get out what you put into the class. He has usually 1-1.5 hours of lecture videos that you should watch before class to know what's going on and there's plenty of homework and practice problems. The material itself isn't terrible, but the work required is probably more combined to other classes. It's a lot but it's also well organized.

He is a fantastic teacher. I studied for days and hours before exams and would still fail them. His exams are so hard. I have never had to work like this for a class. I attended every lecture and recitation and went to the tutor room every week. Good luck, this class was awful for me.

Getting an A is quite achievable if you want it. Even though watching the lecture videos and doing the practice problems aren't required, doing at least some of them is necessary since the test questions are similar to the practice problems. Allows taking the quizzes as partner work.

Marc Smith is a great professor, you can see that in the ratings. Some tips that I picked up to succeed in Accounting 1:
1. Take advantage of the tutor room. Swallow your pride if you haven't been before; they help you greatly if you don't understand a concept.
2. Even though they aren't graded, ALWAYS do the homework. Makes the exams WAY easier.

Fun guy, but lectures and labs are the same format of just going through problems. I got through the class by just attending lectures and labs, barely looked at the online lectures. I had prior acct experience, but for those that don't, it could definitely be a challenging class. Only grades are weekly quizzes and 3 exams.

Marc is a professor that clearly shows a love for teaching, and he definitely wants each student to succeed. The class itself is pretty straightforward: watch the videos, watch the recitations, practice. However, he's a fairly tough grader and you're only graded on 6 quizzes and 3 exams, so it's important to do well on all assignments.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The class was hard but Marc does actually care, just go to his office hours in the beginning of the semester and ask him about how you should structure your studying, then lock in. Class is hard tho, attendance isn't exactly required but you should go.

I love this guy. As long as you watch the lectures and take notes, you will pass. His class is extremely organized and he knows his shit. I've taken 2 of his classes so far. I'm not saying it's easy, but he makes it clear what is to be expected on the exam. Rewatch lectures before the exam and do the study guide. You will pass!

literally one of the best professors i've ever had. amazing lecturer, so if you actually go to class and put in the work, you're probably going to do very well. changed my major to accounting because of this class!! such a nice guy and so willing to help if you need it.

I've never struggled in a class before this one. I watched every lecture, went to class, did the homework and studied for every exam for 10+ hours and didn't get higher than a C+ on any of them, even going into it feeling prepared & confident.
