I don't know about other classes, but in Chocolate Science professor Pohlschneider tried to make it fun although the information was honestly very boring. Overall, an easy and sort of fun class. She also offers a lot of extra credit

This was chocolate science. We tasted chocolate. Yes. Easy A. The good thing is she knows everyone is taking this class for fun so takes the class lightly. Exams are straight out of powerpoints. Take this class!

Mary Kay is such a good teacher! I might be biased because I love the subject of Food Science and Technology, but I really did learn a lot from her and I REMEMBER it too! Her quizzes and tests are detail-oriented, but pretty fair if you study. Attendance isn't mandatory, but you should go because she asks test questions about stuff from class.
Clear lectures, easy to follow, overall nice lady.

Her quizzes and tests are borderline ridiculous. I spend a minimum of 5 hours studying for each quiz (all worth 20 points and none are dropped) and I will still get 15/20. Quizzes are based off book reading and things that are SAID or TOUCHED ON in class. Thus, attendance is mandatory. A 12 point exam Q might be based on ONE SLIDE. That's not right

I really liked Dr. Pohlschneider. Lectures were easy and always posted online. Lab portion was fun. Only thing is, she uses text book material on the midterms/quizzes that we will never go over. But still ended up with an A!

This class was fairly easy and enjoyable. Pohlschneider is laid back and will answer any questions you ever have. This class was a good intro to food processing and I am prepared to move on to the next level.

The class was incredibly easy because it was all discussion-based, but that also made it equally annoying. There really was not much teaching involved, and what she did teach was more on a middle school level. There were several papers for the class (2 3-5pg, 2 1pg, and 1 7-10 pg), no readings, and 1 class presentation. It was all straightforward.
no comment.

Honestly just a very middle of the road professor. he seems really nice and is a pretty good lecture. I just really hate Chemistry so this class was going to be a tough sell anyways. The exams are pretty tough especially later in the semester so beware. Other than that just attend lecture or look over the slides and good luck!

Dr. Chaffin was a very caring professor but he moved way too fast. I found myself getting lost in class cause we tended to be 3-4 lectures ahead of every other section. He is very accessible outside of class

Slides had few example problems to work out and strays off topic a lot. He is not great at planning his time as well and lectures end up very behind. Saved my grade by watching Dr. N's YouTube videos instead take her class!!!

Found myself constantly getting lost due to the incredibly fast paced lectures. I appreciated how he hosted separate review sessions for midterms in addition to in-class review sessions, but the one time I came up to ask him a question he flat out refused to help me and just told me to look it up online. Wouldn't have him again, that's for sure.

Great professor who genuinely made me interested in chemistry. His lectures are clear, engaging, and well-organized, and exams are fully based on lecture and recitation content. He's also very supportive—after an accident affected my exam performance, he took the time to help me fairly address the situation.

I honestly do not know why he is rated so low. His lectures are boring but when you have an over 90 minutes lecture anything with any teacher can get boring. If you go to lecture, he literally tells you what is on the exams and will skip stuff you don't need to know. He responds fast to any emails whenever I asked him questions based on concepts.

Dr.Chaffin is just very average. Lectures are boring and long. Work is chemistry, so the difficulty will depend on how much effort you put into studying and the work. He gets sassy sometimes which is interesting.

His lectures tended to be quite boring, but the material is understandable. He went pretty fast over the important material and slower on in-class problems. He speaks in a monotone voice, but seems like a caring guy. Makes lectures accessible by posting the slides before and after annotations, along with supplemental videos if you missed a lecture.

FOR CHEM 1110: Attendence is not required for lectures talks so slow during lecture that it's worth not even going just watch recorded videos on 2x. Has posted extra videos to watch multiple times since we are behind on lecture. A lot of info on the power points is useless and distracts from what you really need to know. Exams + lab are fairly easy

Dr. Chaffin is just okay. His lectures are very long, and he speeds through a lot of the material. He gives a lot of practice problems, but they aren't always what gets tested on exams. He is a decent lecturer but definitely not my favorites.

His lectures are rushed and he refuses to explain topics when students express confusion. Lectures were not clearly organized and he crammed an insane amount of information in the week of an exam- two of which we had to learn on our own. Expects us to figure it out and openly ignores students looking for further clarification. Nice guy,bad lecturer
lectures are recorded so you technically dont have to go but you'll be insanely lost, genuinely a good guy but does not prepare you well for the exams at all
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Some days there will be little content and other days will feel rushed.  Can be hard to follow at times due to confusing/lack of explanation.
He was a terrible professor and did not care about the students at all. I did not feel prepared for exams at all. He did not care if everyone failed.
Dr. Chaffin teaches the material very well in a way that's easy to understand.

Dr. Chaffin is a clear and straightforward professor. If you want to learn the material without extra fluff, take Chem with him. He does tons of practice problems in class, and recitation is super helpful. He replies quickly to emails and is great in office hours. Highly recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Chaffin is an okay professor. He just reads off the slides & does practice problems. He prepares you fairly well for the exams & gives you a good amt of resources. The chem department writes the exams & will throw in things we never learned. You will need to study/learn outside class. My lab TA sucked, and lab brought my grade down good amt.

Goes over little to nothing of what's on the test. Always doing practice problems that have calculations, but these types of problems are NEVER on the exam. Get ready to do a lot of teaching to your self. Speaks very monotone so it's difficult to even be engaged. He needs to focus more on actually teaching the concepts instead of practice problems.

He was pretty okay. Lectures were very boring. If I could, I'd give him a 2.5, right in the middle, because there really wasn't anything special. He does zoom for his classes, but you might have better luck turning to YouTube to find similar lectures. I ended up taking more from lab. I don't think he did enough in-class preparation for exams.

This professor didn't seem to care about teaching his class past 5pm, so good luck if you take this class in the evening. I always left the class needing to look at YouTube videos to actually learn the material. All in all, I am unconvinced this professor actually likes teaching this class at all and I would say good luck for anyone taking it.

Boring lecturer, just reading off slides. He does every lecture on Zoom, which makes it more tolerable. Definitely the class I put the most effort into. To any mechanical engineers taking this class, good luck.

Professor Chaffin is ok. He's lectures are extremely boring and difficult to sit through. It also seems as if he doesn't really care to be there; essentially he just reads off of the slides. He does prepare you decently well for the exams, but a lot of that is because of homework and recitation and not from lecture.

A lot of people are complaining about the tests but, in reality the tests aren't up to him they're up to the chemistry department which is notorious for being awful. In my experience he prepares you for the exams in the lectures. He also records lectures and gives lots of practice and gives exam hints in lecture.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Good professor, but speaks extremely slowly. You could probably 2x speed his voice and still understand his voice perfectly. He misses some things in lecture and some concepts required outside resources.

Chaffin teaches well, the lectures can definitely get boring - but they're clear and succinct. He's very willing to take questions and takes time to prepare you well for the exams. The exams are definitely tricky, but the practice exams he posts are very similar to tests in the course.
Good instructor. He'd help a lot during office hours for extra explanations.

Exams were mildly difficult but very similar to practice exams. Maintaining an A in the class is easy until the final, BEWARE. First few exams were passable with one/two days of studying, final was on a whole other level. Lectures were boring but helpful in understanding the material if you don't like to read the book.

Chaffin was the only option I had based on my schedule, and I wish I switched out sooner if possible. Exams were so hard and averages were very low. Practice exams were nothing like actual exam, no curves, but the only good thing I have to say is homework is unlimited attempts. Even though I passed, I may retake just for a better prof and grade.

Professor Chaffin was great! Lectures could be a little slow at times, but he greatly ensured that we knew all of the content. During his office hours, he would help every person one at a time if they had questions, being sure to thoroughly explain the answers to each question step by step
He was okay, mostly read from the slides but overall did a good job walking through several examples and explained things well in my opinion.

Dr Chaffin is a good professor. Although not mandatory, his lectures are greatly important. He also solves questions step by step, making it easy to follow. His lectures are on the slower side but the slides and material are greatly informative and important, and help a lot while preparing for the exams.

He was such a chill guy! The class itself wasn't difficult, and his lectures were very clear and concise. I loved his explanations of the content and how to solve problems - he explained just enough to help us understand the steps without spending too much time explaining elementary concepts. I started watching his lectures online later in the sem.
Incredibly slow lectures very hard to stay engaged. Not too much work, tests were worth most of the grade.

He's pretty decent. He knows his stuff and his always willing to answer questions. Goes over example problems in class to help us understand the material. He just goes a little too slow in lecture, but overall he's solid.
Prof. P is a good teacher and seems like he cares about students' growth but the tests are sort of designed to trip you up so they can be tricky unless you study a lot.

Piletz is nice and cares about his students. The class is not unreasonably hard (homework is ~ one hour of lecture videos, one quiz, and a simulation assignment on connect). The exams are challenging but utilize exclusively application questions, so knowing word for word definitions is unnecessary as long as you understand the concepts.
Seriously? Why are the exams so difficult? The study guide didn't even have sample questions we were told to imagine what would be on the test. Unbelievable.
He is a good lecturer but the work outside of class is super over the top. Very nice guy but I hate his class
Great professor. Really cares about you and the class material. Exams and quizzes are difficult, but the class is engaging and fun. You learn applicable things in this class.

This course was more difficult than I thought it would be, but Piletz was an awesome and engaging professor who made the class more fun. The timed and recorded quizzes every week, textbook readings and challenging exams were a bit annoying but if you study enough an A is definitely attainable. 2% extra credit is also offered.

Took honors. Class material was easy but we got through 90% of the 600 page textbook. Exams are more challenging but there are a lot of other grades and 2% of extra credit. Lectures were worth it but participating was required. Passed with an A- even though I got a little below average on every exam. Highly recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Best professor at tOSU

Piletz was great, but for some odd reason the marketing department just loves to make BUSML 3250 hard for no reason. Marketing is not a hard subject AT ALL, but Ohio State really loves to make it harder than it needs to be

Great professor who truly goes above and beyond to know each of this students. Weekly quizzes can be frustrating but ultimately prepare you so well for the exams. Exams are tough but if you study getting an A is 100% do-able. Anyone who complains about Andrew or his class probably just isn't putting the work in to do well. Take him!!

In his smaller class sections you have to speak at least 3 times to even earn a B for participation which is kind of difficult in a class of 25-30 people. Also, his exams are pretty nit picky so you really have to study the materials to do well on them. His averages are pretty low for a marketing class (low 70s) so you definitely have to study lots
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: The class is organized very well so it's pretty easy to set a weekly schedule to get work done and commit to it. He is a very nice guy, always loves to talk to his students and is very good at clarifying what you might not understand. Only negative thing would be that there is a lot of reading but thats nothing concerning the professor.

Andrew is a great professor who cares about his students. He is a very interesting guy who takes the time to get to know everyone on a personal level. His class is tough and requires a lot of reading, but his lectures are very helpful.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The tests In My opinion are unfair. The weekly quizzes I also believe to be a bit of a stretch for students. The first two exams are manageable but the final I thought to be challenging. He makes his class harder than it needs to be. Where the content is pretty easy but he makes his tests so specific that the average was around a C every time.

great professor, but the weekly quizzes are annoying and the exams are unreasonably hard. the hw quizzes are on honorlock and the exams are just so hard to do well on even with studying. the lectures are engaging and fun though
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Great person and cares about his students so much. The exams are horribly set up and are way too difficult for no reason. This class needs to be split up into sections because there is way too much material going on at once. Overall, be ready to work more than you should have to for a marketing class.
PHENOMENAL! Genuinely cares for his students. If you have an opportunity to take Elevate 360, do it! The course was well-organized and inspiring. Very empathetic and nice guy.

The content is Elevate360 (BUSADM 3360) is fantastic, but it wouldn't be possible without Andrew Piletz. He gets to know every student and their passions. He cares about everyone! He the most wonderful professor and one of the best people you'll ever meet. 

This course should be required for each student! Take him for marketing too!

Andrew is by far one of the best prof I've had in Fisher. He's very engaging in lectures and makes the time go by very fast. The weekly proctored quizzes can get annoying, but they definitely helped me feel more prepared for the exam. The exams were a bit challenging but if you put the effort into studying you can get a good grade.

He's a good guy and a great lecturer. He cares what his student's think and changes things based on our feedback which is nice. The quizzes are easy, but the exams are tough. Still very doable to get an A even if the exams don't go well thanks to quizzes, simulations, particapation points, extra credit etc.

Andrew himself is amazing! He cares so much about students and tries to learn everybody's names. The class itself is way harder than other business core like accounting. The chapters are very long and the exam questions are "abstract." He could explain the topics in more detail. Go to his office hours because he will spend time getting to know you.
His exams are so hard for no reason. He does too much and makes a basic introductory course hard because he probably gets off on it.

He himself is a caring teacher, that is it. His lecture is all over the place and does not relate to class material. Quizzes are fine, you will need to look at every single material. Test are very hard, if you do not watch his videos, then you are doomed because he WILL give questions from his lecture videos. Good teacher, bad teaching style.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Test heavy

reviews.comment: He's a great guy and all, but he spends a lot of time talking about himself and goes into many irrelevant details. The concepts in the course are not that hard, but he makes his exams difficult for such an basic course.

Absolutely love this guy. Best professor I have had in my time at Fisher so far. Lectures are interactive and fun, and he genuinely cares about all of his students. It's not even a hard course I just don't enjoy marketing so I got a B. A+++ lecturer.

He is a very caring teacher who enjoys teaching to his students who even memorizes everyones name. There is plenty of opportunities for grades its not just exams. Exams were a bit difficult but not impossible. But Andrew is a very great teacher and has alot of people who come in to talk to his students.

Took the honors version of this and would recommend to other to get a smaller class size. Lots of reading but the exams are fair. Go to office hours and ask for help when you need it and you should be fine. Be prepared to participate in lectures and weekly class activities in small groups

The difficulty of this course is above the middle of all the business courses I have taken, Follow the requirements, read the textbooks, watch the recorded lectures! Quizs are not designed to be hard except The final exam, which in my view, is deliberately to make it hard for you. Content during the in person lectures will not appear in the exam.

This class is not friendly to a non-native. Too many vocabularies. You will have weekly closed-book quizzes with a proctor extension, and normally take you a full afternoon to get at least 80. Final exam's average was 73. No curve and no round up. Be ready to remember tons of vocabularies and definitions. But overall Andrew is a great prof.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Andrew is a very upbeat and energetic. He makes his lectures engaging. Get ready to meet your neighbors as you talk with them every day. Exams are a lil tricky, but he gives you a vocab list to study with for the midterm and final. Read the textbook for vocab and focus on the videos for the exams. Long live the Old Town Ps and Sweet 4 Ps. Just wait
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I really enjoy his lectures and he trys to make such a big class into a smaller one so everyone at least feel somewhat connected to the professor and classmates. His exams are pretty hard but it is manageable if you put in the effort to study. Quizzes can be hard sometimes depending on the material, but overall a decent professor.

This class is the biggest waste of time you will ever have. Piletz talks about himself and his career for two hours straight, then gives you an unnecessarily hard exam that is very tedious and unrelated to any class content. His whole thing is proving marketing is hard and not just an easy business class, so he takes pride in his C averages.

Andrew Piletz is extremely passionate about teaching this course however the exams are pretty tough for 3250. You have to remember very specific details from the lecture videos and in-person lectures. Additionally, there is a lot of vocabulary to memorize. Take advantage of the extra credit and redoing the simulations.

One of the worst professors here at OSU, his exams consistently averaged C's. I'm not the smartest student ever, but I got A's in almost all business foundation classes. I think that clearly shows the unnecessary difficulty of this class. He also expresses his religion a lot which is fine, but it's weird that he pushes it on his students at times.

Piletz really cares about his students and makes the lectures entertaining but all of the actual learning is done through textbooks or videos.  The exams are fairly difficult but he provides extra credit opportunities.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: First, his in person lecture is not helpful in terms of learning, just there to socialize with other people and bring bunch of very unhelpful fake situations. Second, he instill his belief heavily into his class and he would ask students who came to his office office what they want him to pray for which is uncomfortable for me. Very hard exams.

Professor Piletz is a genuinely really nice guy. He wants nothing more than to see his students succeed. I came to office hours in search of help on a subject, and we ended up talking about life and he helped me reduce my stress. He makes a 105 minute lecture enjoyable and really helps make a class that lacks exciting content, exciting. Great guy.

If you want to go to class to socialize for an 1:45 minutes take this class. Class was used to test our knowledge on the videos we had to watch outside of class. The exams were pretty hard even though the concepts seemed easy. He was a nice professor I just do not care about marketing and wish the class was a little easier bc its just a core class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: He is just unhelpful. His lectures were not helpful for the exam, and he deliberately is vague about the exams so the grades were low. It's just more work with the weekly readings and video lectures than any other class, especially for a core class. When I went to his office hours he prayed over me before I left, which made me super uncomfortable.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: He is a very nice guy and the lectures are very engaging but I hated them. Somehow he knows everyones name and makes us talk to our neighbor for 2 hours straight. He makes good lectures but still makes you read the textbook which is annoying. Still one of the best professors you can get here. Class is relatively easy for Fisher.

Andrew is great as a person and as a lecturer. He genuinely cares about all of his students and makes everyone want to be in lecture. His lecture videos are engaging and his in person lectures are super applicable to the real world. Great human being and person. The world needs more professors and people like him.

Andrew is a very great professor. His lectures are great and you can tell he knows what he is talking about from his industry experience that he references often. The readings in the textbook take a lot of time, plus all the lecture videos. He is not clear at all about what he expects of you on the exams or quizzes, and they are very difficult.

Andrew is one of the best professors I will have in college. He truly cares about each and every student, and memorized all his student's names even though he has 800 students in total. Very interactive during lectures to help you understand, not to make you seem dumb. Watch videos, read, and come to class, and Andrew Makes it worthwhile!

Genuinely one of the greatest professors I've ever had. Lectures, both pre-recorded and in-preson, were entertaining, and in class discussions were thought provoking. Andrew made learning feel fun. Anyone who has ANYTHING bad to say about this man doesn't know him at all or just wants an effortless A. Don't miss the opportunity to take his class.

Piletz is probably one of the best professors in Fisher. He genuinely cares about his students. I attended his office hours and he talked to me just about life in general. The exams can be tricky, but if you show up and actually read the chapters, you will do fine. I ended up with 100% on all the quizzes, so just make sure you read the chapters

The best professor who is patient and kind. His lecture is interesting and uses examples to help us understand easily. He cares and always helps all students. In addition to his lecture, he tells us about case competition opportunities and invites marketing-related workers to classroom discussions.

Great Professor all around, genuinely enjoyed his course. Have to say I respect the fact that he stands for 2 hours each class lecturing and making the course appealing for the students. He also listened to students complaints about exams and quizzes and simplified everything we needed to understand down to a single PDF.
Very enthusiastic & kind towards students. Tests aren't too bad in my opinion, but you do need to study. The simulations were useless.

One of the best professors I have ever had. He is different than the majority of professors as he loves what he does and cares about his students. These are big lectures and very long, but that's out of his control and he does a great job navigating this situation. Would recommend to anyone looking to take principles of marketing.

Took this class in the fall and looked forward to it every week! Piletz gives very well-explained pre-recorded lectures and is even more fun and interactive in person. He also invites in interesting guest speakers a couple times. One time I expressed interest in a company he was familiar with and connected me with someone he knew there. 10/10

Andrew Piletz is the best professor I have ever had. Great teacher who cares about all of his students. The weekly quizzes are tough but if you actually do the reading and watch the videos you should be fine. Exams are tough too because they are all application but if you study hard you will be fine. No homework really. You will learn a ton.

I seriously wish I could take every college class with this professor. He is so upbeat and really tries to connect with college kids. The exams can be a little tough because they're application based but if you truly give it your best during lectures and prepare, they're totally fair. He is super funny and makes the class really engaging.

Andrew is a great guy that really cares about his students. His exams can be tough, but he will help you. He has great intentions and wants all of his students to succeed. He may be the best professor that I have had.

Andrew is a great guy who loves teaching and cares about his students. You do have to learn the content to succeed so be prepared to put in some work but it isn't bad. Only thing is the first exam he kind of intentionally doesn't tell you a lot so the grades are low. He helps you out for the next two so grades increase a lot. Great Professor.

I had him for BUSML 4203. I truly do not recommend him for this course. Overall, he gave us pretty easy assignments, however, he barely taught us useful information. This class has you do a semester-long simulation with a group, and he did not give any good instruction to be successful with this assignment. Disappointed with end result.

Andrew is one of the best professors in Fisher- he is clearly passionate about marketing and cares about all of his students. I took the online version and he did an incredible job engaging us and I actually enjoyed the break out room tasks! Take 3250 with him- you won't regret it!

This was my favorite class in the business core so far! Andrew is super laid back and is genuinely a great guy. He's the type that cares that you take away something from his class, rather than focus on grades. However, the exams were tough (class average was usually a C). Take marketing with Professor Piletz.

Andrew clearly loves to teach & wants his students to succeed. He makes sure to apply this class to all majors (not just marketing ones) and it really great at explaining concepts by incorporating his corporate background. Be sure to read the textbook & watch his pre-lecture videos or else you won't do well on the quizzes or exams (both proctored)

Andrew is a phenomenal person. He makes class enjoyable and teaches in a way that is very easy to understand. This class is conceptually heavy so it is important to keep up on readings and lectures. If you decide to take his course you will definitely have fun.

Professor Piletz is very passionate about his teaching. He obviously spends a lot of time preparing for lectures and really has students' best interest in mind. As long as you keep up with the material, you will do fine in this class.
Andrew is good tests are hard all around.

He is literally the worst and I do not recommend at all. He is full of himself and wastes your time. He is a try hard for no reason. Not a fan of him at all. Lectures are pointless as he repeats everything he says in his lecture videos.
Professor Piletz kind of seems full of himself. I didn't really learn anything from him that I couldn't have gotten from the book. I'd suggest taking someone else.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Cannot recommend him enough!!! Incredible guy. Extremely caring and accessible outside of class. Go to his office hours - I promise you will benefit!!! Overall, the actual class isn't too tough. Exam average was a bit low (70s I think) but he offers some extra credit (5% on your overall grade). Totally doable to get a good grade.

This course was conducted online, and both attendance and participation are mandatory. The course is graded on SmartBook activities, mini-simulations, quizzes, a midterm, and a final. All quizzes and exams were closed-noted and proctored via Proctorio. The final was not cumulative. Andrew cares deeply about this class, and keeps it interesting.

Probably one of the best professors Ive had so far, really cares about the job he does and his students success. Most of the content is textbook based, but his lectures are amazing. He also gave a ton of extra credit opportunities, about a 5% overall curve if you did them all.
The professor is very kind. When I needed 0.5 point to get an A-, he kindly accepted my resubmission of assignments and changed the grade.
Professor was hard to follow in lecture, and mostly expected you to figure it out on your own. The way the class was set up (CIVILEN 2060) did not help with this either.
He is a good lecturer. He provide lots of oppurtunity for extra credits in assingments and exams. He is a good grader as well.

Super easy class. All his lectures are online so you don't need to be there to learn. His lectures are terrible, but his the notes he posts are great. Homework is 40% of your grade, and he offers 20 extra points for coding assignments on every one. You can use your homework to take quizzes, and you get more cheat sheets than you need for exams.

He was a solid teacher, but the difference between the one midterm we had and the final was night and day. The midterm was the easiest test I've taken in the Computer Science classes whilst the final was very hard and formatted very differently to the midterm.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Feng is a pretty great professor. Minus points for using flipped classroom model (when he has plenty of time to lecture during class discussion anyway). Also, project rubrics are not published until after the due date which is dumb. Other than that, his lectures (both recorded and live discussions) were great. Explained stuff really well. Helpful
Decent instructor. Not too much homework and exams were okay. The grading seemed pretty fair.
Worst professor ever. Dont know how to teach. Couldnt explain concepts clearly. Obsessed with discussion and just want to make students suffer

Feng is great! He is super helpful and nice, and gives 2% extra credit for visiting his office hours. There weren't many assignments, which was both a great thing and a bad thing. I felt that having more assignments would have made the grading scheme more fair, but overall I would take him again definitely.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Caring

reviews.comment: Good lecturer and very accessible outside classroom. Clear explanation of basic concepts regarding operating systems. Slides are well prepared, and assignment printouts are very clear about what he expects to be submitted. Will take another class of him.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Worst ever professor in the department..!!!
No Comments

THANK GOD.  Finally a CSE teacher who gets the basic concepts across first. Easily in the top 5 cse teachers I've had here.If you take Babic over this guy, your nuts.  I quote this from his own words "dont worry about the midterm" and it was fine cause people understand what hes talking about instead of ridiculous application problems.

Professor Quinn is a fantastic professor. He is a very engaging lecturer, and participation matters a lot in class discussion. You definitely have to put in the work, and the exams are hard, but it is a great class. I wish I could have taken another class with him during my last semester as he is one of my favorite professors at Fisher.
great professor, had him for multiple classes and i love his lectures. exams are hard but the class is pretty easy otherwise. super engaging and funny in class
Professor Quinn is truly the best. His class is very straight forward and he really lays out the concepts well. He is a great guy and will work with you through whatever you are struggling with!!!
Hardest class in fisher, take other professor
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: He is a really good guy, respond email really fast. Answer your question patiently, definitely take his class.

Quinn might be a nice guy, but this class is brutal. Exams average a 65 with no curve, and on top of a 1.5-hour lecture, there's 1–2 extra hours of asynchronous content weekly. It feels like a full-time job. Unless you love pain, avoid if possible.
He's so nice but the class is kind of boring

Quinn has been one of my favorite lecturers in Fisher. The first test caught me off guard, so definitely study everything he gives you, as it's more so memorizing the terms than common sense. Every other assignment is an easy A+. He makes his lecture's super interesting too. Class is a very easy B and an attainable A with some effort.

Jon Quinn is one of my favorite professors in Fisher. He has a great personality and really cares about our learning. Definitely go to office hours and get to know him, ask questions, or even talk careers. He is extremely knowledgeable and experienced and wants his students to succeed. Go to class and participate in lecture. Super helpful and kind

Jon is such an engaging and nice professor but this class is trash. Similar to international business and logistics this class has you do a lot of work on Pearson and take 2 exams. As a student with almost a perfect gpa this class will be my first B at fisher. You should def study but when taking the exam I thought the questions were strange.
I've had Jon for several classes at OSU and he is by far my favorite professor i've had

Prof. Quinn definitely cares about teaching this class and kept the online video lectures interesting using various real life examples. Exams weren't that hard even if you only just skimmed the textbook readings. All other grades were easy As with multiple attempts to score better.
Cares a lot about participation but has very interesting and engaging lectures that go along with the course material. One of my favorite professors at Fisher.

Professor Quinn is really good. He cares about his students and loves to teach. He is kind to offer help and shows respect toward me. He also gave me snacks and participation credit when my teammates answered questions. He called me to answer questions every time I raised my hand. He was nice!

Easy class with guaranteed 100% on quizzes and assignments. Watch all of his lectures and review his slides before the exams and you'll be fine. Make sure to do the extra credit because it helps a lot.

I think objectively he is a good professor. He is passionate about what he teaches and his lectures are super relevant and interesting for anyone. However, exams are tough and some questions on it should not be not fair game because they are never found anywhere in text or lecture. Quite frustrating when you study for so long.

His exams do not cover what is in his lectures. You could read through everything on his lectures/textbook, & you'll still get exam questions that ask about something that wasn't taught. His final includes questions from old chapters even though it's "not cumulative". Confusing wording to throw you off. Lectures consist of photos that don't help.

Buddy made the final exam that he explicitly said was non-cumulative cumulative. His exam questions do not cover his lectures. Take another professor unless you are looking for someone to mess up your GPA with a useless common core class.

I took 3250 over the summer synchronously (6 weeks).  Can find answers to quizzes and homeworks in the textbook or outside of class.  You get the A is on Exams - proctorio and questions not in the notes or online, mostly reference examples from lectures.  I watched all lectures for an exam (only 2 weeks) at 2x speed before each exam and did fine.

I think he's such an engaging professor and genuinely cares about his students. He's always talking about his real world experience and has made many Superbowl commercials. It's hard to pay attention for 2 hours, but he makes it pretty enjoyable.
Take anyone else for marketing. Or don't take marketing. Seriously why are all the professors so bad at teaching marketing?
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He is a good lecturer but the only big problem with 3250 marketing is that it was one, two-hour lecture a week and then some outside of class, I feel like it could be separated into two, one and half hour classes. Overall he is a good lecturer but I am not a fan of marketing, too much memorization. Also, three big exams that make up your grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Low stress class but you'll still learn a ton. Super engaging lectures. Would recommend him for any marketing classes.
Great professor who cares about his students. Never taken a theatre class in my life but this class was very enjoyable and engaging.

Was half online half in person, so it was only two days a week. Easy class, had to read/watch one play a week, and then take a 5-question quiz on it on the second day of in-person class. Online it was a textbook to read with a 20-question multiple choice test a week, literally got 100% every time. Very nice and UNDERSTANDING professor.

Chris was a great professor and I definitely learned a lot from his course. This class is a great option for students wanting to fulfill a performing arts GE as well. You definitely can't miss in person classes because your grade rests upon participation, but theres only two papers throughout the entire semester for outside of class work.

Chris was the best professor I have had during my time at OSU. Not only was the class informative and fun, but the course created an atmosphere of respect, understanding, and team building. This was the first ever class that I felt like the professor actually took time to get to know the students and facilitate team building.
Professor Ahmed is highly underrated. His class was fair and he tried to keep it that way. I thought his lectures were good.

Had him for 3360 (wasnt an option on here)
I feel like he gets a bad rap because the lectures were kind of boring but the tests reflected the lectures and homework.
Gave an extra credit project and was considerate about moving due dates 
Made a genuine effort to help students
does give pop quizzes for participation points
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Prof. Ahmed was super inconsistent. He made us learn an entire coding language (Python) which was not in the course curriculum for 2 homework assignments that he never tested us on. His homework assignments took 10 hours a week to complete and accounted for 5% of the grade. Steer clear of this instructor.
By far the worst professor I have had at any level of schooling. First day of class, he claimed he didn't want to teach the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Very smart guy, but clearly is a researcher that the university required to teach a class. The content was not too difficult and his exams were fair, but he did not communicate the material well at all, and he rarely used Carmen so there were no materials provided besides the homeworks.

Definitely knowledgeable in the subject matter, but awful communication of the material. Lectures are terribly boring and he has little to no interaction with the class. Skipping lecture to read the textbook would be a more efficient use of your time. The exams are far easier than the problems assigned in the homework.

I took Professor Qadeer's Statics and Mechanics of Materials and overall found him to be good. He really does try to explain in lecture although sometimes I found his lectures to be lackluster. The homework is the toughest problems you have to solve and the midterms and quizzes are pretty easy. Overall 8/10 course.

I need to make this clear, this professor has CHANGED, not the same one that people have raved about. In an effort to crack down on cheating, he's made the tests 60% of your total grade and they're HARD, paper and pencil. If you can get out of taking a class with him, DO IT. His new policies are hurting everyones grades, he's been my only C at OSU
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Quiring is a great professor! While lectures can be dull from time to time, he does well making the content applicable through assignments. He wants everyone to succeed and is more than willing to help outside of class when needed. Exams are nearly identical to assignments & content. Would strongly recommend him!
Dr. Quiring is great to work with!

Dr. Quiring is a great professor. He wants everyone in the class to succeed and is there to help every step of the way. He made the material interesting and fun. His exams were straight forward. I would recommend him to anyone.

Dr. Quiring was a really good prof. He gives interesting lectures and really cares about the success of his students. Yes the class involves a decent amount of work, but its a class where you learn so much. I would recommend this class to anyone.

The first half of the semester was great (just assignments and a midterm), but after spring break we had to read 120+ pages of scientific papers a week, present on one, write a 12 page final paper, AND have a final exam. Overall, he was great but it was very work heavy for his first semester teaching it. Just make sure not to fall behind.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: In every time when I ask some questions for her, she is so unpatient.
She is a good educator. She knows what students need. She is awesome! I like her so much!
She is extremely helpful and always knows what students need. Also, she is patient with any questions you may have. Great class and great instructor!
One of the best lecturer!
Very nice teacher！Select her！
Nice teacher, very helpful.
Very nice teacher! Her class is really helpful and not hard.
She knows exactly what students need to learn. Very nice and helpful. Recommend her.
I just like her. She's is a good teacher!!!
He is awesome

Awesome instructor! Explains material well, provides good feedback, very understanding if you need an extension or cannot attend lecture or lab. Literally one of the best Software lecturers on campus.
One of the best Compsi profs I've ever had.

He is a hilarious guy who has a ton of experience and good insights. However, the class is a mess. Grades he gave seemed to be in a whim with no feedback. Something he looked at and says "looks good" would get points off later. HWs were confusing and expectations were ambiguous. It's clear he doesn't believe in 100's as no one ever got 100.

Professor Rogers is a good guy, but the structure of the course makes it difficult. The group projects are not monitored enough. There were lots of internal conflicts within groups. He does say to speak up, but no one wants to be a tattle-tale. 
As a professor, he does a good job, and the projects themselves are insightful.

Class is not easy. Group based so make sure you get a good one. Grades intense however his criteria for what he wants is clear. To get a good grade, go above and beyond and you will do just fine. He likes this. He is a funny guy and class will be entertaining. Ask questions in terms of submissions and he will tell you what is bad and what is good.

Rogers is a great professor. The bad reviews, are a bit of a stretch. He is well-versed in his field and has a heavy resume so he is a great resource. This is a capstone class therefore it is not easy. Put in the work and you will pass the class. He cares about his students and wants them to succeed; allways ready to provide feedback and guidance.
The grading is ridiculously hard and makes no sense. This class is just BSing you way through it...

Thom is a kind guy that evidently cares about helping students succeed, but he's an unreasonably hard grader that doesn't seem to really evaluate your submission. Don't get on his bad side; two very similar assignments will get different grades if he doesn't like your team. He does genuinely care, it just feels like his grading isn't impartial.

Thom is such a good professor and really teaches you what ISE is like outside of school. He is very easy to get ahold of and helps advocate for your project. I dont understand his rating on here because he was one of my favorite professors!!

Thom was a great teacher and mentor. He was hands-off on the capstone until you need him to help. He has a lot of resources and answered any questions our group had. Definitely would connect with for future questions.

Unclear grading criteria, unreasonable grade deduction, said, "It's about the experience not grade, don't focus so much on your grade" and gave you a failing grade during the problem definition phase. For a good professor, working hard to get a good grade means focusing on the course; for him, it's not.

Unclear, subjective grading criteria Poor planning resulted in the class having to learn the last 2 lectures on our own and half the class's presentations turn into papers Didn't really cover the application or how to use the concepts taught

I didn't take this class not really. I had her for chem 1206, but when i got to 1220 made the major mistake of going with professor heather allen instead for the non 8am. luckily since i knew ward i just went to her lecture and office hours instead. fantastic professor really helped me even though i wasn't even in her class.

Amazing person and teacher! She explained topics very well and provided SO MANY resources for exams. Always eager to help in office hours and easy to get ahold of via email. She also has a funny sense of humor so that made lectures more enjoyable. If you have the option to take her DO IT.

Lectures were great (and recorded), plenty of practice problems, and she answered questions clearly. I wish I were able to retake the course with her as my professor again, I recommend her to anyone who struggles with chemistry like I do.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She is a great professor! Personally Chem is a harder subject for me, especially when crammed into a semester, but she is great at helping with questions and explaining things! Make sure you attend every lecture though!!

Dr. Ward is genuinely one of the best professors I have ever had. I had her over the course of 3 semesters (Chem 1206-1208) and also 1220. She is incredibly caring and understanding, and will go above and beyond to help in any way. The class content is hard; however, she provides many resources. She made me like chemistry! Take her if you can.

Dr. Ward is a truly great professor who genuinely cares about her students. She provides many resources and opportunities for success. I recommend attending office hours as she is very personable and helpful. Exams are difficult, but practice exams and study guides are provided, making them manageable. Highly recommend taking her!
Lectures fairly entertaining, definitely keeps you engaged. Definitely heavy on homework.

Dr. Ward's lectures were super helpful! She also offered a lot of support out of class and was always very kind and encouraging. Additionally, she provided a lot of additional resources and practice. 

She recommended reading the textbook which I agree was very helpful. Also, the class is pretty fast paced so make sure to stay on track (seriously).

Dr. Ward was a great professor. She spoke at a good pace and explained the material well. Take advantage of the recorded lectures. She hosts review sessions before each exam and posts practice exams. the homework is full credit even if it is late. i definitely recommend her!!!

Amazing professor. Ik I would have gotten better a better grade if I put more hours in. But overall an amazing professor kinda goes fast and you need to keep up with the material. Do not expect curves barely any were given. Do the HW and the practice exams ask questions and take an active role in recitation.

very good lecturer and responds relatively quickly to emails. exams are on the easier side if you do the homework, do the practice exams, and actually pay attention during lectures. she makes the harder topics of the class very understandable with a lot of real life examples. if you can get her for 1220, do it.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Great professor, very nice and good at explaining concepts. The lectures are recorded and you can submit any homework from the semester until the end of the semester with no late points taken off.
Extremely easy lectures and goes extremely slow making them slightly boring. If chemistry is naturally easier for you don't bother going to lectures and just review the slides and maybe ask ChatGPT.
Dr. Ward is a great professor and prepares you well for the exams. She goes fast so pay attention, but she covers everything you'll need. Made 1220 feel easier than 1210 in my opinion.

Honestly a good professor, the only complaint about her is that she lectures very quickly, but that's not really her fault because there is so much material to learn. She really does want her students to succeed. Homework is completion graded, and there were about two homework's a week. Tests are hard but do hw, labs, recitation, you will be okay.

Dr. Ward not only really understands chemistry, but she understands being a college student too. She provides tons of study materials, has optional lecture attendance, and doesn't require homework to be completed until the end of the semester. Overall, she made some tough content much more manageable, and I am so appreciative!!

She's a pretty good lecturer, although i watched my 1210 professors lectures, she doesn't penalize for homework which allows your grade to stay up. She gives a bunch of review, beyond what the department gives. She's a great professor to have!

She provided lecture recordings which I really appreciated, and her practice tests usually line up very well with the exam. If I studied more I definitely could've gotten an A. She is very nice and would take again. Lots of conceptual questions on the exams that would trip me up, but on the final it was more straightforward.

I genuinely came into college feeling like I wasn't very good at chemistry and I was concerned I wasn't going to do well in gen chem, but Dr. Ward makes the material feel much more understandable. Her notes are well set up and, although she moves fast, she records her lectures. She is such a sweet person and a dedicated professor!

Great professor! She cares about her students and their grades. Going to lectures is a choice: she records and posts lectures. Teaches very well and makes up for missed material. Gave a lot of review for the final.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The best chemistry professor I've had so far. She explains things very clearly and even helped me understand unclear 1210 concepts from my previous semester. Very generous with grading on homework, they're all for completion. Provides SO many studying resources and is so helpful.

She was such a great professor and she really helped with my learning. If you put in the work you will do well in the class. With her class I practiced for the exams by doing the practice exams so many times, reviewing lecture notes, and attending our class sessions. This made the exams very easy, and easy to follow along.

I really loved Dr. Ward, her lectures were very engaging as she always tried to incorporate examples. She explains material in an easy to understand way. She is very caring and also very understanding. For example, one week I was unable to attend recitation, and she still gave me credit for the week as long as I filled out the worksheet.
Dr. Ward was great! Her lectures were very easy to understand and attendance was not mandatory. The course is still difficult as it is gen chem, but having her made it so much better.
Best chemistry teacher at osu next to nguyen, her lectures are fun and she makes chemistry very digestible. Fantastic teacher.

I love Dr.Ward and her lectures! She always came to class with a great attitude and you can tell she cared a lot about chemistry and her students doing well. Exams are worth about 60% of the grade but they're very manageable if you prepare! Take chem with her for sure!

Dr. Ward is an amazing professor in a class that is very challenging. Attendance is not mandatory and the lectures are recorded which was really helpful to go back and rewatch. She is truly one of the best professors at Ohio State. She cares for her students and understands that you have a life outside of chemistry. She's truly the best!

Dr. Ward is one of the best lecturers I've had so far. She packs a lot of information into the lectures but explains confusing concepts in a very understandable way, in addition to plenty of practice problems. She doesn't write the exams, so sometimes the wording is confusing to the point that the coordinators need to give extra points back.

Dr. Ward is an extremely knowledgable teacher and is always there to help. She goes a bit fast in the lectures but you can tell she's actually passionate about what she teaches. She gives useful materials like annotated study guides and practice tests, and is thorough when explaining things even through email.
Probably the most interesting professor I have had this year. Is very lenient on absences and personal issues. Clear instructions and a good attitude on student learning.

Dr. Ward is a great professor who makes all the concepts super interesting. She really wants her students to succeed and makes chemistry accessible for everyone! I would recommend her to anyone taking gen chem, makes me want to take more chemistry courses
Amazing lecturer.

I really did love having Ward as a prof. I thought she was super easy to understand and tried to present things in multiple ways so that you could really grasp it. She assigned homework as a completion grade and allowed for unlimited tries. Overall I thought she was really good and I would definitely recommend her as a prof.

GO TO HER OFFICE HOURS, she explains stuff so well over there. A funny teacher that makes class interactive. You will enjoy her class like I did. Read the e-textbook and use the practice problems to help with succeeding in exams.

Dr. Ward is the best professor I've had at OSU so far. I switched my major to chemistry after taking her course. She cares deeply about her students and is very understanding. Her course is very interesting, 10/10 would reccomend.
Engaging lectures with many practice problems. Very accessible outside of class and always willing to help.

I genuinely love Dr. Ward. She is always so accessible outside of class and you can tell she loves what she does. She makes information easy to understand and gives us a lot of practice problems. Definitely take this class with her if you can!

Dr. Ward was a fantastic instructor! Her lectures were very engaging, and she often tried to relate chemistry topics to real world scenarios which made the content a lot more bearable. Her slides were also very well done, and she captured what was tested for on each midterm very well. Highly recommend taking 1220 with her or Dr. N!

Great professor that knows her stuff! Practice tests were super helpful and I found that her lectures matched every exam pretty well. Was also super accessible outside of class (via after class, emails or office hours) and genuinely cares for students. If you were to take Chem 1220 I would 100000% recommend taking Dr. Ward's class.
Took chem1220 as a freshman and Prof Ward was great and all her lectures were recorded and on canvas

She was amazing! Lectures were brutal at 8 am but she kept everything interesting and is honestly a great person! Chem 1220 is hard in itself but she made it tolerable. Even though she records lectures, I'd recommend going to class because she goes over a lot of practice problems and is always willing to answer questions!

First and foremost, she is a great, empathetic person, which has made her be an amazing lecturer. She is a relatable person and she shares about her life + sees you as a person. Her lectures are fun and she makes it easy to understand things. However, sometimes, she focuses a lot on calculations and not theory, when much of our exams are theory.

One of the best professors I've ever had. She genuinely cares about her students, and her lectures were very interesting. She provides so many resources and opportunities to get help outside of class! Take her for Chem 1220!!

She is new so is still working out what works and what doesnt but she is really kind and wants to help as much as she can, lectures are recroded and posted and she goes through a LOT of example problems which is great. Her mastering hw has as many attemps as you want which is great. Shes a really good teacher to have

Dr. Ward is one of the best professors I have ever had. she genuinely cared about every students success and was incredibly down to earth. 10/10 professor. Gen Chem 2 can obviously be a hard class, but she made the class easier and was very accessible outside of class. Wish she was teaching OChem next semester.

Honestly, she is the BEST professor you could possibly have for CHEM 2. She truly cares and goes above and beyond to help you out. She even makes annotated supplemental sheets to review before the exam with a lot of helpful notes on how and when to use supplamental exam info. She is also hilarious and I wish she taught Organic lol. Take her class!

Dr Ward walked into Ohio State with a BANG!! She is probably one of the best professors I have ever had. Her lectures are so easy to follow plus she makes them so much easier to understand the criteria. On top of that, her office hours helps out so much because she is so caring towards her students that are there. HIGHLY RECOMMEND!
She is great, the semester isn't over yet but She has great lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: One of the best Gen-Chem professors at Ohio State. The only issue I have is that she often doesn't use sigfigs in her lectures which can lead to confusion when learning how logging H^+ molarities can affect decimal points, for example. But trust me, if that is the only negative thing, she is fantastic. It's a tough class but she makes it enjoyable!

I LOVE HER. 1 homework weekly and no actual due date for these assignments. Receive 100% for completing the homework. Just like any other Chem class but her lectures + recorded videos + resources make it go a little more smoothly. HIGHLY recommend.

They were very easy but attendance is mandatory which sucks sometimes because the lectures arent that useful majority of the time. They are very understanding and I would definitely have them again if I could.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Professor didn't answer a single one of my emails over the whole semester. U might as well just go look up random Spanish vocab lists, as they'd be entirely more helpful than the lectures. Mandatory attendance but 90% of the class is painfully useless. If u would like to receive grades back in a course, go somewhere else. Id rather learn mandarin

Class was so easy and extremely manageable. No tests at all just online quizzes that are open note and you get 3 attempts, and a final project and paper (very easy). The lectures are helpful but the online quizzes are over a video not the lecture. She was so nice and I enjoyed her class a lot and would definitely recommend her to anyone

Nieves Rivera is great professor. A lot of the 1103 class is studying vocab and learning to write well in Spanish. She makes sure you understand the material and is very interesting to talk to. Highly reccomend

They do a fantastic job of keeping you engaged. Works with your schedule and accepts late work. Is very generous and reasonable with deadlines. No exams! Just a final project where they are available to help and answer as many questions as you need!! Loved talking about real world instances and examples of grammar and overall is a great class!

This class is easy and informative. I learned so much about the inner workings of Spanish grammar (it's like a linguistics class). We had no exams- just online open-note quizzes and a final group project. Favorite Spanish class I've had at OSU thus far!
Very fast paced summer class. Some of the skills can be learned via YouTube but her class was important for application to my research. She's pretty cool and easy, but is a serious professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: So, she was very flexible and was patient with the many levels we have with technology. I could tell she wanted us to be faster learners, but she took her time and explained everything.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Worst course I've taken in my entire academic journey. You could learn as much (if not more) about NVivo by watching a 2-hrs YouTube tutorial. She didn't give a damn about teaching. Came in with 0 preparation and a few times the whole class waited for 30+ mins for her figure things out. 1/3 of the lectures were cancelled rather last-min.

She's so great and really cares about her student. She gives lot of class time to work through problems and asks questions. She also gives practice exams that are almost identical to the real exams. Highly recommend

Best prof! Lectures are very well-structured and easy to follow. She incorporates work sessions in class, which really help! She provides a lot of resources, and exams are small (20 points), but very similar to the practice exams + manageable. She records lectures but also takes attendance during them (drops 20%). very kind + organized- loved her

So many times, I had to email late or miss class. She is incredibly flexible, always willing to email back ASAP for the benefit of your success. She also sent monthly "progress reports" with a little message at the end such as "Keep going. I believe in you". Best professor I've ever had.

Dr. Ricciardo is amazing. She is always willing to help and walks around answering students questions during the time of practice problems. She also teaches students techniques in understanding the problems. She gives out extra practice problems to go over after lectures.

Took her section in the ag building in the mornings, even though it is west campus and early, it is SO worth it. The group work really helped me to understand the material better than working in a recitation would. Really caring and wants you to succeed, she genuinely wants to help you learn the material, don't be afraid to ask/email her for help.
Very good professor. She is very nice and good at teaching.

She was an amazing professor and she will set you up for success. There are many ways to prepare for the exams and if you are struggling go to office hours. She is always willing to help students out and genuinely wants students to succeed. Use practice problems and pay attention in lecture and you can get any grade you want!

Dr. Ricciardo makes General Chemistry simple and easy to understand. Her lectures involve doing many practice problems on the board and individually which helps me feel confident in my abilities before leaving class. Super understanding and always willing to help.

Here's a corrected version of your text: Professor Ricciardio is probably one of the better chemistry professors at OSU. Your grades in this class are indeed a direct reflection of the effort you put in. If you study efficiently, you should have no problem getting an A. I will say this, she never once responded to any of the emails I sent.

She truly cares about her students and tries to be as accessible and accommodating as possible. Your grade in her class directly reflects the amount of work you put in. I had ZERO background in chemistry yet felt very welcome. Would take again!

Personally, I am not taking her as a professor for 1208 as she wasn't very personable when I was dealing with personal problems outside the classroom and wasn't much help overall when it came to the class In my opinion, the learning portfolios are redundant. She takes attendance every lecture so try not to miss much.

She is so so kind and clearly cares about her students. I liked her lecture style and having an iPad with Goodnotes or something like that is VERY useful. The tests and homework load are manageable. She is also very accommodating when needed. Definitely recommend going to class though or you will feel a little behind.

Never can wrap my head around why we give practice tests when the exams are nothing like it. "The practice exam is similar to the real test". What is similar??? The Unit of the test. Kind of awkward when you ask her questions and overall just not very fair. Learning Portolios are a waste of time and nobody benefits from them. Do better.

Was a pretty good lecturer and could give good examples when you had questions. 4 midterms, 20 questions each, each worth 10% of grade. There are practice exams for them so if you do those multiple times you will just memorize the question structure and process. Chem is not an easy class but it is not super hard. Lab is annoying. HW super easy.
Attend her lectures 100%, passionate with how she teaches, provides good study materials for exams

Dr. Ricciardo is an amazing professor and person. She really cares about her students and wants them to succeed. I don't think this class is too challenging as long as you put in the work and go to her office hours if you have questions. Her lectures are very organized and easy to understand. Best professor I have had so far.

She is an amazing professor and really helps with the transition between high school and college, she is extremely understanding and helps making sure you understand the material as long as you ask for help 10/10.
Awesome professor. Puts lots of work into her classes. Explains it very well and gives you time to work and ask questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: She was a good teacher and was very open about asking for help and encouraged studying before and after class.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She is the best chemistry professor I have ever had. Her notes are very organized and well structured. She writes the notes with the class which makes it very engaging. Her lectures are very easy to digest and understand. She gives lots of practice problems and is very caring and friendly!

She is an amazing chemistry professor, probably the best I've had so far. Her midterms are fair and I felt well prepared for them based off the homework, review, and lectures. However, her final for 1206 was relatively difficult and a bit less fair than most of the midterms. Nonetheless, a simple class with a great professor.

Professor Ricciardo was an amazing chemistry professor. She really cares about her students, and was always cheerful and willing to help with absolutely anything during office hours and in-lecture. She gives time in lecture for work session on tough concepts during which she walks around and gives 1 on 1 help. Super engaging lectures, made chem fun

I love Dr. Ricciardo so much and I cannot recommend her enough. She cares so much about her students and makes topics really easy to understand. She has work session days which are extremely helpful, she gives excellent feedback, and accepts late work for full credit which relieves a ton of deadline stress. Overall, she is an amazing professor.

Awesome professor. She genuinely cares for students and often gives advise on how to best learn the material. She also gives full credit for all the late assignments which is amazing. Lab is the only pain and the exams are not easy. Don't fall behind and read the book!!
Professor Ricciardo made gen Chem 1210 bearable. The lectures moved a bit slow but she is a very kind person and the class isn't very hard.

Absolutely loved this professor, she made it a top priority to value students time and energy. She creates lecture videos on each topic discussed to reference outside of class, and was always accessible through email. Great professor with great teaching strategies. This course was adjacent to Chem 1210 and gave me a great head start going in.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: I really enjoyed this class! She made me able to understand chemistry and I actually enjoyed it! She is really caring and wants to help her students and is amazing in office hours and in class! She teaches based off of example problems and not conceptual which I was ok with. But she is an amazing professor and I would highly recommend her!!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Ricciardo is an extremely nice person. Very caring and truly wants her students to succeed. Does a great job lecturing math concepts. However, the conceptual based information is lacking in her lectures. Definitely have to use the book to fully understand them. Also, some topics are skipped. Overall, a good professor and and a great person.

Professor Ricciardo was amazing. The content wasn't easy, but she gave many resources to prepare for the exam. She starts classes by thanking students for being there which made the atmosphere so much more supportive. Material was clearly discussed, and she did great at answering questions. I could not imagine a better Chem professor.

Although Chemistry is a very challenging course Professor Ricciardo made it very easy to understand and was always working for the students best interest. There is countless examples of her putting aside her personal life to help students through the use of study sessions for midterms, finals, and general topics.

Dr. R is a bright light in the chemistry department! She uses the flipped classroom model very efficiently and I walked away learning a lot. She makes information accessible, easy to understand, and provides lots of relevant examples. She is very supportive and kind outside of class, too. If you have the chance to take her class, please do!

Dr. Ricciardo makes great effort to connect with her students. She is a great lecturer and very approachable outside the classroom. Gen chem takes some practice for sure and she does a good job of providing her students with resources to set them up for success in the class as long as they utilize them. Would recommend her or Dr. Fus for chem 100%.

I really enjoyed learning from Professor Ricciardo. You do have a decent amount of homework and the quizzes are fairly long for just a quiz but her lectures are easy to understand. If you need to reach out be ready for a quick and extremely helpful response. Genuinely seems interested in the lives of her students. I would 100% take again.

Ricciardo was not even close to preparing any student for the midterms or tests that were given. She was inconsistent in content and lacked half of the textbook required material. Make sure you are reading on your own or you will be screwed. Midterm 3 is the easiest, followed by Midterm 1, and Midterm 2 is by far the worst.

Dr. R was the best chem teacher that I have ever had. She does a lot of example problems of everything covered in class and makes sure to get good use out of the time spent in lecture. You can also tell she truly cares about her students and is glad to be there. Chem is not a cake walk, but if you put in the work they tell you to, an A is possible.
Dr. R really does care about her students and goes out of her way to make sure they're comfortable with the coursework. Which is a godsend considering how most of us react to chemistry.

I feel like as a lecturer, Dr. Riccardio was often very vague and often over complicated many concepts, which was confusing. Additionally, I missed a lecture due to personal reasons and when I went back to rewatch the lecture, there was no sound to the recording. There were also multiple lectures that weren't posted at all.

Professor Ricciardo genuinely cares about her students and is very accessible outside of class. Chemistry isn't easy but she does a wonderful job helping you create a plan and mastering the first 4 chapters of chem 1210. I learned a great deal in this class and would highly recommend it.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. R shows that she really cares about her students. She teaches the content in a manageable way and gauges her lectures off of student understanding. She is always grateful that students show up to her lectures and continued to be available for her students even when she had other things going on in her life. SHE IS GREAT!

Ricciardo really cares about teaching! Her lectures were really understandable, though problem focused, and she teaches you how to study. I havent taken Chemistry for 3 years and I understood it more than I did in high school. Pre-lecture videos are very helpful.

Dr. Ricciardo did an amazing job teaching in a very careful way. Any misunderstandings from lecture are easily clarified during her office hours and she tries to not overwhelm her students with content after exam days which I liked. Exams were difficult tho.
amazing! she really cares about her students and is a great teacher. she is really good at making people understand chem easily.

Dr. Ricciardo is the best teacher I've had. She is thorough in taking the time for students to understand the content. She is truly passionate about her work and she genuinely cares about her students. Her kindness makes attending class every day truly enjoyable. She makes pre-lecture videos every day which are a lot but really helpful for learning
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: If you are considering having Dr. Ricciardo for Chem 1210, do it. She is so nice, her lectures are useful and digestible. If you can't make it to class, she records her lectures and posts them. She will give heads up in lecture about what will likely be on the exam as well. Its much easier to get a higher grade in her classs compared to other profs

I love Dr. R, she was the sweetest person ever and really cares about all her students. Gen chem 2 was not my best subject matter, but she definitely goes through the content during lectures so that the material is more accessible to students, although sometimes not to the difficulty of the exams. Definitely a solid choice for Gen chem 2.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Caring

reviews.comment: I had Dr. Ricciardo for Chem 1100: Chemistry and Society, and it was a very easy GE course. She cares so much for her students and is very thorough in her teaching. She gives great feedback on assignments and makes her goals for us clear.

Professor Riccardo was an amazing person, and a really great teacher. This class is flipped so you do all the content and reading before class and only do practice problems during class. However, the questions done in lecture are absolutely no match for the questions on the exam. Also you don't learn anything conceptually.

Dr.R is one of the best professors I've had. She really cares about her students and teaching. The OSU Chem Department isn't the best and the tests are really challenging but she is really dedicated to helping her students. Consistent Mastering Chemistry homework but not excessive.

Rebecca is a fantastic professor. She communicates material clearly and is always willing to help. This class was a breeze, with a few in depth assignments but no midterm -- biweekly quizzes. She is super nice and seems like a very down to earth person.
It's chem so it's hard, but she is the sweetest and most kind prof I have ever had. Super helpful and super caring. She does a good job of working through problems in class.

Amazing professor with a heart of goal and genuine passion for teaching chemistry. She is sweet and personal and her love for her students makes learning Chemistry fun. She walks you through problems and inspires her class through positive reinforcement. It's just obvious Dr. Ricciardo cares.
