Really good professor. Lectures are interesting because she's hilarious. She genuinely wants to help students. But participation is 15% of your grade, and she is not very lenient on grading that. If you're one who doesn't like to participate, you won't do well in this class. Exams are tough but fair, and there's NO curve.

Love Sheneman. Definitely the most entertaining professor at Fisher. If you get a chance to choose her for Audit you should. Wish I could have taken more than just the one class with her. Audit is hard, but she makes it decent through lectures and helpful exam study guides.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Her office hours really helped and she took time to make sure you understood the material!

Her lectures were honestly amazing and informative. She not only delivered the material effectively, but went out of her way to connect with students in the lecture hall. She is passionate about chemistry and I enjoyed going to her lectures.

lectures are kind of boring, mostly reading off the slides. prepare to spend a lot of time learning about muppets that you will promptly forget. she is quite nice though and tries to do her best at teaching. however, she is a researcher as well so she does skip a few days due to conventions/talks.

Dr Hummon is such an amazing professor. She made everything very fun, and was easy to learn from. Because 1610 is chem for majors, but uses 1210 exams, she teaches a bit more than what you need to know for exams. Please take her!!
She is very good at teaching. She is also excited to teach chem which always makes for better learning and understanding.

Very good professor especially if you are just starting out in chemistry, the only possible downside I can see is that recitation is graded, but is only one hour once a week. Seems like most of the ta's were decent. Lectures were engaging, big power point prof but in my opinion way better than chalkboards. Great teacher, but low office hour seating

She was a good professor, I enjoyed her lectures but don't be surprised when you start learning about the Muppets randomly in class. Recitation attendance is mandatory and worth a decent chunk of the grade so don't skip recitation. The labs for this class weren't bad but make sure to take the math seriously because the post lab is very unforgiving.
I absolutely recommend taking her 1610 class. She is amazing.

Dr. Hummon is an amazing professor who prepares you really well for each exam. As long as you put some effort into reading/reviewing the slides, you should be good on all exams. Her lectures are interesting, and you can see her enthusiasm for teaching.

She was average. I would take her again if I had to, but I would prefer not to. She spent a lot of time talking about muppets, rather than the actual chemistry. I would say you should be happy if you got her.

She's AMAZING!! She has very in-depth lectures and is willing to answer questions in a way that you'll understand. She also prepares you well for the exams with her lectures which have demos that are are very fun and interesting.
Dr. Hummon is GOATED. She is so nice and cares very much about her students. You also will get to learn about a couple muppets in each lecture which is always fun. The class is also pretty easy.
Great explanations of material with plenty of memory tricks and breaks so students don't doze off. Lovely personality and remembers students faces and names well.

She is one of the best lecturers for this course. She always prepared some demo experiments for almost every lecture, which made the lecture fun and interesting. She always uses simple language to explain complex chemistry concepts and makes them easy to understand. Homework is a lot, but it did help consolidate the concepts learned in the lecture.

She was an ok lecturer compared to some other options, especially those for 1210. Sometimes she would not explain things very well. She doesn't like to personify chemistry but without that it was sort of confusing. The material isn't hard, but the exams are killer. The homework itself is on a different website not linked to Carmen.

She's a pretty fun teacher to have and is good at explaining things. Definitely still read the book and attend her office hours because they are very helpful. I know that she is also good on giving extensions for online assignments. I'm not happy with my grade but I would take a class with her again because you can tell she likes what she does.
Good at explaining
Plenty of writing, but it's not going to destroy you, it's very doable and easy if you just read the passages properly. Just do the hard work well and on time, and you'll get an A.

Dr. Hufton is very caring of her students. If turned in late, specific assignments have a three-day grace period, and there are no exams. Assignments were graded fairly and easily if you followed all the directions. Some assignments required time to be set aside, but nothing was too hard. She would put out weekly announcements for the class!

Dr. Hufton was always excited to teach us, so that made me excited to learn from her! You'll usually work with classmates during lecture and the in-class assignments are designed to make one think in a way that they usually haven't before. My brain is bigger because of her class.

Professor Hufton was great! 2410 was an easy online class, the work was very organized and there was a decent amount of writing it was over easy topics. There is a good amount of work, but is all easy and she gives 3 day extensions on all assignments.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Hufton truly cares about her students and I really enjoyed the opportunity to meet with her for feedback during office hours. The class consisted of discussion posts and small projects throughout the semester. I would say expect spending 2.5 hours on the class per week. Highly recommend this professor!

Dr. Hufton is the best professor I've had at OSU! The reflection essay assignments will seem intimidating at first, but you get used to writing them, they genuinely facilitate learning the material, and are not graded very tough. She really values student feedback and will dedicate time to what you really need and want to learn.

Great prof! No exams. Class is mandatory to receive points. One "press release" assignment and one research paper (5-6 pages), and discussion boards. Have to watch a weekly lecture before coming to class (ours was just on Mondays) and then we have an in-class assignment during class as well that is easy but expands knowledge on the topic. Def take!
Gave pretty dry lectures, but he was accomodating, and the assignments in his class were pretty easy. I struggled on exams, though they were not heavily weighted.

He is easily one of the worst professors in the CSE department. His lectures were incredibly confusing. Whenever students would ask questions, he would always give incredibly condescending and passive aggressive answers. Exams were poorly constructed and overly tough. Overall, the class felt like an incredible waste of time.

Prof. Baha was easily one of the worst professors I've had at OSU. His explanations were confusing, his questions vague, and his grasp of basic programming concepts shockingly weak. Lectures were frustrating, poorly communicated, and felt like a waste of time. Avoid if possible.

Very unorganized professor and the exams are very detailed, make sure you know all possible functions of Ruby, JS, and all possible stylistic elements of CSS and HTML. He will ignore your email if he does not need/want to accommodate, especially for requesting extensions. He will sometimes be passive-aggressive when students don't do well

Lecture doesn't really make sense. He would jump around materials and stop mid sentences. Vague project instructions. He doesn't know how git and GitHub work. Whenever I asked about environment config related stuff, he would send me to TA or pull up ChatGPT. Midterms were not bad though if you study but final was brutal.

Baha's midterms and final exam are unfair and insulting to the student. During his lectures, he does not actually teach, and has the students teach the material amongst themselves. He will randomly email from his phone, asking you to resend a file that he misplaced. Please find another lecturer to take 3901 with as I believe it CAN be a good course
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He's a great guy and good teacher. He accommodates to most requests and grades easy. His English is not the best so you might want to read the slides yourself. Other than that I think he does a great job and I like that he codes live in class instead of just reading the slides.

Idk why he has so many 1/5. he's one of those professors who makes you laugh in class. i never found myself staring at the clock wondering when class is over. i will say though, that he isn't the best at explaining things and sometimes is even wrong about content. but 3901 has really easy content to understand so chatgpt was able to explain better.

Fall 24 is when Baha started teaching this class. It's not hard to get an A in the course despite him being vague about the content you'll be tested on. He is not quite the best explainer, but everything can easily be answered with a Google search. He is really not that bad as the other reviews make him out to be.

Professor Amayreh is a great guy, he's nice, but a bit confusing. There's weekly reading assignments,but the topics would be covered a week after it was due. This made me feel like I didn't really learn anything. Attendance is mandatory(he loves tophat). I believe it's his first year here, with some improvements I'd enjoy having him as a professor.

He is a really nice guy, but I didn't grasp anything. Everything is through Zybooks. Every week, we have a reading assignment that we need to complete, even though the material will be explained the following week. His slides and PowerPoints look great, but he often explains Zybook content or sometimes skips over material.

Look he is a nice guy with a big heart at the end of the day and grades leniently.  When it comes to exams he gives very BROAD details about it so you have to know every slide and put a lot of time outside of class because you can be thrown with anything. I highly suggest avoiding him.

He seems like a nice person and probably is but it feels like nothing is covered in this class. It doesn't help his sentences make no sense most of the time and he cannot convey ideas at all. If you take him to get an A, you probably will, if you want to actually learn web dev AVOID HIM. You will leave every lecture only more confused.

Nice guy, grades very leniently. He will take up any amount of time available to him for lecturing from the moment the clock hits the time to start till the end he will be talking. Will take attendance, No time during class for project, test are based heavily off of in person coding examples. Pick a good group otherwise this class is draining.

She is very demeaning and expects her students to only do ochem 24/7. She DOES NOT take into account other classes nor does she care that students have other classes. She is incredibly unforgiving and overall rude. She mentions countless times that we are not going to get into med/pa school if you do poorly on a quiz or test.

She seems to assume this is your only class and assigns a very heavy workload. The course uses ALEKS, which Is extremely difficult and not very helpful for explanations. I would not recommend taking the lab at the same time because the lab material does not align with the lecture content at all, and exams have to be scheduled on weekends and early.

Given the selection of chemistry professors at Ohio State, Dr. Baldwin is by far the best that I've had. Yes, the class is hard, however she gives an abundance of resources that will dramatically change how easy the class is. She is a great lecturer and is very engaging. Just show up to class, do the problem sets, and asks questions and you'll pass

She gives a lot of resources but expects too much out of students. If you have a lot of extracurriculars, jobs, and 18+ credit hours -- don't take her class. She acts like it's your only class. I'm taking 2510 with Parquette and he is way better at explaining in my opinion and wants you to learn concepts, not just memorize them.
Generally dismissive and patronizing. She provides a lot of resources for exam prep, but other than that she's consistently one of the worst chemistry professors at OSU.

OChem is a very difficult course, so her class is going to be hard. She provides the most clear resources to be able to succeed. If you want to do good, you are going to have to work hard, and she will help you if you ask. You just gotta earn it. But if youre willing to work hard, she's the professor for you. You'll learn more with her than anyone.
She is the goat

Baldwin's class is hard but she is amazing at teaching. As evil as she can be, she is a great lecturer. Did I have to put in the hours yes. Do I know so much ochem now, though, also yes. Nobody gives practice material like her, and you can hate her, I did, but she is good at her job.

She has a very fast pace lecture and goes over a lot of content. She provides the most practice for her students though and it takes a lot of time to go over it prepares you well. She isn't the nicest professor ever...but she is an amazing teacher and you'll learn more from her than any other ochem professor.

Dr. Baldwin is a very polarizing teacher; you'll either love or hate her. From my own experience, she is the best lecturer I've had; she explains things very well, her lectures move very fast, and keeping up is crucial; if you fall behind, you'll be playing catch-up the entire semester.
really just do not like the way she treats her students.

She's a good lecturer, but so condescending and her tests/quizzes are ridiculous. She asks way too much of her students. Every now and then there will be those 5 people that get 98-100 on an exam and because of this, she doesn't really care that her exam averages were between 40-55%. ALEKS is ridiculous as well. The curve was huge, though.

Very difficult class. Would've been better if I had her for the first section of ochem because of her teaching style. Has really high standards for her students. Lots of memorization. Go to class, its your only chance. She has prewritten notes which was really nice. God speed.

Baldwin gets a bad for the wrong reason. She is a phenomenal teacher (but rude), BUT she covers much more than needed and her tests reflect that. The quiz averages were hovering around 60% and the 2nd test and final were also around 50%-60%, with the 1st being 70%. She provides all you need to succeed, she makes the course way too much work.
condescending af and finds joy in making things harder for her students

If your final average is below a 50%, you have failed as an instructor. I did well in spite of Baldwin making a hard concept even more difficult. Too many smart people I know have struggled in this class despite putting in time and effort. Avoid this instructor, unless you're willing to put in absurd hours with no grace.

I went into this class trying to give her the benefit of the doubt. I should not have done that. I think her class could actually be doable if grading scale and level of difficulty in her exams/quizzes wasn't so hard. Her exams usually average around a 40% which I find really concerning that it's even allowed.

She's definitely not the most personable, however she does provide a ton of resources and every exam had 25 extra points built in. Also my grade got curved at the end from a B- to a B+ so there is definitely wiggle room. Weekly quizzes and reaction notebooks also gave a buffer. Definitely not everyone's cup of tea but I will be taking her again.
rather get 670 wet willies than have another interaction with her. tanked my gpa massively and i got an a in 2510.

Dr. Baldwin is GOATed. Her exams/quizzes are basically the problem sets, she gives so many resources, and she actually wants you to do well. Office hours are super helpful, expectations are clear from day one, and her lectures are organized, and straight to the point. Take Baldwin and thank me later.
ruined my life

Lots of resources, professor is good at explaining, but uses ALEKS for homework. Using a website program for long reaction mechanisms that you have to write EXACTLY the way it wants or it doesn't mark it as correct is beyond me. The professor's own mechanisms would be marked incorrect by the website btw, huge waste of time. Avoid if packed semester

She subbed for my intro class for a month. Doesn't answer student questions; if you ask a question she will say "you should know that already." Very passive-aggressive and doesn't understand that undergrads surprisingly don't have PhDs in chemistry. Explains content well but doesn't like you.

Quiz averages have been in the gutters (single digit out of 25 for the past few weeks) and she doesn't want to make it any easier even though the class is suffering. Took her for 1 and did well but she's just out of it this semester. Don't recommend her anymore.

Avoid Dr. Baldwin at all costs! She is the most passive aggressive person I have ever met. Her exams are incredibly difficult and MT2 averages around 45-50% with a curve built in. At least she can teach the material. I did well in the class but it took too much work!

She espouses a most heinous style of instruction. Her lectures move quickly, and if you fall behind, the jaws of failure await you. Furthermore, she prides herself on positing difficult queries; making a hard subject even harder is despicable. Seemingly profligate effort is actually insufficient in earning an acceptable grade.

Steer clear, reader!
Baldwin is a little hard but gives a lot of resources to succeed

She prepares you and helps you with infinite resources so you know exactly what will be on the exams and quizzes. Just use the resources she provides you and you will excel in ways you didn't know was possible. She has 100s of points worth of EC and truly makes it hard for you to fail. I took her for Ochem 1+2 and did better in Ochem 2. 

Take her.
does not care about her students
Dr. Baldwin is a hard professor, but if you put in the work you'll be very prepared for the MCAT/DAT/etc. She provides many resources to succeed.

Dr.B is smart enough to take on student feedback to make improvements. And yet her true narcissistic and nasty nature comes though throughout the semester as she says things in lectures and talks to students and "answers" their questions. This class is better than when she first started teaching. She is worse/more condescending since she started.
You can tell she like ochem and doesn't have time for people who don't like it.

Her class provides a lot of resources that can be helpful, however her lectures move very fast. She also made a lot of comments about how difficult her exams are and will tell you that you are not going to pass. Overall it was very unmotivating and would not recommend her

Dr. B. is very clear and concise when she speaks, and answers questions clearly. I had a family emergency and b*mbed my 2nd exam. I'm taking her again this fall as she's very kind and the amount of resources she provides is INSANE! She is very fast-paced (helps with ADHD). Go to class, do the problem sets, and remember the curve. You got this!

I really don't understand the overwhelmingly negative reviews of Dr. B. She can come off a tad condescending at times, but I always took it as just being more direct and to the point. She teaches the concepts clearly and I truly feel like my understanding of ochem improved dramatically from ochem I. The first midterm felt unfairly hard, though.

Pros:
Is intelligent, high energy, and a good orator.

Cons:
Extremely condescending and unhelpful, will expect you to put in 20-25 hours a week for her 4 credit hour class, does a poor job with practice problems (she will insufficiently explain a concept and then give us significantly harder homework and quiz problems).

Take away: Avoid Dr. B.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Dr. Baldwin teaches really fast and uses ALEKS, unlike other ochem profs—so expect weekly modules. Her tests are super long (8–9 pages), but she gives lots of extra credit. She can come off condescending when answering questions, but likely wants to help. Just be ready to learn a lot on your own.

It's understandable to dislike Dr. Baldwin based on her past actions. However, she has taken student feedback seriously and made the course more tailored to students' needs. Dr. Baldwin gives you all the resources you need to be successful in her course. Use problem sets and past material. Keep an open mind entering her course, and you'll be fine.

Listen to me, if you have a good critical mindset and are not a procrastinator, take this class. If you are pre- med take this class. She will be helpful for mcat prep with the way she makes you know the specifics. If you arent pre-med or suck as critical thinking run away.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Baldwin gets in the way of her teaching through her narcissistic attitude and genuine dislike for every student.  She has no place teaching on a college campus.  I learned a ton in this class because of the studying it required to place well on her exams.  Her pace is impossible to keep up with.  Ochem isn't that bad, but she makes it worse.

I absolutely loved Dr. Baldwin. Her lectures were concise, good, and there was so much practice material to work on until you figured the conceptual part. I did every single practice set and it helped me so much to succeed. Unpopular opinion, but the people who complain about her being impossible don't put in the work it takes to succeed.

Baldwin is so hard to read, and I genuinely can't tell if she wants you to succeed or not. shes an okay lecturer but likes to embarrass you when you don't know things/ask quesitons. she also has very little empathy/ any filter so be prepared to cry and feel horrible about yourself if you have a meeting w her (i know from experience)

She told me to my face I wasn't going to pass. 
Does not cover material in lecture well, just goes over mechanisms and tells you to go study it and learn on your own. 
Gives homework that sometimes takes 2+ hours to do. 
She gives good materials but acts like her class is the only class you're supposed to be taking. 
Does not account for others
Professor Baldwin ruined my life for a semester. Gave up on my dreams because of how bad she was at teaching.

I check the clock every 2 minutes hoping time gave up like I did. 

Don't take the class unless you are an unemployed students with no other classes.

Good lecturer, exams are awful. Told us that we shouldn't be upset about an exam being hard because our average was higher than previous courses. She told us that there will not be a curve because class average is above a 70%. The way she announces exam results feels slightly disrespectful towards struggling students, from an outside pov.

The lectures are extremely fast and I never understood the content until I reviewed the notes. She has online lecture videos and great resources which are super helpful for catching up and reviewing. MT1 avg was around 80% and MT2 was around 50%, so don't get lazy after the first midterm (or ever because you will be humbled so fast)

Absolutely amazing lecturer, one of the best I have had at OSU. She gets an absolutely absurd amount of hate simply because some people dont know how to study, fail exams, and need someone to blame. Her notes are extremely organized and she teaches very well. Exams are not at all impossible, very fair rather. All you need to do is study properly.

I don't agree with the reviews that Dr. B is a bad person, I think she cares and wants her students to succeed, she just makes it impossible. Her tests are ridiculously hard, and she goes through lectures so fast, its impossible to keep up. My class asked her to slow down and she laughed at us and told us she wasn't going to listen.

I like that she provides a lot of practice but the answer keys to check your work are not helpful at all (ie. If you mess up, you'll never know why, and if you ask her, she will be as condescending as possible). I tried my hardest in this class and it still wasn't enough. I took it with Jennifer Walters over the Summer and got an A. Incredibly rude

Dr. Baldwin's class is FAR from easy, and she will push you as a student, but she makes sure you actually know what you're being taught. If you're not ready to work really hard to learn organic chemistry she is not the teacher for you, but if you're willing to strap up your boots and get to work she'll be your favorite professor.

She runs a tight ship, she takes student feedback seriously (and simultaneously proves the folly of democracy), and she is relatively responsive to emails. Her demeanor can be off-putting to students who don't know what they don't know. Help her help you!

Side note: Dr. Baldwin, if you see this, please don't hurt my friend in 2510. I love her.

Genuinely the worst Ohio state school experience I have had since stepping foot on campus. She emphasizes how she can tell we aren't doing practice problems, her midterms are entirely impossible application and mixing concepts. Weekly quizzes, ALEKS that takes 7+ hour alone. Recitation worksheets for a grade. Unreachable and rude via email

I really enjoy O-Chem and loved the material, but Dr. Baldwin is the worst professor I have ever had. I am shocked that Ohio State continues to allow her to teach given how unpopular she is with her students. Incredibly rude, condescending, and thinks she is smarter than everyone else. Please take this difficult course with a different professor.
homework took so long. exams were impossible. lectures were extremely lengthy. do not take this class with her. and on top of everything, she is incredibly cold

Doc Baldwin is phenomenal. She truly does care about you, even though some people may disagree. She is very clear on the expectations and provides endless amounts of materials to prepare you for exams and quizzes. I can see why some people dislike her, but she tells you how it is, and I see how that may offend people, but she does look out for you.

I could not follow lecture, I felt like the professor went through examples so fast and repeatedly insinuated we should already know how to do things while we were actively covering that section. It was a really demoralizing experience. I did not enjoy the flipped class room set up as it felt more like an online lecture with a 200person recitation.

Dr. Baldwin was a great professor! If you actively are trying to be successful in this course, you can do it with Baldwin. Ochem is a hard class universally, and I believe I was successful because of her. Also, she gives a lot of additional practice in case you feel uncertain about a subject. All in all, love her and would highly recommend.

Good things: big curve (B -> A-), exam seemed to have gotten easier thru the years (still HARD tho, the final avg was 44%), & easy assignments/EC to help grade. She teaches great, you can understand everything but the exams are on level 100 for no reason. This the 1 class you should make friends in. She's better for 2510 esp for pre-health ppl.

I took her class in 2021, and it seems like she hasn't changed. She is a good teacher that, if you were a Chemistry major like me, you would appreciate greatly. You will have amazing understanding of the material, given that you use the materials she provides you. This class took up ~1-2 hrs a day studying. Have a study group for LC to get 100%!

Ochem is a hard class and you will need to be ready to put in the work, but baldwin teaches it in such a way that you will have a really great understanding of it. utilize all the resources she gives to you, it teaches you so much. i wish i had her again for ochem 2; her midterms have gotten easier over the years and she has a good curve

Dr. Baldwin's class is no walk in the park, but she gives you all the resources to succeed. Her lectures move quickly, so self-study is key. Utilize the practice materials and unstuckstudy ai - it really helped me prepare for exams. Tough, but rewarding if you put in the work.

Ochem is always going to be a hard class, but find another instructor. 
Poor lectures, rude and unwilling to help. She acts like someone asking for help is such an inconvenience and rolls her eyes. I wouldn't care so much about that if she was actually helpful, but she doesn't even answer or explain the concept.

She's very smart, and also a good teacher. She provides tons of resources and practice material. She is, however, by far the rudest, least considerate, and most unfriendly professor I've ever had. For that reason, I would highly recommend to not take her class.

She gives a lot of resources which are super helpful and a big reason why I succeeded in ochem. Her lectures move super fast and a lot of the learning is done on your own. The biggest problem i had with her was that she would make students feel so dumb for asking questions both in lecture and office hours

She gets a bad wrap. Her class takes a lot of work, which is expected out of a class like ochem. she is really nice and gives you every opportunity to succeed. People get upset that it requires a lot of work and overall knowledge, but after taking this class I feel very prepared for my next steps as this information was learned! Baldwin was great!

Dr. Baldwin has lots of practice material such as problem sets, practice quizzes, and practice exams, that correlate to the exams and hw, I did not attend lectures but watched her online recordings and completed every practice material available and did fine in the class. Make sure you utilize the practice material

She gets a bad rep, but it is obvious that she cares about her students and success in her class is not impossible. She gives more than enough resources and although her quizzes are tough, she gives enough drops and is always trying to get feedback and change her course. Only complaint was exams are really tought. Gets undeserved hate IMO.

I was initially scared to take Dr.Baldwin, but then I realized people don't want to or can't put in the amount of work it requires. Dr Baldwin does not baby you like some professors I have had you need to put in the work yourself and earn it. The best advice is to prepare before and after class, attend all lectures, and use her practice material.

Baldwin herself is rather blunt, but extremely organized; never felt like I didn't know what was going to be on the exams or quizzes. Practice exams are actual past exams from the course, which I liked. Amount of content can feel overwhelming, so stay on top of things. Would take her for 2520 if I could.

Everyone will tell you that OChem is a difficult class, but Dr Baldwin does her best to make it 10x as challenging just because she can. Condescending, ridiculous grading, and cannot seem to understand that she is the common denominator when everyone is getting a 30% on an exam.

She will teach a topic one way, then test for it completely differently on her quizzes. It makes the information from her lectures useless.
A hypocritical style of instruction is in no way beneficial to facilitating a healthy learning environment; it only makes certain that students learn to distrust their professor.

Dr. Baldwin seriously will set you up for success in organic chemistry. if you dedicate your time to this class, you will 100% succeed. She gives SO many resources to practice and a great amount of extra credit. Quiz drops help too! Great prof, would recommend. she always answers her emails quickly and with very detailed replies.

She provides more than enough resources to be successful such as previous exams, practice problems, and lecture videos. She answers emails very quickly and is really helpful. Weekly quizzes are hard but force you to keep up. Exams are difficult but fair. I feel like I learned the material very thoroughly and am glad that she was my professor.

Organic chemistry is inherently very difficult and this Dr. Baldwin's course is no exception. Although she feels hard to approach, Dr. Baldwin teaches quite well and provides lots of resources to help students succeed. I felt more adept in a lot of the concepts than peers in lab who had different professors. Expect the quizzes/exams to be brutal.

Baldwin's efforts to provide resources and explanations are unfortunately often mistaken for her "making the class harder" or adding unnecessary work. The fact is, ochem is a brutal course, and if you don't keep up with the class (like me), your grade will suffer. Baldwin's exams, while tough, are fair, and she goes above and beyond to prepare you.

I truly found her difficult in the beginning because  ochem is a new language and students are thrown into the deep end. She moves fast but relays the information really well and gives a ton of practice help. You'll have to go over things multiple times to get the grasp becuz of her speed. She can be rude I think when answer questions though.

Dr. Baldwin is a great professor and one of the best I have had. It seems like those who think she is "mean" don't understand her tough love. It is undeniable that she wants you to succeed and she gives you all the ins and outs of the content with lots of practice. The class is immensely difficult, but anything worth doing is!
Dr Baldwin gives you everything you need to succeed but has a very hard class. Exams were super hard but extra credit is often and the homework boosts grade.

Do not let other people's opinion influence your mindset heading into her class. Her tests and quizzes are Herculean tasks, difficult in amount and complexity. However, she does provide materials (Problem Sets, Previous Tests) that allow you to excel in the class. Those who don't put effort are not prepared for OCHEM 2, or any rigorous STEM course.
Her problem sets are super helpful and she even gives us all the lecture videos.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Terrible memory to think back.

Attend lecture! That is the most important key to success with this professor. There are occasional chances for extra credit by attending lecture every day that YOU WILL NEED at the end of the semester.

Baldwin tries her best but ultimately is not accessible outside of class and the tests are impossible. i tried to go to her office hours and there was always a line out the door and i had to wait like 45 minutes just to have one question answered. some of the tests had in the 30 percentage average (which indicates a teaching issue). good luck.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Her lectures are clear and well-summarized. She gives you a lot of resources to prepare you for the exams. She expects you to put in some work, and you should, because it's a hard class. If you figure out the way she grades things and the types of questions she asks, you can succeed. Her lecture checks are sometimes unnecessarily stressful though.

One thing you must remember before taking Ochem with ANY professor is that it is supposed to be complicated. This is a weed-out course because of its rigor, but Baldwin gives tons of resources to set you up for success. I believe I did well because
1. I had a tutor from day one
2. I completed the provided resources
3. I gave this class my time

Class average on our last midterm was ~34%, she then spent ten minutes belittling us over how it was our fault and that we all weren't trying hard enough. Suuurely it wasn't the one thing all 300 or so students had in common (her.) She is inefficient in the classroom, and the flipped approach just makes at worse. If you want to learn ochem, run.

She inefficiently utilizes the flipped classroom style. The tests are designed for you to get a C or below. To be honest, I'm not sure how anyone gets above that. I have disabilities and found this class quite inaccessible which was my downfall. Take it at CSCC.

Provides way to much material, had a flipped classroom for my year that did not help at all. She will explain something once and proceed to go into a very complex problem and expect you to know it right off the bat. Acts as if her class is the only class you are taking.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Not sure why she receives a bad rep when it comes to ochem professors. Explains material extremely better than anyone else in the entire chem department. She also gives an insane amount of extra credit throughout the semester to prep your average before a midterm. Midterms are obviously difficult, so you need to study. Grading is fair.
Exams are based on lectures. Put in the time for lectures and understand them, and you will do great. Quizzes and Lecture checks are straight out of lectures. Very organized and thoughtful!

Such an awesome professor, she replied to my email in literally 5 minutes and she actually cares. She extends deadlines all the time and is really easygoing with grading. It's a hard subject and she knows it so she emphasizes that we don't need to know everything.
So far this is the best class I've ever taken! Awesome professor I'm so glad I didn't listen to all the reviews!!

I will continue to defend Dr. Baldwin to anyone who has an issue with her. I'm currently in 2520 and miss her lectures and learning from her so much. Her class is fast-paced but I found her flipped classroom to be an amazing way to learn ochem. She cares a lot about us and is ALWAYS working to improve the class. Please don't listen to the hate.
Super fun class and professor and it's an extra bonus that she is really nice and friendly with everyone. I look forward to seeing her at office hours. Fantastic professor and great friend!
Dr.B once told us about her favorite animal and she welcome everyone to bring their cat to lecture for extra credit!

Dr. Baldwin is one of the best ochem professors at OSU. She sets her students up for success by providing practice exams, practice problems, and online lecture videos to watch before attending lecture. Ochem is a tough subject, ultimately it is up to the student to make use of her resources to succeed in the class. Dr. Baldwin is truly amazing!

She's great! Super easy class. Super friendly teacher and she is really lenient with grading exams too! Her class is always fun and relaxing, she makes sure you aren't overworked and have enough resources to always do great.

She's great! Super easy class. Super friendly teacher and she is really lenient with grading exams too! Her class is always fun and relaxing, she makes sure you aren't overworked and have enough resources to always do great!

I only did well bc I spent HOURS deciphering her 2x speed speech in lecture vids. Stay on pace the whole semester bc if you fall behind quizzes won't make sense. Don't take the practice exams, they will confuse you. Thoroughly watch the lectures and do every problem set and you will survive. Read the textbook if ur confused on something. Good luck

This is orgo so you naturally have to be intelligent to succeed in this class. With that in mind if you come to class ready to learn and put effort into teaching yourself the concepts you will do fine. Focus on studying for the quizzes and the exams will come easy. Baldwin does a fine job teaching some people just don't pick up on conceptsgetbehind

Dr. Baldwin truly doesn't deserve the hate she receives, as she provides so many resources for her students to do well. She responds to emails very quickly and provides awesome feedback. Yes, organic chemistry is difficult, but the best tip to succeed is to practice and really drill down the basics, which I believe Dr. Baldwin does very well.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She's really bad but I somehow did well enough in the class and it was amusing to see other people struggle and deal with her nonsense. If you're smart you'll be fine and you get the added bonus of seeing her belittle everyone else on a daily basis.

She will be the only one who is teaching this course and ochem 1 is required for any pre-health major. Giving her positive reviews hurts other students. OSU please give us another option, Baldwin put us under mental stress every single day and utilize any chance she could catch to wreck our GPA. She is the worst.

If you can manage a heavier workload in your schedule you should take Dr.Baldwin. She prepared me so well for ochem2. She provides many resources and is transparent with what will appear on exams which not a lot of professors will do. Nothing is more nightmarish than trying to study a poorly organized course, so avoid that with Dr.Baldwin.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I don't get where her "bad" reputation comes from. She provides so many resources for you to do well in the course. She also hands out extra credit like candy on Halloween. Is Ochem hard? yes. Is it easier using her resources and practice problems? Yes. Would 100% take her again.

I do not really get where all the bad reputation comes from. The flipped classroom works great for me. You don't even have to attend lectures to do well. All you have to do is understand the material. It's really not that hard. Force yourself to genuinely understand what you are doing; I guarantee you we do well.

Had to contact my high school chemistry teacher to help me through this class. Dr. Baldwin's office hours were useless and she never responded to my email in a timely fashion. Taking points off for no reason. Pretty sad that an average high school teacher gives more help and value than a high paid professor at a top class university.

Dr. Baldwin praises her abilities to find ways for us to soak up the information. Her rxn book is nonsense. You spend hours working on it and it helps with nothing. Her "practice" problems are nothing like the problems we actually get graded on! Lecture questions are undeniably a waste of my time. She does not like to give herself as a resource.

Dr. Baldwin uses the slew of practice problems she uploads online as a means to disguise the fact that the classwork does not adequately prepare students to try and excel at them. Yes, she has provided "tons of resources," but if the style of the class does not help students understand how to use them, then they may as well just be gibberish.

I had COVID, emailed her explaining how bad my symptoms were and that I would need more time. she told me still do the assignments or to take zeros as COVID is not an excuse, even after I sent her proof from the university that I tested positive.
She claims you'll do better on the MCAT by taking her class...but the averages for the other ochem professors are higher than her students' scores. The statistics are online.

It's a hard class. She does not care and is unwilling to improve the class. No extra credit, no tools to succeed, you'll fail even with a lot of time and effort. I got a 70 on midterm 1 and still have a C. She is unwilling to help or give practice questions. Reaction book does not help. Textbook helps more.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Its a hard class but she does care & is working hard to improve the class. Gives a lot of extra credit + the tools to succeed, it just takes a lot of time & effort! I got a 65 on MT1 but now have an A, don't give up! Reach out to her for help & do lots of practice Qs (especially PS) & rewrite key ideas & make a rxn book! I never used the textbook

There's no way an actual intellectual can go through this class and decide to give her a 5 star review. Luckily, the explanation is that she asked her TAs to write those reviews. They are not written by real students.
She is an average professor but has no redeeming qualities. It's difficult to think of anything that makes her stand out as better than her peers and colleagues teaching the same course.

I truly don't understand the hate Dr. Baldwin gets. She is the best professor I've had at OSU so far. You will learn a ton but you have to put the work in if you want to do well. Luckily, she gives more than enough resources to prepare you for exams and quizzes! Her teaching style is an adjustment but very effective if you try your best to adapt.
She has a reputation of being the worst professor at this university and it says a lot when most are terrible.
A good professor and a funny person! Happy thanksgiving :)
Organic chemistry is a hard subject, and she does not make it any easier. Her tests are hard, and the average are always lower than other professors.
Organic chemistry is a hard subject, and she does not make it any easier. Her tests are hard, and the average are
If you are considering taking this class with this specific professor I recommend seeking therapy.

Organic Chemistry is by no means an easy course and Dr. Baldwin is not an easier professor, however she provides the class with many resources and opportunities to do well. If you are willing to put in the work she is willing to help you! I have attended her office hours multiple times this semester and she is very helpful each time. Thanks Dr. B!!

Ochem is a difficult class with complex material where exams are supposed to be difficult and studying a lot is integral to doing well...It is essentially common sense to everyone who enrolls in the course. With this professor, you are forced through a much more difficult and rigorous version of a normal ochem class. Save yourself, avoid Baldwin.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: She's a bad professor and a bad person with no redeeming qualities. Her lectures are not engaging or entertaining and she is not funny or caring. Someone was crying at office hours and she completely ignored it like it's normal and an integral part of being in this course.
I got diagnosed with hypertension because of her.

Wow. Throughout my education I have never had a worse professor. Andrea Baldwin is horrible at answering questions. She will just laugh at you or tell you to look on carmen. Now I understand Organic Chemistry is a hard subject, but she makes it near impossible. Good luck having a social life when you are in this class. Super inflated ego. Avoid her
Her questions are so hard. I studied for 30 hours for one exam and didn't study at all for the next and got the same grade. I'm open to suggestions for the next exam.
Even the high reviews written by TAs can't agree on whether she uses the textbook or not. She told me to use it one day and scolded me for going by it another day.

Let me help fix the fake high reviews. Ochem is not the right class for a flipped classroom and everyone fails because of this. She provides USELESS resources that do not help with her exams. It is unanimous with 200+ students that she is the worst and her teaching style is terrible.

reviews.comment: Great class, assignments, and professor. This class was super easy-- show up, do your work, and you'll pass. She also provides very clear study guides for the exams. Therefore, don't waste time reading the articles and textbook because she will pull exactly what she wants you to know in the study guide.
There's basically a quiz once a week and two exams. Small paper once a week and long paper for the final. The powerpoints are way too simplified. It seemed like a waste of a class.

Nice professor, but the lectures were very outdated, seemed like she's had them since the 90s-early 2000s. Also 90% of the class is 3 exams with only 30 questions each, so if you miss a few exam questions, don't expect to get a good grade. Wouldn't avoid taking her class, but wouldn't prefer it either.
She is cool. Three exams and random participation. I do get tired sometimes and want to fall asleep.

Most common sense college comm class there is. Definitely would suggest taking her. She makes concepts super clear because she shows you examples from shows like Friends and Seinfeld. Didn't mind listening to her lectures at all because they apply to everyday life. Show up for class she does in class assignments that boost your grade.

Has random in class assignments. Short tests, which kind of suck because if you miss two questions you get a B. She's kinda boring, but not bad. Just an ehh professor. Also, don't buy the textbook she never uses it and even says her test material is straight from lectures.

There's only 3 exams with 20 questions (90% of grade) and 10-15 in class assignments, with the lowest 3 dropped (10% of grade). I wish she would have more questions on the exams, but they're not too difficult. Lecture slides are posted after material is finished. The material is kind of dry, but she tries to make it interesting.
Could not have asked for a better professor.

Class was boring, but extremely easy. Doesn't put lecture slides online, and has several in class assignments, so definitely reccommend going to class, but she gives a review sheet before each exam that covers everything on it. I got an A and never read the book. the only time i used it was for the 2 questions she pulled for each exam.

Easy class if you go to the lectures.  Her exams come directly from the slides she uses, but some questions can be pretty specific.  She posted the slides on Carmen for the 2nd half of the quarter so going to class wasn't as important, not sure if she will post them again-it was something new she was trying. Midterm, 2 short papers, and a Final.
If you yearn for complete uselessness, ambiguity, and slight stupidity...you've found your professor. And, I'm saying this having done well in the class.

such a nice lady! knows what she is talking about and keeps lecture entertaining and lets you out early :) GO TO LECTURE AND WRITE ALL NOTES her tests are straight from the notes but if you dont study or go to class to get the notes you wont do well!

I wasn't too interested prior to her class, but she made the material interesting and relative to everyday life. Take good notes because thats very important. Grade is based on 2 tests and a paper. I would take any class she teaches. She is very clear, and makes a class period go by quickly.
Very nice but material is a little difficult.  Be sure to go to class, take notes and study.  Book not really necessary, grade is based on 2 exams and 1 paper.
Very nice and helpful.  Class turned out to be more interesting than I intially thought.  No need to buy the book, all exam material is from the notes and lectures

You can tell Dr. Nathanson is very interested in the material she teaches.  Her classes are apart of the rare ones that I feel like I actually can apply the material to the real world.  Overall-good class.  A's in both of the ones I took: just go to class and take good notes.
No Comments
The class is about children and communication. Great, interesting class. She is very sincere- wants her students to do well. Also very helpful, especially when you are working on papers.

Nice, interesting class, though would benefit from being smaller.  Grade is based on two exams and a paper, but that doesn't mean it's easy.  The exams can get very nitpicky, but she is willing to help you out.  The TA was harder to access than the actual professor.
Nice class, a lot to learn but put together very well.  Dr. Nathanson is a very nice and sincere person, and very open to students who have questions or problems
covered a lot of material, but it was well organized

Dr. Nathanson is a very nice and sincere person.  She is a great listener and is available to students.  In class, she rarely talked or added to the discussion.  She had trouble moderating discussions.

Her class was okay  Says attendance is not mandatory but gets upset when students don't attend class. I also feel she judges people who come late. Can't ignore outside voices and will stop the whole class and make a scene. Other than that class work is okay just get the work done! Don't fall for attendance not being mandatory! Also so final exam
very nice...

Ashley is an awesome professor. She communicates the material very clearly and makes its easily understandable. As long as you show up to class and participate and pay attention, you should do well in her classes.

Ashley is a great professor and very caring. The class is very straight forward which is great since it is online. Be prepared to give speeches and get comfortable infront of the camera. She is very accommodating to student needs and very helpful through email. I would definitely take her again!

This was a very fun and interesting class, but the professor made it that way. I feel like had I taken it with another professor, it wouldn't have been as interesting. Overall very easy and she would pull up a lot of Youtube clips to help illustrate the point she was trying to make, which is always very helpful.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Caring

reviews.comment: Super friendly. If you show up, you will pass. Some of the theories are confusing but she comes up with great examples to help explain them more. She also starts out each class with an open ended question, which I found really unique.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: Super nice and super easy assignments if you pay attention

Ashley is the best prof I've had at OSU. Took her comm class and took another one of her classes just to have her again. Exams aren't hard. A few easy papers, grades really easily. Super nice, makes class fun.

Took her public speaking, so of course participation matters most of all. Gives you freedom by allowing you to pick the speech topic. The only thing that makes her class difficult is the speaking in front of people, but you get used to it. Make friends with classmates, its easier to speak in front of them that way!

Dr. Sid is a pretty chill professor.  He can be a bit disorganized at times.  He is a very clear grader.  The class is very heavy on workloa. Overall, he is a pretty good professor and is very accommodating.  He really cares about effort and creativity.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Sid is a nice guy and definitely cares about his students. Lectures are definitely boring but when it gets to MATLAB stuff he walks you through code examples which are helpful if you don't understand the zybooks reading. 1181 is not a fun class, but he is a fine professor for it. The quizzes have very random questions and kind of annoying

Don't take this professor for ENGR 1181. He doesn't know how to code and struggles to explain the examples in class. The class itself sucks and is mostly busy work. The game project is fine if you take time outside of class to learn the examples. I'd take any other professor for this class. Only silver lining is that he is a nice dude.

Go to class everyday, take notes of whats important or work on homework in class. When you get to MATLAB non-coders should DEFINITELY GO TO CLASS. Don't request the answers on ZYBooks unless you have taken MATLAB courses before. Lots of fluff assignments, do the projects ahead of time, group work whenever works, and try hard on lab reports.
Amazing professor with well organized notes and canvas page. Makes sure to explain things well and do reviews of last lectures content so you don't forget. Not very much homework which is nice.

No attendance required recorded lecs. Slides are well-organized and easy to cap. Exams are mostly conceptual, and she explains difficult topics like boundaries, Maxwell's equations, and transmission lines very clearly. The course is easy if you did well in Physics 1251. She could've made it much difficult but she chose not to. Very kind professor.

The lectures are great and she doesn't give out much homework. The course gets difficult at the end with Maxwell equations but I feel like she did a great job of explaining. The exams are a little tough due to time constraint but the questions were fair. Highly recommend!

This review is for FRIT 3054, absolutely terrible course. The grading criteria is very unclear, the professor is nice but its hard to accept that when she's grading very strictly and assigning so much work. Truly take any other class for your gen ed this one is terrible and the poor organization/work overload only makes it worse.

Global Citizenship is pretty easy as long as you understand the lectures and participate in class. Be aware that you will be cold called, but it's not difficult and she makes it very lighthearted. Prof. Aski is incredibly passionate about her classes, and she really connects with the class.

Take her!! I took Global Citizenship with her. she does alot of in class participation/discussions, so if you dont like that vibe the class is not for you. But other than that she is very caring about her students and makes sure everyone feels welcome.

I had Janice for Italian 1102 and she was great. She made sure that all of her students were engaged in the class and learning the language. She understood that everyone had different levels of speaking, writing, and comprehension and took that into consideration throughout the semester. She is very funny and an all around great person.

Professor Aski is incredible. It is clear she truly enjoys what she does and it shows in the class lectures. Participation is a big thing in her classes along with homework. She is very approachable and willing to help if you are willing to put in the effort to learn. The best professor I had at Ohio State!

Janice was very nice but a little condescending. Willing to help, but sometimes made you feel stupid for messing up and asking questions. The homework was usually more annoying than good practice and she was constantly messing things up on Carmen like locking assignments before they were due or not allowing any submission types, but she tried hard
Does not care for her students whatsoever. HORRIBLY organized course, would not recommend.

Professor Aski is amazing. She is so easy to talk to and clearly wants the best for her students. As long as you put in the effort for the class, she will do the same. If you are struggling with any topic she will make the time to meet with you outside of class.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Great Professor! I am excited to have her again this semester. Everything is straight forward. She doesn't trick you, and is all about you constantly using italian, for your own good.
She's awesome.

Janice is incredible. She has high expectations, but will go above and beyond to help you succeed. She is kind, brilliant, and passionate about what she does. I always laughed in class and left with a smile. Take her classes!!!

Janice is a phenomenal language instructor. I teach Spanish for OSU and took two Italian classes with her to satisfy a language requirement. I learned a lot of Italian, but I also learned to be a better teacher from her example. Also, a wonderful, extremely personable lady. Highly recommended.
I will say she is my best experience at Ohio State :)
Easily one of my favorite professors. Take one of her classes, you won't regret it.
She is one of the most helpful professors ive ever had. I was dreading taking a foreign language course but she makes me actually want to go to class! Consider yourself lucky if you get in her class.
Dr. Aski is the best. Helps to have a background in linguistics before this class, but she made sure that everyone, even those with no prior knowledge, came to understand the concepts. Great class!

By far one of the best Italian professors I have had.  Her class was always interesting and entertaining as well as challenging.  She kept you awake and alert the entire time. Incredibly helpful and is flexible in schedules so you understand everything. Take one of her classes- you won't be disappointed.
She is sometimes confused, and not friendly at all.
She expects a lot, but she will bend over backward to make sure you understand.

You better know what you're doing because she is expecting it.  Aside from that she is the most helpful and one of the nicest professors I've ever had.  Just try and make an effort and you won't have a problem.  Take her class.
I had her for a really intro romance linguistics class - great class.  Very fun, and she made it accessible to non-linguists, too.
She's one of the best professors on campus.  Do yourself a favor and take her class.  She's always willing to help if you don't understand something.
She'll terrorize your papers.  EX: on a grade sheet I got a breakdown of  A, B, B, C, C  which averaged to a 70%...ouch.  She makes class very enjoyable.
Very enthusiatic.
No Comments
She is an awesome professor.  Probably one of the best you will find at the university.  Take her class, you'll be glad you did.

She was a really good teacher. I always get kind of frustrated with language classes. It's a lot of work. But I went to her office hours a few times  and she was really nice and enthusiastic. She even invited people over to her house on more than one occasion.
No Comments

this professor is so upbeat that she is overbearing. her class was never fun, and it was overstructured and boring. do not schedule a class with her in the beginning of your day- she will ruin your day.
No Comments

MUSIC 3344 but doesn't show as an option. Talks the entire class and is very boring, hard to pay attention. Continues past when class ends almost every day. Doesn't post a study guide, posts 3 total questions for practice problems when midterms are 40 questions, final is 60 questions, doesn't help you. Written part of test can be done online though
Dr. Ashby is a very kind person and very knowledgeable in his field. Lectures can be hard to keep up with since he goes very slow. Other than that, easiest music history class in college.
He's a great guy and interesting to listen to. History of Rock & Roll was definitely my favorite class I've ever taken.

This class should be called the history of music. Not the history of rock and roll. Recitation lectures were not helpful and class lectures were typically pretty boring. I didn't attend a total of 4 classes (class was three time a week) and got a B on attendance. So I'd show up to every single class. 2 papers that are graded with a lot of grace
reviews.rating_tags: LECTURE HEAVY--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Ashby is a passionate professor and Rock and Roll is a great and fun class to take to fulfill a visual/performing arts credit. There are two papers that are graded easily and 3 exams that are easy as long as you use the resources given to you. Lecture outlines are on carmen and recitation TAs use Kahoots that are also posted for studying help.
reviews.rating_tags: Tests? Not many--Amazing lectures--Would take again

reviews.comment: So smart and so fun!!

I love Ashby! He's an amazing instructor and clearly is passionate about his subject. He's also really funny and doesn't take himself too seriously. Even if the class isn't required, it's definitely worth taking.
this was romantic through 20th century stuff.  required, but definitely the most palatable of other mus hist courses for majors...may be because he taught it(?).  nice guy, good lectures.
Really good class to take for VPA GEC. I took it online. It's difficult doing group papers over the net, but we got through them. Not to mention the class is WAY easy!
Easy class, no need to buy the text books. Attendance is graded but their is no recitation and lectures are enjoyable. Papers are in groups and are graded very easy. Very good pick for VPA GEC.
Ashby is a great and amazing teacher.  His class has really inspired me.  I believe in myself a bit more.  He's adorable too.  I hope he adds Tori Amos to his list of rockers!

If you want a really easy A without going to class ever, please take this class.  I haven't been to class in weeks and got a 100 percent on the midterm.  You definitely don't need to buy the books, so don't waste your money.
Class was fun and easy. Very clear and helpful. He obviously loves teaching. Group papers were a pain, but no recitation so it was ok. Take this class with Ashby!
Class was very fun and easy. Tests were a breeze, papers aren't bad because they are group efforts. The online discussions sure as heck beat recitation. Take history of rock!
No Comments
I loved this class! I have to agree that the papers were graded way too hard. The only downfall of the class, in my opinion, was the online discussion groups. I really hated those
He's the best. Everyone should takes his course!!!!

Cares very much about how students do. If you show intrest in subject he will open a whole new world for you to discorver. Loves to teach!!!!!! Lectures give alot of interesting context to the songs that one would have not know about perviously to his course. Strongly recomend taking his course or any that he may teach!!!!
was really interesting some of the stuff i learned.  dr a was very funny and we went really broad in the topic.  one of the better big classes i've had.  four stars check it out

the class was beyond disorganized, often went off on tangents that often trailed off, no real grading scale, seemingly could not think on his feet, believes students to actually spend time on online discussions and 2/3 page papers, makes things more difficult then they should be
Class was easy.....test were super easy...however the papers were graded tough.  Not a bad class if you want an A if you are willing to work a bit on the papers.

I thought this was a very easy class.  I had no problems with the papers, and I actually enjoyed writing about why I hate Britney Spears for one of the papers.  It's interesting material, though I thought Ashby made some of it kind of boring.

Pretty fun class once you get past the blues songs from 1870.  Grades the papers kinda hard, but you know most of the songs anyway.  Only part that actually sucked was having to do online discussions all the time and getting graded for it.

He is a cool guy but he HATES if you leave early while he is talking or playing a song!  So don't leave unless absolutely necessary.  He knows what he is talking about but he grades the papers a little hard.  Still a fun class and easy points if you try hard.
This class was fun, and while slow at times, who wouldn't love hearing about the history of rock? He was interesting most of the time and was genuinely interested in the material. Worth the time
Sweet and really smart!
Dude!  Excellent!!  Entirely worthwhile on all levels.
No Comments

Very funny and realistic about his classes. He calls gregorian chant "Bud(weiser) Music." The course packet was very helpful and his tests weren't too hard. This is the guy you want for your music history sequence.
Ashby rocks!!!

Zoom lectures were not engaging, and I don't feel added much to the weekly course content. Went over by at least 10m for each class. 
Only two assignments, which took over a month to grade. She took points off for personal preference in writing which were not required in rubric. Gives lots of feedback, but again, unfair grading practices. Avoid.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Many students may find her difficult as her expectations are high, but I liked her high standards. She motivated and challenged me to learn more and do my best. I have never received such detailed feedback in discussions and assignments. I always found her to be extremely knowledgeable and very forthcoming.

The class in general is boring. The online format made it worse. Dr. Maleku knows her stuff but there are so many assignments back to back, she takes forever to give feedback, and she is a difficult grader.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--So many papers--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I took a doctoral-level mixed methods research course with Dr. Maleku and I was fascinated by her class! I am not in social work and went to the College of Social Work to take this course as this is probably the only mixed methods course available on campus. Dr. Maleku is extremely knowledgeable and a very rigorous mixed-methods researcher.

I read great things about this professor and was eager to learn. I found the course overwhelming and hard to follow due to slow grading and delayed feedback, not the content itself. There is a disconnect in this course online with gaps of no assignments and then a lot that are hard to piece together without guidance. Maybe this is best on campus.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I took the 7400 Evidence in Social Work Class. Dr. Maleku has been the best professor I ever had at OSU. She is amazingly knowledgable, very rigorous, but extremely supportive. I learned so much about research, which I hated in 8 weeks of summer class, which I had never learned in my entire undergraduate. I hope i have more classes with her.

I took the doctoral level mixed methods research course with Dr. Maleku and was blown away! I really appreciate the effort Dr. Maleku put into this course. She always had comprehensive well-structured lectures with very clear examples of everything she was introducing. Her detailed feedback continually helped me to get a good grasp of things.

Even in the middle of the pandemic, I thoroughly loved the class and would like to follow the social work career. Dr. Maleku is extremely knowledgeable and wants you to develop your critical thinking. It is a tough class, but it is worth it because you will learn a lot. I am grateful to Dr. Maleku.

Best research class I had ever taken. I am not a fan of research courses, but I was very impressed with the way Arati taught this class. It was an online class. Arati took the time to give feedback and did live sessions, which were always enriching! You have to work hard. I would love to take face to face classes with her any day!

Dr. Maleku is the most rigorous professor I have met at the College. She s extremely knowledgeable and expects a lot of rigor in your work. It is a very tough class, but it is totally worth it as you will learn a lot. I wish I had her in my other classes prior to my graduation.

Arati is one of the best instructors i had at OSU. She is extremely knowledgeable and it shows. She challenged me to think critically and engaged in conversations that honestly i had never paid attention to in social work. She does expect a lot, but also gives many opportunities to do well in class. I would take her class any day !

Dr. Maleku is an amazing instructor. It was a touch class, but she is very supportive to the learning needs of the students. Her class to me was intellectually stimulating. I literally learned so much in her class even when i combine what i learned in two other classes this semester.

There is no denying she is very knowledgeable in the course content but seems very busy with other obligations in her career. The course structure is rather disorganized with a lot of stagnant time sitting in groups and lectures being read word for word off the slides. Was also very slow to grade the only 3 assignments in the class.

It was very clear she was very knowledgeable in the subject. She has a lot of experience she can share with the class. She gave a lot of time in class to work our project which was also helpful. Given all of that, I was still not a fan of her. This is because she was rather dismissive and rude to students when they participated.

Course work is difficult but Dr. Maleku is very fair. She takes the time to grade everything you turn in and gives you the opportunity to ace the class if you do the work. I learned a lot in this class and I did a lot of work. I am proud of the final group paper we turned in. Dr. Maleku is one of the professors that makes OSU great.

Professor Arati is a gem to the college of Social Work! She really cares about us and wants us to learn. I wasn't interested in Macro social work until I took a class with her. The class is challenging but so worth it! I learned so much and feel more confident with taking other Macro classes. The class activities were enjoyable and she was great!

definitely in the top three professors i've had at ohio state, if not number one. he's friendly, great at teaching and explaining concepts, exams are very fair, and he has a passion for his field. i wish i would have taken more of his classes but unfortunately i graduate this semester

Does a really good job at breaking down material and making it easy to understand and interesting. Gives questions in advance for the midterm, but be aware that the final project is a lot of work, either a 20 page paper or a podcast episode. Overall a very good professor. Really knows his stuff and makes class engaging. Definitely would take again
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Great professor who is knowledgeable and passionate about criminology. While the readings themselves can become burdensome, the lectures are great and help to summarize (but not replace) the readings and situate them in a larger context. He does a great job of fostering critical thinking and making traditionally dry material really engaging.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Incredible professor who treats students well. The class is fair, but you must attend every session to keep up with the coursework.
The course is very fast paced making it hard to follow. A bit of calculus. Caring professor, provides good explanation and applications for each topic

Though he's new to teaching, he truly cared about his students and statistics as a whole. Very good communication and decent lectures. Very very fast paced course so he tried his best at spending sufficient time on certain topics. Midterm 1 and Final were quite easy, midterm 2 not so much due to the somewhat tough calculus. Reasonable grader.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Curved my grade without asking. Helpful guy.
Lectures include lots of proofs and not a lot of explaining. Dhruv makes himself very accessible and wants to help everyone. Make good cheat sheets for the exams and it'll be much easier.

The course was fast-paced, therefore it was a bit hard to follow. But if you are good with calculus and math, this course was a breeze and Dhruv covered the topics well. He also taught a few things that were not a part of the syllabus. Passionate teacher.

He is nice and approachable. Lectures moved quickly, and I did not find them very engaging or helpful. The first midterm included a curve when the average was around 66%, while the second midterm did not include a curve. Expect to do a significant amount of self-studying outside of class.
You are going to teach yourself gng. Is very passionate about STATS and cares about students. Did not find any of his lectures useful.

Dhruv was a lovely guy and an excellent instructor! The material is tough if you're unfamiliar with stats, and he can be a harsh grader at times, but he truly cared about his students and their success. Go to office hours and play Catan with him too!

This was Dhruv's second time teaching (I think) and I think he did a pretty good job even with the fast pace nature of this class. He was very caring for every student and truly wanted everyone to have a good understanding of the topics he taught. Accessible outside of class and allowed cheat sheets on the midterms/final. Good dude.

Just sit there. Its required so just do the 5 minute assignments and go to class. They do get stingy for points sometimes but its pass/fail. Annoying but easy. She is caring and will answer any of your questions.

She is truly an amazing, kind, and generous professor. She went out of her way to review my situation, showed genuine understanding, and added back the points I needed. Her empathy and willingness to help made a huge difference, and I am incredibly grateful for how supportive and fair she was throughout the process. She is honestly an angel
RUN run run away quickly, she will deduct points and be unfair to you on your assignments! do not DO NOT!
this class is so easy. just log onto zoom and sit there. the assignments are easy and not worth a lot, the quizzes have unlimited attempts. i don't really like her but that doesn't matter lol

Attendance is mandatory. EXTREMELY harsh grader. Failed me on 2 assignments (worth 100+ points) and docked me -30/50 points simply for incorrect format submission on SIMPLE grade school designed worksheets (multiple of them). Also was my neuroscience advisor, didn't seem like she cared about anyone individually, poor communication.

The lack of transparency and fairness in her grading system makes the class unnecessarily stressful. Despite putting in significant effort to meet the outlined expectations, students often feel their work is undervalued.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Ard seemed a little scatterbrained every lecture, so certain topics or themes were not communicated + taught very well. She used videos as a crutch. Almost every class had an in-class assignment, an overly complicated (bc it was ill explained) five point activity that sometimes took up to two hours. Her TA/grader took several weeks to grade.

Professor Ard was really disorganized and her class was hard to follow. The assignments were easy, but sometimes lengthy or just straight up annoying. The exams were difficult because her lectures were all over the place, but they're online. Her TA grades everything harshly and not for weeks after assignments are due. Easy A, just an annoying class
She really cares about what she's teaching, which is what makes her such a great professor!

Dr. Ard is a great professor; she knows what she's talking about and is passionate about it. The class is easy; there are 3 exams, all online and open-note. The final project is a 2-part essay; the 1st part is a group essay, and the 2nd part is a solo essay based on the group essay. This class is very video-heavy, which is one thing I didn't like.

Society and Natural Resources was a really easy class. No reading or outside notes required. Just go to lectures and you're fine for tests. Tests are open note and all in the lecture notes. We had to do a poster presentation at the end that was a little unorganized but overall great class.

Dr. Ard is amazing! Not too hard of homework and she usually gives time in class to complete it. There's an overall wicked problem essay group project at the end, but its easy grading. The course topics are also super interesting and talks about the social aspect of history.

Professor Ard is very sweet but did not seem very passionate about what she was teaching. She does not reply to emails about questions from the lecture and came off as a little rude when she told my class that she will not respond.
