Mrs. Buuck is such a great teacher! She cares so much about helping her students and does everything she can to see them succeed. This class has greatly strengthened my writing skills. I had so much fun learning and improving throughout the semester! SUCH A GREAT TEACHER! highly recommend taking her classes!

Mrs. Buuck cares so much about her students and does everything she can to help them succeed. This class has strengthened my writing skills and I had so much fun learning and improving throughout the semester! GREAT teacher! Highly recommend taking her classes!

I took her for fiction writing II and thought that she was overall very positive. At the same time, she was helpful and was constantly offering feedback. she was highly interactive with students. The course was not easy though; she gives A LOT of assignments. Perhaps a little more than was comfortable. But overall, 5/5. Great class.
harsh

Professor Brown is an engaging lecturer and is clearly very passionate about philosophy. He made it easy to pay attention in class. 1100 was an easy course—we were allowed and encouraged to use AI on assignments and Dr. Brown was a lenient grader as long as assignments were turned in on time.

Favorite professor ever. He genuinely cares so much about his students and class discussions. He structures the class in a very discussion/participation-based way, deciding what to talk about based on the class's interests. He's so lively and passionate about his class. Super easy to get an A. Best most entertaining lectures. LOVE him

Had Prof Brown for 1100 and 2450. He is one of the greatest professors I have encountered during my time at the university. He genuinely cares about his students and the current state of the world, as well as the material he introduces to the class. I would take Prof Brown over and over if I could.
Very entertaining lecturer. you have to be an donkey to not get an A in this class.

Lectures were really engaging; you can tell he cares about what he's teaching. Midterm and final are heavily based on lecture. As long as you pay attention in lecture you will get an A. Assignments are fairly easy, not very time consuming, and quite interesting even if you're not a philosophy major.

Such an interactive professor! Grading is very chill, and if you need this elective credit in any way take his class! He comes up with his assignments on the fly and the class gets to explore ideas you're actually interested in. 10/10 wish I could take again.
Amazing guy. Very funny and his lectures are super chill. 100% would take again. The class was very interesting and he kept the class non boring.
Took his demo philosophy of religion class in 2022 that he co-lectured and had a conversation with him after a lecture that was so good that it healed my religious trauma, thanks Steve miss u forever

hands down the BEST and most interesting class i've taken throughout all of college. being a GE course, it is very very easy, but due to this, he's pretty strict about lecture attendance and doesn't accept late work. that's literally the only challenging thing about the class. i really want to take this professor again

Dr. Brown is a great lecturer who is able to make topics that would usually seem pretty boring to me a lot more enjoyable. Class itself is pretty straightforward, and all of the reading/quizzes are pretty simple. Great class to take overall.

Stephen Brown is probably my favorite professor I've had so far, he was always so funny and spontaneous. He rarely followed a slide show, he typically just had a google doc open and wrote stuff down as he went on, which made his lectures so easily to pay attention to.

He knows what he is talking about and doesn't just read off the slideshows. Lectures can be overwhelming, but you can bring a cheat sheet for the tests and use AI to write essays. He gives you readings approximately once a week and weekly reflections. Easy grader and would definitely take him again.

This class was so easy and required little work, but it was super enjoyable and so interesting. Not a lot of homework, just weekly readings. Definitely take this for an easy gened and great professor.
Was a really fun class to go to and was very interesting
Clear teaching style.  Considers viewpoints of lots of people.  Charming.  Intelligent.  Logical.  Yes, would take classes from this professor again.  Always.

Best GE class I have taken so far. All of the topics are interesting. However, lectures can be overwhelming with the amount of stuff he takes notes on. Tests are easy and you can bring a cheat sheet. You have to write an essay using one of the topics and connect it with the thing that you are interested in but you can use AI to help you.

Professor Brown is an engaging and passionate teacher who makes this philosophy class super enjoyable. Easy grading, open-note quizzes, and minimal work - plus Unstuckstudy was a huge help for study prep!

Although I took this class for a GE and I don't care much for the subject, Dr. Brown had some of the most interesting lectures I have ever attended. He explained everything really well and is the easiest grader I have ever come across. I would recommend this course for anyone who needs a GE requirement.

Doc Brown loves to teach his material, he definitely isn't a professor who just reads off a slideshow. I didn't have much interest in philosophy ( I still don't)- but he just made it interesting and made me want to learn about it. Awesome professor, definitely recommend.

Classes are fun and interesting, lectures + discussion. There was a large group project component in my class (Global Flourishing) which I don't think was typical of his classes in general, but he was very laid back about things and it worked out really well for my group.
Interesting content and nice professor.  Clearly very knowledgable but does not have super structured lectures. Easy A if you attend class.

Very easy and interesting class. Takes attendance. Weekly reflections (≥3 sentences). Weekly homework: 1-2 readings and ≥3 annotations per reading. Only 2 exams (5 FRQs, 1 AI-assisted essay, and a note sheet). Dr. Brown is very passionate and lectures were engaging. Class highlights besides content: tea ceremony and temple visit. Highly recommend!!
Professor Brown is a funny and witty professor, he is clearly great at what he does and loves to teach his material. Class was easy to understand and material was always clarified.

Would 10000% recommend professor brown. Any of his classes are probably amazing. Really interesting to listen to and an easy A. Do the homework and you'll be fine. One midterm and a final, you can use AI for both essays and have a cheat sheet for the 5 short FRQs. He makes philosophy interesting.

My favorite professor this year. He was hilarious and passionate about what he was teaching. There's not too much homework besides a few readings and a weekly reflection—but nothing difficult. The exams are 5 FRQs, but he does the notes for you, so you just need to go over those. On the last day of class, he has a tea ceremony with his Grandma.

Dr. Brown is incredibly engaging and funny. The readings aren't always interesting but his lectures on the readings are. There are two short AI-assisted papers and two exams with a note sheet. Very easy A. He takes attendance. Take his class for your GE!
Very nice.  Very kind.  Not arrogant.   Listens to all viewpoints.

I had Professor Brown for "Death Meaning Life" and enjoyed his class from the first day to the last. The class itself is straightforward with the formatting. You read and annotate a couple of pages before class, talk about what you read, and then have a midterm and final on it. Great and engaging class overall. Amazing and caring professor!
Very inspirational and genuinely excited to teach. Wants to have dialogue with his students and welcomes questions and debate.
He made lectures interesting, even if the topic wasn't. He cares about his students and tries to do right by them. Almost no exams but the exams are very manageable.

He runs class well, but it is reading heavy with annotations every week. Attendance is taken each lecture, but he makes it really interesting each week. The only flaw in class is that he makes you take written notes while he types for the whole lecture, and it's impossible to keep up. Only 2 tests which you get cheat sheets for and are super easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Dr. Brown is hands down my favorite professor at OSU. I specifically took this class so I could have him as a professor again. The class itself is engaging, and requires deep thought. Just because Dr. Brown grades nicely does not mean the content is easy, as it is still requires hard work to understand the complex concepts.

Dr. Brown is very funny and is also very good at teaching his content and getting you to think (which is like the whole point of philosophy). Two pretty big papers, but you are encouraged to use AI to help you write, you just can't copy the whole thing from AI. The content is deeply interesting and academically enriching.

Dr. Brown is a fantastic professor! You can tell that he is super passionate about the subject he teaches. His lectures are thought-provoking, engaging, and often involving real-world events. The majority of your grade consists of two research papers with topics of your choice. Super chill and fun- I would 100% take a class with him again!

I LOVED THIS PROFESSOR! Attendance is mandatory, but I would go either way. His lectures are so engaging and fun, his heart is in his work. Only complaint is that assignments were randomly posted so I missed a few, but they are usually 1-2 points each and very easy. If you check Carmen twice a week you'll be fine.
He is absolutely the best!

Dr. Brown is an amazing and caring professor! Each of his lectures are very enlightening and his class has changed my opinions on so many different things. He is so caring to all of his students and is a very flexible professor. He will also make you believe in aliens.

Amazing and hilarious guy. I thought a philosophy class was going to be extremely boring and paper heavy, but not with him. There are a few quizzes, but it's open note so they're super easy. The reflections are also super easy. No exams, just an 800 word takeaway portfolio at the end which also isn't that hard. Take him if you need your GE!!!
Best and one of the easiest professors in the philosophy department. Come out every lecture with a different perspective. Very funny guy too

Easy grading and overall fun lectures. His easy grading takes away the pressure, and you can actually just enjoy learning the material he gives. He does a great job of explaining complex philosophies and makes it a fun process by cracking jokes and being retable.

I'd recommend Steven for your GE classes. His classes aren't much work, just show up and you will do well. He likes to talk about current events and compare it to class content which makes his class entertaining.

VERY FUNNY GUY

going to lectures is mandatory but it's worth it dude he's so funny with his tangents

and you may be thinking "oh isn't going off on tangents bad?"

fret not my philosopher friend these tangents are integral to the experience

very sad to be done with this class cause i love attending the lectures

Professor Brown was an elite professor, really funny person who made this class interesting and fun to learn. really wants his students to learn and cares about them, workload was low with weekly readings, quizzes were open note and untimed pretty easy, overall a really good class and professor brown is a goat

I love Prof. Brown. Take his class (PHILOS 2120) if you want a fun and easy GE. He is an incredible lecturer, makes students laugh every class, and clearly passionate about his work. Just be careful with attendance because he takes attendance twice every class and it is a decent part of the grade.
Brown is an excellent public speaker, and he knows how to keep his audience engaged. Very laid back and chill. One the easiest classes I've ever taken.

Such a cool guy. Very open about his personality and lets it shine through his work, genuinely cares, and is pretty funny. Not really any grades in this class, I didn't even take notes, I'd just sit and listen!

Just amazing. Super willing to talk about cool stuff outside of class. He cares a lot about the subject matter and helping students with it. One of the coolest dudes of all time. Also likes great music. Based guy.

Great guy who knows his stuff and wants the best for the students. He teaches you a lot about life during this class and no matter what your opinions are, you will learn at least something valuable in this course.

If you get the chance, take a class with Dr. Brown. He is one of the most charismatic, most enthralling professors I've ever had the pleasure to take a course with. I literally created this account to let people know how badly they need to take a course with him. 100/10 would recommend. Life changing lecturer.

Professor Brown is awesome. This class is very easy and you can get an A easily by just showing up (attendance is 20%, can miss 3) and doing simple assignments. Many people just showed up at the end of class and got the tophat code but I thought that was crappy and that his lectures were very much worth showing up and listening to. Great professor.

Overall great class but the randomness of assignments threw me off, he randomly says that there is a reading due next Thursday. There is not an overwhelming amount of reading but there is some required writing. Overall great class and professor.

My favorite professor at OSU! He is hilarious during lectures and he really gives out good information. Homework is light and stress free and he makes the notes for you so you don't have to. Would definitely take a other class with him if I have the chance.

This class was really interesting, and there were only a couple of easy quizzes, and like 3 papers. He makes class fun and has good discussions. I was worried about taking this class because it sounded boring but his personality makes lectures interesting and keeps your attention really well
Best porf ever.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: His lectures were one of the best I have ever been to. This course is amazing, its extremely engaging. I love that Professor Brown does not have a fixed syllabus and let's the class take it's own path based on extremely engaging discussions. He is also a very jolly and funny person, so it's a great class to attend first thing in the morning.
He's Awesome

This class is ENTIRELY lecture based with no imagery to look at while the lecture is happening... if you're not an auditory learner, do not take this class. It is very easy to get by, but I did not retain any of the information. I had 250 in my class and 80% of them were doing something else on their computer -- it's one of those types of classes.

Dr. Brown is an amazing professor. You can tell from his lectures just how knowledgable and intelligent he is. He conveys the information in a way that keeps you actively listening, retaining the info, and enjoying the lecture as well.
Very smart man and an excellent instructor, I looked forward to class.
Two words: great professor.

Asian Philos was great, super interesting! No need to take notes or get a textbook bc the notes are shared w/you on a doc. Quizzes are all easy based on notes and readings are easy too! Overall you can get an A doing the bare minimum (I did) and lecture is very interesting. The easy grading allowed me to pay attn and actually learn w/o worrying!
An interesting professor! He has a clear mind and his philosophy classes are not boring! I would like to take his other classes!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: An amazing course and professor. I highly recommend this course. Its easy A if you show up to class and stay up to date on the assignments.

What a lovely guy. As long as you have a brain, you will get an A. NO exams. Handful of quizzes that you get multiple attempts on. 3 papers. Reading reflections for participation points. Literally most of the points are participation points. Take this class. Even if you aren't interested in philosophy. I'm not, but he managed to make it interesting
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Absolutely loved his class! I took this class as well as Death and The Meaning of Life at the same time. Loved it! He really motivated me to learn more about philosophy! He is very funny, cares about his students and is so funny. If you are looking for a fun GE course or want to learn some basic philosophy, take his courses!

Easy class, pay attention write notes/use his for the quizzes and exams. the answers can almost always be found in the notes. There is only 2 exams and 2 essays. I would highly recommend going to office hours for the essays as they give good feedback on your essay before you turn it in.  Overall you NEED NOTES i took this online so he gave us his
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Really funny. Not a lot of grades but everything is open note. His online lectures werent mandatory and we could rewatch later on. I enjoyed his class.

he is a great philosophy teacher, very passionate and caring of his students! dont take this class if you dont like to think. he encourages us to question and think in his classes. classes are structured nice. a few quizzes,one for each topic, only top 5 count for grade.2 exams and paper +EC opportunity. class require work and critical thinking!
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Accessible outside class--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Would not recommend to take class as a GE. While the quizzes are very straight forward, the exams are a big part of your grade and there are only two of them. I did not regularly attend lectures, but know many people who did and got a worse grade than me.

Don't take this class if you don't think like a philosophy teacher. His quizzes are so difficult because he makes every question have what seems like more than one answer, and there aren't enough points to make up for the fact that you may miss one trick question on every assignment. He won't tell you when anything is due until a week before.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Good professor. There are 2 exams that 25% so its test heavy but they are not that many questions and he gives you plenty of time. Loved this class.

Professor Brown is super funny and his lectures are really interesting. He takes notes during the class so you dont have to attend lecture to pass which is nice. There arnt many grades in the class tho so be careful!

I love this man. He's very type-B with pretty much everything in his class. Short and easy quizzes, very few assignments, and a pretty chill schedule. His lectures are always incredibly enjoyable and they were always the highlights of my week. He also has an ongoing public document for all lecture notes so we didn't need to take any. 10/10 class

This is the type of professor i wish all GE's had. He uses a loose schedule (but always gives an advance on quizzes/exams to study) and the class has a loose structure. This means the classes are always so much more interesting because he allows students to question the content and will dive deep into philosophical questions.

Dr. Brown is definitely passionate about philosophy, but often times gets off topic during lectures. At the beginning of class they said only participation in recitation was required, but then I was deducted credit for missing some lectures. Also, for the papers, they take off silly points. Overall, not a bad class.
great professor, very sweet and caring. helps a lot and really cares about his students success

He is an awesome teacher and makes the class reasonable but he says it is an overtly easy A and that is not true, as he graded papers and exams relatively harshly. The topics of the class were interesting and taught to us well, I just wish he made a better attempt to fulfill his promise of the class being an easy A if you just do the basics...
Chill and Laid Back Teacher
If you ever have to take Philosophy class at OSU, you should take him for sure. Lectures are great and interesting. He is an easy smart guy!

Professor Brown is amazing. He really knows the subject that he is teaching and his lectures are very interesting. You get a 1% extra credit by attending the lectures. There is no homework at all. Just go to the lectures and be prepared for the short answer exams and you will get an A.

Professor Brown is AMAZING! His lectures are hilarious and he is very good at explaining the material. His quizzes and tests are pretty easy and you get a cheat sheet for exams. His class was amazing; it was the only class I didn't dread going to and that I was actually excited to attend that semester. Would defintely take him again!

Dr. Brown is hilarious and passionate about the material. We talked about Star Wars a lot and watched a decent amount of videos, so if that's not your thing this professor might not be a great fit. You don't really have to study (you get a sheet of notes for exams), he gives extra credit, and the work load is minimal, so great for a GE class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Awesome, funny professor! It is surprising how much energy he has every single class. The material is super interesting, and he tries a lot to make obscure philosophical concepts easy to swallow. Few assignments, and they're all pretty easy.

Dr. Brown is a great teacher and I highly enjoyed the class I took with him. Lectures are pretty much required as that is where you receive the notes and information that is on the quiz. The only homework consisted of the occasional online quiz and reading some short papers before class. His lectures are super informative.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Amazing lectures--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Brown is super passionate about philosophy, has good jokes and explains complex topics in easy to understand ways. He teaches the class like a GE should be taught with minimal homework. If you pay attention in class you'll do well.
Super super nice guy, very fun professor. Slacked off and thought it was gonna be a very easy A and it shouldve been. Didn't study at all on the final and it hurt me.

Probably my favorite prof at OSU. He is great and teaches a general education class like it should be. It is interesting and stress free, yet still provides you with a great understanding of the subjects. You come out learning something new. If you show up to class you will do well, no curveballs are thrown on the tests and you get a cheat sheet.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Nice guy and his lectures are funny but his lectures can be confusing and it can be hard to decipher what information you actually need. The class is graded on so few things that it is a bit stressful, but as long as you actually come to class you should be fine.
Dude is hilarious. Great prof that makes class fun to come to.

I took this for a GE credit and he was a great professor. The tests and one mandatory paper were easy. He gave several opportunities to raise your grade. He makes a real effort to make lectures interesting. The side rants were entertaining and the content was never really difficult. If you show up to lecture, you're guaranteed to do well.

Don't take if looking for an easy A. Not a lot of work, but the papers and exam essays are graded harshly with weird symbols no one understands with no criteria or rubric given to be graded so harshly. Grades not recorded online until the class begged him to do so. Gives little feedback and never answers questions clearly. Very hard to raise grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Participation matters--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: There are few ways to get points making it hard to bring your grade up or get a good one because he is a tough grader. You can take the final and write another paper to bring up your grade. Rambles in class making it hard to understand when the information is important enough to write down and what will be on the exams & Atten. basically mandatory

Dr. Brown is a phenomenal teacher. He is clear and concise about what you need to know, and makes every day entertaining. Midterms and the paper are easy, and he gives optional quizzes and an extra paper to help with grades - these aren't counted against you if they hurt your grade. He also gives extra credit for participation/attendance. Take him
He's a funny guy; his class isn't necessarily the most fun,  but he makes it pretty entertaining most days.

Prof Brown has an incredible way of teaching even complex concepts in a way that an average person can not only understand but contribute to the conversation. He values your opinion and encourages you to think for yourself.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Good lecturer. Doesn't personally grade tests or papers, passes them along to other graders

SO, I got a B on an exam I studied so hard for. Like I had a study guide and it was pointless. Homeboy does the most when he is teaching. Like he gives long examples that have NOTHING to do with the subject.

Terrible professor who makes this GE so challenging. Exams are open notes but your points get chipped away so fast. Papers are harshly graded on, and my second optional paper was not even graded when the final grade came out. A lot of extra credits but those pull up grade like 1%. If you are taking Phil 2120 avoid this guy. Tried hard but only B+.

I loved this class so much! I took ethics initially to satisfy a GE but I fell in love with philosophy and am now minoring in it.  Professor Brown has become one of my favorite people in the entire world.  He is funny and his lectures are my favorite part of the day.  Take this class- it won't disappoint.

Dr. Brown makes class entertaining, tying current events and stereotypes into his everyday lessons. He relies a lot on class discussion, so this is very interesting if you care at all about the subjects. He has quizzes every few weeks, but he only puts them in if they helps your grade, so it's an easy GE. Attendance is optional, but is extra credit

I expect very little out of GE courses like PHILOS1300. That being said I looked forward to coming to class because I knew that Steven made the material interesting. He makes getting an A a very achievable goal, simply show up to class and take some notes. That isn't a lot to ask for when you spend most of the class discussing Star Wars.

By far my favorite professor at OSU. I took 2 courses from him and looked forward to each and every class. I have always loved philosophy, but friends I have made in his classes has zero interest in philosophical debates before his class, yet still thoroughly enjoyed his lectures and learned quite a lot. I would recommend Dr. Brown to anyone!

Best classroom experience I've had at Ohio State! I came for the credit, I stayed for the captivating lectures, and I left with a new view on the world and the people around me. Steven Brown is simply amazing.
Fun class. It was his first time teaching it so he struggled at times. EZ gen ed.

My favorite teacher so far at Ohio State. He comes into class every day full of energy and coffee in hand. It was the only 8am I would ever take again. He makes possibly dull content entertaining. If you are looking for a fun, easy A class, take this. You will learn a lot about how/why we think the things we do.
Class was great
Asian Philosophies was the easiest class I've ever taken (cheat sheets allowed for exams that are already very simple, and only one short paper), and it was also interesting. Steven Brown is awesome.

Funny professor! Going to class is an enjoyable experience. Youll learn a lot about the philos as well as random tidbits about the world when he digresses:) Easy A Only 2 midterms which you will be allowed a cheat sheet for. I recommend this class to anyone as long as you do not get offended easily by controversial subjects. He won't sugarcoat

Funny professor! Going to class is an enjoyable experience. Youll learn a lot about the problems with art as well as random tidbits about the world when he digresses:) Easy A Only 2 midterms and 1 paper. you get a cheat on test. I recommend this class to anyone as long as you do not get offended easily by controversial subjects. He won't sugarcoat

Mr. Brown is the best teacher I have ever had. He explains readings very clearly and is genuinely interested in helping. He does not talk down to you, which especially made me feel more open to talk to him when I was having issues or questions on a topic. Only 2 quizzes and 2 exams, no homework. You'll actually learn and have fun!
Best prof I ever had at OSU. Take one of his classes, you'll actually learn and and you'll love him.

Been at OSU for 3 years, and this guy is the best lecturer I've ever had. Clear, hilarious, and great at making the points he wants you to know. First time I've ever literally looked forward to going to a lecture every day. Take any class you can with this guy, he's fantastic!

I had Dr. Brown for Ethics and Intro to Philosophy and am so glad I had the opportunity to take classes with him. He is very energetic and extremely fair. If you need help he is always right there. He has to be Ohio States finest. If you make an effort to care about the class he makes an effort to care about your grade. He likes to maximize the min

He is the man. Lectures are clear as a whistle. Exams are essentially your notes, so take good notes of what he says and writes on the board. Taking his class was like a breath of fresh air. He's hilarious, understands the material well, and makes the student really enjoy philosophy. Would take again.

I had this class as an 8am and I can honestly say it was worth getting up to come to. Professor Brown was so energetic, passionate, and hilarious. Despite his refreshing spastic-ness, he is extremely knowledgeable and very clear when explaining concepts. The only two grades were the midterm and the final, though, so take good notes.

Great professor. Intelligent, passionate, knowledgeable, and can display the concepts to others with ease. Very active and upbeat, infectious energy. Makes you want to learn and understand. Allows for discussion and debate in a civil classroom setting without invalidating anyones opinions. Does not introduce his own beliefs in teaching. overall A++

Steven Brown is amazing. He is so funny and entertaining. I legitimately enjoyed coming to class not to mention I learned so much. Because of this class, I want to minor in philosophy. He explains difficult concepts with ease and his class(es) will be stay with you and change your perspective on life.  Also, his class is pretty easy.
Nice man.  Great examples.  Lots of humor.  Most enjoyable.  Excellent teaching abilities.  He should go far.  10/10

Very easy class. Just go to class and take notes. You'll be fine on both the exams and quiz. Only 2 exams and not CUM, 10 quiz which is very easy. He's quite interesting and laugh every joke himself says...

So extremely offbeat but in a good way, and gives us essay questions/key terms ahead of time (for midterm), PLUS one full cheat sheet able to be used on all exams. Quizzes are open note but timed on Carmen.
Steven has a good sense of humor. He's very intelligent and knowledgable. Quality professor.

He was by far on of the best professors I've ever had here. He was funny and kept all the material interesting. His teaching style kept me interested in the class and his ability to be personal in a large classroom was astounding.

There couldn't be a better philosophy teacher, hands down. This was a Saturday class, so things were a bit different than they might normally be, but daily quizzes not hard at all if you take notes and read. Papers and exams slightly harder. Amazing teacher. In 5 years at OSU, I learned more in this class than in any other. Take his class. Amazing.

Really was a fun teacher, I sat in the back all quarter, bad idea, I suggest you be actively engaged in the class. Definitely do the readings, his quizzes don't require reading (open notes) but your essays will suffer if you don't, trust me. Learn as much from him as you can!

This guy is great. Friendly, funny, and you can tell he loves what he does. You're guaranteed at least a B with bare minimum effort. Learned a lot from this guy. If youre a girl whose into dorky guys, you'll love this guy. Just saying... haha
He is great. He makes class fun and interesting. Extremely friendly and nice. He is one of the best professors I have ever had!

Lectures were interesting and he was quite funny. Don't sit in the back, he mumbles quite a bit. No real book, but excerpts of philophers writings-MUST READ THESE. His tests were cake, so long as you filled out the study guide and went to class. Was very unbiased with views on religion; which is how it should be in this sort of class.

Could be a very dry class, Social/moral problems in US, but he was enthusiastic and engaging. I just remember him writing/drawing on the board figuring out the issues, calling on people and spinning around shouting Yes! with each point, often dawdling back and forth wrestling with the lesser "ehhhhh" kind of remarks trying to make them fit. Great!
Awesome professor
Best. Teacher. Ever. Hilarious, great discussions, and fair. This guy's gonna go on to be a great prof when he gets his Ph.D.

Steven is a great teacher even though some of the material is rather confusing, and at times boring. We had daily quizzes over our reading, which actually helped to keep us current with the reading assingments. His exams are moderately easy and he gives you good study tips. Overall, he's really nice and nerdy funny!

The topics were more interesting than I thought they would be.  Papers are pretty easy to write as long as you read and go to class for discussions.  You could also submit drafts that he would grade and return for you to fix.
Very cool and funny guy.  Made a very very very very boring class at least tolerable.  Responds to emails pretty quickly and is an all around nice guy.

Great professor! Readings were always interesting and he gave great historical context and author biographies in his lectures to help your understanding. Really easy-going in class and loves to hear what his students think about the readings. Taking him again right now and he's just as good!

Professor Burry is a great professor who cares a lot about his classes and his students. As someone used to stem classes, this class was a little more difficult than I expected. However, Professor Burry is very fair and after doing the extra credit he provided, my grade went up from an A- to an A.

Burry is not only a fantastic professor but a kind, caring person as well. The class is enjoyable and he genuinely cares about his students and what he is teaching. The readings were a lot to juggle at times, but overall they are pretty interesting. The two papers are not bad at all, and he is a VERY easy grader (no one got worse than a B).

Great class! Dr. Burry obviously cared a lot about his students. We had 2 papers (a 3rd extra credit one) and participation and attendance points. He was a little strict on the participation points, but he clearly says that if you participate 2-3 times per class you should be getting full or almost full credit. Would 100% take other classes of his!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Burry was an incredible professor who did everything he could to engage students in discussion of the literature we were reading. Being a literature course, there was a lot of reading, but he split it up and made it manageable. Not a super tough grader, but not a walk in the park either. Go to class and participate and you should be fine.
Absolutely great Professor. Take him if you get a chance.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Amazing lectures --Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Hands down best professor I've ever had at OSU (coming from a fifth year). I wish all the professors I had were just half as understanding and passionate as Dr. Burry. Not only does the guy really know his stuff, he's just a genuinely kind and understanding person. You won't have to explain yourself if you're struggling, Dr. Burry will sympathize.
I loved this class and professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Burry is awesome! The class consisted of six reading pop quizzes, all of which had five questions about factual information from the reading. As long as you did the reading, they weren't difficult. Additionally, there were three papers, the longest being 7-8 pages. Professor Burry was always willing to meet with me to discuss my papers.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: There is a solid amount of reading (15-25 pages a day), but I found it manageable. He was always very willing to engage with students and answer any questions. As long as you participate and do the reading, you should be able to get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Participation matters

reviews.comment: The class does require a lot of outside reading and your grade is based on only a few grades, but Dr. Burry is an excellent professor who is obviously passionate about the coursework. He is great at promoting class discussions, communicating details on assignments, and is always avaliable to offer help to any student who needs it. Take this course!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: This is my third time with Professor Burry -- honestly, a treat every single time! This was a graduate-level course, the reading-load was heavy but I enjoyed most (emphasis on most) of his choices for us to read. He grades only based on a few things: 5-6 quizzes, two papers, attendance, and participation, so it's easy for your grade to fall behind.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Burry was so kind! Pretty easy grader, but asks for a lot of outside reading. He does pop quizzes but always tells you the night before if you'll be having one so if you weren't prepared you can be. Very willing to help students if you ask. Since it was all online the attendance wasn't graded, but watching the lectures helped for exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This is my second time with Professor Burry  I think hes great. His quizzes are usually pretty self-explanatory, hes an insanely fast grader, and he gives great feedback on exams and papers (if you ask for it). The reading schedule may be a little tough to keep up with, but if you got a good schedule going, you should be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Burry is super nice, the class was very easy, and I really enjoyed it. The books we read were good, but it was quite a bit of reading. If you read and watched the lectures (only 15 min long), the quizzes and exams were very easy. Two exams and 1 paper made up most of the grade, but very easy if you read the books.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: Hasn't properly adjusted for pandemic teaching. Pop quizzes are easy, but he is very specific for answers to a fault where it doesn't make sense. The tests make up an enormous portion of the grade. He seems like a nice guy, grades quickly, and is enthusiastic about the class. The study guide won't help. The test is overly specific. No extra credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: My favorite professor I have taken in college. The class is fun and engaging. As long as you read the class is an easy A. The amount of reading isn't bad at all. Take this class you won't regret it.

The tests and quizzes are very straightforward. As long as so pay attention to lecture and do the readings, it won't be hard to get an A or B. The final paper isn't too bad either. He's really approachable when it comes to discussing paper ideas or the readings in general.

Take Alex's Literature class!!! So caring and sweet. The readings aren't bad at all. Go to class and take notes & read, minimal studying and you'll get an A. You don't have to like Russian to like this class or like him. Great professor

Where do I start? Dr. Burry is one of the best professors here at TOSU. During his lectures, you will be able to tell that he is very passionate about Russian literature. The only down fall is that the course is very reading dense but Dr. Burry understands that we are not all literature majors and makes the quizzes/exams straight forward!

Prof. Burry is a very enthusiastic professor and genuinely cares about his students! Make sure you attend lectures, read the assigned materials and take notes! His exams are easy and the quizzes are simple and straightforward as long as you do the readings!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: Lots of reading!! But as long as you stay current on the reading you will do fine on the pop quizzes.  Make sure you pay attention to lecture,  a lot of test questions come directly from lecture.  Willing to help a student who is struggling or having difficulty with their final paper.

Professor Burry is great!  The course was reading heavy with pop quizzes.  He doesn't give prompts for the papers but he is very willing to discuss options with you and help you develop a topic/give feedback on a thesis, etc.  Definitely take advantage of it!  We had so much fun in the class, I highly recommend it.

Amazing professor. Very passionate and knowledgable on the subject of Russian Literature. Fair grader, and also very approachable/accessible outside of class, especially by email. Probably the best professor I've had at OSU, hoping I get to have him again before graduation. Get ready to read and participate in class discussions.

I can't say enough great things about Dr. Burry! He is without a doubt one of the nicest men I have ever met & will go above and beyond to help his students. He is incredibly knowledgeable, and his lectures will show that. If you do what is asked, you will have absolutely no problem getting an A in the class. He is a must take! One of the best!!!

Wonderful class and prof! His tests are really easy, and so is the final paper (5 page). Everything ended up being really easy and the clear grading criteria helped. Participation is optional since the lectures are huge. If you actually read the books then it's extremely easy to get an A. Crime and Punishment is rough.

Not a lot of grades in the class, but attendance and participation are important to getting the good grade. Likes unique ideas, especially in the papers. Only real grades for the class were some quizzes on readings and a midterm paper and final paper. Super easy if you actually do the work. Great class!
Taken for GE credit. Pretty easy A for minimal work. Lots of reading, great guy. Very down to earth professor
Really interesting lectures. Very fair professor and probably the man with the most knowledge about Russian literature at Ohio state. One of the best professors I've had.
Dr. Burry is very nice and helpful.

Took class as a literature GEC and I am not much of a reader but prof burry picks out very interesting readings and is a very good instructor. He is very clear about what you need to know and genuinely cares about students. Crime and punishment section is rough but overall a great class, I 100% recommend it!

Genuinely kind professor, very interested in helping students and seeing them succeed. There are a few books to read but if you pay attention he is extremely well spoken and clear, the class is easy if you put forth some effort. Brilliant in his field, all around ideal professor.

A brilliant, helpful, kind man. One of my favorite and one of the best teachers I have ever had at Ohio State. He made the material very interesting and really pushed everyone to do well. I wish I would have him again.

What a pleasant man! As an honors science major, I took this class as a GEC with little interest/knowledge on the subject. Entirely discussion oriented, the only grades outside discussions are 2 papers (midterm & final)...a lot of reading, but a wonderful break from hard sciences. Wonderful professor, creates a great environment for discussions.

Knows a ton about all topics Russian. Really nice and always willing to help. No textbook, but a ton of printing/online reading of articles. Open to all opinions of the articles. Good course, not so bland that you're bored to death but not too hard for a GEC.
The best class I've taken since I started college.  Awesome teacher and guy.

He is the most helpful professor you can have. He explains the text and history wonderfully and with a contagious interest. Each class is interesting. He is very open to discussions different from his views and encourages other interpretations. Exams are not too difficult if you pay attention and read the books.
Awesome, and super nice

Great teacher and really wants his students to succeed. Class is discussion based and he keeps it pretty interesting. Not really necessary to read the books, just read cliff notes and go to class and take notes. One of the best classes I've taken at OSU.

Professor Burry is one of the most helpful and dedicated professors I've had at OSU.  He knows his subject inside and out but is still very interested in his students opinions and will go above and beyond to help them succeed.  Great guy and professor.

When I had him, it was a 20/20/60 midterms and final setup. Most questions on all of the tests come from what he went over in class, which wasn't always directly having to do with the books (rather-- author info, other background, etc.) so going to class AND taking decent notes is a must. But I had fun and ended up w/ a B. He's really helpful, too.
Genuinely interested in the performance and advancement of students.  One  of the best professor I've had up to date at Ohio State.
Great proff, worked well with students and not arrogant like many others. Class was discussion based with paper final. Be able to synthesize an intelligent argument and you'll do fine.
No Comments

I wasnot interested in Russian literature before the class, but now plan on reading more for my own enjoyment after the class. He is a wonderful professor who writes fair tests and is always willing to help out a student. Reading the mateiral is strongly recommended from my point of view.
Actually kept class discussion based, so if you're lazy, get to know SparkNotes. Despite being a GEC, he made it interesting. Definitely less mind-numbing than some of the other options.

Honestly I really loved her teaching style, physics is a hard subject as it is but the way she went step by step to explain the math and how to get to the answer was great. Shes super friendly and very open to meeting outside of office hours for extra help. Would highly recommend especially if you're a slow learner like me.
Really nice, gives points back, slow lecturer but explains in depth, and taught me alot

she was an OK professor her lectures weren't the greatest and did not prepare you for the midterms or the final. She is a very kind person and is willing to meet outside of office hours. Her quizzes are relatively easy and when compared to other lectures.

Very caring! However, she doesn't know much about resources outside of lecture material. Super kind she set up extra office hours during finals with hot chocolate, I just wish she went over more complex problems in class as we would get more complex ones for the homeworks or quizzes. Recitation two times a week with mandatory attendance.

She is a great lecturer! I was scared coming into this class because her ratings were so low, but from the first day, she showed that she cared about teaching the class and getting students to understand. Her lectures are quite interactive if you choose to participate, she goes at a very understandable pace, and her demos are really helpful.

I would not recommend this TA at ALL. Very rude, mean and doesn't care about students. If you ask for help she will read the problem to you again and leave you more confused, and will interrogate you for needing help. She is not respectful towards the ways different students learn, everything has to be done her way. Seriously would not recommend.

Professor G is a nice lady. She is always willing to answer students' questions if needed. Although this is a GE course, it still has a lot of assignments to do (Question of the day, unit check, and video homework), and has 3 exam and 2 quizzes in total. However, it is really confusing about the Plan-Do-Conclusion format in her assignments.

Decent at explaining physics concepts but struggles with explaining problem solving, even though exams and quizzes constantly require problem solving. Her quizzes were generally fair. Accessible outside of class and makes her office hours clear to students. In general, she also cares about students and wants to see them succeed in the course.

Dr. G is a wonderful professor, don't let these reviews fool you! She is good at explaining concepts and her quizzes are similar to the topics covered in lectures. She made sure to have both in-person and Zoom lecture options for students. The midterms and final is difficult but expected for a class like this.

I'm not sure why all of these horrible ratings are on here. Prof G explains things in a clear, easy-to-grasp way, and is always trying to meet the needs of her students. Physics 2 is a weed out course, and it takes individual work outside of lectures to apply and understand these concepts.

Lectures are useless since she copies from summary notes she posts online. She doesn't do math problems in class, it is just conceptual. Recitations and labs are a mess. Nothing new from physics department. Quizzes extremely difficult, test are slightly easier. Awful professor.

Literally the worst prof ever. Going to class doesnt help. She has a copy of notes page that she just writes over again on the chalk board verbatim and no explanation of why. You can just look at the definitions and equations on the slide yourself and learn the same thing as you would in class. Answers questions vaguely and often wrong

Physics 1200 By far worst/least caring professor I've ever had. Awful lecturer who doesn't make practice problems/exams or post her slides online. Makes her own diagrams for lecture that she basically expects you to memorize since they will show up on quizzes. She gave laughably little effort and had a sub or cancelled lecture 5 times.

Awful lecturer. Goes to fast to write everything down and refuses to post her PowerPoints. Really doesn't care how students do. Will not post reviews or answer keys.  This class should not have been this hard. Consistently ends lecture early then claims we don't have enough time to finish things. Avoid her at all costs.

Terrible at explaining concepts. She explains it super half-baked and seems like she knows she's doing a terrible job at it and still moves on. Make sure you understand homework and quiz problems. Also beware, class gets a bit harder after the first midterm. Avoid.

Lectures are not helpful at all for homework, tests, or quizzes. you will see the tests and have no idea what half of the things on it are because she never went over it in lecture.  She is very unclear and unhelpful. Didn't help that she was also my TA so I got no extra help there. If you can avoid it don't take physics with this professor.

Very unclear about topics in lecture and then gets mad when students do not understand. Either does no problems, or extremely easy problems in class (relative to the homework,quizzes,etc...). If you go to her office hours with questions about the assigned homework, she will just restate the exact wording of the homework question. Avoid this prof.
Very boring lecturer. I'd suggest studying from the book and doing book problems for exams.
Lectures were pointless and a lot of self teaching is needed. Do your best to understand the material on quizzes and practice tests rather than information from lecture.
Tests are ridiculous hard. Not useful to attend lectures. Don't take this class with this professor.

The lectures are definitely a waste of time. Her explanations of concepts are unclear and uses no example problems in lecture. She puts her notes online but they are unorganized and lack detail. The exam and homework problems were tough and wording on exams was VERY unclear.

The lectures were not helpful at all. I get that she wants students to think for themselves to solve complicated problems, but the exams are stupid hard compared to the homework, in-class quizzes and the infrequent examples offered in lecture. She spends most of the lectures deriving formulas using calculus and doing simple examples symbolically.

Sure, the lectures don't spoon feed you the answers to your tests and quizzes but I found lectures to be interesting.  Her style of teaching by writing the notes in class rather than prewriting the slides kept the class well paced and her examples and demos made it easy to pay attention. The tests are hard but manageable with hard work.

Her lectures are a complete waste of time and she only shows conceptual things. Then on the homework and quizzes you have no idea how to implement formulas because she doesn't do any examples in class. Avoid this professor.

I created an account to review this professor. Worst professor I've ever had at Ohio State. This class was ridiculously hard due to the manner of teaching. It's not learning based whatsoever. It's interesting how the test questions aren't that difficult yet the averages are in the 50s, which basically demonstrates that no one learned anything...

i didnt think she was so bad. She is new at OSU so its understandable that she is adjusting. No need to go to class. She puts everything online. Her tests are stupid hard though, and the extended response on them often require you to make assumptions which can be annoying
Her show work problems on exams are poorly explained through the directions, and VERY difficult. She is new and her lectures are almost pointless. Would NOT advise to take her
Horribly unorganized lecture notes, spends more time on proofs than explaining or giving demonstrations of the concepts, never provides any kind of formula sheet. Would not recommend.

I feel that she does have the same respect that I have for her and it feels like middle school. She gets along very well with other students which makes me feel like an outsider despite active participation and showing an interest in the material. I have good attendance and put in a lot of effort in and out of class but she just doesn't like me.

I had Samanta for Italian 1101 and she was amazing. She was extremely understanding and genuinely wants you to learn and understand the language as well as having fun doing so. She is very funny and upbeat which a lot of professors seemingly lack. If you have the choice I would take her in a hearbeat.

She was really good about getting everyone to participate and by the end of the semester, I really felt that I understood three semesters worth of material and could have a conversation relatively easily without struggling. She explains concepts really well in terms of the language itself.
Caring, accessible, and funny professor. Always prepared, willing to answer questions. I looked forward to every class. Truly helped me learn Italian. Overall, an excellent professor.

Dr. Tania is awesome. I took the lecture online and the lectures were straight forward, just a little long. Everything is open note and she doesn't use lockdown browser. Some tiny tiny projects here and there but they are so easy and actually interesting. Last project is very very difficult but go to TA office hours and they will be happy to help!
Nothing to write home about. Assignments were easy, though sometimes points were taken off for arbitrary reasons. All in all, easy three credits.
My favorite professor I have ever met!

She's so great. I loved her class! I didn't need it for my major (I just took it for upper division credit). But it was really informative and enjoyable. She's clearly so passionate about what she does and it shines through in how she lectures. Highly recommend.

I had ENR 3000 online (would not let me select correct course code) and it was a breeze! I learned a lot even though it was online, and Tania was extremely nice and helpful. Easy to get good grades and much of it is self paced with quick grading and flexible deadlines. Definitely would recommend taking her if possible!
She's very good at helping you to understand the material without it being too difficult or technical. Very kind person. She has games during class, lots of extra credit opportunities.

The class had a decent amount of work, but overall was pretty easy if you paid attention during the lectures and did the apps. Professor explained all of the topics well enough to do well on the exams, but could have articulated a bit better.

The professor was absolutely amazing. They had you read the textbook before going to class, I found that I didn't have to, and I did fine in the class. Sometimes the material (coding-heavy) can be a little confusing, but the TA's and Bulut are very good at explaining. The exams were very easy, go to review and look over quizzes.

Osman is a stud. Definitely the best FEH professor and I would definitely encourage anyone to take his class. His lectures are short and most of class time is spent doing assignments. Osman is very pro-AI and encourages students to use it "correctly" to learn. This class is a lot of work, but Osman as set it up for students' success. He's the goat

Osman was amazing for FEH. His lectures were short and sweet, and while some concepts were difficult, he was more than willing to help. Of the problems that I had with this course, none were with Osman.

Professor Bushman is overall pretty nice and gives plenty of resources to learn the material. The course requires a textbook, but I literally never used it as his lectures covered everything. There is not any extra credit opportunities, so be sure to do well on writing assignments and exams.
Exams take topics straight from the lectures, but were still a bit challenging. Very interesting class though, I enjoyed it.

He's a cool guy and nice, but you'll definitely put more effort into this class than most other 3000 level classes that aren't directly needed for your major. It wasn't that bad, but the bulk of your grade is from the two exams and paper. The exams are also with honorlock, so yeah. It's a pretty interesting course, though.
The class was pretty easy. Just make sure you are taking notes and you are set to go on the exams.
Awful professor - do not take this class. His tests are so hard and he doesn't care about the success of his students. Anyone that says hes amazing is lying.

Prof is a good guy who cares about his students. I liked how he did homework, and it definitely helped me with keeping my grade up. His study guides are a little ridiculous for midterms. There are 4, 19 question midterms, but each midterm I made over 50 flashcards for everything that was on the study guide.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I really liked Dr. Bushman as a professor, but the class was definitely harder than a 1100 class should be. Homework was easy, but there was a decent amount each week. Exams are fairly difficult, but he gives great resources and is transparent about the number of questions per lecture and where extended responses come from.

I loved this class, Dr. Bushman is famous in the psych world and cool guy to have as your teacher. A lot of the studies he cites are his studies! His lectures can get a little boring at times and has a tendency to over explain, but he makes everything easy to understand. Definitely take this class if you get the chance he's such a sweetheart.

Prof. Bushman is such a caring and intelligent teacher. He posts the slides online, so attendance isn't required, but he is a great orator and has interesting lectures. The homework and tests are pretty easy, but that isn't to say you do not learn a lot in the class because you do. I would love to take him for another semester for sure!

I would take this class with Brad again if I could. The content is so interesting, and he cares about what he is talking about! Although majority of your grade is based off 2 exams, this class was very investing and I highly recommend him. Best class I've taken at OSU so far. Also, if you do the weekly quiz, you're guaranteed a 100%.

If you keep up with the readings and lectures, it will be pretty easy. I think a lot of people will complain about the exams, but they honestly were not bad. Most of the questions came straight from the weekly quizzes and there's an outline of exam topics, so it was easy to study for. Make sure you read the syllabus well! He does not stray from it.

Brad Bushman is such a wonderful professor and guy. He is funny, genuinely cares for his students and knows so much about his subject. His class is very stress free and he is just the best overall. A wonderful professor 100% recommend.
I really love this professor. He is very passionate about what he teaches, and he knows what he is talking about. His lectures are also very interesting and engaging.

Brad himself is a nice and sweet man. This class was bad though. Every week you have a quiz worth 5 points which is not too hard. The tests were awful though. Very specific questions that require intense studying. There are not a lot of points in this class so tests are important. 1 paper which is easy if you're good at writing research papers.

i really loved this class, despite what others are saying. you spend no more than 2 hours per week doing his work and the lectures are super interesting. beware of the exams because you must watch the lectures to do well, but again, there are only 2 and the rest of the work is very minimal
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: super disrespectful and treats his students like he is way beyond above them. Does not care if you fail and will not offer ANY extra credit. The 2 exams hold the majority over your grade so if you do badly on one be prepared to have to drop the course.

I took this class online--it was really well organized, Professor Bushman's lectures were clear and straightforward. The class wasn't super difficult either. There's just one final paper and a midterm and final exam. As long as you actually watch the lectures and take notes, you'll be fine! Definitely not a bad GE course.
DONT TAKE THIS CLASS! I WARNED YOU

DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS! If you are part of SLDS I encourage you to find a new professor because he will not accommodate for you. He did not want to give me double time on my quizzes and exams and was very rude about it I had to drop his class and take another class

Good professor. I took the class online, but didn't feel left behind or lost like I do in some of my online classes. There is a lot of reading in the class, and the exams are definitely more difficult than you might expect, but manageable. He was really good at replying to emails, which is very important for an online class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Gives great lectures every week (avg 25 min), a paper about a concept in the lecture, and small McGraw HWs. Three exams that you'll have to look over notes for, which weren't too difficult since he tells you what you need to study. Prof was also very kind and gave me extensions as needed. Highly recommended!

I enjoyed Comm 1100 with Dr Bushman and will try to schedule him again as I accomplish my communication minor. He is well respected, and a somewhat famous guy in the field of social sciences. He's very kind and patient, lectures are very relaxed and fulfilling. My grade in this class felt well earned, it is not a ton of work but it is challenging.

I really enjoyed professor Bushman! He really knows what he is talking about and ties it into real life. Lectures can be boring to listen to, but he posts the slides. His tests are hard because it really relies on you having a solid understanding of the concepts but he gives you study tools. As long as you take good notes and study its good!
reviews.rating_tags: So many papers--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The lectures were enjoyable, but did seem to get somewhat off track at times. Dr. Bushman was not very approachable, he would reply to emails in a very short manner, forward to TA's, but would not correct my grade. The exams and the lectures didn't really line up. There are weekly writing assignments, but the exams are worth a lot of your grade.

Don't take this class if you want a good grade and GPA at the end of the semester. The worst teacher ever in my life, no extra credits, tests is extremely hard, lecture was so boring, not care about students at all! Definitely try to stay away with this horrible teacher!!!
The worst professor I ever had in the osu. His lecture are fine but the exam are super hard. And he doesn’t care about the student’s feeling.
His Classes are good and interesting but the text is so hard.
PLZ do not come to this class. U will feel hopeless

This was my FAVORITE class! He was the best professor ever! The lectures were very interesting and he taught the material very well. The textbook is very useful because it's exactly what he says in lectures. He is the author of the textbook! Few extra credit opportunities. Exams were fair, questions mostly came from tophat, slides, and textbook.

Dr. Bushman is a solid professor, and the course is a great introduction to communication and social psychology. I throughly enjoyed his lectures and found the content engaging and relevant. There are short weekly papers (one page) along with three exams.

Dr. Bushman is such a well respected guy. It was an honor to learn from him. You gotta watch the lectures and do the readings. The exams are pretty difficult even after studying. But I really loved his class

One of my favorite professors that Ive had, hes really nice and makes the content interesting/easy to understand. Workflow is consistent and not overly difficult, as there is an essay and short quiz most weeks. Downside is that exams are somewhat difficult, but do the reading before lectures and before the exam, and prepare in advance.
there is a short essay to do every week but it's no big deal. Exams are considered okay if you read the slides from lectures and the book. Overall this is a good class for GE.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: Prof Bushman is truly the most caring professor I've ever had! As long as you communicate with him, he can be very accommodating and you can tell he truly cares about his students. Just make sure you watch the online lectures and you can pass without too much difficulty!

I agree with both the good and bad reviews. Bittersweet experience, the class is crazy hard but I lucked out with my grade. I feel like its easier to do bad than good but the bigger issue is the title. I feel like perhaps he makes it so hard because comm 3442 isnt an as respected class to take oppose to a different open elective.

Really narcissistic. He comes across as someone who has his students back but is essentially non existent when you need help and is cold and short with you. Tried to comfort the class on doing poorly on the midterm by announcing the majority of us did bad as well in his lecture. Shouldnt that tell you that maybe what you teach isnt on the tests?

Pretty misleading, from lectures you think youd know whats on a test but open it up to something completely different. Hes someone you want to like because hes funny but as an actual professor hes not the best at teaching and is actually not understanding at all which you wouldnt expect in the beginning. Regret taking this class. Never again.

Overall good professor. I would go to every lecture you can and read the chapters to keep up with the content for exams. Shows videos and examples throughout class so it's not so boring and he's pretty funny. No extra credit and 3 exams were kind of tough. Weekly assignments graded by TA, but he seemed to care about his students.

I really liked Brad! Lectures could be boring and usually were spent by him showing a ton of goofy videos that sometimes didn't really seem relevant. Tests could be kind of difficult and didn't really have study guides. Overall, he was a pretty good and caring professor.

I think Brad Bushman is a nice guy, however, his class was unnecessarily hard. Your final grade is based on four exams, so if you do poorly on one your grade is kind of screwed. He doesn't offer any homework or extra credit and I felt like he didn't really care if his students did well or not.
I liked his class, but youll have to read the chapters before the lecture. He only goes over half of the material in lecture and the other half is from the reading.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Brad Bushman is such an angel. He's very funny and passionate about the material he teaches, and lectures were always very interesting. Attendance is not mandatory, and if you read the textbook, do the tophat review, and the quiz yourself questions in the book, you can probably pass without going. I went just because his lectures are interesting.

My class was a hybrid, so every Monday we had an online essay instead of a lecture. For the essays, you have to read the chapter of the book he assigns, and sometimes find real world examples. Those weren't fun. The exams are easy, and if you pay attention in lecture he tells you what you should focus on, and gives you the short answer questions.

I loved this class!! Wasn't mandatory but if you go and pay attention you will do well because he gives great examples and is awesome at applying the concepts. most papers and assignment were graded by TAs so the grading is a little difficult they expect specific things. However, tests are in class and if you do the guide you will surely flourish
Boring lectures. He doesn't seem to have anything interesting or significant about him. More interested with hoping on the latest SJW bandwagon than actually being a force that brings about change.

He's a really cool dude, and he really cares about how you learn the material. I would love to take another class by him. Barely studied and did well on all the exams. There's 3 and homework is extremely quick and easy.

He forces his beliefs on you. He says "he cares" about his students, but really if you ask for help or email, he is short and rude and tells you to your TA. My TA saw me a lot because I had so many questions. I went to every single lecture, all he does his talk about his OWN studies. This class is all about him. He's arrogant, just STAY AWAY!

If you come to class every day, you can easily ace the exams without ridiculously studying. Two-three hours the day before the exam is plenty. If you don't come to class, though, and you want an A, you should expect exam-prep to go very differently.
You can tell he genuinely enjoys teaching, which makes a BIG difference.

He is the best professor I've had. He is extremely kind and helpful and made a huge class seem small. It's easy to skip because it's a massive lecture but I never missed one because no lecture was boring. Would definitely recommend his classes.

I had Dr. Bushman for Psych 3325 and he is one of the best professors on campus. Period.  He took several teaching classes to ensure his tests are fair and understandable. There are no tricks. He is very kind (takes students to get bagels) and is always accessible and approachable. People underestimate his class though, but there is a curve.

Favorite professor by far. Obviously loves what he does and loves to talk about his personal experiences as an experimenter. Even though it's a giant class he tries to get to know his students and really cares about how you do. If you don't enjoy this course it is your own fault because he makes it very easy and fun.
Professor Bushman is amazing. I really enjoy his class.

This is my favorite class this semester! The material is interesting, and Prof. Bushman tries to keep the students intrigued with comics and opportunities for class participation. He very clearly lays out what to expect on exams, classes, and quizzes in the syllabus. If you read the assigned readings and review the PP's - the exams are fairly easy.
Best professor I've had so far. Super clear and very fair grader. Always implements a curve so 25% of the class gets an A on each exam. Highly recommend!
Just look at his accomplishment!
He was really helpful when I asked him to clarify some information. I took both Comm 1100 and Comm 3442. He was really interesting with Comm 3442 and I would recommend that class to anyone!

I enjoyed his teachings. He expressed his beliefs but never tried to force someone to believe what he does. He's just passionate about his research and I am mature enough to separate my beliefs from his without criticizing the way that he teaches. I enjoy his lectures, though his powerpoint are a bit disorganized at times.

Overall, not the best experience I've had with a professor.  His lectures are based on his own beliefs, and many times he will force those beliefs on students; with the justification of "studies show that..."   Exams can be a bit vague and the class average, at one point, was around a D+ without a curve.  Stay away... far away...
The tests are easy if you go to lecture and do the assigned readings. He takes questions from both. Easy to understand and tries to relate the material to what is going on in the news.

This guy is not nice. Do yourself a favor and do not take this class from him.  He is super arrogant and into himself.  He responses to emails are rude short.  He does not care about his students because the class is so big.  The tests are though.  He is extreamly smart, too smart for his own good.  KEEP AWAY FROM THIS CLASS!!!

Lectures are almost pointless except for the entertainment value. His power points are confusing and not helpful for taking online quizzes. He meets his students for bagels but seems disinterested in what they have to say. He also comes off as arrogant and quite rude. He's accomplished a lot but he will make sure you know about it.

This class is not too difficult if you study for exams. Like others have said, it is never clear exactly what will be on an exam. Most of the lectures do not contribute to you actually learning the material. A lot of video watching, when you're not quite sure why you are watching it. Forces his own personal views on class. Highly do not recommend.

Bushman was the best professor I have had at OSU. He is clearly passionate about the material and tries to make it relatable to students. I love the way he tries to make a giant lecture feel personal. I didn't buy the text book and still received an A. I definitely recommend his courses!
He's very interested in the material, but his enthusiasm  didn't motivate me. Not as easy as it could be.

Not recommended Gen Ed.  He is a really nice guy and tries to meet all of his students in a 515 person lecture. Tests are pretty difficult especially if you don't have time to study for them. Helps a lot if you go to class but not mandatory and has all ppts on carmen.  You can succeed in the class if you do all the readings and focus

Super cool and interesting professor. Funny, good guy, buys you bagels if you let him. Should easily get a B if you go to class, if not just look at the study guide before the test and you should still do fine. Online quizzes are easy and you get 3 attempts. Rest of grade is C-REP and you get all the points just for participating. Enjoy

It was his first time teaching the class, so it was definitely difficult at first but it got better. I found class very interesting. I reccommend going to class, although its not mandatory, because not everything is on the Powerpoints. Plenty of extra credit opportunities. He tries to get to know his students by inviting 5 every out to get bagels.

Make sure you come to every class! He really knows what he's talking about. He once showed us a study that had been published in The New York Times that I had read before. It ended up being his study! Despite being a 300+ person lecture, he would treat 5 students to "Bagels with Bushman" at Brennan's on High Street. I recommend --but go to class!

Didn't really care for him. Exams are tough (not as tough if you attend class regularly) and not many other points are offered besides the exams (80% of the final grade) Rambles a bit in lecture and I was never sure what material he talked about in lecture would actually be on the exam.) Study guides he provides are lengthy and didn't help much.

The class wasn't easy, but it was incredibly interesting.  Dr. Bushman is an amazing scholar, and great teacher.  If you go to class and take good notes, it's not hard to do well.  He uses a curve (that doesn't punish you) in case the class doesn't do well.  I would recommend taking the class if you actually plan on attending.
major cool points for playing "Friday" by Rebecca Black during class.
Cares a lot about the students' learning. Gives a lot of opportunities for asking questions. Fast responses to emails. All these make Prof. Byna an awesome educator.

The lecture slides/lectures in general are missing a lot of information we need to know for the assignments. Difficult to find the information needed. Also, the grading was all over the place. Some assignments would be graded very easily and others I would get -20 points even being close to the answer. The average on the final exam was a 58.

Avoid both Suren and Spyros. Take this course from Christopher. If no choice, take it in the next semester w/ Christopher. I mean it. Suren is unwilling to help during his office hour and TA doesn't know anything about this class.

I had her for 2101. She's not the most peppy but she does care about her students and wants them to succeed. there was a lot of work and at times she grades pretty hard. i also lowkey thought she hated me and she didn't really have a reason to. participation and group work is big and she moves very quickly through material but overall good.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: An intelligent,  caring professor who  encourages students to think critically.  Offers opportunities for extra credit
