His lectures were kind of dry, and I missed a lot of them, but between the thorough notes and slides he posts on Carmen and the textbook I was able to learn the material well enough to earn a grade in the B+/A- range. He also seems to just be a nice guy in general, and spoke candidly in lecture.

I was a TA for one of his lab sections.  Easy to work with. Has tough exam questions, but compensates with extra credit.  Creative teacher... brought his dog to class one day to talk about evolution.  Be prepared to read a weekly article and do a blog response.  Uses clickers during class almost every time. I wish I had him when I took Bio101!

Dr. Cogan was hard but i learned so much just by paying attention to the lectures. I personally recommend him for bio. He is a little monotone but he knows his material well and is very clear on the material.

The guy is very well spoken and knows his stuff but very scatter brained and the lectures are very boring.  Must listen to what he says because a lot of it shows up on tests instead of what is on his long presentations.

I'm a senior, I've seen it all. This guy is pretty terrible. His lectures are scatterbrained, his TA's are incomprehensible, and his quiz's are very difficult. Also, he teachers "clicker" classes (if you don't know what that is, Google it, you wont like it). Hes nice, but i recommend you avoid at all costs.

I wouldn't advise the guy but he's not quite so terrible as some people on here are saying. If you can, choose some other section but I wouldn't put off taking the class just because you have him.  Problems are often oddly worded and difficult to follow, not due to content but rather phrasing.

AU09 - Looking back, I think we was a pretty decent professor. It's difficult to get 100% on the quizzes even with 2 attempts. I had no midterms, just a final, that I got an A on. Make sure you write down what he SAYS instead of the PPT! If you complain to your lab TA enough, they will probably say something to him,mine did, and helped us out a lot
PUSH

His guided notes are hard to follow, and his lectures are boring. He never emails his students back -- don't even bother. He doesn't seem extremely excited about teaching. I find his exam problems very hard to reason through.
Avoid Cogan at all costs. Learned absolutely nothing.

Dr. Cogan is a terrible professor. His lectures are impossible to follow, his slides are useless, and he is incredibly boring. All quizzes are online so they are not too difficult, but when you don't understand anything during lecture even an online quiz becomes frustrating. You would do well to avoid him!

Dr. Cogan is a very confusing Bio lecturer. He jumps around a lot and barely talks about the subject at hand, and when he does, it rarely makes sense. It makes paying attention difficult which in turn makes the online quizzes difficult. The easy part is the labs which are with your TA and I actually understood it when my TA taught.
WORST professor I've ever had. Doesn't cover material well, jumps from topic to topic, puts stuff you've never seen on exams, boring and rude. DO NOT take Dr. Cogan for biochem. AVOID AT ALL COSTS.

Not organized. Lectures boring, confusing, hard to follow. Never know whats gona be on the test because the study guides tell you to memorize every line of the notes and textbook. Extremely frustrating. Avoid this professor.

One of the most confusing classes I have taken including OChem. Dr. Cogan flies through the material and expects you to remember everything. Literally the review sheets are everything you covered. Plus I never felt like I was taking Intro to Biochem. It felt more like a grad school class.

Absolutely one of the worst professors I've ever had. His lectures are poorly structured and its hard to follow along with anything he does. He has 0 enthusiasm when talking. He draws with a permanent marker on white paper and you can't tell what the hell he's doing because nothing is labeled. Exams are know everything or get rocked. AVOID HIM.

Lectures were somewhat boring and didn't flow that well. However, his class was easy and his quizzes were online with multiple attempts. The labs were also fairly easy. He also had questions at random points in the class that you had to answer with an electronic clicker. If you answered 100 or so over the course of the quarter you got full points.

Dr. Cogan is not a very enthusiastic teacher and does not enjoy communicating with students over email even for simple questions. For both midterms he taught half a chapter of material the day before the midterm (which was then covered on the midterm). Good news though his quizes are online. I would highly recommend not take Cogan for any class.

Easiest science class I've taken. The labs are easy. The quizzes can be difficult but online with two tries each. No midterm. BUT. Lectures are incredibly boring and don't flow too well or match the labs very well. But there is TONS of extra credit and go over quizzes and practice final for the final and you'll be fine.
He was a really nice guy.  But his lectures topics were confusing and did not flow very well.  Because of that, his tests were hard to figure out.

Dr. Cogan is a nice guy but a boring professor. Its VERY EASY to get an A in this class: take it. You don't need to buy the textbook, the labs are very easy, there is no midterm, there are tons of participation points and lots of extra credit opportunities, and the 5 quizzes are online and can be taken twice. I did nothing all quarter and got an A.

Dr Cogan is a good teacher who tries hard to get his class to understand the material, but the lectures are often unclear and hard to pay attention to. He offers 20 extra points which can bring up any grade, and the labs and final are farely easy. The online quizzes can be difficult, but as long as you stay on top of the class its is not too hard.

The class is harder then the rating i gave it if you are actually looking for an A, you will not get it in his class. But you can get by if you do well on the labs which are simple and the online quizzes follow directly from the power point lectures. Also participation is required in the sense that you can answer questions in class to earn points.
I do NOT understand why he doesn't respond to e-mails. His exams are extremely hard. He doesn't do a good job explaining the material. I would NOT recommend to anybody...

Cog is a nice guy, and you can tell he means well. He bounces around in his lectures and it's hard to tell what's going on. 5 quizzes in the quarter, some are harder than others. Labs are easy. You have to come to class to get 40 clicker points. opportunities for extra credit points. no midterm.
Dr. Cogan is a nice guy and is extremely helpful at office hours because he knows you care. The only thing is, he kind of makes the material more complicated than it needs to be at lectures.

Biology is a subject that  really can't be taught in an exciting sort of way, unless you are a Scientist yourself.  Since I major elsewhere, this course is somewhat boring yet required.  A majority of the class likes him, since he's an all around nice guy.  He cares and will take time for his students.  Pay attention in class, and you'll do well.
He is a really nice guy who looks like Alan from the Hangover, but his lectures are hard to follow. But labs are easy and he tells really dry jokes and he is really nervous in front of the class.
Extremely boring. Hard quizzes

His lectures were incredibly boring and he makes sure you attend class by having clicker questions throughout class. The quizzes are hard at times, but you get a couple tries. If you need him for a GEC, it isn't that bad. Just do the work and pay attention.

This guy is the most monotone person alive. He is so boring. Impossible to stay awake in his class. His test are impossible because he gives you concepts you never have seen before. His "Study" guides are useless. He basically takes his notes and copies everything down and tells you that everything will be on the test, you study you a$$ off. LAZY
this guy is sooooo boring.  did not pay attention in lecture b/c its impossible.  labs are so stupid.  supposed to be bio 101 but more like bio 114 way too hard for an introductory class

Someone wrote that Dr. Cogan does not teach new material....well this is not a research class. He teaches facts and how life on Earth emerged, I do not know what people need more. Anyway I should say that he is not the worse professor. The only disturbing thing is that there is one cumilative exam and bunch of quizzes on Cramen that are challenging

I do not think Dr. Cogan as described by others. He is fine professor, lectures jus fine as well. First of all he does not require to buy a book, since he posts all notes online and he created an online book. Second labs are interesting and TA a way better than those in Chemistry.

This was a horrible class!  Sign up for another prof!  Going to classes is useless and so extremly boring, and the labs consist of things that three year olds would be better off doing.  Cogan makes Bio 101 so much more difficult that it needs to be.

SIGN UP FOR ANOTHER TEACHER!! His lecture is way too in depth for a biology 101 class and the lab and lectures are so unrelated that it is hard to grasp any concepts.  Also, you only have online quizzes that you get to use your notes, but the notes from in class barely help you on his quizzes, because there is so much in depth stuff!

Everyone tends to get an A in the class. But he isn't a very good teacher. His lectures are too in depth for a 101 course, but not in depth enough for his quizzes. You don't have to buy the textbook, but you have to buy a clicker.

Simple, don't take this class with him as a teacher. He teaches far beyond the requirements of the class, and quizzes are completely different from his lectures. Lab is really easy, but even if you do well in lab it won't help your grade that much. Again, don't take this teacher. FIND A DIFFERENT TEACHER!

don't waste your money on the book. the lectures are very boring and the labs are stupid but if you go to lecture to get the participation points and you get good grades on your labs and quizzes, it will be easy to get an a in the class. its easy to get a good grade in this class if you put some time in, but you won't learn anything

Lecture and lab are completely unrelated, it's like taking 2 classes. So unorganized! I spent hours outside of class every week trying to organize my notes to no avail. While I admire his passion for biochem, it makes for less of the basic bio you signed up for and lots of completely unnecessary information.. his 101 class is NOT a 101 class.

I basically agree with everyone else. His lectures are virtually incomprehensible, the labs are completely unrelated to lectures, and his grading system is ridiculous. There's only a final exam, which will most likely end up killing your grade since it's so hard and he doesn't tell you what to study. Nice guy, but terrible professor.

this is the worst professor i have ever had. he does NOT stay on track. he spent 3 lectures on photosynthesis, yet barely anything on that was on the final. he focuses on MINOR POINTLESS details. quizzes don't match up with what was taught. class avg for final was 71% in a BIO 101 CLASS. worst teacher at ohio state, NEVER EVER take him. ever.

Not that this class was too hard, it was just all over the place. It seems like he taught more chemistry than biology. The average on the final was a C-. I feel like he should have taught the class like an introductory biology, and he didn't.

This teacher is awful. Listen to all the comments on this site because it's true. The teacher acts like its a 400 level class and his quizzes are rediculous. Don't take this teacher under any circumstances.

This class is a 101 class taught by a biochemist. He cannot teach the material and maybe that is not his fault since he has taken many biology classes to get where he is. BUT this professor is terrible, his lectures are impossible and quizzes are irrelevant to current material. DO NOT use this professor if you have to take this class.

Worst professor ever. Quizzes do not correspond with the lectures.  Labs are ridiculously easy and simple, like a bio 101 class should be, and the lectures are incomprehensible. Unorganized and never has planned what he's going to talk about in class. NO NO NO.

Doesn't teach to an equivalent of 101 level. teaches like a 400 level. Very confusing. Took forever to get an e-mail response for help. Lectures are incredibly boring, and the information is all imperative to know for the only test given (final only) online quizzes (get two attempts)

He seems like a nice guy but I had difficulty with this class - many concepts were rushed or briefly touched upon and I didn't feel as though I learned much of anything by the end.  I ended up with a decent A but I don't feel as though I did much to deserve it (a lot of points came from lab work which at best was loosely related to the lectures).

Worst professor I think I've ever had, he is extremely unorganized and all over the place. The material was way to indepth for a 100 level course. He tended to forget that he was teaching Bio and very frequently focused more on Chem. Did give extra credit which greatly helped my grade but do not recommend him for this class.

I signed up for biology, not chemistry. I dont really care if hes a biochemistry major, thats not what I signed up for. The lecture material has nothing to do with labs or quizzes. You don't use the book at all so do not buy it.

I would definitely NOT recommend this teacher.  The class is completely unorganized, lecture material is unrelated to labs, and the material is grazed-over. DO NOT buy the book. You won't learn anything, but you will get a decent grade. Requires blog writing and quizzes outside of class.
He is very boring, unorganized and hard to follow in lecture.

The worst professor I have ever had in my entire life. Doesn't understand basic chemistry. Doesn't teach. Doesn't come to lecture, review sessions,final exams on time. Doesn't answer emails. Makes you memorize everything you have to learn to the atom. Does absolutely nothing you want in a professor.

He tended to blab a lot and tested on random things on Midterms and finals.  For taking AP Bio in high school, I only came out of this class with a B- after attending class and studying.  Just make sure you study every single random thing.  Not a bad guy though.
Hard exams. Tests you on the most obscure things from powerpoint pictures that you dont pay much attention to. Concepts are fairly easy but the concepts aren't what is tested.

Cogan is a good teacher, and the notes are all online so you should bring them to class so you have a chance at actually following along. We did not get through the syllabus so it seems he has started to get better about going slower. It was still a REALLY difficult class, especially for a GEC so take 101 if you can.

Took his class AU 08.  He was an ok guy.  He did provide quiz reviews/lecture notes and was a helpful when we had questions.  His quizzes were somewhat difficult, but he allowed his students to challenge their grades. Would recommend.

Took his class in fall 08' and thought that his lectures were a waste of time.  Just MEMORIZE his lecture notes, because there were often minute details that were on his tests from the notes, also don't bother with the textbook, you won't need it.

He is good guy but he doesnt give enough study guides, his exams are tricky and hard. he gives previous exams for study guide but they dont help. i wish he could give study guide. other than that he is a good guy.

Lectures should be focused on important topics and less time wasted. Students are more likely to be apt to come to lectures if material covered was not prefaced with "this won't be on the test; don't worry about writing this down." He goes way too fast!

He posted thorough quiz reviews and lectures online.  His quizzes and final exam were fair and presented in a way that encouraged the students to think about the subject matter.  He was very easy going and likable.  His lectures were organized and  presented using various methods such as PowerPoint, films and etc.  I would definitely recommend him.
Only had him for half the quarter. Course is at a very fast pace. Exams were hard. Seems like a nice enough guy but did not like him as a professor.

The labs & article responses are easy points, but his quizzes and the final are difficult. The first few quizzes are pretty easy, then they just get ridiculous. His final is pretty hard too; he said to study the quiz reviews for it and that didn't even help. His lectures are very boring as well; luckily he posts the notes online & quiz reviews.

Avoid him! I did not like his teaching style (confusing examples...tried to incorporate pointless and unhelpful media sources.) Quiz questions are confusing and unclear and he only has one test:the final. I would have definitely taken this class with another professor. Plus, to top it off he makes inappropriate jokes to try to relate to students.

Dr. Cogan was very interested in the subject matter.  He did a very good job of making the long lectures interesting and helpful.  Some quiz questions were vague at times, but he usually tried to understand and make things fair in the end.  Great guy, recommend him.
he sort of expects everyone had taken AP Bio unless how could he cover 10 chapters in 4 weeks?! His explanation on the subject matter is not clear either...

I really tried to like Cogan because he seems like a nice guy.  His exams, however, are completely vague, which seemed to be the general consensus among my class.  If you study a lot and like to do well, take someone else!!When you don't know what test questions are asking, it doesn't matter how much you study. If only someone would have told me.

Cogan has the very best intentions. Unfortunately this wasn't exactly manifested through his somewhat mediocre teaching abilities.  In his defense, there is a ton of information to cram in your head in only one quarter, so often times the subject material seemed scattered and incoherent. None the less, I would still recommend taking him.
Cogan was alright. He was pretty boring, but his midterm was pretty easy if you studied. He gives homework so that the midterm is worth less. The assignments aren't bad.
Professor is very nice but very jumpy on subject matters. The quizzes and final was very hard even with studying the review sheets.

He was a super nice guy and great to help you when needed, considering the class size. The quizzes and tests were difficult, but there usually is quite a curve. Dr. Cogan is a great professor and I enjoyed getting to know him! Very funny, always said something in the mornings to make us laugh!:)

The class really isn't that hard.  The questions asked on the quizzes are more specific than you'd expect but he gives review sheets... show up to class and stay somewhat awake (not as easy as it sounds) and read the review sheet and you were fine.  I didn't buy the book... getting an A.
His exams are really hard as mentioned.

He's a little dry... and his PowerPoints make lecture a little useless to attend. My best advice for this class is READ THE BOOK! And you know that little CD that comes with it? Use that too! I did and I aced this class.

His efforts to be funny did not go unappreciated. He is very easy going and just an all around great guy. His quizzes were straight forward even though the tests were a little trickier. He made the 8:30 am 5 days a week go a little easier
Nice guy, but he is very boring. It is hard to stay awake in that class. His slides are really good and he gives helpful practice problems prior to exam. Study his slides and you should do fine.
He is helpful but I felt like at times he didn't know his stuff.  Class is very disorganized and exams were extremely hard.
Dr. Cogan was a pretty good teacher. Explained things well, made occasional jokes, and he answered questions correctly and to the point. Posted helpful notes online. I would recomend him to anyone.

He was our laboratory coordinator.  He never had anything set up by the time lab started and didn't even bother posting the stuff that we were supposed to read before class online, so we had to waste 30 minutes of class listening to him explain it after he made us read it.  He made bio lab a worthless 2 hours twice a week.
No Comments

posted notes online, which was nice.  tried to make lecture interesting and tell jokes, with occasional success.  quizzes every friday at 8:30 am were a pain, definitely required studying.  final was alright.  anoter prof would probably be easier for 101.

In the beginning of the quarter the course wasn't too bad, and I did well on the weekly friday quizzes. But later on, the class average for the quizzes started to drop. I would prefer non-multiple choice questions; the final exam is going to be hard.

early in the quarter he was very clear and everything made sense. as time progressed it seemed like he gave less useful information. its' best to just study the quiz review like a fiend than to actually attend this lecture.

I don't know whether the lecture is too early or just boring but I always fall asleep. Quizzes every Friday seem easy when I take them but the class average has steadily been declining. All notes are online and a really nice quiz review once a week.
Well organized material. Slow to get grades out. Gives helpful feedback.
Exams are crazy hard and professor is boring. Study guides are confusing and I've found she gives terrible help, basically study what she does't tell you on the review.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: One of those professors that thinks if the test average is 50% it's the students fault for not studying enough. The lectures themselves are easy to follow, but the questions on the exams are on a whole different level. Avoid if you can.
Hardest Class Ever! Short answer exams. One time, the midterm class average is 50.
Good professor. Exams were mainly short answer with a few T/F and an essay question. If you study the notes, read the cases, and pay attention in lecture, you shouldn't have any trouble.

Felt like the readiness homework assignments were busy work and that I didn't learn much from them but overall the class is an easy A. Do the homework assignments and pay attention in lecture and answer to top-hats and you'll do fine. Studied the night before the exams and still ended with an A with no prior psych experience. Super easy class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: She's quirky and her lectures are sometimes interesting but aren't useful for the tests. Top hat questions are like 20 percent of your grade so make sure to pay attention during the lecture. Also if you go on your phone a TA will yell at you which is annoying. Weekly textbook readings are also annoying, but the 2 exams are based off vocab from it

Dr. Cravens-Brown made the lectures interesting by discussing recent research in the field of psychology. Most of the information for the tests is learned through the textbook. If you do the reading, you'll be fine.

Lectures were boring most of the time and didn't really pertain to the reading or the exams. Despite that, Dr. CB is well-spoken and is very knowledgeable about psych. Textbook assignments are a pain. No-phone policy and laptop zone in lecture hall. Overall OK professor, could be more engaging and make lectures useful for exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Prof. Cravens-Brown is a passionate and engaging instructor. Her class is manageable with lots of extra credit opportunities. The content is interesting, and she genuinely cares about her students' success. unstuckstudy was a helpful study tool alongside the readings and lectures.

Weekly homework: chapter reading & reading assignment (usually 30-45 minutes). Lectures were interesting & engaging. Attendance tracked by top hat questions (2-4 per class). NO EXAMS. 4 application assignments (~15 questions). Participation in research program is required; took up time outside of class but was easy. Minimal work. Highly recommend.

She's great! The lectures aren't necessarily mandatory but there's solely in-class activities that make it more encouraged for students to attend class. There was no final exam for us which made it stress-free. She has a somewhat strict no phone policy and a laptop zone in the lecture hall but it wasn't a big deal since notes weren't required.

Please disregard my grade because I missed far too many classes; otherwise, I would've gotten closer to an A with minimum effort. The lectures can get pretty boring. She does have her TA's watch for people getting off-task (on phones, on laptops, talking, etc.) so if you cannot help yourself with that kind of thing, maybe choose another professor.
She sure has energy! Its a fun class but if you don't really like psych it can be a drag. She is super entertaining and keeps the students engaged.

I'm obsessed with Lisa CB, she is so funny and really wants to keep her students interested in the material. You can also tell she genuinely cares about all her students and wants them to do well. She's super kind and there's not a ton of outside work, I would definitely take her as a professor again!

Easy to get a good grade. Provide 12 extra credits. Use Tophat to take attendance and ask questions. Can miss a few lectures and recitations based on your grade. No final exam, but optional quiz point make up exam(score will add to quiz category as extra credit.)

READ THE ENTIRE SYLLABUS. I didn't and it put me behind a lot on REP credits. But CB does a good job keeping students informed of deadlines. Very funny and interesting person; lectures weren't bad. Extra credit! Lots of points are from in-class. This isn't a class you'll want to skip if you want an A. Weekly quizzes are just vocab, pretty easy.

Such an easy and interesting class! LCB is a very fun professor and is very approachable. There is plenty of extra credit throughout different sections, and she sets the course up so you can earn more points than you can get, basically giving you points to throw away.

Dr. Cravens-Brown is so cool. I had my intro to psych class in a lecture hall of 600 and was still able to learn the content and do well. She's easy to contact outside of class and is always straightforward with grading. Overall I'd highly recommend taking a class with her!
Vocab quizzes are given every Tuesday but super easy! I would love to take her again!

She is an easy laid back teacher. We have weekly 5 point quizzes that take maybe 15 minutes to study for every Tuesdays. She goes through a lot of case studies and examples when she lectures. She does top hat questions which are like general questions for points every class.

Dr. Cravens-Brown was awesome. This class was about psychology podcasts and was mainly a discussion-based class. She was very interesting and intelligent and it was a very engaging class that felt like a community. It's very easy to get an A as long as you show up every day and do the discussion posts.

She's friendly and approachable, and I enjoyed taking her class. No textbook, but a lot of reading in her class, mainly research articles for group projects. Be prepared to communicate/work with many different people in the class; almost every day is a group project with a randomly-assigned group. Graded on completion of assignments and attendance.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: Conflicted about her - very good, high quality prof who's passionate about clinical psych. but her teaching style is unorthodox - no lectures which means no notes/slides. Class title is deceptive - not actually about clinical psych. Exams are essay for better/worse but lots of extra credit opps. grading is strict. nothing is hard but unfamilar.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: She made class fun and interesting.
She made class funny and interesting. I never skipped this class. There aren't any major surprises on her tests, just study the material and you'll do well.

You need the book for the online exams. I can't imagine trying to do those without it. Participation matters a lot, it's like 30% of your grade, but she's hilarious so it was rare that I didn't want to go to class.

Definitely the best professor I've had at OSU! Couldn't bring myself to skip her class because it was so fun. Exams are all online, and a decent amount of your grade comes from attendance/participation. She makes topics that are sometimes seen as taboo really easy to discuss. Show up and make sure you get the textbook and you'll pass.

Dr. CB is awesome! Super engaged in lectures and gives really relatable/funny personal stories. Makes the topic of sex very comfortable and fun. Uses random tophat questions for participation points. Exams are all online and decently easy. Buy/rent the book. Definitely recommend taking her and this class, you won't regret it!
She is just wonderful. So engaged in class with interesting material to lecture on. She doesn't lecture on what is on the textbook so that part is up to you, but the textbook is an easy read.

Lisa was a professor that cared A LOT about what she taught, as well as having a good relationship with her students. This class style is different than others in the way that there were no exams, almost all of the points came from in-class participation and assignments. Its a good filler class, but there is work during class unlike others.

I learned so much from Lisa in my gender class. For one, she didn't teach a regular lecture(slide)class. The students were communicating with each other, and the conversations had a lasting impression on me. I find myself talking about the content of the course to everyone I encounter now. Thank you for this delightful experience, Lisa.
I thought I didn't like her for like a good month or 2, but turns out she is really cool. I just didn't  how it sounded as if she was getting smart with me when I spoke to her.
I loved this class. The professor is super hilarious and makes the class engaging. Easy A if you take notes.

I love Lisa!! I've taken two of her classes and she's been great for both of them. The tests can be a little tricky, especially for this class. (But I also didn't read as much as I should've.) Her lectures are fun and interesting, and she's very approachable and loves to help you out if you go to office hours.

Dr. CB is my favorite teacher I have ever had. The subject material is my academic focus, so I'm biased in saying that it is super interesting, but I think most people agree, it rocks. The tests are entirely based off of in-class lectures, so you have to show up, but you'll want to come anyways because the class rocks.

She is one of my favorite teachers, you can tell she loves what she does.   She also does a great job at making lectures interesting.  But make sure you attend class, she does a lot of participation points

Professor Cravens-Brown was amazing!! A lot of particpation so attendance is a must!! But you'll find yourself wanting to go to learn about the day's discussion and subject! She was always bright and cheery and really made the class quite delightful!

SO many in class assignments, hard tests, but she was a good teacher and stats was required for a psych degree so if you have to take this class then I would take it with her because I was actually able to understand the content

Dr. Cravens-Brown is an extremely intellectual woman, and I recommend taking her Human Sexuality class to anyone who may be interested. She's very clear about grades from the get-go and attending class is paramount since almost all of the exam questions are based on lectures (maybe 15% come from the book, so you need to have it as well).
Great instructor but as far as exams go, 90% of the material on the exams is from the lectures so good notes are key.
Lisa was AWESOME. Assignments and Exams were all online. Allows you to use notes. Lectures were fun and active. Nothing really bad to say. I would recommend her class!

LCB is a good teacher, but you will be very dependent upon the textbook for most learning. Reading is essential. HW every week and easy exams. I studied <1.5 hrs per exam and scored very close to perfect. 5% total extra credit also helps. TBH, I didn't pay attention too much in class and did well. Only took class for the minor. No major complaints.

Dr. C-B is a very enlightened professor. She does more than deliver information because she challenges the student to think for themselves. Some people may get offended because she is very research based, but take it as a grooming lesson. Especially if you wish to go to grad school or do research. She's down to earth and great at what she does.

Though everyone I've talked to says they loves her as a teacher, She can not teach this class. Nothing makes sense. Her slides are useless. I am surviving in the class by learning everything from the book, not her. Take this class with another professor!
She is a brilliant teacher. It wasn't hard at all to pay attention in her 8am class. Loved every minute of it.

She is a breath of fresh air! I talked about loving her class so much my friends started coming to her class just for fun. She is wonderful. If you come to class and do your work, it's an easy A. Online exams, attendance is extra credit and the online reading assignments are fascinating! TAKE THIS CLASS.

Great class, many easy extra credit opportunities, online exams. You can tell Lisa is knowledgeable and passionate about the subject, but she also adds in humor to her lectures. You'll need to go to class to do well, but I didn't purchase the book and ended up with a high A.

She is an extremely interesting teacher, and I enjoyed her vibrant personality and sense of humor. She knows how to teach and she does it well. The tests were all on CARMEN and timed, but it helped that I was able to glance over my notes if I needed them. Overall, she is a solid teacher, and I would recommend taking a class with her.
This professor was alright. The class in general was pretty easy (it was mostly just a vocab centered class).

I was really excited to take a class with her due to all of the good reviews.  boy was I wrong. She comes off as very rude, and has no problem failing you on the group project if she doesn't like the topic you chose. She also spends a lot of time telling boring, personal stories that don't relate to the material. The tests are easy though.
Best teacher ever!!!

This class was really easy. She let us redo 2 tests (so that you can get up to 100% on them). However, I was not one of the people to actually like the teacher herself. Every single time I asked a question, she'd reply with, "Oh, I can't tell you that." She did this 3 separate times. So I went to the TA and she would answer my questions.

I stumbled onto Prof Cravens-Brown out of a mutual interest in subject matter. Doing an independent study is pretty difficult but she made it soooo fun. She would have me in tears sometimes because she is so funny!!! She was able to communicate the difficult material in a very clear way. She is a wealth of knowledge and will keep you on your toes!

MOST AMAZING TEACHER AT OSU! Human Sexuality is the most interesting and fun class and Lisa is truly the best teacher I have ever had! She is informative, makes class fun and is really passionate! If you get the chance to take her class, DO IT!
Stats in Psychology may be a boring subject but she makes it very interesting and is very helpful its a somewhat difficult class but she breaks everything down very well.
She is the best lecturer! She is so helpful, clear and interesting. Take every class she teaches, you will not regret it.
Awesome professor. She's hilarious and her lectures are enjoyable
I absolutely loved this class. Very helpful teacher who loves what she teaches and it shows in how she conducts herself during classes. Could not recommend this woman enough!
She was the best professor I have had at OSU. She is energetic and makes material interesting. There is no busy work in this course and options for bonus points.

She is literally the best prof I have had at OSU. Her lectures are extremely entertaining and you learn a lot. She uses a lot of humor and stories about her family/life to keep class awesome. Take her for whatever class you can. This class should be required for the major!

Dr. Cravens-Brown is a great professor to have. She tells great stories about her children and family that relates to class. She also shares things about when she was doing therapy. She made boring and sad topics entertaining and easy to learn.  Great class to take.
Enjoyed the material and the attituted she had while teaching us. I would recommend this class to anyone even semi-interested in this subject.

She is an awesome teacher. Very knowledgeable over the topics she teaches and is very genuinely interested in helping people and see them succeed. The class is very interesting and she is very entertaining in her lectures and incorporates interesting media. I would 100% recommend her as a teacher.

Interesting class and the perfect professor to take it with!  She is very clear and enthusiatic about what she does and there will never be a boring day in class. Homework reading material is even interesting.  I have learned and will be taking a lot out of this class. Highly highly recommend!!

very entertaining! topics are interesting and she tells fun stories at the same time. tests are simple if you study. attendance isn't mandatory, but you'll want to go and get the notes... she also gave extra credit to those with high attendance.

Very eccentric teacher - fun to listen to. Had one issue with my project grade - she told us after we turned in the project that if we did what she asked us, we would get a B, and only by doing extra will you get an A. Otherwise nice teacher.

She's a lecturer, so her main focus is to teach, which is a very nice change from many professors in the psych department. Class was fun and interesting with plenty of extra credit. Definitely my favorite class this quarter.
Awesome, awesome class. Lisa was a very enthusiastic, interesting and helpful professor. This class is pretty easy just make sure you go to lecture, a lot of info on the exams come just from lecture!

She's very very good! I like the way she arrange the schedules and she's very helpful if you have questions. lectures are very important even though she will let you make up attendance by finishing extra homework, going to class very helps a lot! take her class.
Makes class very easy and entertaining.
attendance isn't mandatory but there is a sign in sheet every class - if you attend all of them you get bonus points. really fun teacher, tons of stories and always an interesting class to attend
very good attitude toward teaching! Makes stats easy to understand.
Awesome professor, relates subject matter to real events and stories from her life, couldn't imagine a better prof to teach a class on sex.  and you'll learn a lot!

Lisa is such a fun and exciting teacher! I love her! She will make you burst out laughing in an 8am class. Lecture is mandatory since she doesn't post any notes. Grade comprised of 5 carmen discussions, 3 midterms, and a non-cumulative final. Go to class, study a little, and you will have no problem. I highly recommend taking a class with her!!!!!!
She is awesome..very recommended
Lisa Cravens-Brown is extremely dedicated to her students. Her class is full of hands on learning and humor.

The class was great, Extremely interesting.  I enjoyed the subject and she kept me awake for an 8:30 am class.  The only issue i had with her was that she is opinionated and pushes her views on the class as FACT. She claims to be open minded, yet she only considers her own ideologies to be correct and dismisses all other possibilities
Loved her.  She was the most interesting professor I've ever had.  Great sense of humor, made me want to go to lecture.

I think Lisa Cravens-Brown is an awesome teacher who communicates the subject matter very clearly and thoroughly! She is very passionate about the subject matter which makes the class atmosphere very inviting and relaxed. It was an 7:30am class and she made it so interesting that it was almost impossible to fall asleep in class! Awesome teacher who
Very helpful and extremely enjoyable class environment! You can tell she loves her job and that's what makes a great teacher! Very clear and is quite funny! :) You'll enjoy this class!
excellent and very easy course. quizzes online with the book and periodic projects. no midterms, and no final if you do well on the quizzes!
Great teacher, not very difficult. This class was a lot of fun, but there were so few points that if you missed a few, you were in a bit of trouble. Would definitely recommend, though.

Great teacher, enjoys teaching students and helps keep classes interesting with stories about all of her experiences in therapy.  You do lose points for missing a class, but exams are based off the notes with maybe 3-5 questions from the text.  Overall she's great and I'd recommend any of her classes
Professor is really funny and helpful!  My all-time favorite class at OSU!

She is awesome. One of the best, most passionate professors I have ever had. Attendance was mandatory, but that was no problem, I love going to class. She has a great, fun, goofy personality and really know her psychology. She definitely goes out of her way to help her students and has helped me out a lot. Love her.
She is fantastic! She's a great teacher and she's really funny. The class is already interesting and she makes it even better. Take this class!
Very very good teacher. She knows what she is talking about!

Pretty decent class, you have to attend to get the attendance grade (20 points). Also, there are 4 exams, 30 points each plus 6 extra credit homework assignments worth 1 point each. Pretty easy class if you attend lecture; she doesnt post the notes or outlines online or send them to you via email, even for an excused absense.

Attendance is required.  If it weren't, the only people who would be there are the girls who love to giggle ecstatically as she brags about how great her two kids are.  I aced every test but got a C on attendance (reading the book is much more enjoyable), which is telling of her teaching abilities.
Awesome class! She's an awesome teacher and makes lecutres hilarious.  This is the only class I look forward to going to... def take her 333.02 class on human sexuality!

She was great! She is very very liberal though and she devotes much of the class to homosexuality and not much to heterosexuality.  Overall she was funny and the class is very easy! Only textbook question on a test was a bonus no need to buy.
She makes her Psych 333.02 class interesting and funny.  She also has a lot of stories.  The exams are not the easiest, but she offers extra credit.

She's fantastic! I took both 540 and 333.02 with her and loved both. She's very personable and engaging, as well as incredibly helpful. Exams are not the easiest but don't let that scare you away because you will enjoy learning from her. She is definitely my favorite professor at Ohio State.

Puts outlines on Carmen that follow the notes in class.  Just print the outline, come to class, fill it out and you have an easy A.  You could also get by with filling it out yourself via the textbook, but it was easier to go to class.  The exams came directly from the class notes.

Extremely interesting lectures.  However, her tests were somewhat hard, but she curved significantly at the end of the quarter.  One of my favorite professors at OSU.  Make sure you go to office hours...it helps out a lot!

She is very energetic and makes the class interesting.  I think her 530 class was easier than it normally would be because I took in summer quater.  There were 4 exams.  Each was multiple choice and 30 minutes long.  She also provided extra credit opportunities.
She grades her homeworks easy, do all of the extra credit. Her exams however were very lengthy and sometimes difficult.
Great, nice, and helpful teacher.

Laura is an AMAZING professor because she is so personable and  very organized. She relates her real-world experience to what she is teaching and makes the classroom experience relaxed and enjoyable. Probably the BEST professor that I have ever had an Ohio State and I'm not even a Psychology Major. She made it worth getting up at 8:30am.

Everyone should take this class! Its so fun, interesting and not too difficult. Homework is easy, test arent too hard (if you study)and there are lots of opportunities for bonus (do them). GO TO CLASS and you wont need to read, however, this is the greatest book you will ever have for a class.

I thought she was wonderful, and I sincerely wish I could take more classes with her. Her lectures are all power point, and everything is explained in complete detail. Absolutely NO NEED to buy the book, as she only will quiz you on her class notes. The quizzes are fair, and HW is graded easily. You do not want to have to do the 4th h.w. (its hard!

Hit or miss.  Material was interesting, a few too many personal ancedotes, and she likes to use semi-tricky questions on quizzes.  She is incredibly knowledgable, and I took a lot away from here.  I got a B from just going to every class and never touching the book.

She was a pretty awesome lecturer. Kept up with current research and told us alot of side stories that help in remembering the material. Very helpful professor, clear and interesting lectures. I would definitely take her class again and recomend her class to anyone else interested.
The lectures are very interesting and she has alot of fun stories to go with them! I thought the quizzes and homeworks are very fair and information is very interesting!

Had her for 333 and 530.  Both classes were relatively easy.  Lectures go right along with the book, and tests aren't too hard if you come to class.  She's funny and often lets class out early.  Overall, a really good professor.

Probably one of the least sympathetic people I have ever met. Lectures were boring, homework was pointless and she doesn't grade them herself. All together worse professor I've had here. My greatest sympathy's go out to those of you who have class with her
Very interesting class, and she is willing to help you succeed on the tests. Very approachable and lectures were easy to follow and went right along with the book.
Tests are a little hard but keeps class fun and interesting.

Great class, great teacher! Didn't mind the class starting at 8:30a because the information was so interesting. She told great stories about her kids and was very willing to answer questions. No need for the book, quizzes are pretty easy if you study and the final isn't much worse. Highly recommended!

I adored this class and this professor.  Quizzes are easy if you attend class and go over your notes. The text book is totally unnecessary. This professor is funny and makes lecture fun to attend; I managed to make it to class nearly every day for an 830 lecture.

Very helpful teacher. She is also very kind and funny. The class material is not very exciting but she does a great job to keep you interested (considering it is a psych requirement). Homework is not too difficult and she grades fairly. Tests arent super easy but they arent too hard. She likes applied questions rather than definitions.

took human sexuality with her.  class was interesting and humorous at times.  assignments were not very hard and graded fairly.  sometimes she took a long time to return our graded homework.  don't need to read the book -- nearly all of the material is presented in lecture.  just attend class and you'll be fine.
Really good teacher, makes class fun and interesting.
Great professor.  She's very helpful, informative, and fun but you will definitely have to study for her tests.
No Comments
You rock girl :)

She is an awesome teacher.  There is not a lot of work either.  There is reading but you do not have to do it because her notes are so good and her tests come from her notes.  She is available for help if need be.  She also makes the material very easy to understand.  I highly suggest taking any class with her.
She's fantastic!
LISA IS AWESOME!!!!!!!!!!! The best prof in the department

Dr. Dunlevy was super kind and good at her job! She is retiring after the spring semester, but her class was great. You have to take good notes and go to the lectures in order to get the notes. But the exams made complete sense if you did that and studied.

She's a great person and has nice energy when teaching. 5 exams with averages around 80%. Got a 70 on the first one and was caught off guard since I didn't write down all information she mentioned, exams are pretty detailed. Says questions aren't tricks but they lowkey are. Overall, just make sure you attend every lecture and type every word.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: What a cool lady. Genuinely, she is so funny and comes into lecture so prepared. Her exams are extremely fair so if you study well, there is no reason you shouldn't get an A.

I really liked this class with her. She makes the lectures interesting and is very clear on what will be tested. Everything in the class is pretty straightforward and she is very intelligible with all the topics. Exams are the majority of your grade, but they aren't too hard if you pay attention in lecture and write good notes.

Such a fun class and quite interesting. Her lectures are very easy to pay attention to, and she'll never test you over something she didn't talk about in class. Your grade is mostly exams, but they aren't too bad. I'm looking forward to taking more classes with her in the future!

I have gotten Cs and Bs on all of the exams so far and I had a B in this class until this one 5-point homework assignment that I forgot to do that she won't let me make up. Even if I get 100%s on the rest of the assignments and the final exam, I will get a C in the class. This is very frustrating when I have had a B the whole semester before this.
She is straightforward, entertaining, and available for help - all you have to do is ask. I wish I could take her for every class - hands down the best prof I've ever had.
Dr. Dunlevy is a horrible professor to say the least. She will make you feel ashamed of yourself and is friendly. I recommend a different professor at all costs.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I love Dr. Dunlevy. She's hilarious and I really enjoyed going to her lectures. She will absolutely tell it to you straight. This class was pretty difficult content wise, but the exams weren't too bad if you studied a decent amount. Only negative is your grade is almost completely (86%) based on exams, so you have to do well on them consistently.

I've had 3 different classes with her now, and this was by far my favorite class with her. She has lots of life experiences that helps explain the material. But, also beware that while attendance isn't mandatory, attending is the only way you will get all the material needed for exams. Only grades are exams and a few short assignments.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I really did not enjoy her teaching style. When asked questions outside of class she is condescending, rude, and doesnt explain very well. I read the text to do well in her class since the lectures were cursory at best. I think she knows what she is talking about, but is not able to convey it very well, at least with the online class edition.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She honestly has been one of my favorite professors so far! I always looked forward to going to her lectures. She is very interesting and funny, the class was almost always laughing. Attending lectures wasn't mandatory, but I made sure to go because she provided information needed for exams. She also gave bonus questions on exams. Love her!

She is hands down my favorite professor I have ever had. I purposely scheduled more classes with her just because I loved her that much. Definitely attend and pay attention or you won't pass, but she makes it so easy to pay attention. So hilarious and sassy, but she is very clear and definitely knows what she is talking about. 100% recommend
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Really funny, great lecturer. Will not hesitate to call you out and is always happy to share her opinion. Class itself was pretty easy but she doesn't always explain assignments too well. The exams can be a little tricky but if you get high Bs/low As on them and complete the other couple assignments (graded on completion), you'll get an A.

I really loved Dr. Dunlevy, she was super funny in lecture which made it a lot more interesting to come to and she was very good at making time for questions and making sure people understood the content. You only get graded on the exams and a few short quizzes so you definitely have to study hard.

I found myself laughing at her sassy humor that helped keep the class attentive, but beware of the fact that pre-reviewing lecture slides, taking good notes during lecture, and studying fairly heavily still doesn't result in getting a strong grade in this class. Good professor (although a little harsh), but the class was harder that it needed to be
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Best professor I've ever had here. Her style of teaching was a bit crazy at times but she was always willing to go back and explain things as many times as we needed. Her stories during lecture are always hilarious and borderline crazy and she made attending lecture fun. Tests are fair, hard class and requires a lot of work but doable if you study.

By far my favorite class/professor I have had at any of my 3 colleges. Attendance is not mandatory, but her lectures are hilarious and extremely helpful. The only grades are 5 exams and 4 short assignments, so be sure to study! The exams are taken directly from her powerpoints/lectures. She is very straightforward and just an amazing professor.

Not exactly sure what to say about Dunlevy. Most days shes hilarious and real. Other days she can be hard to respect. Definitely likes maintaining the authority in the classroom. Dont say something out of line or against her or else she will call you out on it immediately. Overall shes really great, just dont put yourself on her bad side.

Dunlevy is my favorite professor ever. Between her hilarious commentary and knowledge about disparities, there's something wrong with you if her class doesn't change at least one of your perspectives in life. It isn't just her opinion, she has the expertise and research to back it up.

Don't let her laid back style fool you. Typical "figure it out in your own" prof. Not helpful at all. Extremely critical when it comes to grading but yet her instructions explain the absolute bare minimum.  After you complete the assignment, according to her guidelines, she takes off points based on details that were never clarified.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: Dr. Dunlevy goes right up to the top of my favorite professor list. Her whole attitude of "do less" and "I don't care" is brash, hysterical and relatable to college students. Did I mention she's also a good teacher and not just funny? Well, she is. Just because she says "I don't care" and cusses doesn't mean she hates her job. She's great. 11/10

I heart Dunlevy!  She knows more, is cooler, and gives a damn about more things than any prof I have had at OSU. I have learned more from her and her style of teaching than anybody. Dunlevy walks the walk.

Dunlevy is the only prof in the school who makes you think. about everything. She has honestly made a difference in the way I think about politics, issues, and argument. She doesn't care what side of an issue you take, but you best be prepared to defend it on more than a knee-jerk response.

Dunlevy IS COOL, FUNNY, ENERGETIC... However, the material is very boring and abstract. We all understand that being poor directly correlates with being unhealthy. Why the hell do we care about every spit of detail about it. The only way to study is to MEMORIZE, there are very few patterns but a large amount of slide material to look at.
Seriously, If you do not absolutely LOVE her, there is something wrong with you! Most entertaining and fair professor ever!
best...teacher...on...the...planet.
Dunlevy rocks!

We all think Dunlevy is just bad-ass (and she is) but I had a low point and she friggin' hugged me.  Meant more to me than if some regular person had hugged me - just sayin'.  She makes an effort to know you and she genuinely cares about all of us. She is one in a million - you will be better for making her your role model. And she's funny as hell.

I just really like her - she is down to earth and she really knows not just the subject matter, but how to teach.  Dr. Dunlevy is lively and makes going to class enjoyable.  I will be sad when I can't take her for another course.

I like her as a teacher and a human being.  She is very genuine, funny, and she watches too much TV! I am learning so much and I look forward to her class each week.  She uses examples from real life and I love to hear her stories.
The real deal. I dreaded this course (evidence-based practice), but I learned a lot and had fun doing it. She uses relevant examples that I could relate to.
Dr. Dunlevy is no joke - she is scary smart and has a razor-sharp wit. I really learned a lot in her class - she had me arguing health care reform with my Republican family and winning the debate!
Hands down, the best teacher I've ever had.  She will go the extra mile to make sure you get it. You'll love her.
She's Jim Gaffigan in a skirt.  Loved her.
She's a rock star!  Far ahead of the curve re: any professor I've had.
Knows what she's talking about and how to teach it. I never missed class, even though it met for 3 hours on Monday nite - it's a floor show!  Who else uses "chopped and screwed" in the right context?
She is a riot!  I never thought I would enjoy going to a medical terminology class but I actually looked forward to it.  Knows the material cold, too.
This course was a lot of work for a one credit seminar. But, if you have to take it, it is not too bad.

She is an amazing professor who truly cares about her students. Yes, GE sucks but she honestly makes it worth coming to class. Her personality and charisma made it my favorite class to go to throughout the week to see her!! 10/10 would recommend
GE launch sucks. She makes it worse. This class is a joke, there is no need to actually grade my assignments. Calls out kids for not paying attention on zoom. ITS A ZOOM FOR GE LAUNCH, WHO CARES

Craig Franze is a good professor and passionate about what he is teaching. The lectures were easy to follow, and if you have any questions about the material, he will help you understand. You will succeed if you go to office hours when you need help, do the extra credit, attend lecture, and actually do the Ximera homework problems/written homework.

Craig Franze was a great professor. The exams and written homework are very challenging, but he wants to give you points, so show as much work as possible. Homeworks are ximera, which suck but are helpful. He is very passionate about teaching and is a really nice guy! Lectures are also clear, and he reviews the material before the exam.

This professor was constantly late to class and did not respect his students time. He would make a fuss about students leaving lecture on time to get to other classes on time. I did appreciate his review sessions that he would provide before the exam. He was never actually present at exams. I felt as though my TA was a better teacher.

Pretty easy class honestly. He uploaded slides with the info before every class and then would work out some examples by hand to understand the concepts. Tough quizzes but they prepared me for the exams. Between him and the recitation professor I was able to get an A.

Avoid him if you can. He is so lazy with his teaching methods, and no accountability or improvement. People pay thousands of dollars to get a professor who reads off pre-made lecture slides on math. He doesn't teach in real time or go through examples; he comes up himself. you will sit there being lectured like it's English class instead of math.

This professor is passionate about mathematics, but it's obvious that he doesn't know how to teach. He reads from pre-made slides during lectures that will make you fall asleep. The class itself is easy, but be prepared to teach yourself because you will most likely leave in the middle of class, fall asleep, or just stop attending completely.

This professor is the worst math professor you will ever have. They never show up on time, so they rush through the slides. All we ever did was go over slides that weren't even his slides and he rarely ever did examples. Almost every single class he was 10-15 minutes late, so be prepared to teach yourself or spend hours at tutoring.

Lectures consisted of the professor reading off slides, which allowed me to learn close to nothing. The full first half of the semester the professor showed up 10 minutes late, so we wouldn't be able to cover the full lecture information.This did though start to improve at the end of the semester, and I was able to learn the material in recitation.
Dude doesn't teach at all and just goes off notes and does random examples. Him and the recitation professor are never on the same page as it feels like you're lea

Rlly easy class, but not a great teacher. Was consistently 5-20 minutes late to lecture, and would only talk over pre-written notes. Wish he had worksheets to follow along with his lectures. You could look at his notes at home & get the same out of it. Sad bc he's a rlly kind, funny & willing guy who just doesn't teach efficiently :(

He's okay when it comes to explaining math but his attitude towards us was just lazy and disrespectful. 10 to 15 minutes late every single time to a class that costs my family 1000s of dollars. Never replies to emails. Just talks over prewritten notes instead of working out problems in class. The OSU math dept. should pay students back their money.
If you do the homework in this class you will get an A. It is optional, but to study for exams I did the homework and my lowest exam grade was a 95 of all 4 exams. Super easy class, great professor!

I love this guy. When learning any math, you need a good teacher and this is your guy. I would retake calc anytime, anywhere if I always had him. He's really funny and cracks jokes. Exams are HUGE for your grade so study before them or you'll probs fail. Hw is super easy and recitation is easier. If you're nervous abt calc, take this guy.

Craig Franze is an amazing teacher. He is by far the best professor I have had thus far, as he was tasked with making the dry calculus material interesting. He was engaging in all his lectures, and always did everything in his power to make sure everyone was prepared for exams. Nothing but high praise for Professor Franze.

I genuinely think this is one of the best math professors I will ever have at OSU, this professor knows how to lecture and is always willing to explain further if you need it, just ask. My TA was great too, and I definitely recommend going to lectures and recitations. The only bad thing about him is that he takes a long time to respond to emails.

I found the lectures to be easy to follow and pretty helpful. The class is only composed of homework, quizzes, and exams, so there's not a lot of room for error. I think my TA really helped with my understanding of the material, but the homeworks weren't hard and neither were the quizzes. The exams were moderate but I never got below a B.

Good professor overall as long as you actually show up to class and recitation with your TA. Lecture time doesn't have mandatory attendance, however highly recommend being there as much as possible. He is very relaxed and appreciates those who participate. Also, be sure to go to math tutoring or your TAs office hours if you need help!

Great professor who really enjoys teaching and explaining things thoroughly. Also a really funny guy. Exams are worth 85% so it is very test heavy but he does his best to prepare you for each exam with practice tests that are helpful.

Could tell that he was new to lecturing this year. But, got more comfortable as the year went on. Tries his best in the big lecture hall to help everyone and answer questions. He is hilarious and makes jokes during class. I've had experience with Calculus in high school, but the way he teaches it clarified a whole bunch of questions. Great person!

I didn't get to pick this professor and was just assigned to the class. He sucks. Exams were worth 85% of final grade and were ridiculously hard. Gives practice exams completely different from actual test. Also writes with white chalk in small print on the chalk board in the 300 seated lecture hall. Could barely see in the front/middle section.

Took two weeks to respond to my email and only after I had to reach out to someone else. Does not truly explain himself when going through problems on the board so make sure you go to recitation

I did most of my learning through youtube videos and recitation
Try to avoid if possible.

Dr Curley herself was very kind and has a good sense of humor. The class was pretty boring, lectures were not engaging and you do not learn a lot from the class. Recitation is very conversational. However, there are no tests or quizzes and it's a very light workload in general. So, if you want an easy GE this is a good bet.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: One of the best classes to fulfill a GE credit. Recitation with Patrick Dunn was brilliant. Melissa herself can be a bit boring at times or go on some tangents, but the class will give you what you put in. Papers were easy and fun to write. I would only not reccommend this class if you aren't interested about learning new things.

Easy class, didn't learn as much as I thought I would but still learned some. Main grades are participation and midterm/final paper. She is a funny lecturer! Some preperation material for classes provided, but you don't need to read it if you don't want to. You get what you put in. Nothing else really stand out - took this class for GenEd credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Class was interesting sometimes and assignments do not take too much effort. There are no exams or quizzes. Although, my expectations for this class were high and I did not learn nearly as much as I thought I would. It felt like a joke at times rather than a genuine reflection on different religions.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I had her for a one credit, graduate cohort class. Her primary goal for the class was teaching Masters/phD students how to take notes???? I'm sorry, but I'm pretty sure we all know how to take notes by now. We tried to bring this up, but she was really offended??? And she argued with us on matters of opinion for the rest of the semester. Don't take

I don't have a single good thing to say about her. She used outdated materials, most of which were irrelevant to the topic she chose for the seminar discussion. She criticized students to the point a number of us were concerned she was bullying on of the foreign exchange students. She could be a high school teacher. Wish I had room to expand.

Prof. Curley is a sweet person but she tends to put grades in late and is hard to reach outside of class. This class was a breath of fresh air however, lots of chill assignments and fun discussions in class.

Be prepared for VERY passive aggressive comments about your work. She responds to your opinions that disagree with hers and gives no parameters as to why she is disappointed in you. Group work is excessive- especially when online.

Dr. Curtis is very knowledgable in this field, but she does not have the skills needed to be an educator. She is a strict grader and does not set expectations for the class, and then will post passive aggressive announcements stating she is disappointed because the whole class failed to meet her expectations. Do not take her if you can avoid.

She is intelligent but a poor communicator. Only 3 assignments (2-pg paper & 2 exams) but be prepared to read (syllabus has 5 pg bibliography). She talks in circles and references her own publication (required). Have no idea what course objectives were. Learned nothing but that she seemed to have her own agenda & to avoid taking again.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Tough grader

reviews.comment: We only had three assignemnts in the class and 2 were exams that were very unclear in terms of expectations. We only went over 1/2 of the material in class that we were tested on. She is very intelligent but talks in lengthy circles and the structure of class and lectures is incredibly confusing.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Carla is a wonderful person, but I can't say that I learned anything in her Policy Analysis course, and I attended all the classes except for one. Also, it's hard for a group of 5 to 6 to write a 2 to 3 page limit paper collaboratively. Especially if you have different viewpoints with one another.

She is knowledgable and incredibly informative. Her lecture's are interesting as she really knows what she's talking about. She grades papers very tough, but gives other projects to cushion the grade. I've heard mixed things on willingness to help..

Very kind, knowledgable, flexible with attendance, and interested in students success and feedback. Her lectures are very confusing though. It sounds like she almost tries to be wordy, very abstract and doesn't speak directly to the point. Powerpoints are not very clean. The assignments and tests were simple.
It was ok.
Carla has a wealth of knowledge about child welfare and working with youth and families. She expects excellence and carries herself gracefully. I enjoyed the class!

I love Dr. Curtis. Textbook use is fairly high,although it is not really necessary - she can be a little scattered in her thoughts and reading the book helps to make everything fit together. Her assignments take a bit of time outside of class (and she does not use carmen) but i found it manageable with a full time and 2 other classes.

It was clear that Carla is an incredible intelligent and knowledgeable woman but it did NOT translate to good professor. Her lectures were disjointed and baffling. Class lectures, readings and assignmements had NOTHING to do with each other. UGH! You don't have to read...at all. I put in minimal effort and got an A though (shrug).

She's a nice lady, but she does not know how to organize information and teach it. Lecture is ridiculously boring, textbook is dry and never used, and she grades easy on one thing then hard on the next. If you actually want to learn, do not take her.

What I liked most about professor Curtis was how much she cared about feedback. She really wanted student input on the class.  In addition, it was great that she did not push any particular political view, since this aided in class discussions. I learned the most from the class discussions, and the papers. Thanks Carla!

Professor Curtis is a nice person who obviously knows a lot about policy. BUT her lectures are truly incomprehensible.  She talks in circles and uses abstract thoughts way too much.  The grading was fine and the final wasn't too bad, but the class itself was so frustrating!  Any learning was done by reading the text.

Dr. Curtis is a very interesting and intelligent woman.  Class is very unstructured, and assignments are time consuming.  She keeps the class interesting though and doesn't grade too hard.  I loved having her as a professor!!
Class was extremely interesting. I learned a great deal from Dr. Curtis. She is very knowledgable and encourages lots of conversation.
She doesn't grade very hard, but her class was just sort of useless.

Easy GPA booster class for 3 credit hours, I only spent like less than an hour completing the 2 weekly assignments. Other than the final project which did take some extra time it wasn't bad and easy since its a topic about yourself basically. I turned in my final project late a bit but I got full credit and I am just happy she takes all late work.

Jessica is a fantastic option to take for the online section of this class. Everything is outlined well ahead of time allowing you to work ahead if you wish to do so. There is a decent amount of projects to do, but she grades extremely easy on all of them. Only need the book to study for the midterm. Would definitely recommend this course.

Jessica was an awesome instructor! We had really interesting discussions in her class and the assignments were interesting. I have recommended this class to all of my  friends. Through the course I gained confidence in myself & truly feel like my college skills were improved. Love her!

This class was serious. Her lectures are fast-paced. Exams are hard. If you don't have adequate time to dedicate to this course, you will feel pain. She knows and understands the subject very well, so that's a plus. Everything was covered in a general way with few examples or applications. The HW and exam problems tend to be long, hard, and boring.

Not accessible outside of class and office hours AT ALL. Her exams are harshly graded, homeworks are fine but long and tedious. She's very old fashioned and doesn't provide practice exams or study guides or allow cheat sheets. She's a bit intimidating but is nice if you try and ask questions. She could have done more for her students though

Although this was one of the most difficult courses I have taken, I feel like I learned a lot about both Algebra as well as being a better mathematician. Dr. Cueto is a fantastic professor and cares about how her students perform. It is because of this the course was challenging, however if you put in the effort you will do well in the course.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: this is your sign if you are reading this to not take this professor. I have gotten an A in every single math class I have taken until I took 3345 with her and failed. She is the most harsh grader I have ever seen and is rude. If you show up to office hours/ask questions she acts mad. She will give you a 0 on an exam question if you miss 1 part.

This course was challenging, but the tests were not too hard. The lectures focus on the theory instead of practice questions. something I dont like: 50% of the final is series (23AU), but the series was only 2/13 of everything we learned. (2) We do not have enough time to review for tests; the Instructor didn't pay much attention on review sections
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Avoid at all costs. I already took the equivilant of 1181H and she still manages to make the easiest concepts incredibly difficult to understand. If you take her class get ready for math with no numbers and only letters. Tells us tests will be easier than practice tests but they're actually way harder. Very inaccessible outside class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Tough but doable. First suggestion- READ THE BOOK. Her lectures are extremely hard to follow at times (not always), but the book covers everything you need to know. If you study the book very thoroughly, you'll be good.  3 exams, 4 quizzes, weekly homework. She gives optional homework questions too- do those when you have the time, or to review.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I absolutely loved having Professor Cueto this semester. Her class was tough -- probably the toughest I have ever taken. However, if you put in the work, you get so much out of it. She really inspires the whole class to love calculus and understand the underlying concepts. Exams were hard and make up most of your grade, though. Would recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Inspirational--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Cueto Is a nice person out of class. Her teaching style though seems to lack when it comes to an introductory class. Sometimes lectures are helpful sometimes not. The textbook is a brick wall and the proof she does is not related to the homework/test itself, except for specific types of problems. Self-study and try to work more efficiently in math.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Prof. Cueto was unapproachable. She was clearly annoyed when you asked questions in class. Her exams are unnecessarily difficult. If she is teaching this class, just pass out of it with the qualifying test instead because you will have a terrible time in her class.

Professor Cueto is a really nice professor. Her lectures were decent and the midterms weren't hard at all but for the final it felt like she shot a death cannon at everyone. Averages were an 85% and then the final average was like a 60. Read the textbook along with her lectures and the class is not bad
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I found her to be intimidating and difficult to approach. I was afraid to ask questions because I felt that she was being judgmental. If I take another class I'll tale my chances with a different prof

Prof Cueto is very willing to meet with you. She is very understanding about extensions and stuff like that, just make sure to show her that you are putting effort in. Her lectures are very close to the book, but she does a good job illustrating theorems. There's a reasonable amount of homework due about once a week. Overall, great prof!

Overall she was a very forgiving grader on both the homework and the exams. She wanted the whole class to succeed and do well. The first exam was a lil rough, but all the ones after were not hard. She adapted to the classes abilities and the class as a whole was successful.

She is very lecture heavy and I do not find her lectures to be very helpful.  The homework is optional, but to do well you really have to do it.  She provides very few examples (and even the examples seemed pretty abstract to me).  She says the tests are easy, but I did not think so.

Cueto is willing to meet outside of class to answer questions. Teaching is heavily based in theory with few examples (in recitation challenging examples).
