I had to read and re-read the text to understand. TONS Of HW and tests are challenging and too long.  Noticed several errors in her online keys. I'd avoid.  My class ended up with a big curve.
You have to be the next einstein to get an A in her class

Prof Cueto is one of the most confusing professors I've had to date. She only teaches conceptual ideas and never does numerical problems. If you ask a question in class she talks down to you and never fully explains the topic. Her exams are very difficult and she assigns very long homework assignments. AVOID HER AT ALL COSTS.

Wow this class was awful. she's so robotic when teaching, you can tell she's taking phrases right from the book and she never does examples so you learn nothing in lecture. She also talks to students like they are dumb when they ask questions. Try and avoid having her as your teacher.

Try your best to avoid this professor you will not learn majority of the material because you will be overwhelmed with the way she tries to explain the materials and the amount of homework she assigns

If you have to take this class, i would recommend taking it with another professor. Her lectures are very long and confusing and she doesn't give a lot of examples. I didn't really understand the topics until i did the homework. The homework is also pretty long , and took (at least for me) a long time to complete.
Makes the class way harder than it needs to be. Do yourself a favor and take any other section of calculus 3.
she use course percentage to determine your final grade.. tough grader
She has long pointless lectures and shows mostly proofs which dont really help me. said the tests weren't hard but she was clearly lying cause I failed the first exam...

Easy class and easygoing professor. Lots of assigned reading but you can get away with not doing a lot of it, and didnt take long to complete assignments. Enjoyed the small group discussion and activities.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Way too much work assigned for the end of the semester, over 70+ pages of writing in just the last two weeks of class for projects only worth 10-15 points. Prof grades too harshly for someone that gives unclear instructions, time crunching due dates, and pathetic feedback. The amount of work you put into this class will not show in your final grade

Flexible about assignments/deadlines and good about responding to emails, but a ton of reading and assignments piled up towards end of semester- partly on me for not starting to work on those earlier tho. Also major assignments didn't seem like they were worth enough points for the effort required.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: By far the WORST professor Ive had during my academic career. She preaches self-care but I dont think she truly cares about it with the insane amount of assignments and projects she makes you do in a short amount of time. She takes forever to grade things. When she does grade she is so hard and tough. DONT TAKE THIS CLASS WITH HER!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: I have never had such a terrible a professor. Assigned four projects the last two weeks of class, all of which took over 6 hours each to complete. Did not teach helpful material during class and assigned an overload of readings every week.
I didn't learn much. It was lecture heavy. She gives a ton of projects with little to no explanation so my whole class was confused. I wouldn't want another class with her as my professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: She is an amazing professor but there were times where I felt like I really didn't need to come to class. She was flexible on when assignments were but she also assigned a ridiculous amount of work at the end of the year and didn't really care that a lot of us are taking 4 other classes.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Lots of homework--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: This class requires you to rent/buy multiple books. The books are easy reads, but it is heavy on the reading. I didn't read like half of the books and I manages to fake my way through. Emilie is very kind and you can tell she cares about her work. I looked forward to this class each week. I bet it would be even better in person.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: shes a good teacher. easy workload. just show up, participate and youll be good. shes really nice and cares about her students well being!
Emilie is a wonderful professor. She gives clear expectations and is wonderful at talking about difficult topics with large groups. There is a lot of really in this class but it's enjoyable.

Curtis cares more about what you learn rather than grades. His exams are pretty easy and he is not a tough grader. With that being said, his lectures are not helpful as he gets off topic in every one and he just reads off the slides in his online videos. There's really no way around reading the textbook. He does care about his students tho.

His lectures are exceptionally pointless, you will still have to watch online lectures, hours of tedtalks, and write discussion posts. Exams are pulled directly from quizlet's so study those. Once i found those I got 100% on every exam. Also have a 15 page paper that just requires effort.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class consists of the option between weekly discussion posts or a 15 page paper due at the end of the semester, weekly quizzes, and a few exams. Curtis lectures about random things instead of the actual graded material during lectures, while also pushing questionable political narratives within the course material.

A lot of people who don't like this class are people who like being spoon-fed their education. Haugtvedt is extremely intelligent and chooses to focus on more real life examples in lectures. I learned soft skills of critical thinking and drawing my own conclusions from the text/ news about marketing and CB. Don't take this class for granted!

Specifically for branch campus students, he is the absolute worst. He doesnt care about the other campuses at all. Your grade depends one one group project that hell give little feedback for. Its required though, so best of luck

He uses class time to discuss anecdotes from his personal life/family/students problems without relating it to course material. The final/only exam is over the book and slides which we don't use except for them being available on carmen. You have to read/study the material on your own in order to learn about public policy or social marketing.

Easiest class ever taken discussion posts but have whole semester to complete Everyone tries really hard on the first few and write novels Wait a few weeks in and people will be writing less Even replies count eightteenpage paper but b s ing works Presentation but you can do it online Exams must watch videos questions worded easy easiest a

Tests are so easy just read over the slides and know definitions from book (only 3 exams). Instead of class on Friday he has "Internet Friday" where he posts videos for you to watch. Requires 3 discussion posts a week (don't procrastinate). Only downside is the 18 page paper. Lectures are basically him telling stories about his life. No homework.

Class is almost entirely based off of Ted talks and his own anecdotes. Interesting guy who obviously cares a lot about consumer behavior but has little actual teaching ability mainly due to the fact that he is constantly cancelling class.

This class includes participation, 45 discussion posts, 3 exams, and an 18-20 page APA style paper. Don't procrastinate on discussion posts, exams almost exclusively cover bolded definitions from the book and class PPTs, and the paper is over a topic of your choice (easy grader). Professor Curtis is a very nice, caring, and knowledgeable teacher.

If you are interested in going through 5 minutes of slides during class & then discussing current events or his/other students personal & often unrelated experiences, take Curts class. It is a cakewalk, but you learn little to nothing about what you're supposed to be learning. 15-20 page paper at the end of the semester he definitely doesnt read

Not a bad instructor overall.  Nice guy, good lecturer.  Canceled our Friday class so it was just Monday Tuesday each week.  But in its place you have to write 3 discussion posts a week (kinda a lot - gets annoying)  There is a 15 - 20 page paper for the final, but you get to choose the topic so it is not completely terrible.

Good teacher, learned a lot. He stands up there and talks about advertising in general and doesn't really teach you about the notes. DON'T buy the book. The notes he posts on Carmen are all you really need to study for the two tests. 3 discussion posts per week and Friday videos instead of class plus a 10 page paper that was on an advertising topic

No friday class for all his classes. Instead, you'll have internet friday to post discussions. Boring  lecture, just watch videos. Really nice personality!  May get so so  scores on the exam, but your overall grade will look good.

Pro. Curt is my mentor at OSU! Had 3 of his classes and all got A. Paper required but page limit is not strict. 8 is fine for a 10-page paper. Pictures are allowed. Reading is preferred for exam. Very approachable. Had a mental break down last semester and he talked with me on the phone for 1 hour!  You can visit his office just to chat.
World authority on Consumer Behavior. Very personable and easy to approach.  Concerned for students' understanding of the topic and its impact in the real world.

Very rarely have I came across a class that was as relevant and meaningful, and goes beyond just book theories like his class. Really  great class to take if you want to learn instead of just memorize useless information to get by.

The most "engaging" professor I've had at OSU. He actually talks to you, not at you. He piques interest using relevant topics for discussions. The textbook he assigned is incredibly relevant. This isn't a fake post… I just loved the class. The tests were easy if you study the terminology from the book. Big paper at the end, but it was fun to write.

I was longing to take this course but he really failed my high expectation. He barely talks about any of the info thats from the textbook which would be on the exam, and spends a lot of time on watching videos in class.

Easy as pie class that's actually really interesting. For the exams, Don't bother with the slides (as he never goes over them), just study the definitions in the book and you'll ace the class. Essay paper is a bit long, but really that hard if you know how to write and have a lot of references (which is not hard with online stuff)
He doesn't follow the notes or the textbook. Just shows videos and leads pointless, unproductive discussions. Don't need the book. He makes you write a 10-20 page paper. Not a worthwhile class.
Curt is a good professor and a good person.  He talks to the class like an old friend and goes off on tangents that are ofttimes much more interesting than the notes.  Highly recommended.
extremely easy professor n class! I learned alot from him
Favorite teacher at Fisher! He actually talked about things that MATTER and doesn't ramble about nonsense in textboos all day.

He's super chill and very personable. He'll go out of his way to help you out and always treats his students as equals. Class is never boring and he's extremely lenient about grades. There's really nothing more to say. He's and nice guy and I wish more professors were like him. Take him. You won't regret it.
The best teacher I've had at Ohio State.  Loves what he teaches and more than willing to help and give advice.  100& Recommend.
Nice guy and easy A
Great professor! He loves what he's teaching!  Class is fairly easy but you MUST read the book as some of his test questions come directly from it.  Overall great class!  :)

Very easy professor.  Classes were mostly him just talking about his research or trips to China.  If you're interested in Consumer Behavior you probably won't learn a whole lot from this class.  Also he's huge on busy work ... papers, etc.
Really easy class. 3 Exams multiple choice, very obvious answers. Group or individual project. I did it by myself, got an A. Curves class even though it's unnecessary. Really nice and always helpful!
Huge group assignment - 25 page paper. Easy. Essay and short answer exam. Also easy. Interesting guy, very nice. Talks a lot. Class can be very boring sometimes but what can you do

easiest class ever. seriously, the xams are easy as hell b/c he gives you exactly what to review. If you're not sure of the answer, just guess. chances are you'll get it. I got 100% on everything. I think that was the class average. Pretty interesting lectures too. Just go to them, because he grades on participation too.
Take this prof. He is great. Good conversation in class and exams are simple if you go over the reveiw sheet. Easy A.
what an easy ass class. participate in interesting conversations and the exams nobody got less than a 99 on

Exactly what you want from an online gen ed class. Just look up YouTube videos of read alouds of the picture book for the book reports. Super easy and can get the work done for the week in about 30 minutes. The final is a 5-7 page essay though, but since the rest of the class is a breeze you really can't complain about it.

I had this course online so it was really easy. You're just reading picture books and children's books and discussing what you learned from that week in a page-long summary, book report, or other assignment. She's not super fast at emailing back, but she was a chill professor, and it was an easy A. The only large assignment was the final essay.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: I took Intro to Children's Literature, so you're discussing children's books and to make it better, Cynthia is very down to earth. She is funny and sassy which makes the class bearable. She expects you to be in class with the books read and work done, but overall its a fun class to take!

Cynthia is a very cool person. She clearly cares a lot about the subject and enjoys discussing it. The books assigned were great too and the readings were reasonable. I missed almost half of the discussion posts but still received an A- in the end, so she is very forgiving as a grader. I would recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Expected to read a number of pieces, but they are all interesting and manageable. The only assignments are weekly discussion posts, which are graded pretty fairly. Attendance isn't mandatory, but I enjoyed going to class. Burack is extremely knowledgable and really just wanted to have open discussion (not mandatory) with the class!

Dr. Burack provided very relevant material to read. This was the first time that I actually read every. single. book. for a literature class and loved them all. There are about 6 papers that are one page each (double spaced) and a weekly discussion post--not too much work. Truly enjoyed the material and loved both her teaching and the class.

Her grading is specific and feedback equally so. All the papers were exactly one page long (with the exception of the journal due at the end of the semester). The lectures go with the flow and are quite laidback.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Expected a lot more from a writing class than nitpicking grammar or points off without meaningful feedback as to why. Had high expectations, but ended up often disappointed as lectures went off-track and the class became more history/polisci than lesbian literature. I really wanted to like this class, but I just couldn't. Would not take again.

Read a WLW book list instead. It could have just been the online format but neither this class nor Prof. Burack were great. Online lecture slides were lackluster + time spent in class wasn't spent teaching us but rather making us ask questions, then giving non-answers or personal anecdotes. Grading was fairly tough and expectations were unclear.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: She grades based on 6 papers only and does not provide adequate feedback for these papers. She also never provides a rubric for these papers and expects you to just be good at writing. She only draws on her own experience as a lesbian and does not actually share knowledge with the class, she only discusses history from her point of view. Awful.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: One of my favorite professors! Extremely smart and an expert in her field. No exams but does use group/class discussions in class. Lectures are not pre-prepared and instead flow with the conversation. Pushes students to think differently. Reading due each week with one-page responses. Also graded on quizzes and in-class work. Only met once a week.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I felt like the exams were super easy, I can only remember missing one or two questions on each. Shes pretty straightforward about exam prep, but if you dont literally take notes during lecture, youre not going to do very well in the class. Felt like I deserved an A, but the grading criteria was not clear at all! Did not use Carmen at all!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Really great professor, incredibly knowledgeable and interested in her subject. I could listen to this woman talk about paint drying.

Six papers, but the max length for each one was 2 pages double spaced, and each had a different format (like one was a chart) so it was surprisingly easy for a writing II course, but she is a very tough grader! We read six books but they were all good, and overall the workload was very light. She is definitely cynical but has good things to say!

I really did not like Prof. Burack. Her lectures were incredibly boring, and although it was supposed to be a discussion-based class, she rarely let students get a word in. Her discussion questions were boring and not thought-provoking. Everything was graded very vaguely and she literally had no grades in Carmen, ever.
Awesome class. The reading assigned is really good. I am a male and never felt Professor Burack discriminating towards me. Professor Burack is the best professor Ive had at Ohio State!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Amazing lectures--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Prof Burack is refreshingly down to earth and gives great anecdotes. She can be cynical but I would definitely like to hear to lecture about anything just for her specific view point on certain topics.

Cynthia was a professor I actually enjoyed listening to. Class was always interesting and I learned something new everyday. My TA was an easy grader and the Midterms and Finals were no-brainers at all. I aced bothed. Definitely the easiest and most interesting class to take!

She's very knowledgeable and helpful. However, I've never received less than an A on papers prior to her class, but in this class I never received anything higher than a B. She is a stickler for writing rules that are completely asinine. But the class is really fun, especially when the class gets involved.
great professor!

I am a female and I took this class with my friend who is a male. We both wrote the papers together and did excessive amounts of reading. I got B+'s on my papers and he got C+'s consistently. He is a much better writer than me and its unfair how biased she is. Don't take the class unless your a girl who is good at sucking up.

Dr. Burack is one of the best professors I've had the privilege of learning from. She is an extremely articulate speaker and more than willing to go the extra mile to ensure that you understand the material. The class was one of my more difficult ones for the term, but if you put in the work required it really pays off. Would recommend to everyone!

I had professor Burack for WOM STDS 367 and WOM STDs 110, 110 was very interesting and well organized. 367 covered material very quickly. Professor Burack often runs off on tangents and looses track of where she was in lectures. TAKE NOTES! slides are not available online and ALL information on her slides are helpful for the tests.

Great professor. Clearly excited about the material. Fair to all students, both in opinion and grading.   As a writing course, she didn't cover the art of composition in much detail, but she more than makes up for it in explaining and backing the reading material.  I would definitely take her again - despite what a previous post says - I'm a gu

Prof. Burack is very clear -everything was repeated to the point where taking notes became a formality; tests are easy.  However, she was my least favorite teacher at OSU.  She was incredibly rude to all of the boys in our class and not at all friendly with the rest of us.  I would not repeat this class with her, despite my interest in the subject.

Horrible professor.  Always wanders off topic, is horribly biased against men, and refuses to back the points she makes in class outside of it.  She is incredibly condescending, but easy.  If you want a guaranteed A, it's a great class, and if you want a radically one-sided view of women's studies, take it, but otherwise STAY AWAY.
Hands down the best professor I have ever had. Extremely intelligent and highly engaging. Cannot wait to take another of her classes.  Great lectures and fair grader.
Very good professor. Study guides before tests were very helpful. I learned a lot in this class.
No Comments

Comes off a little bit intimidating in the beginning, but as the quarter went on I found myself liking her more and more. Lectures were organized and interesting, and study guides before the finals made the class so much better. Highly recomended!
She's great. No ifs, ands, or buts.

She is, hands down, the best professor I had in the women's studies department.  I learned so much in her class not only because if I hadn't, I could've failed, but because she inspired me to.  I ended up with one of the most satisfying "A's" in

burack is the reason i decided to minor in women's studies.  she is straightforward and informative, but never dull.  she does have a great voice, and provides a great performance overall, and is in everyway the kind of professor i aspire to be.

Dr Burack is one of those professors who is really smart and expects her students to keep up with her.  If you do the reading and work hard, it will be one of the most rewarding classes you will ever take.  If you don't, drop the class now.

Her classes are tough and definitely *not* an easy A, but you get a lot out of it if you keep up.  Also, she's very willing to stay after class for a bit to talk theory or clear up a topic, but she's pretty inflexible in requirements for her class.

I received an A- on the midterm, but I still dont' really like her. She gives off a vibe like she's totally unapproachable, and she's not very clear about what she's going to test you on. She also got rude w/ me when I told her I had to leave early once.

Class was a small seminar, so students talked mostly.  Always very interesting, engaging, and friendly. Also, she has a beautiful, soothing voice that you just want to close your eyes and listen to.  She should get a radio job. :)
No Comments
She is one of the best teachers I have ever had. You just need to be a little bit smart in order to keep up with her. She knows her stuff and I was priviledged to have her as a professor!!!!! A++++++

She was one, if not the worst teacher that I have ever had.  I dropped the class solely because she was so utterly unhelpful.  She tells you flat out that she is not there to help you!!! Stay far far away from this prof.

She is an extremely nice woman who cares deeply for her students. The class is tough because of the material and I think she is better than most of the other cost teachers. Her class is disorganized and hard to follow sometimes because she jumps around. I did really bad on the midterm but studied hard and was able to get an A

I have mixed feelings about this professor. The class is a lot of group work which isn't bad if you have a good group. She talks the entire semester about giving all these bonus points at the end, but then doesn't follow through. Her final was so much harder than her midterm and her so called "curve" ended up being 1%.
Prof Turner cares a lot about making sure the class understands the material. If the class seems behind pace she will adjust due dates accordingly.

Very disorganized class, she gets off topic very easily. Doesn't use PowerPoint just teaches with problems so it is hard to understand the concepts. Nice lady, just not a great professor. Exams are 60% of your grade and there is a lot of group work. Really slow grader so half of the time you don't know what your grade is.

Awful professor. If you have a chnace to take it with literally anyone else, do it. Her lectures are confusing to understand, and the practice questions are nothing like her exam questions. She is not organized, very unclear in instructions, and gets off topic all of the time.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Turner is a really fun professor and she cares a lot about her students. She is pretty dry but her class is straightforward and it's easy to know what the exams will be on.

Terrible class. Do not take with Turner. Her exams are impossible and she does not teach. Only a midterm and a final. Lecture notes and homework nothing like the final. Her notes are all over the place and she is such a slow grader. Gets off topic all the time.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. T is a dry lecturer but the material in this course is pretty straightforward. She requires the textbook but you could probably do well in the class without it, I didn't really read it. She wants to help you so if you have questions, she is receptive to them. 70% of the course is two exams and there are group quizzes and one group project.

Shes a super nice lady and is very understanding if you need to miss class or need extra time on a deadline, however this was the most unorganized class Ive taken at Ohio State. Extremely slow with grading, she doesnt use powerpoints so you dont have much notes to go off of, she doesnt use the book,& gets extremely sidetracked during lectures
Definitely hands down the slowest grader I've ever experienced. Pretty interesting in lecture and tests have a lot of minuscule details but are relatively fair.

Really like Dr. Turner as a professor and enjoyed her lectures. Not a hard class but it was a bit unorganized. Homework, review materials were often not posted until 24 hours before due date/exam. Grading criteria not very clear. Slides don't always follow lecture content. Take notes on what she says since that stuff will be on the exam.

Probably the best pick for cost. Turner makes a dry class more interesting by incorporating her knowledge and experience into the course. Enjoyed her lectures. A lot of small easy assignments and two fairly difficult exams. Slow posting assignments and grades. Need to practice a lot and know the material as the test questions are specific.

Professor Cynthia is very nice and helpful person, very knowledgeable in the subject and brings in a lot of real world experience and inject it into the lecture, helps you to succeed, and very approachable. enjoyed her class and recommend her 100%
Cynthia is very nice but her lectures are super boring. All of the homework and such is graded very lightly
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--GROUP PROJECTS--Would take again

reviews.comment: She has a tendency to go on tangents. Overall, she's a nice person and it's worth your time to visit her in office hours. The tests ranged from an 86% average to a 68% average, so don't let an easy test fool you.

Cynthia Coles was one of the worst professor I have had, if not the worst. The exam averages were a C and the final paper that students worked hard on all semester had a B- average. She often took forever to grade so you were left wondering what your grade was until the very end of the semester. This class was overly stressful for no reason.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She is the worst professor I have had at Ohio State. She is extremely disorganized and should not be teaching if she can't balance responsibilities. The class is graded on a paper, two exams, a group presentation, and participation. The exam averages were in the 70s and she didn't seem to care at all. It's a shame you can't avoid taking her class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Colen is very disorganized when it comes to this class format. Took a decade to grade our midterms and the course is unnecessarily stressful overall.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This is the worst class I have taken at OSU, as a senior. Professor Colen is very unorganized. Took over a month to grade midterms. She laughs it off in class whenever people about it but it's really just annoying and unfunny. She changes guidelines last minute for assignments. She says it's her first time teaching this class so that's her excuse.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Amazing lecturer, made class interesting. Heavily reliant on readings but as long as you do most them, attend lectures, occaisonally participate, you should get an A. Everything on tests is covered in lecture. Would def take her again. Only thing is I think she bses the participation grade considering I doubt she knew the names of 95% of students.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I took SOCIO 3549 and even with the textbook, it like did not help, if anything it made it more confusing. She did not test us over things that we actually learned. The tests were extremely hard. Other students and I would spam her email with questions before and after the exam and we would hear nothing. Like absolutely BEWARE!

Great professor! She knows her stuff and is passionate about her students. There are multiple articles to read before every class and some book chapters, but you really do better in the course if you read yourself beforehand. The information is really in-depth but the exams covers MAIN POINTS of things. She's a fair grader too. 2 papers & 2 exams
Not good
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: She forces you to go to the stupid testing center instead of taking exams in classes.

Class is fairly boring, however the professor really is interested in the topic and wants all of her students to do well. The class has multiple ways to get extra credit and the map quizzes are easy to do well in. The book isn't necessary, but I found it helpful. If you do the study guides and read it over a few times this class won't be a problem.

Cynthia is an amazing lecturer. The course is very interesting and she adds some anecdotes that can help connect to the material. The grade is based on 4 exams and some map quizzes. I never bought the textbook, which you can get by on doing only if you attend every class and take notes on the lecture.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Clopper is absolutely fantastic. She is organized, communicates and lectures clearly, and is truly invested in her students' success. She is always accessible and is just a wonderful person and professor. 11/10.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Clopper's class was amazing. The directions for assignments were always super clear, so if you show up to class and learn how to do what the assignments cover, getting a good grade is a breeze. She's great at explaining material several ways, and seems to genuinely care about her students.

Dr. Clopper was a really nice lady with a good sense of humor. She's a good teacher that knows what she is talking about as is willing to help. However, I found her class painfully boring and tedious. A lot of work with Excel and R coding. No tests or quizzes, just homework and group projects. Not my favorite class but she made it bearable.
She's great--really helpful and knowledgeable, and things just sort of make sense the way she explains them.  Class wasn't too hard, but likely would have been much harder with someone else.

Dr. Clopper, like many other professors in the linguistics department at OSU, is truly an expert in her field. Her strong research background shows in the way she teaches 2051H. Ling 2051, though tough, was very informative, and it can help the student who wishes to pursue research. I personally enjoyed her sense of humor, and she was very helpful.
Occasionally tough with grading, but kind and helpful. Very clear and willing to explain things more than once if something is unclear.

Tough as nails grading, but at least you know you'll be trained well. Make sure you're an expert at APA because she'll take points off for the smallest error. Grade is based on 12 quizzes and 8 labs, I think.
Such a boring class. But it's also super easy. The most effort I usually put into my work was using my calculator and using copy and paste.
Made the class fun and interesting. Looking at language at math concurrently in a new way. Very clear, helpful professor. Strongly recommend.

Dr. Cyzewski is a very caring woman and can/will work with you if you need accommodations on any of her MANY papers or assignments. There are readings every night and its expected that they be analyzed and ready for class the very next day, which can feel like busy work. She tries to make class interesting but her teaching style is a bit awkward.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Caring

reviews.comment: Julie grades papers fairly tough, but she is a good professor overall. Her quizzes and informal writing are easy and she leads class discussions very well. I enjoyed the class albeit the reading was a lot at times.

You'll ed up reading about an hour every day. I thought this intro to fiction class was contemporary fiction like harry potter LOL but it's dry readings like one reading was cask of amontillado, lonely londoners, ajantala, the tiger's bride, just dry readings. WAYYYY much work than I wanted to do for a gen ed.

I thought Jen did an amazing job teaching such a high level of calculus. I attribute my grade only to her since our lecturer for the course was pretty bad. shes a little laid back,and different, but is a very fair and just teacher. I would highly recommend her!

Jen was my TA for this class, and I thought she was a pretty good teacher overall.  This class is a fairly tough class for non-math majors so you have to study.  Her only drawback are her quizzes; all following questions are based on setting up the 1st problem correctly, but she still gives points for incorrect work as long as it is fairly logical.

Jen is a trip! She's one of the most laid back TA's I've had in a long time. As long as you keep up on the homework, the quizzes are easy. She's more than willing to help or explain something if you don't understand it. The best were her nerdy examples and making fun of herself to lighten the mood of the class.

She comes of as pushy and not nice, but as the quarter goes on you can tell she really wants to help. Does whatever is needed to make sure you understand. Course was somewhat difficult and Jen made it a lot easier! Great TA

not a very good teacher. She always seemed to have a teacher vs. student mentality. quizzes are hard. she says her classes have the highest grades on the final but this is probably because half the class drops out by then.
Doesn't seem interested in helping students understand
The melodious sound of Jen's voice sounds like waves on a deserted beach in summertime.  Also, I received a 74 on the first mid-term.

The highest grade on our first midterm was a 73. The class average was 59. 2/3 of the class dropped after Jen went on a tirade assuring us there would be no curve. Jen wrote the exams herself. She didn't seem to care that the class was obviously struggling.

I actually learn more in recitation than I do in class. As long as you complete (and understand) the homework assignments, the quizzes are easy. If you have questions on anything, she's more than willing to answer, and explain until you understand what the f you're doing :)
loved her.  she is so smart and such a good teacher.  she will make sure you are more than prepared for exams!! VERY HELPFUL

Decent TA, sometimes tends to explain things in an elementary fashion that just ends up being confusing.  Quizzes were way too hard and kill your recitation grade, but do the homework and practice midterms and you'll get an A.

First time you meet her you will be thrown off guard but she is the best math TA and her class averages are always higher than all the others. i thought she was so good that i had her for 131 and then made sure i had her for 132 also. Always willing to help you and good at explaining things too. Only bad thing is that she has hard quizzes.

10/10 professor. Very understanding and genuinely cares about what he is teaching. The class is graded on only three exams, which are very manageable and he provides a lot of review material. Homework is optional and he also offers plenty of extra credit. Attendance is not mandatory. I would definitely recommend taking his class!
He's awesome

My biggest gripe with this course is how poorly organized it is. The carmen page is hard to navigate, specifically the modules where each week the layout is different from the last. Not to mention the connect section where he tells us we will have X and Y connect assignments in class, but all of the materials are different on connect.

I LOVED Thompson - one of my favorite professors I've had at OSU. The lectures aren't mandatory but he makes them fun & engaging with clips of movies and being a great lecturer. It's graded by three exams, but they're easy and he offers a lot of extra credit. He is caring and genuinely wants his student to learn. Take him for org.

I agree with the post before me, he deserves more credit. Wants students to learn as much as possible, while trying to make this boring subject entertaining. Graded on 3 exams, where if you read the notes, they aren't too bad. Also offers lots of extra credit.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I honestly think he deserves a higher rating. I highly recommend taking 3200 with Thompson. The material in this class is laid out clearly to help you study for exams. Attendance isn't mandatory during lectures and he doesn't give homework. Thompson does his best to make it as simply for students to follow and truly wants his students to succeed.

One group project about a Harvard case, one 10-pager (minimum) essay, participation and attendance (pop quizzes), 40% of the lecture grade is factored into your final grade. This is the same for all sections (except pop quizzes), however, thompson is a tough grader for the presentations. Take heidi instead, I would not recommend taking his class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: His lectures are decent, but attendance is not mandatory, so there is pretty much no reason to go to class. The class is made up of 3 exams with no other points, but he offers a couple extra credit opportunities and he outlines how many questions from each chapter and section of the book will be on the exam which is clutch. Take him for sure!

Exams take up 100% of your total grade. No homework, No practice. Class is so boring. Hes a good teacher and cares but this class could not be less appealing. If you dont know definitions or psychology youre bound to not do well
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Thompson could give a lecture on the phone book, and he'd still find a way to make it interesting. Expect an enthusiastic professor with a lot of stories and some great job advice. Very easy guy to talk to. Clearly outlines which topics he'll include on exams. Just study a little bit and you'll do well.
One of my favorite classes taken this year! Really engaging and simple as long as you came to class. Not a lot of outside work if you did work during class.

Grade is based entirely on 3 non-cumulative exams, which are supposed to be based on the lectures but if you really want an A, at least skim the text & know all vocab. Best to create a study guide based on lecture slides, which he just read off of during lecture. He sometimes cancelled class last minute which was frustrating. Do the extra credit!
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Take 3200 with someone else! He just read the slides and had no idea what was on the exams (which are the only thing you're graded on). I bought the hardcover book because I study better with the physical thing, then for exam 2 he said that you needed to buy the online text because exam 2 and 3 were administered through McGraw Hill. DISORGANIZED!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Thompson did a good job with this class. Class consisted of one presentation, a final paper, and attendance. Every class had one team presenting and an optional discussion at the end regarding the presentation. I liked the setup of this class and enjoyed the conversations during it. Very relaxed atmosphere and easy to get a good grade.

Very unorganized Professor. Class is graded off of 3 exams only. Accidentally included random information on the second exam so he had to curve it because the average was in the low 60s. Pretty easy class if you study the terms in the textbook, just a really unorganized guy.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Take 3200 with someone else if you can, worst professor by far! Was never prepared for class and grade was only from the exams. Exams had no corelation to the material that was taught, he would just read off the slides and did not give any other information. Class average for second exam was a 60 something I believe.

I had him for recitation and did not care for him. He NEVER responds to emails and takes a very long time to grade papers and presentations. He did not teach at all and he was never really prepared for class. This entire 4490 class is a waste of time and effort, didn't get anything useful out of it besides sitting through 20 min presentations.

Professor Thompson is a wonderful choice for the business senior capstone class. He knows what he is talking about and gives every student a fair chance to grab an A for the class. Everyone should take his class!
He's a great math teacher willing to work with his students ans hes funny

He's a super nice and chill guy. Lectures are a little boring but are easy to follow and understand. He answers questions very thoughtfully and is accessible outside of class especially around exams. The exams are very similar to what we learn in class and he creates practice exams that are also very helpful.

David was always really laid back and handled all the lectures in a really calm way that was conducive to learning the material. The tests were always very similar to the samples, and the take-home tests were always similar to the homework.
He makes trig very easy and there is so many office hours to receive help! David was such a nice person and definitely take this professor if you can!
the nicest professor at OSU

Pretty much a class where you need to teach yourself stuff. Two midterms and a final make up a big chunk of your grade. Exams are long and nothing like homework of quizzes. David doesn't make the exams and tried to help but the math department at OSU doesn't set you up for success.
Only understood this class and got a B- because he had a good TA; review sheets don't fully match to what's on the exam

I really enjoyed Professor Kish. I am not the greatest in math, but his lectures are easy to understand and he truly knows how to break down a problem. Plus he records all of his lectures, in case you miss a day. His office hours were extremely helpful so I'd advise to take advantage of them when you can. He's a sweet guy overall!

Prof. Kish is an exceptional and caring professor. I had him for 1148 and he is great at explaining concepts and answering questions. He posts most of the lectures online, but I would go to class in case of questions. He prepares you well for the exams, which are mostly multiple choice, so they are easier than you would think as long as you study.
He taught the material in a great way! I was able to understand everything and apply it to quizzes and tests. He is also cares about what he is teaching and about his students!

I am in my first year at OSU and I am positive that Dr. Kish will end up being my favorite professor that I will have. He is a very kind man and gives very helpful lectures. He responds quickly and cares about all of his students. He extends deadlines and makes accommodations. I highly recommend Dr. Kish.
Nice guy but its a math class so expect to be bored.
He is very good with explaining hard concepts and is a very nice person overall. He puts things into dumb dumb terms which was great for me lol

LOVED Professor Kish! He's such a nice guy and always goes over the material in a good way! I'm not the brightest at math but I found with his lecture style, I did well! Highly recommend him for any math!

David was awesome, as someone who is bad at math he truly cared about my success, making time one on one to help. He's the reason I passed, when taking the same course at other colleges I did poorly. Attendance wasn't mandatory, but if you're on the edge of passing or failing attendance is taken into consideration with grading.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Prof. Kish is an excellent choice and you can really tell that he loves his students. He is always very willing to explain or reexplain and clears any fog of confusion for the lessons. He brings a very positive attitude to class every day. He makes the difference between trying to learn the concepts on your own and going to class night and day.

KISH IS SO AMAZING 100/10 IF I CAN RATE HIM. Having Kish in your schedule = Great Semester/Year

trust.

Professor Kish was amazing! He was the kindest professor I've ever had. He has so many office hours and will add extra ones during exam weeks. He is always willing to answer questions during lectures and genuinely cares about student's well-being. He provides guided notes which is also super helpful.

Had him for 1075 and 1148. Amazing guy, can't say enough good things about him. Always had office hours and was always accommodating and caring. One of the best profs I've had, by far. Clearly conveys the material and answers questions. Always available to help and posts the lectures. Just amazing overall.

I absolutely love David Kish. I had him for math 1075 and now for 1148. He goes above and beyond to help students understand the material, even offering different methods to make sure everyone understands. He is super understanding when sick and missing assignments, quizzes, and exams. Genuinely the best math teacher I have ever had.
Really nice professor, very flexible and his way of explaining concepts is comprehensible.
I really dislike math but Professor Kish was extremely kind and wholesome. Great teacher to be around even if the course material didn't interest me.

David was great, I'm not good at math and started the course nearly failing. David helped and supported through every step, I also used tutoring in the Math basement. Take advantage of office hours and tutoring. If David sees you trying and investing, he will invest in you.

Professor Kish is the literal definition of a dream professor! He is so caring and genuinely wants all of his students to succeed. His teaching style is very easy to follow and he tries his best to be as engaging as possible during lectures. Don't be afraid to ask questions because he will be more than happy to answer them.

Professor Kish is an amazing lecturer. He is so chill and genuinely cares about students! He is really patient with questions as well (doesn't make you feel stupid). Although math itself could get a bit dry but his humor kept it fun and the lectures are entertaining! Easy to talk to as well.
Such a genuine guy, really cares about his students and explains everything very well. I would take this class over again just to have him be my professor again.

We used AI way too much in this class, I get that its becoming more sophisticated but we used it so much that there was no intellectual stimulus required to complete a majority of the assignments. I also think there was way to many assignments given in this course for it to be considered one credit hour.

Taking MMC is a bigger waste of time than watching paint dry. Any other class, club, or other extracurricular would have a better impact on your life. This is because David Mcintyre ruins any potential this class has. He rarely adds anything of value to the class, leaving previous MMC students to do all the work for him. Should not be 1 credit hour
Waste of time
Don't take this class unless you hate yourself. This should be 4 hour credit course with the amount of papers we wrote. You would much better off joining a club then MMC

David is obsessed with AI and he makes it the entire class. For a one credit class there is way too many assignments with most of them being useless or busy work. For a class revolved around Media Marketing and Communications, there is very little Marketing and Communication, just using AI to make presentations.

DMAC failed to show dedication based on his passive aggressive approach to criticism and lack of creative encouragement. I expected material to cover Media, Marketing, and Communication but was met with AI, Media, and more AI. I hope to see emphasis on student creativity instead of encouraging ChatGPT and more variation in course material.
Easy class, David was extremely nice and wants to get to know his students. He made the class more fun by how he taught and his personality.

His class will be one of, if not the most difficult on your schedule. You will not do well in his class unless you participate, and I mean participate. Ask questions, attend office hours, etc. You can't just memorize the lecture slides and expect to do well in the course. Dempsey is very helpful and a skilled lecturer, but you have to be proactive.

Much like the other reviews say, Dempsey is a nice guy and is passionate about what he teaches. However, he does not translate the conceptual style of his lectures into solving economic problems (i.e. those on his exams) very well. You are only vaguely taught how to apply the material to the things that matter. He's OK but I don't recommend him.

This is a tough class. Dempsey does not write a lot of problems or give much practice material. He is not very accessible outside of class. During lecture, he spends too much time on simple concepts and speeds through the difficult material. You can learn enough to do well if you read the textbook and teach yourself.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I had Kyle Dempsey for ECON 4002.02 (Intermediate Macroeconomic Theory). The course consisted of one quiz, weekly problem sets, two midterm exams, and a final exam. The course was conducted online, and the midterm exams and final exam were proctored via Zoom. Prof. Dempsey was relatively unavailable outside of office hours. Doesn't allow appts.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I was highly impressed by Professor Dempsey especially since this was his first semester. He handled online classes extremely well and was always accessible. As for difficulty and grading, the top 15% of students received and A in my class. If you want to go to grad school for Econ, take Dempsey. He offers a true intro to real high level econ!

Solid guy. You can tell he's passionate about the course material and really cares about and wants his students to understand the material as well. Brings really good energy to his lectures and great about answering any questions students have.

Dr. Danhart seems like a nice guy, but I genuinely don't know how anyone does well on these exams. They require an extremely deep understanding of 30+ learning objectives for each exam, a good understanding of the content is absolutely NOT enough to get higher than a 60%. Maybe consider your other options if you don't have 10+ hours a week to study

The flipped learning was helpful because the lectures usually took the information from the previous night's readings and took it a step further, looking into more difficult problems that may appear on exams. Overall the exams followed the class material pretty well. He's a great teacher and is good at explaining things.

No exams- 6 quizzes. Quizzes are very straightforward and he tells you usually what he will and will not ask about. Labs are pretty easy and fun. He is funny and nice and really wants what is best for every student.

I really did not like the flipped learning environment, it made the class so much harder than it needed to be. Having to read the long material before class and then do problems in class was so dumb and unhelpful. Lectures were boring, exams were moderate, lec. not recorded. He is a sweetie though and will help out during office hours if needed
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Professor Danhart was truly so great to have. He cares a lot about his students and is willing to help out. lot. His tests are hard, but not unreasonable. If you attend his lectures he pretty much tells you what will be on the exam.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Exams were a little on the difficult side for and entry level bio, but Dr. D was always willing to answer questions and explain concepts. It's a large class so be prepared to grow up a bit and learn to seek help because it won't find you.
Great class great prof. Class is set up well and provides lots of points so one thing won't kill your entire grade. Very quick to respond to email and Teams messages.

I studied way too much for this course. His exams were significantly harder than the material on his slides. For an introductory biology course, it felt way too difficult, especially considering how little information was on the slides. He's really sweet and willing to help, but the exams were just harder than they should've been.

Eric danhart single handedly ruined my gpa. Nice guy but cannot teach the class and it's set up for you to do badly. I got an A- but that was in studying 8 hours a day weeks before exams and still getting B- exams average. His lectures are so vague and the exams look like they're written in spanish. Don't know a single person that got an A.
Great professor! Lots of points available in the class so one bad exam doesn't kill your grade.
Danhart was great for Bio. He explains things well and is super helpful in office hours. Covers maybe 15-20 slides per hour lecture and does plenty of tophat questions to break up the lecture time.
Exams were extremely difficult compared to other Bio 1113 sections. Lectures were so boring and he reads directly off the slides.

Dr. Danhart is a great dude. His midterms are brutal, but he gives plenty of opportunities to raise your grade through other assignments. You can tell he loves what he teaches and is overall very genuine. His streams his lectures on Zoom and posts them, and he also emphasizes his office hours.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Danhart was really clear on how to succeed in his course, if you follow the learning outcomes you should be good. However, his exams were very difficult compared to other bio 1113 instructors.

Dr. Danhart is an engaging lecturer who makes complex topics understandable. Exams require solid preparation, but his teaching style and helpful resources like unstuckstudy make the class manageable. Definitely worth taking if you're interested in biology.
Dr. Danhart was a great Bio 1113 professor! Would defiantly recommend him.

Dr.Danhart was a good professor and clearly loves biology. His lectures were a bit dull as he read off of slides in a vaguely monotone voice, but it wasn't bad overall. If you don't have any biology experience (like AP Bio or the intro to bio courses) and take this class, then be prepared to play catch-up. Overall an A is achievable with effort.
Professor Danhart is amazing. Really engaging lectures and clearly cares about his students and their success. His exams are fair and he makes sure you know what study.

Lectures have Tophats but are accessible through Zoom. He's decent at explaining concepts and if you know the slides and application questions well then you're set. Nice and funny guy. Most exam are 80% MC with a few short responses. Overall, easy class with a good professor.

The class is pretty easy overall and there were plenty of assignments throughout the semester. He provides learning outcomes for each chapter in his slides which directly correlate to what will be on the exams. Labs were confusing at times, not necessarily his fault but more of the TA I had.
His exams are kinda tough, you really have to have a good understanding of the material. He did a good job of explaining everything, and there was never an exam that had stuff that we didn't cover.

Take Dr. Danhart's class! He is probably the best professor for biology by far! Some topics may be confusing but he does a great job explaining them. The difficulty of the lab is really based off of which TA you get. But I wouldn't say his exams are super difficult if you know how to study. Find a rhythm and go over the application questions!

I love Dr. Danhart. He is clearly passionate about biology and provides an in-depth understanding of basic biology. He includes TopHat questions in his lectures and talks through the slides more thoroughly in class but he provided a Zoom option and recorded his lectures. The exams can be difficult but he provides enough resources to preform well.
I've taken 2 classes now with Dr. Danhart and i have no complaints at all.

Dr. Danhart is a really great prof.  I am not good at biology, but going to his office hours helped me so much. 
The class is definitely a lot of studying and not a lot of homework assignments, but there are a good amount of extra credit opportunities to get your grade up.  The class is weighted heavily on the 3 exams throughout the semester.

Dr. Danhart is such a gem! He genuinely cares about his students and is very kind and approachable. Exams were a bit difficult because there's a lot of memorization but he did his best to make lectures straightforward and not overwhelming. Labs were long but not challenging. I wish he'd teach every biology class I took.
Dr. Danhart is a great lecturer. However, his tests are a little harder than other bio 1113 teachers. However, I think this is offset by the quality of his explanations. Definitely would recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Absolutely amazing professor. Knows how to teach and explains everything in great detail. This class is not an easy A, be prepared to study. If you follow the learning objectives you will be fine. Has lots of Tophat and HW points so take advantage. Lab is very dependent on your TA. Enjoy him while you can because he is one of the best at OSU.

If you can get Dr. Danhart for Bio 1113, PLEASE take his class. He explains things in the same amount of detail as he expects you to know for exams, and often provides mnemonic devices to help remember more of the difficult stuff. If you go to his office hours, he will like you and help you a lot with homework/projects/lab work/studying etc.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. D is an amazing professor. 420 out of the 1000 points come from exams. To get an A, all you need to do is rewatch old lectures and be able to answer each of the learning outcomes. The labs are harder than what we learn in class. Dr. D is a good teacher and one of the best professors at OSU - he explains the 'why' behind everything!

This class wasn't super hard but be prepared to study a fair amount for the exams. Danhart has specific learning outcomes that are perfect to study with because he makes the exams off those. Over 1000 points in the class so not horribly test heavy. I recommend going to lectures because he gives a lot more detail that the slides don't have.

Dr. Danhart loves his to use tophat in class for every lecture, but honestly as long as you pay attention to the lecture you'll be fine. The midterms are also kinda easy because they are exactly like the tophats.

Dr. Danhart is a great professor who really cares about his students. He is very accessible outside of class. This class is difficult and it covers a lot of content but he is a good lecturer. You definitely need to put in a lot of time studying in order to do well. The labs are often annoying, but your lab grade is very dependent on your TA.
Great class and great teacher. He is always available to answer questions and his lectures were so helpful.
Awesome.
Good Class all around, and Dr. Danhart is an excellent lecturer.

Dr. Danhart is one of the best professors at osu and I highly recommend taking him. The class is difficult but he is extremely helpful and accessible through discord. When studying I recommend looking over the application questions, learning objectives, and tophat questions (his form of attendance). I loved this class and am going to miss it!

Amazing Prof. Cares a lot about his students and provides them with all resources necessary to succeed. Love the discord server as my questions were answered within minutes by him or a TA. Labs sucked, but that was because my TA sucked. I would have had a better grade were it not for my lab group and my TA. Try for a TA that cares about their job!

Dr. Danhart is funny and smart. Lectures are over only about 12-20 slides. Always read the Mastering book to get a more in-depth understand. Do the Exam Reviews before the exams. Test are based around the learning outcomes provided. There is a discord server made where one can asks questions and the professor replies instantaneous at anytime.

It is evident that Dr. Danhart prepares for his lectures. The material is quite dense, but he makes it manageable and interesting. You simply have to put in the time and effort to study his lecture notes and you should be able to get an A in the class. The labs are a little annoying, but just make sure you do your best to keep up.

This class is manageable if you put the time in. Dr. Danhart is phenomenal! Definitely read the textbook, do not cram for exams (they're hard), and go to lecture - homework and TH points will help your grade in the end! Overall, solid class and great professor. The labs are ridiculously annoying, however.

Dr. Danhart really cares about his students. Personally, I'd say if you have any background of Biology, you will do completely fine in this course. Just make sure you utilize his notes and practice questions when studying for his exam. If you have questions, Dr. D will be more than happy to help you out. Good luck!

Dr. Danhart is a very good professor. Lectures are very helpful and information heavy. His learning outcome based class makes it easy to study and focus in certain things. The labs are a little annoying, but bearable. He also has a class discord server, which is very helpful. Highly sarcastic and humorous.

Dr. Danhart did a great job at communicating the lecture material as well as caring for students. Although the course was set up with too many points and the labs were at time unbearable, I found myself enjoying the lecture. I did not enjoy the pre-med scope of the class as well.

Dr. Danhart did a great job at communicating the lecture material as well as caring for students. Although the course was set up in a manner similar to a death of a million paper cuts (SO MANY POINTS) and the labs were at time unbearable, I found myself enjoying the lecture. If you're more into plant bio, this class in your alley.

For as much as I dont like biology, this class was surprisingly not that bad, mostly thanks to Dr. D. He genuinely cares about the success of his students and he is very passionate about the material. The class discord server was a great idea, and he was always accessible there. Overall, great professor who you should try to get if possible.
Dr. Danhurt is amazing. Lectures are easy to understand, he live streams and uploads recordings. Also a very down to earth person in office hours, never condescending.

Eric Danhart made me remember why I wanted to be a biochemistry major. He made everything he taught the most interesting thing ever and explained everything beautifully. He also runs a Discord server for the class so if you have a question you can just ask him or a TA.
THIS IS THE BEST MAN ON THE PLANET!!!! TAKE HIM YOU WILL BECOME BESTIES!!! BEST PROFESSOR IN THE WORLD!!

Went too fast in lecture and was often condensing if you didn't understand the content. Did not care to help when seeking advice on how to do better in the class. The class is more difficult than expected if you have not taken a previous biology course.

I would recommend taking any class by him because he is such a great professor. He truly cares about his students and its easy to meet outside of class. AMAZING PROFESSOR so helpful in and out of class, what he expects out of you is super clear. He says he only tests whats on the slides and its true. It's bio so theres a level of difficulty but it's entirely doable and having Dr D makes it so much better. Attend the lectures, read the textbook if you're confused, and ask for help if you need it

reviews.comment: Awesome professor. The absolute best and really cares about his students. His lectures are interesting and his tests are fair.

He’s the best! His class is pretty average difficulty wise like the average for most tests is about 75%. But he writes all his own tests and the final isn’t cumulative. Attendance to lab is mandatory and lectures have tophats so they’re kind of mandatory.

Dr. Danhart is an amazing professor. Hes kind, chill, and actually cares about the students. The exams are not hard, and the tophat questions are good tools for review. I had him as a lab instructor also and hes even better in person.

I thoroughly enjoyed Dr. Danharts lectures, even on zoom. His slides were concise, organized, and easy to understand. He was very accessible outside of class and his office hours were very helpful. I loved this class and would definitely recommend!!

Dr. Danhart is a very good professor who explains difficult concepts well. He gives a lot of easy or free points throughout the semester, which makes up for the slightly difficult exams. Provides good practice problems before exams. If you attend lectures and study you will be fine.

Dr. Danhart is an amazing professor to say the least. Having him straight out of high school is a great transition into college. This course has many available points, but you have to do well on the exams if you want to get a good grade. Also, go to lecture or you will be very confused

Great prof. He's funny and kind. He teaches well and tries to make sure you understand everything. He also lets you choose songs and makes a playlist for the beginning of class! Dr. Danhart was a great professor but was very difficult with the exams. He is a 50/50 professor in learning and the difficulty level.

reviews.comment: Dr. Danhart is a great professor, he explains materials and information very thoroughly. He takes his time to make sure you understand the material. Hes a really funny guy and he does his job very well. He explains things very thoroughly and you will learn a lot if you are willing to put in the time. He is a great prof to have straight out of high school, but he does have high expectations though.

I loved Dr. Danhart. By far my best professor this semester. While the stuff he is teaching isn't easy, he does a phenomenal job of explaining it. He makes it clearer than the book. Dr. Danhart did amazing with the online format and was very accessible outside of class. Any homework or questions he was always more than willing to help in office hours. Dr. Danhart was the best professor I have ever had. His lectures are interesting and he does a really wonderful job of explaining concepts instead of just expecting us to memorize facts. Danhart is a very good Biology professor. The class was a little difficult online however he was very accessible outside of class so it seemed to be fine. Dr. Danhart is one of the best professors Ive ever had. He is an amazing teacher and sets you up for success. Dr. Danhart was one of the professors for this biochemistry lab. Danhart did his best to make the material easy for everyone. The exams were fair, but definitely have to study a good amount for them. Overall, not a bad class.

Really cares about his students and his lectures are genuinely entertaining. Covers a lot of material in lecture but it flows well. Requires you to apply a lot of material for quizzes, but this is all to aid in mcat prep.

Class can be challenging but they make it easy to do well if you put in the work. Overall amazing teacher and very accessible. Always answered emails and questions in class. Make lab a great experience!
Super straightforward. If you look at the learning outcomes and study the things written well, you will get an A.

reviews.comment: Very good instructor. Lectures were always pretty interesting and grading was pretty lenient - most of the points were very easy to earn. Exams were super straightforward (but he expects you to know all the details he gives in lecture). Very nice guy.

The grading and weight of assignments in this class is very fair.

Danhart makes it really clear what he expects for students to know for tests in his slides. TopHat points and in-class activities give several opportunities to make up points if you don't do great on the tests. He is super genuine, subtly funny, and cares about his students a lot, even in a giant lecture hall setting

Sometimes staying awake during his lectures was tough. It may be because it was at 9:10AM, but his slideshows can sometimes be lengthy and arduous to endure. Nonetheless, Danhart is a great professor who knows how to teach biology and truly cares about his students' success. He also has a sense of humor that displays his love toward teaching.

Great class, lectures clear and at steady pace, recorded so you can rewatch later for review. Online study materials through Pearson/Mastering were helpful but honestly if you pay attention in lecture and ask questions in recitation you'll be fine. So Danhart is a nice enough guy, but I struggle with the very fine details of the cell, which is what 1113 is. So I found his tests very difficult, and I worked really hard for my grade. Loved his class!

cute!!!

Exams are Too difficult. Not much relationship among class, homework, and exam. Cost too much time on the homework which is useless at all. I really should drop this course.

believe it when you hear that his exams are impossible

worst, biased

He's a very funny guy

Don't listen to the people that say he's unfair and mean. Professor Zaccai is hilarious and clearly tells you the exams will be similar to the projects. He makes boring slides into a comedy act and is genuinely a really good teacher and connects with all his students. Personally, my favorite professor I've had at OSU.

[BE CAUTIONATE] Diego is a great lecturer who can explain concepts well, but you really have to put in the work during labs and projects. I wouldn't be mad but there's zero opportunities to correct your mistakes, so look back at your previous feedback.

Excellent professor. During lecture, he explains concepts clearly with lots of examples and can answer any questions you may have.

Make sure you get with a good group because you are stuck with them for the whole semester and group projects are a huge part of your grade and have a very strict rubric.

Diego Zaccai is a funny teacher, though sometimes his sarcasm can be seen as demeaning. However, Diego genuinely cares about his students. Projects are difficult, and TAs are very nitpicky; however, this is just because the class is difficult. The curve helped; I ended with a B-, and after the curve, it was a B+.

Exceptional lectures- engaging, barely uses the slides, and explains the concepts well. Genuinely shows character, often voicing opinions on various topics which is admirable. good professor.

person who wrote the review before this one is a little strange.

Handsome and brilliant like Ed Snowden, his soothing voice on the Softwear 2 sleeping aid link is the only thing that brings me peace on my lonely, restless nights. His calm tone wraps around my insomnia like a warm blanket, offering the only solace I've found in the quiet lonely hours. He keeps saying he's mean but tbh he's a darling of a person!!

He's a pretty fun professor and he actually cares about the material which helps. I would say that his class is on the more difficult side, but you should be able to get by if you actually put in some effort. You will get screwed if you don't pay attention (learned that the hard way). He will also foreshadow something on the exam, which is helpful.
Funny professor, knowledgeable and really good at teaching the course material. A bit of a tough grade but still fair. He is secretly evil tho, I still rock with him, but he has malice in his soul.

Midterms were challenging but in my opinion Software 2 is an inherently difficult class. Amazing professor and lecturer. Very accessible during office hours/after class and genuinely wants to see his students succeed.

He is such a fun professor and he makes the class laugh every lecture. The main downside is that his exams were difficult (more than other sections) and graded very strictly. Otherwise, I had a great time in his class. His prerecorded lectures have questionable audio but they're pretty good. Still remember when he crashed the groupme for his class

Similar sentiment to other review. Excellent teacher -- if you are looking for a professor that will genuinely help you learn concepts and show you real industry application of them, this is your guy. Also hilarious. However, exams and grading were definitely rough -- my first non-A here at Ohio State. Felt that studying provided marginal returns.

reviews.comment: Zaccai is funny and gives good lectures, but the course is really hard. He moves quite fast in lectures with the notes and the TAs grade quite harshly with the homework. Great prof! Exam medians for my section were 64-73, but imo the questions were mostly fair. I am salty I did not get an A- tho. :( I believe that the curve is only to ensure that the class median is a B-/B, so do not expect much of a curve. Number 1 advice: show up to class and go to office hours.

Lectures: He makes the dry slideshows enjoyable (his humor isn't for everyone tho).
Labs: Same as SW1.
Projects: Pretty difficult and TAs grade harsh, but most of the time you'll be fine as long as u ask questions.
Exams: Really difficult with minimal curve. Although I enjoyed the class, I failed cuz of exams. Gives barely any partial credit.
i hated this professor
Diego is one of the best lecturers I've met. He makes boring slideshows funny and really tries to connect with his students. He's a tough grader but you'll learn a ton by talking things out with him.
Exams were extremely difficult, and the curve was minimal. Humor was used in a degrading fashion.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The version of 3341 he teaches (Michael Bond's curriculum) is really difficult, but I feel like I learned a lot from it. Keeps lecture interesting and worthwhile to go to. Cares about students and is easily accessible outside of class. Projects are graded objectively on how many test cases they pass, so it's easy to get a low grade if you mess up
Was skeptical at first because of his humor, but was actually a great lecturer. Keeps content entertaining and is always willing to explain more complicated topics in depth.

Professor Zaccai is first and foremost a teacher and cares about the success of his students. He makes the dry slides of the OSU Software sequence bearable and always clarifies when students are stuck. The exams are tough, but the class is curved to compensate if the grades are especially rough.
Nice guy and a decent lecturer. Exams were very diffcult however, and there was not much curve.

I think Prof Zaccai was very funny and entertaining and great at teaching the material. My only real complaint is that the exams were for the most part very very difficult. The class was curved though which helps. (unrelated - Rate My Professor needs to increase their word limit!)
I enjoy this professor a lot, he makes content that would be hard to pay attention to more engaging by cracking the occasional dad joke.

I found professor Zaccai to be a good lecturer due to his humor and knowledge of the material. However, his midterms and final were unbearable due to their difficulty. I had good marks on the projects with my partner but the exams tanked my grade. We were expected to memorize and write lines of code from the projects without prior warning.

Very knowledgeable prof with a good sense of humor. A little intimidating at first, but he's super nice and is always willing to clarify and answer questions. Definitely speak up in lecture or go to office hours when you need clarification. I do wish he would make the midterms easier since this class is rough grade wise.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Did not care my partner didn't participate in group projects leaving me to do all the work.
