Diego is extremely knowledgeable, funny, and caring. His dry sense of humor can make him intimidating, especially in a large group setting, but he was nothing but kind when answering questions and interacting with students individually. His exams are challenging but the overall class is set up to be graded very fairly, and he usually curves!

Had him for software 2 and really enjoyed him as a professor. Probably the funniest instructor I've ever had and uses that humor to help keep students focused. Also super knowledgeable in general, really glad I got him as a professor.

Zaccais lectures were a true joy to attend, he had a great energy about every subject and I regret not participating more. The class is tough, but just attending lectures and office hours as needed will get you through it. Ignore all comments about drinking students tears online, every interaction I had with him was fantastic.

Don't let his sarcasm scare you; he genuinely cares about his students and his humor will grow on you. It's not often that you have a professor who can provide insight that is useful outside of the classroom either, so attend class. Lastly, the material can be difficult depending on your prior knowledge.

Just had a test with him today. He did not remotely prepare us for it in that it was extremely time constraining. He makes annoying dumb jokes to cover up his attitude and poor teaching style. Cool guy! Only catch, really hard tests. Take only if you already know a lot of things in advance
Man uses Linux over Windows. Zaccai is the real deal

reviews.comment: He does tell jokes, but they are all offensive and makes students feel dumb. Tests are difficult. Most time consuming class I ever taken. Avoid if you have any social life.

He is the worst professor I ever had. He doesn't care about your grade and will tank your GPA easily with his hard quizzes and his difficult structure. His lectures aren't interactive and don't correspond to the actual tests. Don't want a bad grade don't take him.

Dr. Zaccai is one of the better, if not best professors in the CSE department. reviews.comment: Very annoying professor! He makes impossible quizzes and doesn't explain anything well in his prerecorded lectures, which are boring due to them not being live or in person. One of the most difficult professors I ever had. Avoid him to save your GPA from sinking

reviews.comment: Hes lenient and curves his class. Make sure you study well and hard for the quizzes. reviews.comment: Diego is caring and social. He calls people out in class and you can start a conversation with him. Very approachable and kind. If you like easy professor and want some enjoyment, then pick him because he will best suit you for that.
Diego is sweet and kind and I love him. His irony makes this class fun and enjoyable. Diego is very comfortable and easy to talk to. He is relax guy and just wants to have fun.

He's pretty knowledgeable on the content matter and knows his stuff. Zaccai will try his best to explain things for you to understand. Loves to joke around every once in a while. I recommend him to take for every course, he will make you enjoy. He always has something to laugh about and learn from him.

His class isn't that hard. If you study for his online quizzes and do well, then I'm pretty sure you can get an A in his class. The projects are easier and they are done with a partner. The homework is just for effort so you can just try your best and will get full credit. The labs/Piazza are just for participation and the most easiest points.

Diego is pretty chill and you can talk to him like your regular average friend. He talks and mess with students in a very nice way. Diego is outgoing, so don't be shy. He's very energetic and cool. I wish I had him in my foundation 2 class. I'll miss his sense of humor and a professor like no other.

He has many respects from other students. Easy to get a long with and you can talk to him about anything really. He's humorous as to everyday in class he will say something hilarious. Easy on the inside and will answer any questions on anywhere honestly. I realized he's open with people and shares info about himself. Overall, I recommend him.

Very cool and nice professor. He is willing to help you at any cost if you ask him questions. Very funny and has a nice personality. He truly cares for his students that he reminds them not to copy from GitHub. He will reach out to people who dont understand the material and help them out. I am truly SORRY for the people that makes you not happy.

Diego was a hilarious and perhaps the most helpful professor Ive had at OSU. He gives great feedback and is incredibly helpful. Overall super nice guy and a really passionate teacher; would definitely recommend/take again
Excellent lecturer and enjoyable class. The written exams are quite difficult and his grading is difficult, but the content is similar to the practice exams. Overall, good but difficult class.

Zaccai is one of the best professors in the department. His lectures were hilarious and he knew the material well. The exams are tough, but fairly graded.

Zaccai is a funny guy. There are easier professors, but there are also harder professors (supowit). Zaccai is not an easy grader, but he's definitely fair. The content of the class was varied and I enjoyed it overall.
tough grader

Great professor; one of the best I've had at Ohio State. Funny, engaging, and knowledgeable. Teaches in a straightforward manner, and assignments and midterms are very reasonable. Would highly recommend.

reviews.comment: This was a difficult class, but Diego made the lectures entertaining and the grading was pretty fair. I would definitely recommend him as a professor. The first exam was tough, but the class was curved and I learned the material well.

He cares about what he teaches and makes the material fun during lecture. Best part, if you do not understand what is going on during lecture, then he will help you during his office hours.

reviews.comment: Very nice and funny guy. The only person on earth who can put 5 sarcastic jokes into 1 sentence. Has a sadistic side as well. A bit tough, but the lectures are never boring. I would strongly recommend!
Best lecturer I have ever met so far. He is humorous, handsome and inspirational. He explains things very clearly during class. Would definitely take again.
I think it was first year teaching, but he didn't know what he was teaching and gave the wrong examples during class multiple times! Harsh grader and barely gives any partial credit :(
Great lecturer. He's clear and humorous during lecture. Very likely to help after class and gives good feedback. If you follow him during lecture, everything shouldn't be hard. Highly recommend.

Meh. His failed attempts at humor irritated me more than anything, and his lectures just weren't clear enough for me or other classmates to comprehend. I'd recommend him if you have no better options.

reviews.comment: This was the first time he taught this class. He tried his best to make himself clearly in the class. But he always made mistakes. He was willing to help everyone. And his office hour was really useful. He gave a curve.

He tries very hard to be helpful and is very nice and funny.  Since this was his first time teaching this class, the lectures were pretty hard to follow and the homework and tests were difficult. He's just alright. This professor once wrote a personalized email to me, answering a very specific question I had... at 2 am the night before the final. He answered my question and wished me good luck.  That's all you need to know.

Really funny and enjoys teaching. He has a lot of office hours for questions which wsa nice. He is very sarcastic and funny. Really knows his stuff and makes the lectures interesting. Class is difficult but manageable. Make sure you get a good partner for the projects because you will have to work with them all semester.
Very caring, go see her during office hours it really helps. I worked medium hard and got an A. Make sure to go to lecture.

By far one of the worst, most annoying classes I've ever taken. Assignments take 4+ hours to complete and hard to tell what grade you'll get. Attendance is mandatory for pointless recitation while still expected to watch online lectures for the week. One of the most mentally draining classes I've taken. Material is fairly difficult, not impossible.
Get khan academy ready you will not learn anything from the in person lectures or recitations. You will basically be teaching yourself. There were only two exams, mid term and final.

I took this class in person, but I just watched the online lectures, which were really helpful. Attendance for recitation is required, but you get 4 excused absences. Recitation assignments take a really long time. I find Professor Rumsey's online lectures more helpful than in-person personally.

WATCH HER VIDEOS. gave up going to scheduled lecturer and switched to watching her posted lecture and they were great. Only took ~45 of watching to understand concepts for the week. TAs sucked and recitation is more of a free work period with mandatory attendance. If you want a good grade, watch her lecture vids and they cover all concepts on tests

DISCLAIMER: SHE ONLY WAS RATED 5 BY PEOPLE BECAUSE SHE IS NICE. This is college, not high school. Her being nice did not mean she was helpful. Did not teach well, assigned very long recitation worksheets and had all TA's who could barely speak english. Very bad class

Very underwhelming professor. Obvious to tell she lost all motivation to teach students compared to the time she created a whole statistics book. Required useless recitation, long (VERY LONG) recitation worksheets, and changed her exams from all multiple choice to MC and short answer. Pretty unfair

Recitation worksheets are long and redundant. Oftentimes the same question over and over with different numbers. TAs are no help either. Recitation attendance is mandatory and they don't take attendance til the end of class and won't give it to you if you haven't been there the entire time.

Don't understand all the 5 star reviews. Is she really nice and caring? Yes, but does that translate to the class being enjoyable and understandable? No. The worksheets in recitation take quite a bit of time and it's a toss up on the grade you'll get on them. You won't learn anything in lecture, as she is a little all over the place when teaching

From what I see this experience may be exclusive to the online version of the class, but I found 1430 to be a major pain. The TA's are some of the worst I've had thus far and would even be late to the zoom classes. The lecture podcast videos can sometimes be hard to follow as well. I suggest taking this class in person, as the online was bad

Debs the GOAT. Her lectures can be boring but she is such a genuine person and you can tell she cares about every student. She'd have us send in pictures of our shoes of the day, watch football highlights during the season, and she invited us to her ranch at the end of the semester. You gotta lock in and do the work if you wanna pass tho.

Definitely an above average professor. I had no problems with Dr. Rumsey. She was funny, and the in person lectures were useful I also thought the class material itself was easy, and the structure made a lot of sense. A good amount of weight on the exams, but they're not too difficult. Final grade average was an 80%.

Deb has good lecture videos that are easy to follow and understand, but I had a very bad TA which made the class way more difficult than it had to be. It matters more who your TA is rather than the professor. The mid-term and final are also 65% of your grade so study a lot for those.

Deb Rumsey was overall a good professor. She cared for her students and was very clear about what you should expect. Personally, I wouldn't go to her in-person lecture because I found them to be a waste of time. On the other hand, I would recommend going through her online lecture videos. Just try your best and you'll be fine.

Deb Rumsey was great! She is super engaging in lectures and you can tell she cares SO MUCH about her students. Her lectures are clear and the exams are fair. If you study and go to all the lectures, you should get an A.

Although I never met her, I didn't like her. She was not on the same page as her lecturers and TAs, causing confusion. Also the final is worth like 30% of your final grade and is only 25 multiple choice questions. It was a very easy final, but the mean was a 79%, and she thought that was very good. If you know what you're doing, you will get an A.

The professor is good, but not cares too much about students. The homework is heavy, you need to finish all the questions, but they just randomly select 5 questions to grade(2 points each). Recitation assignments are unnecessary hard, TA's are beyond useless, makes showing up to recitation mandatory, the actual content isn't too bad but she uses statcrunch which is unnecessarily difficult. No grade rounds ups, doesn't accept late work, good at explaining the concepts, overall kind of easy class, but she isn't at all understanding.
