reviews.comment: I've had her for Polish 1101, 1102, 1103, and Slavic 2230. In all of these she was never too difficult and lectures were always informative.
While the readings and lectures could be long, Slavic Vampires was a very interesting class taught by a caring professor. The grading could be a little bit slow, but the content was great.

If you can take a class with this professor, do it! She is a kind individual and excellent at teaching. She teaches in a way that you genuinely learn the material. The lectures never drag on because she switches between different engaging activities throughout the class. Just take Polish!! It's a good class!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Slavic vampires is an amazing class that teaches you way more than you would expect and gives you two semesters worth of GR credit. You get to read about vampires with an amazing professor, what isnt to love????
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Inspirational

reviews.comment: Quite literally the worst professor I've ever had in college. He makes 80% of the class worth of exams for an online class. It would not be as bad if it was open note, but he makes this class that is supposed to be easy much harder than it needs to be. Run away and choose somebody else!
The bi-weekly quizzes should be open note tbh. Has a lot of info on the slides yet doesn't specify which ones we should really know.

Would not recommend, making us show up to a Zoom call at 8 am on a snow day; the whole school, other than him, had recorded lectures, not him. We sat in an empty Zoom call, and he couldn't even figure it out for 25 minutes. Literally every assignment had issues with it at some point, and he could not remedy these issues in any capacity.

His class is structured very poorly. He weights grades, is too strict, and doesn't allow you to use notes on bi-weekly quizzes and the final exam. He was also not very friendly when I went to see him in his office hours. Worst professor I've had.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Hard to reach and lectures were hard to sit through.  I thought the content was very interesting at times, but quizzes and exams were harder than they needed to be. Didn't do a great job explaining tough concepts. Just another annoying Fisher class to get through.

I missed a quiz because I was taking care of my mom in her 60s. She had hurt herself and asked me to come home and help her out while she rested. He ignored my email asking him if I could take it a few days later. Come to find out, he allowed another student who was "going out of town" to take the quiz. This quiz was worth 12% of my grade.

One of the best classes I've taken in Fisher. He does cold call, but in a small class everyone was called on, if you don't know the answer he'll tell you instantly. The class is really interesting and as someone with a short attention span, I paid attention a lot. He cares about students success. 
Hard but pay attention and you'll succeed.

I like him, classes are hard and he is kind of strict. but the rigidity is something I thrive under and honestly what the world kind of needs more of I feel like. I was not a good student(2.7 GPA), but the structure he provided forced me to be a good one. Fond memories, thank you professor.

This class sucked. An asynchronous class should be pretty straight-forward but he managed to over-complicate it. Massive part of your grade comes from a couple quizzes and the final. His quiz questions are written in vague terms. He is not willing to listen to any communications so I would say don't bother writing him.

The best professor I have had at OSU. He is extremely knowledgable and genuinely cares about his students doing well in the class. He was very helpful and responded quickly to emails. I found this class very interesting but challenging. Attendance and participation are mandatory.
never got back with me
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Clear grading criteria--So many papers

reviews.comment: He does not respond to emails whatsoever and is very difficult to communicate with. Takes days/weeks to answer and to even get a response you need to email him 45 times. If there is a technical issue, he basically says he can't do anything about it and is very reluctant when it comes to accommodating.
He is a nice person but the class (BUSFIN 4255) and him are difficult. You need to study a bit for getting a good grade. Though the content of the class is important for any finance job.
Fantastic Professor! He is very knowledgeable and intelligent. He cares about each student's success and learning.

I recommend taking 4250 online because it is very easy, but he provides no value besides reading the slides. Terrible lecturer with a heavy accent that could barely explain what was written on the screen. Easy class, bad prof, I will retain nothing from this class.

He was a terrible teacher. Was boring and cold called people all the time. If you look at your computer for more than 5 seconds, expect to be told off. There are no acceptable absences AT ALL. Especially picks on girls

Definitely the best class I ever took. So many things learned during this semester. In the beginning, the professor could seem a bit rough but he will always try to help students by providing additional practice questions. If you are not afraid to work and want to learn many things concerning international monetary policies, this class is for you!
He's not accommodating to his students

If you want a good idea of what it's like to sit in one of the mandatory lectures, I suggest watching the Ben Stein lecture scene in Ferris Bueller's day off.
Attendance is graded, exams seem unfair.  Would recommend taking something else.

Difficult class, but everything you needed to know is on the slides. His office hours and review sessions before exams are helpful as he often tells you what details you need to know for specific pathways. Cares a lot about the success of his students and doesn't mind explaining/answering any questions.

Don't take this man's class he is a bad lecturer, his slides and lectures are disorganized and do not make sense. His quizzes are hard and he barely gives enough time for them. I would read every chapter of the textbook and slides and still get bad grades on them. Also the lab sucks and is so much extra work for no reason and graded way too harsh.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Challenging class, but manageable considering he provides a checklist of things to study for the exams. Provides extra credit, but typically leads to a smaller curve. Could be a lot worse given how extensive the curriculum is.
Do not take.
so many quizzes and so much information. this class should be 2 classes. so sick of it already. seems to be two camps in this class: people doing really well and really poorly. lectures are boring.

Dr. Kudryashov really cares about his students and helping them understand concepts in this class. It is a difficult class with a lot of content, but if you go to his office hours before exams and stay on top of class notes, you can succeed!

5614 has a lot of material but Dr. Kudryashov made it all very interesting, which certainly promoted my learning & studying. Clearly cares about the content and his students; took time for mental health/confidence check-ins + a metacognition exercise. There's a lot to know but he made quiz/exam expectations clear. He made the class fun & enriching!
I had Dr. Kudryashov for biochem 5614 autumn semester of 2023. He was an amazing professor very knowledgeable and prepared us well for tests and quizzes. I had a great time in his class
Really great teaching of the material. Willing to help students when they are stuck or lacking understanding. Class was difficult but enjoyable.

Dr. K was super fun to have as a professor! This class is difficult and requires a lot of studying outside of class. However, Dr. K is very willing to help and encourages students to come to office hours. He provides bonus points. I did bad on an exam, and he worked with me to get my grade up to an A. COME TO CLASS! He is very funny and caring!

Pros: 

Good lectures with notes posted
Very clear study guides for exams

Cons:

Uses in-class tophat quizzes
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I enjoyed this class and learned a lot. His exams have a particular format and he grades a specific way but once you learn his style you can do well! Dr Kudryashov was genuinely funny and made lecture interesting. Go to lecture, pay attention, participate, and ask questions! you will do so much better if you invest a little bit up front.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Kudryashov was very caring and supportive throughout the semester. The course itself is content heavy but he made it fun and enjoyable! Going to office hours also helped a lottt and he is always happy to help! I would really recommend him if you want to have a great biochemistry experience!

Great professor and super passionate about the subject. Always helpful/accessible and accommodating when students need help. Definitely cares about his students. Study the lecture slides and you will be set for the exams!

This class is very demanding in terms of how much material you are required to know but it is doable. Dr. Kudryashov definitely cares about his students and this is evident as he holds extra office hours before the exams - GO! He gives helpful hints on what to study. Everything you need to know is in the slides, and grading is very fair on exams.

The hardest class I've ever taken due to the amount of material, but so interesting. Dr. Kudryashov does an excellent job translating the intrigue of the material in his lectures. He expects a lot but truly cares about his students. I received a lot of help by simply asking him questions after class. Thanks to him, I did quite well on the final.

he's a funny guy and you can tell that he cares about biology, but he is extremely difficult to understand and he goes incredibly fast. if you skip class you're doomed. lots of material covered, and it's a very quick-paced class

Dr. K was a good guy and you could tell he had fun teaching. He does go in-depth and fast, but it is definitely manageable. I appreciated his dry humor. He is very knowledgeable, and his tests weren't bad at all.

This class is not weighted and merely point based. The content in the first half is taught by Kudryashov. He seems like a nice guy but has a Russian accent and moves VERY fast. His tests are also extremely specific and didn’t focus on content. It was like remembering one sentence out of the 400 slides. Be prepared to study.

I screwed up the first exam otherwise Dr. Kudryashov's class was great. He really seemed to care about his students and encouraged us to think positively and eat lots of chocolate. I appreciated him, his accent also isn't thick at all, I think some of the others just can't come to terms with not having done well and are blaming his accent.

Dr. Kudryashov is a great professor, he really cares about his students, and he gives generous curves (5-10%). That said, this course is a 4000-level science course and should be treated as such. Because of the large amount of material to memorize, it's an easy A for people who prepare BEFORE lecture and is hell for procrastinators.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Test heavy--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: His accent makes it impossible to understand what he is teaching. I tried very hard to understand him, went to every lecture, and read the book. The class itself is structured well, you get 1/2 of your quiz points in recitation just for showing up. Mastering homework and quizzes are much easier than exams. Exams are all extended response.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: His thick accent is very hard to follow, even after reading the textbook chapters before the lectures. He also talks very fast and studder here and there so relistening to the lecture doesnt help much. Please avoid if you cant understand accents. I have been doing well in all advanced science courses but I dont think I can in this class.

Dr. Kudryashov definitely makes you work for your grade. It is a lot of work but your work will pay off. From what I've heard he is more difficult than other professors but you really learn the material. I really enjoyed him and his class and would definitely take him again.

It's not that bad. You just really need to read and review the material well and really take time to listen in lecture. It's a lot of memorization, so space out your time well to memorize all of the structures needed. The first two exams were pretty easy, but final was difficult. Also you can get points back on the exams by going in & talking to TA
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: It's a very tough class. There's a crazy amount of material expected of you for exams, which there are only 3 of, so don't mess any up. He's a nice guy and makes himself available, but he never makes it easy to do well. I'd study so much for this class only to be disappointed. If I could do it again, I wouldn't take it with him. There is a curve.

Doesn't explain things well, very dry. Just reads off of PowerPoint slides and expects you to get it. I believe he means well but it gets hard to stay motivated in his class because his lectures are so dull
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Really nice professor with lots of practice problems, but way too much material thrown at you at one time. Other classes had open note, multiple choice tests. Take someone else unless you're really strong at chemistry.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Though scary at first, he cares about his students and is a very good lecturer. Sometimes he cracks a joke which lightens the mood in a heavy class. He wants you to pass but only if you earn it, which is fair. He is also very clear about what he expects you to know for exams

The class is very challenging because it requires you to memorize large quantities of material that feels impossible. If you start memorizing the material ( like 2 weeks + before an exam) you will do well. Not much of a curve so start strong. The professor is funny but expects you to put in a lot of effort so don't slack off.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Terrible! His exams are a insane amount of information and very detailed! His lectures aren't helpful because he just reads from the slides fast and with a thick accent. He expects you to have very complex topics and structures memorized after hearing him talk about it for 5 seconds. Exams are all extended response. Good luck.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Tough class, lots of study required.  Professor was good, humorous, and always available, though the powerpoint lectures were fairly dull.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Dr. Kudryashov was an excellent professor. However, I believe we tried to cover too many topics in the semester. This being said, everything he tested us over was very fair. What made the class difficult was the fact you needed to know almost EVERYTHING.  If you keep up, study weekly with the material, and understand concepts you will do very well.

He is nice but not that helpful talking fast and reading from lectures is not teaching. High expectation that u should know and memorize every single thing  on each single slides not fair each lecture over 50 slides! Exams are tough and very detailed. YES STUDY EVERYTHING DO NOT SKIP! curve helps students on & below average not above average!!!!!!

I dont think this class was organized well. The material is all over the place (at times) and he doesn't explain the basics of each lecture well. It was hard to decide what was the most important take aways from each lecture. I ended up watching hours of YouTube videos to figure it out. Would I recommend him? Probably not.

Hardest class I have taken. Exams are over 200-400 slides and he expects you to memorize every thing on every slide; and the exams are all fill in. Lectures are impossible to keep up with as he spends no more then 30 seconds on each slide. Good Luck.

I would recommend Dr. Kudryashov over any other Biochemistry teacher. I did feel he went through the lectures relatively fast + had unrealistic expectations like expecting you to and understand the material right when it left his lips and to memorize everything for the exams. Go to office hours, make this class your #1 priority + you'll be fine.
He is a little hard to understand sometimes, and he tells you to remember everything. The exams were all extended responseshort answer, but they were fair and similar to the recitation activities.

Very hard professor. Took 4 exams total, all of which felt like finals (2 hours long all extended response quetions). He would tell you to memorize basically everything. Unneccessarily hard exams. Looks for very particular answers. Overall, this class is one of the most challenging I have taken, I recommend the other professor instead of Dr. K.

Dr. Kudryashov was very helpful and clearly cares a lot about his students. His exams are fair but it kind of feels like he rushes through lecture. Overall, he is a pretty good professor and I highly recommend him.

Kudryashov is the best! One of the rare ones at OSU who really cares about the students success and not only about their research. The material is very challenging, but like any science class, you won't be handed an A. In short, he makes class enjoyable and this Russian accent makes things a lot more interesting to listen to! I recommend.

The class obviously isn't going to be easy. That being said, Dr. Kudryashov makes his exams very fair!The final isn't cumulative which is nice.Quizzes are online, fairly difficult but you can use your notes. His recitation worksheets are also very helpful and representative of exams. Overall, great professor and great class set up.
You're better of taking it with someone else. His midterms aren't that hard if you study, but his quizzes are ridiculous. He is helpful, though. He's always present at office hours.

I learn so much from Dr. Kudyrashov's lecture. He is great at explaining things and uses interesting facts and statistics to relate things to real life. He is definitely a good professor for Pre-Med students to take, as he has a great interest and focus on medicine incorporated into biochemistry.

Dr. Kudryashov really cares about his students. He is constantly sneaking in little comments about good study habits and eating properly (in terms of biochemistry). The content is challenging, but doable if material is kept up with. Tests are fair, and Kudryashov is more than willing to help struggling students.
Dr. Kudryashov is a great lecturer and his exams are very fair. Quizzes are online and can be challenging, but they are good preparation for the exams.
Easy

Her lectures are very instructive, did a good job considering short session. She does have long lectures, advise taking breaks or speed up. Accessible and understanding though, homework is mostly discussion boards and quizzes that can be retaken once. 1 research writing as a final. Not bad for me but others could be overwhelmed.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: The class is very lecture heavy but its balanced with a reasonable workload of assignments. She can be somewhat of a tough grader and just about never gives perfect scores but is usually reasonable. Textbook was technically required but not necessary to get a good grade in the class with how dense the online lectures are.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Douglas was a great professor. Her lectures were informative and matched with the quizzes/discussion posts. It was a lecture/reading heavy class, and sometimes the lectures would be long, but she kept it interesting.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She is very upfront on the amount of work this class demands. I loved watching her lectures. Quizzes were pretty straight forward and you get two attempts. If you go in expecting to get an A with minimal work you will be caught off guard, but if you understand this is a half semester 3000 level class, you will like the course.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: somewhat difficult class with a lot of material as it is only a 7 week class. There is a lot of reading, watching, and writing that is very hard to avoid but the material is great and very interesting. I would defo take this class. Easily one of the easier GE
As long as you watch the lectures you're set. Her videos were interesting and easy to watch and understand.

She was very nice and had manageable assignments. The comments for the discussion question responses were harsh, and I lost the most points from the responses. I still don't understand how she wanted me to respond and what she considers offensive to the writer. I didn't write anything mean. I only said I disagree with this for this reason.

The grade is mostly made up of several papers and a quiz each week based on lecture videos. The quizzes are easy and the papers can be time consuming but greatly help to reinforce topics mentioned in the videos

I absolutely loved Dr Douglas. She is super funny and makes the online lectures worth watching. The online courseload is not as bad as people make it out to be. I'm not much of a history person but I did enjoy the material and writing the paper for this class! would recommend. Also, super accommodating as long as you communicate w her!!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Expects too much out of any online course.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Had to drop this course after the first two weeks, The Reading consists of 50 pages per week, and the Lectures: are almost 5 hours long, expect you to write at least a 5-page paper every week, not really helpful regarding issues with YouTube playlists. don't take this class with other classes, take this class by itself if you want to succeed.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Good professor. Very knowledgeable. Easy class if you put in good effort, just a good amount of writing. Material is kinda boring and really long, but pretty easy A
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--So many papers--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The amount of reading for this class was insane, not to mention the videos which added up to hours worth of material. The lectures were also super long. The research paper was easy enough and the quizzes were not too bad if you read and watched the videos but you need multiple hours to dedicate to reading, watching videos, and watching lectures.

Dr. Douglas does is passionate about what she teaches but assigns absurd amounts of weekly readings and videos. It would take hours upon hours just to read everything she says you're supposed to for the class. She has a TA and only has to grade 3 discussion posts and one final paper yet she hasn't graded the discussion posts yet.

Great prof. Made online lectures interesting. Fair quizzes. Paper for final. Tri-weekly discussions, which were time consuming and kind of annoying, but tolerable given that they were only tri-weekly. Class counts for two GEs, so I'd definitely recommend it! Also lots of extra credit points available.

Dr. Douglas is super nice and understanding if you need any help, extensions, etc. Her online classes seem to mostly be just an hour long lecture then a quiz every week. Every once in a while there's a discussion post which can be a little harder, but it's not bad. It's a very manageable workload!

First few weeks are MUCH harder than the rest. After that 3rd week, the workload (textbook readings) lightens significantly. Graded based on weekly quizzes and biweekly discussion boards; easy and accessible extra credit as well. Great and informative class to take, imo.

I took her class over the summer, and while I didn't do the best, she was very understanding when I asked. The course has a YouTube playlist each week of the lectures, along with an assigned section of the textbook (which is a pdf through Carmen). The lectures are long, anywhere from an hour to 4 hours. Space out your watch time to make it easier.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Douglas was overall great, this was a 6 week condensed course, so lectures were extremely long, 4 hours, not taking into account additional videos or the reading material. During a normal academic term the work load would be manageable. Make sure you complete every assignment as missing 1 forum post can take you from an A to a low B.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Time-consuming class but Dr. Douglas is passionate about what she teaches and helps you learn a lot of interesting things. Follow her assignment guidelines and you will do fine. Readings are long but you can just read enough to get an idea and then skim for supporting info. If you have issues just email her and she's always happy to help you.

Professor Douglas is one of the best lecturers I have ever had. Lectures are long (1 1/2-3 hrs.), but they are interesting and she conveys the material very clearly. The only thing to watch out for, other than the lecture length, is that she will set due dates for papers on Saturday nights. Regardess,l if you have the chance, take this class.

Very very unclear grading criteria and probably the toughest grader Ive ever had in my 2 years in college thus far. If you see this class I HIGHLY recommend avoiding it if youre looking for an easy quarter class!!!

Dr. Douglas did a fine job teaching the content, however bulky it was. The main fault with her grading is that it is dogmatic. She establishes clear rules for what good writing is, and, upon a violation of her Bible of writing, she psychoanalyzes the cause of why you write differently. Maybe historians have the illusion of objectivity? Not sure.

This was the easiest class I've taken through 2 years. One quiz every week and 5 papers that were only 500 words. We also had the opportunity to fill out a 2 minute survey about ourselves and get 10 bonus points. Very easy class.

4 week summer course, 750-word+ discussion, three comments, and a quiz every week, quiz has two attempts but only shows you the ones you got right after the first attempt so do well the first time, easy A if you can keep up
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--So many papers

reviews.comment: Dr. Douglas is very passionate about what she does and I actually learned a lot from her class. Wrote like 6 papers and had weekly quizzes but they were not that hard, just be good at thinking broadly about topics. She was flexible with me when I had a deadline issue and you can tell that she enjoys what she teaches about. She's cool!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--So many papers

reviews.comment: If you need a history credit, take history 1212. the easiest class i have ever taken. a quiz a week (with 2 tries and it shows you the ones you got wrong) and a discussion post as the "tests" which are also easy if you watch lectures and find some quotes from the book. so so so easy could not recommend it enough. you can also learn a thing or two

I took this over the summer. 2 discussions 4 quizzes. You need the book to find the answers for the quizzes but I didn't actually read assigned chapters. 65 points available for extra credit. Two chances to take the quizzes. If you want an easy A pick this class.

Prof Douglas is great. History is far from my favorite subject, and I only took 1212 to fulfill a history GE, but I am glad I took it with her. She is extremely understanding if something happens, and the criteria for grading in this class is clear. She works with students to help them learn and achieve. I would take more classes with her! Easy A.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: Clear expectations, weekly assignments, lots of extra credit available. The workload was pretty typical for an online class so it was an easy way to take care of a GE.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Typical week consists of watching videos, reading excerpts from a text, then writing a discussion post. These aren't very difficult, but they can be time consuming. There's also a book dissection at the end of the course, so beware of that
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--So many papers

reviews.comment: This is the second class I've taken with Prof. Douglas and I would definitely take more. Interesting topic and I really liked the way that the course was laid out. Mostly discussion board based. Gave us the week off for Thanksgiving. Very understanding when I turned in a paper 30 min late due to a computer issue.

Super nice professor and a very straight-forward class. We had a discussion post every week, a break for thanksgiving, and book dissections to write on the 4th and 8th week of class. Very easy and goes by super quickly. I hate history but I loved this class and actually learned a lot. Very willing to help too.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Readings and Videos for course are excellent. TA's grade tough, but fair. The whole course is a great lesson on how to read information and articulate what you learned. If you work hard you'll do fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I'm not a history buff but everything was easy to understand
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Way too much work for a second-session online class
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: This class was a lot of work in 6 weeks, but I feel like I learned a lot. There were papers on two (complete) books along with weekly reading and writing, so if you don't like a lot of reading and/or writing, Prof Douglas is not for you. Along with the readings, she includes video playlists to take the place of a lecture, which I liked.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--SO MANY PAPERS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Not enough room to explain. Far too much work for a 3k level class. 5 papers (5-7 pages) based on 400-700 page books that you have three weeks to read and write. On top of reading for these, readings are assigned weekly for discussion. Discussion 600 words and you better cite everything or she will report you. I beg you to take someone else.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Fair criteria and interesting topic
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Be prepared to work because online classes are tough. That said, the prof was nice and helpful when I had question, the class was interesting, and I learned a lot. A solid class overall.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: The class was a second session course, so she expected to get two weeks of material done in one week. While doing this you are expected to spend a majority of your week, reading and writing for her. Her TAs are also the harshest graders Ive ever had.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: It's an online class so there's lots of work but I enjoyed it overall. It's different than an in-class course but I learned a lot and I would take a class with her again.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Way too much work for the course level. Tough graders (her and TAs.) Weekly discussion posts are extremely formal- never had a professor take discussion posts so seriously.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: There is a ton of work in this class but Ive learned a lot and the prof is very helpful. Ive had family issues this semester and shes been more than willing to help me out and give extensions if I need them. Any mention of her being too hard is exaggerated and unfair, honestly. Id take her classes again any time.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: very passionate about the subjects she teaches, learned a lot from her, little bit arrogant when it comes to knowing facts or when people question something she said, but she's nice enough. gave us 20 bonus points on a test for voting in the election, so that helps. not many hw assignments, so gotta do well on exams, all essay exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: She's great. Loved her class. I hear people complain about workload but I really didn't find it bad at all. I also felt like I learned more from this class given the amount of work I did, compared to any other History class I've taken. If you have the choice, take Dr. Douglas.

Her class has 5 book dissections/reports, heavy reading, discussion boards with foot citations. Very tough grader. Not an easy A at all. Even if you think you're working hard, you have to work harder. Power points are nothing but her just speaking.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Took class online as an 8/10 week course. SO MUCH READING. Entire semester's worth of work in half the time. Professor is nice and communicates well. My advice: skim through weekly textbook readings (especially beginning and ending of chapters) and research topic independently and then write response--saves SO much time--TAs grade easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--SO MANY PAPERS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Douglas is one of the best. She clearly conveys expectations, the deadlines are clear, and her lectures are fantastic. She knows what she is talking about and I personally enjoyed her fun fact type stories she included. She will go out of her way to help you,but she is NOT a pushover. Don't mistake her kindness for an easy A, you must work.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational

reviews.comment: Super helpful professor. Definitely need to attend lectures if you don't have the textbook, because her lectures are all notes and the powerpoints only have pictures on them. Willing to work with you and really, really kind if you pay attention and participate.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Great great professor. She teaches a bunch of different history classes at osu but I had her for 3500. She makes lecture interesting. Biggest tips would be to show up and do some course readings. Her teaching style is powerpoints that go with lecture, lots of neat history thrown in with lecture too on the side. Be willing to work and you're fine
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: She's great.  She understands how to relate what could easily be boring material to students.  I enjoyed her class.

Easy to work with.  Do the Carmen readings and show up to lecture (attendance is graded and her powerpoints don't have any words on them, just pics). Don't buy the book. She's really knowledgeable and nice, although a bit intimidating the first week or two.
